postings.title: Senior AI Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are.

Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. We have some of the industry's most prominent and storied go-to-market brands, including Bluehost, HostGator, Domain.com, Network Solutions, Register.com and Web.com. We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a hands on Senior Applied AI Engineer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical AI problem solving. You will help build production AI experiences across Network Solutions, including conversational agents, business and website creation, knowledge and FAQ agents, content experiences, domain discovery, and intelligent automation.

You will work with senior engineers, architects, and product partners to turn customer and product problems into reliable, secure, observable, and cost efficient AI systems. This is an applied engineering role focused on building, measuring, and continuously improving real AI products.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark

• Translate product requirements into practical AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, tool calling, agents, deterministic workflows, or traditional software where appropriate.

• Build production AI services using Python, FastAPI, asynchronous workers, PostgreSQL, Redis, queues, model APIs, and external tools.

• Implement reliable tool calling agents and multi step workflows that interact with internal APIs, MCP tools, business systems, and knowledge sources.

• Build event driven workflows using RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent platforms, including retries, dead letter handling, idempotency, and failure recovery.

• Build and improve RAG systems covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, context construction, and citations.

• Integrate models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and open weight ecosystems, and help select models based on quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

• Build and run AI evaluations using curated datasets, regression tests, retrieval metrics, LLM as judge techniques, groundedness checks, and tool execution evaluation.

• Debug hallucinations, retrieval failures, incorrect tool usage, agent loops, latency issues, provider failures, and unexpected inference costs.

• Operate as an AI powered engineer using Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent coding agents to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed

• 5 or more years of professional software engineering experience building production backend, distributed, or cloud based systems.

• At least 1 year of hands on experience building Applied AI, LLM, RAG, NLP, or agent based applications, with production experience strongly preferred.

• Strong Python skills including FastAPI, asynchronous programming, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy or SQLModel, and production API development.

• Good backend and distributed systems fundamentals including REST APIs, concurrency, background processing, caching, reliability, and production debugging.

• Hands on experience with RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent queue and messaging architectures is required.

• Hands on experience integrating LLM APIs and building structured output, function calling, tool calling, or agent execution workflows.

• Experience building or contributing to a RAG or knowledge grounded system, including retrieval, embeddings, indexing, context construction, and evaluation.

• Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and data modeling, with exposure to Redis, pgvector, vector databases, or hybrid search technologies.

• Demonstrated use of AI coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools as a regular part of software engineering work.

Nice to have.

• You should be comfortable going beyond a working demo and understand the core engineering patterns needed to make AI systems reliable in production.

• Understanding of prompting, structured outputs, tool schemas, context management, retries, fallbacks, rate limits, caching, and streaming responses.

• Ability to use experiments and evaluations to compare approaches using measurable outcomes rather than subjective testing alone.

• Understanding of retrieval quality, grounding, hallucination mitigation, prompt injection risks, tool authorization, and practical agent guardrails.

• Experience with Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, observability, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar tooling.

How You’ll Work

• You will often receive a product goal or technical direction rather than a fully specified implementation.

• You should be able to break the problem into manageable pieces, validate assumptions, implement the solution, and work with senior engineers when architecture tradeoffs require discussion.

• Turn product goals into testable technical tasks and prototype alternatives when the best approach is not obvious.

• Choose simple, maintainable solutions and avoid using an agent or LLM when a deterministic approach solves the problem better.

• Measure quality, latency, reliability, safety, and cost and use those signals to improve the solution over time.

• Own implementation across APIs, workflows, data, queues, model integration, evaluations, observability, and production support for assigned features.

• Use AI coding agents aggressively to increase engineering velocity while preserving testing discipline, security, maintainability, and code quality.

What Will Make You Stand Out

• Experience with Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, PydanticAI, or equivalent agent frameworks.

• Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol tools and servers, or working with model gateways such as LiteLLM.

• Experience with Azure AI Search, pgvector, Chroma, Kubernetes, Azure, OCI, or similar production AI platform technologies.

• Experience contributing to customer facing AI products, open weight model inference, AI safety controls, automated evaluations, or high scale backend platforms.

• Curiosity, strong problem solving, solid software engineering fundamentals, and the ability to learn quickly and turn ideas into reliable production features are the foundation for this role.

Join us to build the agent-powered backbone of our AI platform—robust, model agnostic, and ready for millions of users.

This Job Description includes the essential job functions required to perform the job described above, as well as additional duties and responsibilities. This Job Description is not an exhaustive list of all functions that the employee performing this job may be required to perform. The Company reserves the right to revise the Job Description at any time, and to require the employee to perform functions in addition to those listed above.

postings.title: Lead Software Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
BUILD SOMETHING BIGGER THAN YOURSELF

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. 

How you will contribute to our magical experience?:

Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment & ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, and the engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity.

This team is responsible for building the tools used by our operator teams to perform quality control (QC) across highly visible live and video-on-demand media workflows, implementing playback features, and ensuring seamless integration with operator tooling. These solutions enable operators to efficiently monitor content and deliver the highest-quality experience to our customers.

The Lead Software Engineer Will Be Responsible For

• Own the architecture of our shared player library. The contract between our player internals and the Disney teams that consume it. You decide its API surface, its versioning strategy, and how it evolves without breaking consumers.

• Lead the layering work already in flight. Moving streaming-protocol concerns out of the player and behind a clean API.

• Design the hooks and data APIs that let consuming teams build their own control layouts, rather than shipping them our UI.

• Implement and maintain features on the QC player stack used daily by our operator teams.

• Establish the engineering standards for the team: test coverage, code and design review, and how we decide what belongs in which layer.

• Work directly with QC operators to turn observed pain into product-shaped requirements.

• Lead deployment quality and stability strategy, including testing approach and player telemetry/RUM.

• Provide technical expertise and mentoring to the engineers on the team, and raise the bar through review.

• Unblock issues that are blocking the testing and release of content to our customers.

• Provide on-call rotational support as needed.

What we need from you to be part of this story:

• 5+ years of experience building and delivering production-grade software applications.

• Advanced level of English.

• Hands-on coding. You will implement and debug in an unfamiliar codebase.

• Concrete system design. Handed an unfamiliar problem, you get down to the actual interfaces, interactions, and responsibilities.

• A track record of technical ownership as an engineer. You have set the direction of a system yourself and held that bar over time, through your own code and design review rather than by managing the people who did it.

• Communication and mentoring. You explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and to non-engineering partners, and you measurably level up the people around you.

• Strong React 18+ and TypeScript.

• Experience integrating media players into web applications.

• Solid grasp of async programming models (events, callbacks, promises, async/await) and concurrency.

• Experience designing or maintaining a library/package consumed by other teams (versioning, backward compatibility, breaking-change management).

• Source control, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub; comfort with containerized build and deploy tooling.

• Problem-solving skills to identify the root cause.

Additional Information

At Disney, we believe it takes great people to create the memorable experiences, products and services our consumers know and love. We are a team of storytellers and hire under equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability and gender identity. We foster a corporate culture of belonging and inclusiveness, which empowers our staff and company to thrive. At Disney, everyone has the opportunity to speak up and participate, grow and share ideas.

“You can design and create, and build the most wonderful place in the world. But it takes people to make the dream a reality.” Walt Disney

Disclaimer

This position is with TWDC Argentina S.A., which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology.

To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here.

Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help.

postings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Software Engineer - Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms

• ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

• ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

• ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

• High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

• Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

• AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

• Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

• Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

• Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

• Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

• Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

• Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

• Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

This role is remote, so it can be executed globally.

About The Role

You’ll use your creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to design tailored solutions that make a real impact.

Embedded with our most strategic customers, you’ll get a front-row seat to some of our highest-stakes projects. From brainstorming technical architectures and product features to building full-scale integrations, you’ll take full ownership of complex, high-impact challenges—helping clients achieve their goals and push the limits of what’s possible.

What you will do

• Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.

• Collaborate daily with our customer’s engineers and executives teams to ensure the best use of ElevenLabs’ technologies.

• Drive real innovation by using your coding and technical skills to solve complex problems, making a real difference for our customers.

Requirements

• Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity

• Proficiency in Python and strong software development knowledge, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and APIs integration.

• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical knowledge and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.

Location

• This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Argentina, with a preference of Buenos Aires. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and Spanish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

postings.title: Senior Blockchain Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Remitee , a fast-growing fintech specialized in international payments, is looking for a Senior Blockchain Engineer to join our Technology team.

Our Blockchain team is building the on-chain infrastructure behind Remitee's treasury and cross-border settlement: stablecoin liquidity flows, tokenized balances and on-chain accounting that reconciles with our core ledger. In this role you will design, write, test and ship smart contracts and the backend services that interact with them, running in production and moving real value for our Treasury team and our banking and payment partners. You will own technical decisions end-to-end, from contract architecture and security to custody integration, gas management and monitoring.

We are looking for a developer who has already taken blockchain products to mainnet, not just tutorials or hackathon projects, and who understands what it takes to operate them safely in a regulated financial environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, test and deploy Solidity smart contracts on EVM networks, including token contracts (ERC-20 and custom token logic), access control and upgradeable patterns.

• Build and maintain the backend services that interact with the chain: transaction submission, nonce and gas management, event indexing and reconciliation against our internal ledger.

• Integrate with digital asset custody and wallet infrastructure (MPC wallets, policy engines, transaction signing workflows).

• Implement stablecoin flows (e.g. USDC) for funding, settlement and liquidity across corridors, including on/off-ramp and cross-chain integrations (e.g. Circle CCTP or bridge protocols).

• Own smart contract security: threat modeling, comprehensive test suites, fuzzing and static analysis, and coordination with external auditors.

• Evaluate and benchmark EVM networks (L1s and L2s) considering finality, cost, tooling, custody support and liquidity.

• Set up observability for on-chain components: monitoring and alerting on failed or stuck transactions, balance thresholds and contract events.

• Take part in architecture decisions and translate requirements from Treasury, Finance and Compliance into robust technical designs.

• Review code, mentor other engineers and help define development standards, CI/CD and deployment processes for on-chain components.

• Use AI tools to accelerate development, testing and documentation.

Must Have

• 5+ years of software development experience, with at least 2 years building blockchain products.

• Proven track record shipping smart contracts to mainnet that are (or were) used in production with real value at stake.

• Strong proficiency in Solidity and deep understanding of the EVM: gas optimization, storage layout, upgradeability patterns (proxies) and common vulnerabilities (reentrancy, access control flaws, oracle manipulation, etc.).

• Hands-on experience with modern development frameworks such as Foundry and/or Hardhat, and libraries such as ethers.js, viem or web3.js.

• Solid backend development skills in at least one language such as TypeScript/Node.js, C#/.NET, Go or Python, including APIs and asynchronous services.

• Experience with wallets, key management and the full transaction lifecycle (signing, broadcasting, confirmations, reorgs).

• Hands-on experience with ERC-20 tokens and stablecoins.

• Experience with Git, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.

• Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics or related fields.

• Advanced English.

Nice to Have

• Background in fintech, payments, banking or treasury operations (liquidity management, prefunding, reconciliation).

• Experience with institutional custody providers (e.g. Fireblocks) or MPC wallet infrastructure.

• Experience with cross-chain messaging and bridges (CCTP, LayerZero, Wormhole, Axelar or similar).

• Experience with smart contract security tooling (Slither, Echidna, Mythril) or participation in audits and bug bounties.

• Experience running nodes, working with RPC providers and building indexers (The Graph or custom).

• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (Azure, Kubernetes) and containerized deployments.

• Knowledge of crypto-asset regulation (e.g. MiCA) and KYC/AML in regulated environments.

• Public GitHub, open-source contributions or audited contracts you can share.

About Remitee

Remitee is an international, expanding organization with a vibrant culture that sets us apart. Our work environment is fast-paced and stimulating, offering numerous opportunities for growth and development. If you're a self-starter who thrives in a collaborative and challenging environment, we encourage you to apply. Our company values are fundamental to our daily operations. To succeed here, you'll need to embrace and live our company values.

• We build trust (Integrity and Transparency).

We inspire through example, fulfilling promises, and communicating sincerely.

• We embrace diversity (Respect and Empathy).

We listen and connect, valuing diverse perspectives. We recognize achievements and efforts.

• We trust in the synergy that emerges from effort and collaboration (Teamwork).

We forge authentic bonds through offering opportunities and sharing responsibilities.

• We focus on what is essential (Simplicity).

We simplify complexity, constructing effective solutions. We promote simple and accessible communication

• We create our best version (Excellence).

We act with discipline and perseverance, taking care of our physical and mental well-being. We live with passion and purpose in everything we do

Description

TuxCare offers a comprehensive portfolio of security solutions for Linux and open-source software designed for enterprise organizations. With TuxCare, companies can automate live vulnerability patching, minimize downtime, ensure security and compliance, and rely on a team with deep expertise in Linux security. The solutions cover the most popular Linux distributions, end-of-life systems, programming languages, and more.

Learn more at: https://tuxcare.com/

Product Description

KernelCare provides automated live patching for Linux kernels without requiring reboots. Our Extended Lifecycle Support products keep end-of-life Linux distributions secure by backporting important security and bug fixes to older software versions used by enterprise customers.

Role and Team

We are looking for a Kernel Developer to join the KernelCare ELS Team. The team investigates upstream Linux kernel changes, backports fixes to supported enterprise kernels, builds distribution packages, and validates that patches are safe and reproducible. The role is centered on practical patching and building work. • Investigating upstream security and bug fixes and identifying their dependencies.

• Backporting Linux kernel patches to older RPM- and Debian-based distributions.

• Validating patched kernels through focused tests, build checks, and regression analysis.

• Improving patch preparation, build, and validation workflows with Python, Go, or Shell.

• Using agentic development tools.

• Documenting technical decisions and participating in code review with the kernel team.

• Strong C programming and Linux debugging skills.

• Practical Linux kernel development, patching, or backporting experience.

• Confident use of Git, GNU build tools, and standard Linux development utilities.

• Experience building Linux kernels or distribution packages.

• Automation experience with Python, Go, Shell, or a similar language.

• Some experience with agentic or AI-assisted development and a clear approach to validating generated output.

• English at an intermediate level or higher, both written and spoken.

• Strong ownership, careful technical judgment, and readiness to explain trade-offs.

Nice To Have

• Experience with RPM/SRPM or Debian kernel packaging.

• Security patching, CVE analysis, or extended lifecycle maintenance experience.

• Familiarity with Docker, QEMU, Jenkins, or other CI systems.

• Experience designing kernel tests or investigating core dumps and regressions.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

• A focus on professional development.

• Interesting and challenging projects.

• Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.

• Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.

• Compensation for private medical insurance.

• Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.

• Budget for education.

• The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy ( https://tuxcare.com/privacy-policies-hub/candidate-privacy-notice/ ) , which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handle your data.

postings.title: Sr Fullstack Developer
postings.descriptionText:
Department / Project Description
Join an established, high-performing development team supporting a key client in the healthcare industry. You will play a pivotal role in engineering mission-critical applications that directly impact patient care and healthcare operations, balancing modern cloud initiatives with robust enterprise systems.

Position Overview
We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in .NET and Angular to join our engineering team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end design, development, and deployment of scalable, high-quality applications. You will work across both on-premises infrastructure and Azure cloud environments, driving technical excellence and technical improvements across the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

• End-to-End Development: Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable web applications using Angular on the front end and .NET Core on the back end.

• Architecture & Cloud Integration: Architect and manage application deployments across hybrid environments, including on-premises systems and Microsoft Azure cloud services.

• Collaborative Leadership: Partner closely with developers, solutions architects, product managers, and key client stakeholders to translate business requirements into efficient technical solutions.

• Quality & Engineering Standards: Conduct thorough code reviews, champion best practices in software design, and drive continuous improvement in code quality, security, and performance.

• System Optimization: Identify performance bottlenecks, propose technical enhancements, and modernize legacy components to maintain system reliability and scalability.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Core Technical Stack:

• Back-End: 5+ years of software development experience with .NET Core / .NET 6+ , C#, Web APIs, and microservices architecture.

• Front-End: Solid hands-on experience with modern Angular (v12+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and state management.

• Database: Strong background with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and ORMs (Entity Framework Core).

Cloud & Infrastructure:

• Hands-on experience developing and deploying applications on Microsoft Azure (App Services, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Blob Storage).

• Experience with hybrid deployment models ( On-Premises integration and cloud migrations).

Engineering Best Practices:

• Proficiency with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), automated testing frameworks, and version control (Git).

• Practical understanding of SOLID principles, Design Patterns, and Clean Architecture.

Domain & Soft Skills:

postings.title: Systems Architect and Full-stack Engineer (Remote Latam)
postings.descriptionText:
This is an architecture role that writes code, not a coding role that occasionally diagrams.

The hard problems here are not framework problems. There are questions like

What is the right abstraction for behavior that must stay identical across brands with wildly different experiences?

Where does a system have to be deterministic and reproducible, and where can human judgment live?

What belongs in a shared contract versus a local implementation?

How do you make a system's invariants checkable rather than aspirational?

We need someone who thinks in systems and concepts first, and who can then build the thing. Specifically

System architecture and concept design

Define service boundaries, data models, and contracts between components

Design seams that let the same code run locally and hosted without a rewrite

Turn fuzzy capabilities into clear models of core entities and rules

Apply MIT concept design methodologies to agentic system design

Design abstractions that keep behavior consistent across brands with very different experiences

Decide where systems must be deterministic and where human judgment can apply

Make architecture decisions alongside founders with product and engineering backgrounds

Verification and documentation

Plan up front how each system will prove its correctness, rather than retrofitting tests

Make system invariants checkable through code and tests

Write specifications, decision records, and product invariants in RFC 2119 language

Agent-driven development

Direct AI agents to build features and review their output in depth before merging

Write specs that agents can execute and reviewers can check

Maintain agent instructions and skills as first-class artifacts

Run independent adversarial reviews before opening pull requests

Catch plausible but wrong results (e.g. silent safety gates, empty version pins, hollow dependency directories)

Requisitos

Must-haves

• 8+ years of software development experience

• Proficiency with TypeScript

• Proficiency with Python

• Experience directing AI coding agents with rigorous review and verification practices

• Experience building component-driven front-ends and data-heavy internal consoles

• Experience with Postgres, including migrations, indexing, and query performance diagnosis

• Experience with containers and production deployments

• Experience with monorepos and multi-repos (e.g., workspaces, shared packages, versioned internal contracts)

• Experience building CI/CD pipelines (e.g., merge gates, reproducible builds, release and rollback, environment parity)

• Experience owning system architecture decisions in production

• Experience implementing protocols against specifications and building the conformance tests

• Experience with messaging APIs (e.g., carrier, WhatsApp, chat)

• Experience in instrumenting systems and reading traces for observability

• Ability to become productive with unfamiliar frameworks within a day

• Ability to hand-code and deeply review AI-generated code

• Deep understanding of typed schemas as a single source of truth, generated clients, and centralized validation

• Deep understanding of UX quality for pixel-perfect feature execution

• Interest in cutting-edge technologies and proposing new ideas for internal tools

• Strong communication skills in both spoken and written English

Nice-to-haves

• Startup experience

• Experience with business messaging platforms in production (e.g., Apple Messages for Business, RCS Business Messaging, WhatsApp Cloud API)

• Experience with Rust, Swift

• Experience with iOS or Android device automation, or computer vision applied to testing

• Experience designing certification, audit, or compliance systems

postings.title: AI Efficiency, Innovation & Automation Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
General Summary

Sony Pictures Entertainment is seeking a hands-on, technically strong AI Automation & Innovation Analyst to join the LATAM Data Analytics & Business Insights team, based in Bogota, Colombia or Buenos Aires, Argentina.

Reporting into the Head of Data Analytics, this role will work closely with Analytics and Data Science team members and collaborate with stakeholders across all business lines to identify, design, build, and operationalize applied AI, automation, and data-driven solutions that improve efficiency, innovation, and decision-making.

The role requires a practical full-stack profile capable of translating business needs into working prototypes, internal tools, dashboards, automations, and AI-enabled workflows. The analyst will connect front-end interfaces, backend logic, APIs, workflow automation, and AWS-based data warehouse assets to deliver functional end-to-end solutions.

This position will work directly with the company’s data ecosystem, including hands-on querying, data preparation, integration, and application development using trusted AWS-based data assets. The analyst will also coordinate with Sony Cloud Operations, DevOps, Information Security, and technology governance teams to support deployment readiness, infrastructure alignment, access controls, documentation, security reviews, and compliance with internal technology standards.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical execution, business curiosity, agility, and a practical innovation mindset. This is an individual contributor role.

Responsibilities

AI-Enabled Automation & Efficiency

Develop and implement automation solutions that streamline repetitive, manual, or time-consuming business processes. Build AI-enabled workflows using Python, APIs, workflow automation tools, approved generative AI capabilities, and cloud-based data assets to improve productivity, speed, consistency, and decision-making.

Full-Stack Solution Development

Design and build end-to-end solutions, including data ingestion, backend logic, APIs, user interfaces, dashboards, lightweight web applications, internal tools, and deployment-ready prototypes.

AWS Data Warehouse & Data Integration

Work hands-on with the company’s AWS-based data warehouse to query, transform, integrate, and prepare data for AI, automation, and business-facing solutions. Develop reusable SQL queries, data extracts, backend logic, and data workflows that connect internal data sources with applications, dashboards, automations, and AI tools.

Analytics & Data Science Collaboration

Partner with Analytics and Data Science teams to understand analytical assets, predictive models, business logic, reporting products, and strategic priorities. Support the integration of analytics and model outputs into tools, workflows, dashboards, and AI-enabled solutions.

Cloud, DevOps & Information Security Coordination

Coordinate with Sony Cloud Operations, DevOps, Information Security, and technology governance teams to support the approval, deployment, and operationalization of AI and automation solutions. Prepare technical documentation, solution diagrams, access requirements, data flow descriptions, and deployment information for internal reviews.

Applied AI Innovation

Identify and apply practical AI techniques to solve concrete business problems, with emphasis on usability, speed, and measurable business value. Experiment with emerging AI capabilities, including generative AI, natural language interfaces, document intelligence, semantic search, summarization, classification, recommendation support, and AI-assisted content workflows. Stay connected with external vendors, technology partners, startups, and innovation ecosystems to bring relevant AI, automation, and emerging technology advancements into Sony, helping identify opportunities for pilots, proof-of-concepts, and scalable business applications.

Agile Delivery & Documentation

Develop quick prototypes, pilots, and modular solutions that can be tested, refined, approved, and scaled. Document solutions, workflows, assumptions, dependencies, technical requirements, and governance considerations to support adoption, maintenance, and scalability.

Qualifications

Education & Languages

Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative or technical field. Fluent Spanish and English required; Portuguese is a plus.

Experience

2 to 4 years of professional experience in full-stack development, analytics engineering, data automation, AI solution development, data engineering, business intelligence engineering, or related technical roles.

Full-Stack Development

Experience building practical end-to-end solutions involving user interfaces, backend logic, databases, APIs, workflow orchestration, and deployment-ready prototypes. The role does not require enterprise software engineering ownership but does require the ability to build functional, reliable tools that business users can test and adopt.

Programming & Data Skills

Strong proficiency in Python and SQL is required. Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Flask, FastAPI, Streamlit, Dash, or similar frameworks is a strong plus.

AWS Data Warehouse & Cloud Analytics

Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses or modern data platforms, preferably AWS. Experience with AWS services such as Redshift, S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, SageMaker, or related analytics services is a strong plus.

Applied AI & Automation

Working knowledge of generative AI tools, large language models, prompt engineering, document automation, semantic search, embeddings, vector search, RAG architectures, chatbot development, or AI-assisted workflow design.

APIs, Pipelines & Integrations

Experience with APIs, data pipelines, data integration, system connectivity, workflow automation, data quality checks, and scalable analytical workflows. Familiarity with Airflow, AWS Step Functions, Prefect, Dagster, or similar orchestration tools is a plus.

Cloud, DevOps & Governance

Ability to work with Cloud Ops, DevOps, InfoSec, and enterprise technology teams. Familiarity with cloud deployment processes, CI/CD concepts, containerization, access controls, data privacy, and information security review processes is a plus.

Visualization & Business-Facing Outputs

Experience presenting data, automation outputs, AI-assisted results, monitoring metrics, and operational insights through dashboards, reports, custom tools, or Python visualization frameworks.

Industry Experience

Media and entertainment experience is a plus, especially in streaming, production studios, theatrical distribution, TV networks, digital media, social media, marketing analytics, advertising, content distribution, or audience insights.

postings.title: Embedded DSP Firmware Engineer - HW/SW Integration
postings.descriptionText:
Imagine being part of a team that’s redefining the future of mobility—where your ideas don’t just sit in a lab but power next-generation technology. At indie, we are developing cutting-edge semiconductors, photonics, and radar sensors and systems for automotive, industrial, and adjacent markets. Our innovations are at the heart of advanced intelligent sensing and user experience applications, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

If you're passionate about groundbreaking technology and want to make a real impact alongside a fast-paced team that thrives on creativity and collaboration, we’d love to have you on board!

Do you enjoy working in a creative, fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment? With indie Semiconductor, Inc. (Nasdaq: INDI), an Autotech solutions innovator, you'll never walk alone! We place high value on our teams and pursue excellence for our employees and customers!

indie Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in the design of innovative mixed-signal System-on-Chip (SoC) solutions for automotive applications.

Our design team develops custom and standard SoC solutions for automotive applications that integrate advanced digital ICs (Arm® Cortex® MCUs and/or DSP) with mixed-signal devices into a single System-in-Package (SiP). The mixed signal can include power management, RF, high voltage, as well as high-speed converters, allowing us to provide complete solutions to our international customer base.

You will join a small team of highly competent engineers involved in the design, implementation, and verification of firmware for embedded systems targeting automotive driver assistance system (ADAS) applications. You will architect, design, implement, and support firmware modules and sample applications. You will also support the hardware SoC design team’s pre-silicon verification and application engineering group’s customer-facing demonstration platforms. This is an excellent opportunity for a talented and motivated firmware developer to join a growing team of engineers who strive to solve automotive problems.

Job Responsibilities

• Design top-level simulation and FPGA tests from the test plan to ensure correct system-level integration before tape-out

• Collaborate with digital design engineers to integrate software with SoC-specific accelerators, so firmware is ready for silicon bring-up on day 1

• Profile and map neural-network models onto hardware accelerators when required, translating high-level framework metrics into efficient machine code and data flow

• Design, develop, and optimize DSP embedded software for ADAS systems, including DSP techniques, data-path design, and cycle/memory profiling

• Support customer-facing activities such as firmware customization and root-cause analysis, together with application engineering

• Use AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude, and other LLMs) to accelerate implementation, test generation, documentation, and debugging

• Contribute to Git-based workflows and CI (build, regression, and bring-up tests)

Job Requirements

These are the skills and know-how an ideal candidate would bring. We understand that nobody is perfect! After all, your new job should challenge you, and you will have the opportunity to grow.

• B.S. in Electronic/Computer Engineering or Computer Science (or equivalent experience)

• 1+ years of embedded firmware experience (or equivalent depth), including bring-up and debugging on real hardware or FPGA

• Deep understanding of computer architecture principles: pipelining, memory hierarchy (caches/MMU), interrupts/exceptions, and ISA-level behavior

• Strong Embedded C and working Assembly for ISRs, exception handlers, and bare-metal driver development

• Solid command of build toolchains and object-file formats (ELF), including linker scripts for memory placement and system initialization

• Familiarity with HW/SW partitioning and mapping of neural-network models onto heterogeneous architectures (CPU/DSP/NPU)

• Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent LLMs) in day-to-day engineering work

• Excellent communication in Spanish and English (written and verbal), with a collaborative mindset for cross-site, team-based development

What Extra Skills Make You Stand Out?

The following skills are not required for the position. If you have experience in any of them, it would be a plus. The goal is to understand candidates' backgrounds and/or strengths.

• Experience with SIMD/VLIW, fixed-point arithmetic, and cycle-accurate profiling

• Hands-on firmware development experience with Cadence Tensilica (Xtensa), ARM Cortex-M/R/A, as well as familiarity with RISC-V (RV32/RV64), including CSRs, interrupt and exception models, toolchains, and ABI conventions

• RTOS experience (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or AUTOSAR OS) in addition to bare-metal

Location: Córdoba City, Córdoba, Argentina

postings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (TypeScript + AI) - Remote - Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

• Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.

• Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.

• Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.

• Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.

• Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Position

Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, find the work that actually warrants AI, architect the system, build it, and make it hold up in the real environment.

This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer . You should be as comfortable pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering as you are debugging why an agent’s tool-calling loop degraded after a context change. The people who succeed here can hold a discovery conversation on Monday and ship what they scoped on Thursday.

On this track, your edge is application engineering: you make agents real inside the client’s actual systems, workflows, and delivery pipelines.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment:

• Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.

• Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.

• Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why.

• Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch.

• Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes.

• Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually.

• Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two.

• Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success.

• Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better.

• Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology.

What You'll Do

• Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business and engineering stakeholders. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Come back with a scoped, defensible point of view.

• Structure the process and the spec. For any business or engineering process being automated, map the current state, decision points, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably.

• Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end — orchestration, context and retrieval architecture, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and the boundaries between deterministic and non-deterministic components.

• Build. Ship working systems — agents, multi-step automations, internal tooling, integration layers. You are hands-on. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware.

• Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build: build, test, release, environments.

• Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of professional software development experience with at least one mainstream production stack (TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, C#/.NET, or Go).

• 1 - 4 years of professional experience building and shipping LLM-powered and agentic AI systems beyond prototypes or demos.

• Advanced English is required.

• Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.

• Hands-on experience with frontier AI developer tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex.

• Proven experience evaluating current-state environments and defining technical roadmaps.

• Demonstrated experience with APIs, service design, event-driven and distributed systems, and data modeling.

• Experience designing and owning CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, release, environments, and deployment processes.

• Strong understanding of context and specification engineering to produce reliable AI output.

• Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including APIs, webhooks, event streams, iPaaS platforms such as n8n or MuleSoft, and MCP.

• Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls, asking "why" before "how" to decompose unstructured business problems.

• Skilled at exercising end-to-end delivery ownership and managing project scope without requiring product manager supervision.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• Forensic attention to detail.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams.

• Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.

• Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Strong Plus

• Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems.

• Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases.

• Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing).

• Pre-sales support: discovery calls, SOW and estimate shaping, technical proposal defense.

• Process mining, operations analysis, or transformation consulting background.

• Client enablement and training — building the client team’s capability, not just the system.

• Prior consulting or agency environment; comfort with ambiguity and multiple accounts.

Work Authorization Requirements

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.

• FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

• Competitive pay.

• 100% remote work.

• The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.

• Continuing education opportunities.

• Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

Buscamos un/a Strategy Specialist con destacada capacidad analítica y pensamiento estructurado, capaz de transformar grandes volúmenes de datos en insights accionables, construir modelos financieros/cuantitativos rigurosos y diseñar presentaciones de alto impacto que sirvan de base para las decisiones estratégicas de la dirección regional.

Tus Responsabilidades

• Análisis del Negocio (Salud y Liquidez del Marketplace)

Run the race of your life

• Entrepreneurial and growth-oriented mindset, thriving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with an iterative development process.

• Highly analytical, data-driven, and capable of working independently and making real-time decisions, with a strong work ethic and a "get-the-job-done" attitude.

Job Description

Join our Counterparty Credit Risk team and help shape how we measure and manage risk across dynamic financial markets. You will enhance stress testing and scenario methodologies, develop analytical tools, and deliver insights that support strong risk decisions. This role combines quantitative problem-solving, data engineering, and close partnership with stakeholders across risk, technology, and the business. If you are curious, hands-on, and motivated by complex challenges, we would like to hear from you.

Job Summary

As a Counterparty Credit Risk Analyst in Counterparty Credit Risk Methodology and Stress Testing, you will design and enhance stress testing frameworks, build quantitative analytics, and automate risk processes to strengthen transparency, controls, and decision-making.

Job responsibilities

• Design, enhance, and maintain counterparty credit risk stress testing methodologies, scenario frameworks, and supporting documentation

• Perform sensitivity analysis, backtesting, and scenario reviews to assess portfolio vulnerabilities and validate methodology performance

• Analyze counterparty exposures and concentration drivers using quantitative models, risk management frameworks, and relevant risk metrics

• Develop Python-based analytics and automation solutions that improve efficiency, control, and data quality across stress testing and monitoring workflows

• Improve risk monitoring transparency through explainable metrics, governance-ready reporting, and well-controlled processes

• Partner with stakeholders across Risk, Quantitative Research, Technology, Credit, and the business to deliver analytical insights and process enhancements

• Prepare regulator- and audit-ready materials, including methodology papers, testing evidence, and governance artifacts

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Financial Engineering, Physics, Engineering, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline

• 3 years of experience in risk management, quantitative analytics, stress testing, or a related area within financial services

• Proficiency in Python and experience building analytics, automation, and data-driven solutions

• Understanding of financial markets and core risk management concepts

• Experience with stress testing, scenario analysis, quantitative risk methodologies, or model validation practices

• Experience creating clear, effective visualizations using tools such as Tableau or Power BI

• Knowledge of artificial intelligence and large language model concepts and practical applications in analytics or risk management

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and a control-minded approach

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• Financial Risk Manager (FRM), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), or equivalent professional certification

• Experience in counterparty credit risk, including derivatives, futures and options, or securities financing transactions

• Experience working with large datasets and modern data platforms

postings.descriptionText:
About The Company

At OneClick Code, we are revolutionizing the roofing and restoration industry through smart automation, data transparency, and instant access to critical building information. Our mission is to empower contractors, adjusters, and insurance professionals with accurate, jurisdiction-specific codes and permit data, instantly, so they can work smarter, not harder.

Founded in 2018, with a vision to eliminate the inefficiencies and guesswork that slow down claims and repairs, OneClick Code has become the go-to platform for accessing trusted roofing codes, manufacturer specifications, tax jurisdiction data, and permit requirements, all in just one click.

We're a fast-growing, venture-backed startup that thrives on innovation, collaboration, and impact. As we scale, we're looking for mission-driven team members who are passionate about using technology to bring clarity and confidence to an often-overlooked corner of the construction world.

The Opportunity

The Senior Data & Analytics Engineer will own the reliability and evolution of the company’s data and analytics infrastructure, including data models, the warehouse, pipelines, integrations, and billing data. This role moves beyond reporting into data modeling, analytics architecture, instrumentation strategy, and cross-functional enablement. The person will independently identify opportunities, translate ambiguous business needs into clear analytics initiatives, and drive those initiatives from definition through implementation and adoption.

This individual will serve as the technical bridge between raw data and business decision-making, leading the design of robust data models, optimizing SaaS metrics, and ensuring accurate tracking across web and native applications. Success in this role requires ownership of both technical quality and business outcomes.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. The person is expected to demonstrate leadership through initiative ownership, sound judgment, proactive communication, and cross-functional influence. People management is not currently a requirement.

Responsibilities

Analytics Architecture & Data Modeling

• Design, build, and maintain scalable analytics data models to support business reporting and decision-making.

• Build, maintain, and troubleshoot ETL/ELT pipelines and data transformations.

• Own source-of-truth definitions and reconcile data across application, billing, and analytics systems.

•

• Own the structure and optimization of SaaS metrics, including subscription lifecycle, billing, churn, retention, LTV, and revenue analytics (Stripe).

• Ensure data integrity, consistency, and governance across systems.

• Monitor data flows and proactively detect, troubleshoot, and recover from pipeline failures or missing data.

• Partner with Engineering to assess the data impact of product releases and prevent breaking changes to collection systems.

Instrumentation & Event Tracking

• Define tracking specifications and lead the auditing and validation of event strategy across web and native applications in partnership with Engineering.

• Partner with engineering and product teams to define, implement, and audit tracking standards.

• Improve reliability and completeness of user event data (Segment, Mixpanel, or similar tools).

Data Analysis & Insights

• Perform advanced analysis using SQL and Python to generate actionable insights.

• Identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities within SaaS performance metrics.

• Translate complex datasets into clear business recommendations for leadership.

Analytics Platform Ownership

• Build and continuously improve the company’s analytics framework and reporting ecosystem.

• Develop dashboards and data visualization assets that provide reliable, self-serve insights for stakeholders.

• Optimize data pipelines and queries for performance and scalability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Lead cross-functional analytics initiatives by aligning Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Finance on the business problem, requirements, KPIs, measurement approach, milestones, and expected outcomes.

• Act as the subject-matter expert in analytics and data interpretation across the organization.

• Proactively surface relevant trends, risks, and opportunities, and provide leadership with clear recommendations and forecasting support.

Initiative Leadership & Ownership

• Independently identify and prioritize analytics opportunities aligned with business needs.

• Lead analytics initiatives from problem definition and stakeholder alignment through implementation, adoption, and measurement of results.

• Establish clear scope, milestones, success criteria, and ownership for assigned initiatives.

• Proactively communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions needed to the manager and relevant stakeholders.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, analytics, or related data-focused roles, preferably in a SaaS environment, including demonstrated ownership of complex cross-functional initiatives.

• Strong proficiency in SQL (advanced querying, modeling, performance optimization).

• Experience using Python for data analysis and automation.

• Experience designing, building, and maintaining databases, data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, and integrations across multiple business systems.

• Experience with cloud data infrastructure; AWS experience is preferred.

• Strong understanding of SaaS metrics (MRR, churn, CAC, LTV, retention cohorts, subscription analytics).

Nice to Have

• Experience with Amplitude or comparable product analytics tools.

• Experience working with SaaS subscription and billing data, including Stripe.

• Experience with data visualization platforms such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.

• Experience partnering with Engineering on instrumentation and data-impacting product releases.

Desired Characteristics

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

• Self-sufficiency and sound judgment.

• Fast learning and adaptability.

• Proactivity and a willingness to identify and solve problems without waiting for detailed direction.

• Demonstrated ability to communicate proactively, manage stakeholder expectations, surface risks and tradeoffs, and translate technical findings into business impact.

• Demonstrated ability to operate effectively with ambiguity, establish direction, and move initiatives forward without requiring detailed day-to-day guidance.

Compensation: USD $5,200–$6,000 per month, based on relevant experience and qualifications.

Benefits

• 15 days of paid time off in your first year, increasing to 20 days in your second year, covering vacation, personal time, and sick leave.

• Paid company-observed U.S. holidays.

• Reimbursement of up to USD $125 per month toward your own medical coverage.

Location: Remote — Latin America. Candidates must be available to work with substantial overlap during standard U.S. Mountain Time business hours.

International consultant Full-Time, 12 months (up to 48 months, subject to eligibility).

postings.title: Performance Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Remote position available for candidates based in La Plata, Bahía Blanca, CABA, Córdoba, Rosario, or Mendoza.

Avature is a large, highly configurable platform serving hundreds of client instances across multitenant environments, running on both on-premise and cloud infrastructure. As a Performance Analyst , you will investigate how that system behaves under real load: why a response time degraded, whether the infrastructure can absorb a planned campaign, where capacity is being wasted, and what a degradation in production is actually telling us. You will be one of the first people engineering turns to when something looks slow, and you will work with development, infrastructure and support teams to get to the root cause and a possible solution.

Your Challenges And Objectives

• Build a working model of our platform: its modules, services, and how they interact under load.

• Investigate performance issues end to end, from a symptom on a dashboard to a root cause in infrastructure, configuration, or code.

• Turn observations into evidence: use statistics to separate a real degradation from noise, and correlation from causation.

• Take on progressively more complex and more ambiguous problems as you grow in the role.

• Improve how we see the system: cross data sources, script your own analyses, automate what you repeat, and maintain the dashboards and tooling the team relies on.

Your Day-to-day Activities

• Investigate performance issues end to end, from a symptom on a dashboard to a root cause in infrastructure, configuration, or code, and hand your findings to the team that owns the fix.

• Analyze response times, throughput, and resource usage across logs, metrics, traces, and profiles, using statistics to separate a real degradation from noise and correlation from causation.

• Act as an entry point for engineering when a performance question appears, triaging it and connecting the right teams.

• Validate planned changes before they reach production: run performance tests with artificial load in dedicated environments, and confirm whether infrastructure and configuration can absorb limit extensions, bulk imports, go-lives, and campaigns.

• Work on capacity and cost efficiency: sizing rules, resource utilization, and where we are over- or under-provisioned.

• Plan preventive measures: take part in post-crisis procedures, learn from what went wrong, and think ahead about preventing issues rather than only diagnosing them.

About You

• You have a background in STEM, or equivalent practical experience.

• You are comfortable with statistics: distributions, percentiles, variance, correlation, and the difference between a real signal and noise.

• You have strong analytical skills, you are autonomous and curious, and you enjoy open-ended investigation more than well-defined tasks.

• You can reason about software systems without being a developer: how components interact, where time goes in a request, and what logs, metrics and dashboards tell you about what is actually happening.

• You can read code well enough to follow a call path and understand what it does.

• Intermediate oral and written English (B1), mainly for internal communication.

• Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day work and genuinely interested in staying up to date with emerging AI capabilities.

About Us

Avature is a market-leading enterprise SaaS provider for global talent acquisition and talent management. We have a strong commitment to high-quality engineering and customer service and are recognized innovators in the large enterprise market. Leading organizations around the world rely on Avature, including Fortune 500 companies, global consulting firms, some of the world's largest banks and manufacturers, and government organizations.

We design, build, implement, and support our product ourselves. With a strong culture of ownership and innovation, we continuously evolve our platform to help organizations meet the changing demands of talent acquisition and talent management. As technology continues to reshape the world of work, we leverage AI and emerging technologies to help organizations innovate, adapt, and gain competitive advantage.

At Avature, we value opportunities to learn and grow within a dynamic, creative, and collaborative environment. We encourage autonomy and empower our people to approach challenges innovatively while bringing their unique perspective to the table. We believe curiosity, continuous learning, and openness to emerging technologies are essential to building the future. Through our career development programs, mentorship, and leadership opportunities, we support each person's professional growth while making a meaningful impact on our product and our customers' success.

What We Offer

• A fast-paced, energetic, and engaging environment.

• We combine flexible remote work with in-person collaboration, encouraging team members to spend one day a week at their nearest office. We have workplaces in Buenos Aires (Palermo, La Plata and Bahía Blanca), Rosario, Mendoza and Córdoba.

postings.title: FBS FP&A Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Our Client is one of the United States' largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.

What to expect on your journey with us:

A solid and innovative company with a strong market presence

A dynamic, diverse, and multicultural work environment

Leaders with deep market knowledge and strategic vision

We are seeking an FP&A Specialist to drive financial planning, forecasting, and business performance analysis across multiple insurance portfolios. This role partners closely with senior stakeholders, including the CFO, to deliver strategic insights, develop financial models, and support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Job Summary

You will play a pivotal role in FP&A team, with cross-functional reach into Actuarial, Product, Distribution, and Commercial areas. Your remit will extend beyond standard planning cycles, encompassing the creation of financial models, performance analytics, and strategic advisory. You'll work closely with senior stakeholders, including the CFO, and be a key driver in shaping financial strategy across various insurance portfolios. You'll partner with business owners to assess strategic initiatives and translate technical analysis into executive insights, and you'll contribute to planning/forecast cycles with high autonomy and conceptual thinking, delivering frameworks for emerging topics.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role requiring a hands-on approach, strong ownership, and the ability to independently deliver financial insights that influence strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop customized financial models to support planning, forecasting, product development, and distribution analytics

• Analyze sales funnels, lapse curves, persistency, pricing structures, and loss performance across diverse entities and insurance lines

• Lead forecasting and performance tracking with high technical precision and business alignment

• Validate and present key findings to senior leadership, influencing financial decision-making and business strategy

• Ensure timely and accurate delivery of management reports, dashboards, and presentations

• Interface with cross-functional teams across Finance, Actuarial, Product, and Sales to align data and insights with organizational goals

• Own the control and sign-off processes for financial modeling assumptions and reporting frameworks

• Prepare and present management reports and executive decks, including CFO and governance forums

• Maintain control, validation and sign-off processes ensuring data accuracy and reporting relevance

Critical Skills

Financial Modeling - Advanced

Forecasting/Planning/Business Case Modeling - Advanced

Software / Tool Skills

AI tools to build advanced scenario modeling - Entry Level

Excel - Advanced

Insurance industry metrics - Advanced

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in FP&A or a comparable analytical finance role within the insurance industry, with hands-on experience in financial modeling, forecasting, performance management, and executive-level reporting

• Insurance industry experience is required

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Actuarial Science, Engineering, Finance or related field

• Fluency in English

• Availability to work according to Pacific Standard time zone (PST)

Benefits

• Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses

• Comprehensive benefits package

• Career development and training opportunities

• Flexible work arrangements (remote)

• Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group

• Private Health and Dental Insurance

• Pension Plan

• Meals tickets

• Life Insurance

By applying for this position, candidates acknowledge and agree that:

• Personal Data Processing: The personal data provided during the recruitment and selection process will be collected, processed, and retained for legitimate recruitment and compliance purposes, in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy laws and FBS internal policies

• Legal Authorization to Work: Employment with FBS is conditional upon the candidate having valid, local legal authorization to work in the country where the role is based at the time of hire. FBS does not sponsor or obtain work authorization unless explicitly stated

• Exclusivity of Employment and Conflict of Interest: Upon acceptance of an offer and during employment with FBS, employees will not be permitted to engage in parallel employment, professional activities, or paid work for other entities. Any ownership, partnership, directorship, or participation in other businesses or companies must be fully disclosed and formally reviewed in accordance with FBS internal conflict‑of‑interest and external engagement policies prior to the start date or as soon as such circumstances arise

Failure to comply with these conditions may impact the hiring decision or employment continuation.

postings.title: Growth & Strategy Leader | AI & Automation
postings.descriptionText:
Somos una AI-first EdTech con base en Europa . Buscamos una persona ambiciosa, resolutiva y MUY manija para sumarse a la mesa chica de nuestra startup de más de 100 personas creciendo +80% YoY, con un equipo 70% europeo .

Vas a trabajar directamente con los founders y junto a personas que estudiaron en MIT, Oxford, ETH, San Andrés, ITBA, UTN, Di Tella y UNSAM. Queremos alguien que se involucre, encuentre oportunidades y se haga cargo de llevarlas adelante.

Antes de seguir:

• Es exigente. Jornadas largas, presencial en Palermo y con dedicación exclusiva (sin otro trabajo ni proyectos paralelos). Resignás equilibrio a cambio de crecimiento acelerado y ownership real. Si no es lo que buscás hoy, está perfecto, pero no es para vos.

• Acá no vas a recibir un paso a paso. Vas a encontrar problemas abiertos: esperamos que hagas preguntas, investigues y propongas cómo resolverlos.

• Necesitás experiencia práctica con AI: haberla usado para construir algo, mejorar un proceso o resolver un problema concreto.

• Excellent spoken and written English is essential: vas a trabajar diariamente con un equipo internacional.

Te seguimos contando en inglés.

THE ROLE
During your first week, you’ll sit down with all three founders to discuss your interests, strengths and the opportunities we see in the business. Together, we’ll identify an initial project for you to own across sales, marketing, growth or operations.

You’ll take it from diagnosis to results: understand the problem, analyze the data, test a solution, implement it and measure its impact.

Recent examples from our team:

• Facundo - Growth & Business Strategy: took ownership of paid acquisition, funnel experiments and upsell initiatives, managing the whole advertising budget.

• Mateo - AI Sales Manager: took ownership of the whole sales funnel covering 50+ sales reps within 3 months driving AI initiatives to increase end-to-end lead conversion and reduce manual operations.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Business judgment: you break down messy problems, prioritize and identify what matters.

• Execution: you can show something you built, improved or grew.

• AI-native mindset: AI is already part of how you work, and you validate its outputs.

• Ownership: you take initiative and follow through without constant supervision.

This role typically suits someone with 0-3 years of experience . We welcome backgrounds in business, economics, marketing, engineering and data.

Coding, API and automation experience are nice to have, not requirements. What matters is your ability to use AI to solve business problems and deliver results.

WHAT WE OFFER

• Founder-like ownership and responsibility. Involvement in key business decisions and rapid growth.

• EUR 2,500/month during an initial six-month period.

• EUR 6,000-9,000 sign-on bonus if we continue after that period . From there, a long-term package with a clear path to ownership, such as profit share and equity-like participation.

• Company-paid AI tools, including Claude Code and access to leading models.

¿Te ves en este rol? Postulate. Si completás el campo de motivación, ponele onda: contanos qué hiciste, qué te entusiasma de esta oportunidad y qué podrías aportar. Un ejemplo concreto nos dice mucho más que una presentación genérica.
