postings.title: Senior FP&A - Fractional & Advisory
postings.descriptionText:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. Founded in 2023 and backed by a $4 million seed round led by Harlem Capital, MAVI was recently featured in TechCrunch.

Our professionals join in-house finance teams in full-time, long-term roles, not short-term projects. The companies we work with range from venture- and PE-backed businesses to public companies and CFO advisory firms, including Athena Club, MotherDuck, and Within.

The work centers on judgment. As AI takes over more transactional accounting, the people who review the output, question it, and own the result matter more than ever. MAVI professionals work alongside US finance leaders, using AI tools to do more and applying the judgment to catch what those tools get wrong. At one client, an AR dashboard now used across the organization was built almost entirely by MAVI talent.

We stay involved throughout, from role alignment and interview preparation to onboarding and long-term career development.

About the role

We’re looking for a strong FP&A professional who enjoys working across different businesses, solving different problems, and partnering directly with founders and CFOs.

In this role, you’ll support multiple high-growth US companies and help them improve forecasting, modeling, cash planning, management reporting, and strategic decision-making.

This is especially suited to someone who enjoys variety, can switch contexts quickly, and is comfortable building trusted relationships with multiple stakeholders.

What you’ll own

• Build and maintain financial models, budgets, and rolling forecasts across multiple companies

• Own or support cash-flow forecasting, working-capital analysis, and scenario planning

• Review monthly performance and explain the key drivers behind variances

• Build management reporting packages, KPI dashboards, and decision-ready analysis

• Work directly with founders, CFOs, and senior business leaders

• Translate different business models into financial assumptions and forecasts

• Manage priorities across multiple companies at the same time

• Help clients improve planning, reporting, and finance processes

• Support strategic decisions around growth, hiring, pricing, investment, and cash management

• Bring structure and clarity to businesses that may still be building out their finance function

Must-haves

• 5+ years of finance experience, with meaningful FP&A or strategic finance exposure

• Strong budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling skills

• True multi-client, portfolio, advisory, or consulting exposure

• Experience working across multiple companies or business units at the same time

• Strong cash-flow and working-capital understanding

• Comfortable working directly with founders, CFOs, or senior leaders

• Strong communication and stakeholder management

• Excellent written and spoken English

Nice to have

• Fractional CFO, outsourced CFO, finance advisory, or consulting background

• Experience with startups, SMBs, or high-growth companies

• SaaS, DTC/eCommerce, CPG, retail, consumer, or marketplace exposure

• Experience building models from scratch

• Process improvement, automation, or finance transformation experience

• Board, investor, or fundraising support experience

Why this role is exciting

You’ll get broader exposure than a traditional in-house FP&A role, work across several business models, and build strong client-facing and strategic finance experience — a great step toward senior advisory, Finance Lead, or Fractional CFO opportunities.

postings.title: Recruitment Marketing Manager (Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
We’re hiring a Recruitment Marketing Manager to attract qualified candidates through social media, paid campaigns, and other channels across Latin America.

About Viva Talent

Viva Talent connects US companies with exceptional Executive Assistants and creates meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America. We’re a globally distributed team of 200+ people across 15+ countries and 3 continents, on a mission to expand real opportunity for women in LATAM.

Why we’re opening this role

We’re opening this role to make candidate generation more consistent as Viva’s hiring needs grow. We need a builder-minded manager who can set up and drive a recruitment marketing strategy, using social media, paid campaigns, and other channels to attract qualified candidates and help us broaden our mission to empower more women in LATAM to access meaningful job opportunities.

Responsibilities

• Lead candidate demand generation: Build and manage a multi-channel strategy to attract candidates, with social media as a core channel.

• Generate candidate leads and applications: Develop campaigns that grow qualified candidate volume and improve results using performance data.

• Own paid campaigns end to end: Identify campaign needs, analyze the audience and opportunity, build and create ads, launch campaigns, measure their impact, and optimize performance.

• Create and coordinate content: Develop original organic social content and coordinate staff- or influencer-generated content initiatives as relevant.

• Build an effective function: Identify the processes, channels, tools, and partner support needed to make candidate generation scalable.

• Start hands-on and grow into leadership: Begin as the sole recruitment marketing contributor, personally developing and running the work. As the function grows, take on people management and lead and new team members.

Requirements

• Marketing management: 3+ years in a marketing manager role, including at least 2 years with people management responsibilities.

• Demand generation and results: Experience building a multi-channel strategy and increasing lead or application volume through campaigns. Use performance data to improve results and connect campaigns to pipeline impact, hires, and post-hire quality. Candidate-generation experience is ideal; customer or user lead generation is transferable (B2C preferred).

• End-to-end paid campaigns: Assess campaign needs and audiences, build and create ads, launch campaigns, analyze impact, and optimize results. Hands-on experience with LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok.

• Organic social content: Create consistent, original content that attracts candidates and encourages them to learn more or apply.

• AI, automation, and systems: Use LLMs, tools such as Zapier or n8n, and vibe-coding tools such as Lovable to improve workflows. CRM experience is relevant. Bring original ideas and make independent creative decisions.

• Communication: C1+ English, with clear, confident, concise written and verbal communication.

Nice to have: Recruitment marketing, Talent Acquisition, employer brand, candidate-generation, or B2C experience; staff- or influencer-generated content experience; Google or AEO experience.

Location
Remote, based in Argentina, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Colombia, Ecuador, or Mexico.

Benefits

• 100% remote work, forever.

• Competitive compensation with increases every six months and performance bonuses.

• Global health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, mental health, and routine care.

• Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.

• Parental leave and flexible support.

• A culture centered around growth, ownership, well-being, and continuous learning.

How we hire

A focused process : application → recruiter screen → skills assessment → hiring-manager interview → final interview. We move quickly and respect your time.

🔎 Important Notice: All Viva communication will come from an @execviva.com email. If you receive messages from unofficial sources (e.g., Instagram, Facebook), please report them to careers@execviva.com. We never request payments or personal information from candidates.

Principales responsabilidades

• Estrategia de marca y crecimiento del negocio: Desarrollar e implementar los planes estratégicos y operativos de las marcas asignadas, definiendo posicionamiento, segmentación, targeting, propuesta de valor y prioridades promocionales para impulsar el crecimiento sostenible, la participación de mercado y la rentabilidad.

• Estrategia y ejecución omnicanal: Transformar la estrategia de marca en campañas y journeys integrados, combinando canales presenciales y digitales, contenido relevante, capacidades CRM e insights de clientes para ofrecer experiencias consistentes, personalizadas y medibles a los profesionales de la salud (HCP).

• Contenido y excelencia promocional: Liderar la planificación de contenidos y la ejecución de campañas en colaboración con equipos multifuncionales y agencias externas, asegurando el desarrollo, la adaptación, la aprobación, el despliegue y la actualización oportuna de los materiales promocionales, de acuerdo con los requisitos regulatorios y las políticas internas.

• Analítica, desempeño comercial y forecasting: Analizar resultados de ventas, participación de mercado, tendencias competitivas, efectividad promocional, presupuestos y retorno de inversión (ROI). Generar insights accionables, desarrollar forecasts y contribuir a la planificación de demanda para respaldar decisiones comerciales y favorecer la disponibilidad de producto.

• Liderazgo e influencia multifuncional: Colaborar con Ventas, Medical, Regulatory, Market Access, Supply Chain, Finanzas y Commercial Operations para alinear prioridades de marca, fortalecer la efectividad de la fuerza de ventas y movilizar stakeholders hacia objetivos comunes, ejerciendo liderazgo por influencia y promoviendo una ejecución coordinada.

• Excelencia operativa y mejora continua: Gestionar presupuestos promocionales y prioridades operativas, coordinar actividades de planificación de demanda y muestras médicas cuando corresponda, e identificar oportunidades para optimizar procesos, mejorar la efectividad de las campañas y fortalecer los resultados del negocio mediante decisiones basadas en datos.

Requisitos esenciales

• Título universitario en Marketing, Administración de Empresas, Publicidad, Comunicación, Farmacia, Bioquímica, Medicina, Economía, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.

• 4 años de experiencia profesional en la industria farmacéutica, marketing, gestión de marcas, excelencia comercial u omnicanalidad.

• Experiencia en el desarrollo e implementación de planes de marca, campañas promocionales y estrategias orientadas al crecimiento del negocio.

• Experiencia trabajando con equipos de ventas y fuerza de visita médica, con exposición a presupuestos, forecasts y análisis de desempeño comercial.

• Experiencia en marketing digital, CRM, desarrollo de contenidos y ejecución de campañas o journeys omnicanal.

Requisitos deseables

• Experiencia como Product Manager, Associate Product Manager o en posiciones equivalentes con responsabilidad sobre marcas y resultados comerciales.

• Experiencia en marcas establecidas, General Medicines, compañías multinacionales o iniciativas de alcance regional.

• Participación en proyectos de transformación digital, automatización de marketing o mejora de la experiencia de los profesionales de la salud.

• MBA o posgrado en Marketing, Negocios, Dirección Comercial o áreas relacionadas.

• Formación complementaria en marketing digital, estrategia omnicanal, analítica de datos, automatización de marketing o gestión de proyectos.

Skills

Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Marketing Campaign Planning, Marketing Measurement, Marketing Strategy Implementation, Omnichannel Marketing, Scientific Literacy

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Rest assured that your information will be treated with the utmost confidentiality, in compliance with applicable regulations, and will not be available to hiring managers or anyone outside the recruitment team. Help us maintain, together, an inclusive and welcoming environment.

Ayudarás a empujar límites, desafiar convenciones, y construir soluciones más inteligentes que lleguen a las comunidades que servimos. ¿Listo para perseguir los milagros de la ciencia y mejorar la vida de las personas? Persigamos el Progreso y Descubramos lo Extraordinario – juntos.

postings.title: Head of Growth Marketing
postings.descriptionText:
En Bidcom impulsamos la evolución del comercio electrónico liderando el mercado con nuestras marcas propias, como Gadnic, y una consolidada presencia en canales digitales y marketplaces. Somos un entorno dinámico, de alto impacto y en constante aceleración, diseñado para profesionales orientados a resultados que buscan transformar datos en decisiones estratégicas. Si te apasionan los grandes desafíos e impactar directamente en la rentabilidad y escalabilidad de un negocio digital líder, este rol es para vos.

Tareas y Responsabilidades

Como Head of Growth Marketing , asumirás un rol clave y transversal para acelerar el crecimiento rentable de Bidcom y Gadnic sobre todo el funnel (Adquisición, Activación, Retención y Revenue) tanto en nuestros canales propios como en MercadoLibre y otros marketplaces.

• Liderar la estrategia integral de Growth Marketing alineada a los OKRs de la compañía y de la Plataforma de Marketing, con foco en el crecimiento de GMV y net profit.

• Desarrollar y coordinar un equipo de 5 profesionales distribuido en tres squads (Customer Acquisition, Customer Activation & Retention, y Revenue & Optimization), además de dirigir las agencias y partners externos (medios, SEO/GEO y martech) como extensión del área.

• Supervisar y optimizar la inversión publicitaria en medios de performance y brandformance (Google, Meta, TikTok y Mercado Ads), garantizando eficiencia en ACOS/TACoS y ROAS, y migrando el modelo hacia POAS e impacto incremental.

• Construir el business plan anual y el forecast mensual de inversión, integrando la visión bottom-up del área con los objetivos estratégicos top-down de Dirección.

• Liderar la estrategia comercial en Mercado Ads y la relación con Mercado Libre, gestionando el Joint Business Plan y las reglas de automatización de la pauta.

• Impulsar la estrategia de tráfico orgánico (SEO técnico, contenidos y GEO) para reducir progresivamente la dependencia del tráfico pago.

• Dirigir la estrategia de CRM y lifecycle en Salesforce Marketing Cloud y Data Cloud: automatizaciones, crecimiento de la base contactable, frecuencia de compra y personalización onsite midiendo el impacto incremental con grupos de control.

• Asegurar la excelencia en la infraestructura de analítica y medición junto a Data y TI (GA4, GTM, feeds, modelos de atribución y Marketing Mix Modeling) para establecer la agenda de experimentación y escalabilidad.

• Planificar y ejecutar la estrategia de Growth para eventos masivos de la compañía (CyberMonday, Hot Sale, Black Friday, Navidad) y presentar los análisis post-evento.

• Gestionar la contratación, negociación de fees, alcance y seguimiento de resultados de agencias y proveedores.

• Reportar periódicamente a Dirección mediante tableros de KPIs, reportes mensuales de performance y propuestas estratégicas de inversión.

• Coordinar con las áreas de Comercial, Web & Marketplaces, Brand & Social, TI y Data para alinear el calendario comercial, la conversión del sitio y el roadmap tecnológico.

Requisitos

Excluyentes:

• Más de 8 años de experiencia en marketing digital o growth en e-commerce, retail o marketplaces, con al menos 3 años liderando equipos.

• Experiencia comprobable gestionando presupuestos de paid media de gran escala en Google Ads, Meta y TikTok, con foco en performance y rentabilidad (ROAS, ACOS, CAC, POAS).

• Experiencia en retail media y marketplaces, con foco en Mercado Libre y Mercado Ads.

• Solidez en CRM, automatización de marketing (deseable Salesforce Marketing Cloud) y estrategias de lifecycle y retención.

• Manejo analítico avanzado: GA4, análisis de funnel y cohortes, definición de KPIs y toma de decisiones basada en tableros de control.

• Experiencia en armado de business plan y forecast de inversión publicitaria.

• Experiencia gestionando agencias y proveedores externos, incluyendo negociación de contratos y fees.

• Trayectoria liderando la estrategia de Growth en eventos de alto volumen (CyberMonday, Hot Sale, Black Friday).

• Título universitario en Marketing, Administración, Economía, Ingeniería o carreras afines.

Deseables:

• Experiencia previa en marketplaces, fintechs, retailers regionales o agencias de performance.

• Experiencia en roles con alcance regional (operación en múltiples países).

• Posgrado o Maestría en Negocios Digitales, Marketing o afines.

• Conocimiento de SEO técnico, estrategia de contenidos y GEO (posicionamiento en respuestas de IA).

• Manejo de BigQuery/SQL, Looker Studio o herramientas de BI.

• Conocimiento técnico de martech: GTM, server-side tagging, gestión de feeds, modelos de atribución e incrementalidad (MMM / Meridian).

• Experiencia con Salesforce Data Cloud, personalización onsite y WhatsApp como canal de CRM.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio-avanzado.

Beneficios Corporativos

• Cobertura médica prepaga de primer nivel.

• Membresía con descuento en red de gimnasios Sport Club.

• Día de cumpleaños libre (Day Off).

• Descuentos corporativos en productos de la compañía.

• Licencia por paternidad extendida.

• Posibilidades reales de crecimiento y desarrollo en una empresa líder.

Información de la Vacante

• Lugar de trabajo: Saavedra (Híbrido)

• Horario: 9 a 18 hs

postings.title: Manager, Digital Product (Temporary)
postings.descriptionText:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

ㅤ

*This is a temporary role*

Your New Role
The Manager, Digital Product LATAM leads the performance, growth and monetization of TNT Sports' digital products in Spanish-speaking Latin America, managing digital platforms such as YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and X. The initial focus markets are Argentina, Mexico and Chile, with potential expansion to other countries such as Colombia.
Key responsibilities include leveraging data and analytics to drive audience engagement, boost revenue and strengthen platform partnerships across markets. The role works closely with local content teams in each country, offering strategic insights and actionable data from each platform to guide business decisions, and builds a consistent regional view of digital performance. Through regional live broadcasts such as CONMEBOL competitions, the role also reaches audiences across all of South America.

Your Role Accountabilities

Performance, Data & Experimentation

• Define KPIs and targets per country, platform and product/program (engagement, watch time, revenue...), using a common framework that allows comparison across markets.

• Build and maintain reliable, automated dashboards with daily performance visibility for local newsrooms and regional leadership; ensure data consistency across tools and countries.

• Lead a structured testing agenda with clear hypotheses, goals and learnings, scaling what works from one market to the others.

• Run regular performance reviews with the content teams in each country, turning data into concrete actions; promote the use of AI to gain efficiency.

Platform & Rights Holder Partnerships

• Be the main point of contact with platforms such as Google/YouTube, Meta and TikTok for Spanish-speaking Latin America, working with their local and regional teams: manage existing deals and joint projects, access beta features, and escalate bugs and technical issues affecting operations. Track and share new platform features and best practices with the teams in each country.

• Act as the digital point of contact with rights holders and competitions (e.g. CONMEBOL and local leagues) on topics such as content protection, anti-piracy, geo-restrictions, digital rights usage and platform guidelines.

Digital Monetization & Live Products

• Partner with ad sales and content teams to grow digital revenue.

• Lead the product side of live broadcasts on digital platforms - including regional CONMEBOL lives with audiences across South America - from setup, geo-targeting and real-time monitoring to post-event analysis.

Market & Audience Insights

• Follow digital, platform and audience trends in sports and entertainment across Latin America, identifying local differences in consumption and translating them into insights and new opportunities for TNT Sports' products and content.

• Ensure the quality and consistency of TNT Sports' digital presence in each country (profiles, featured content, publishing timing), partnering with local content teams to act quickly on opportunities.

• Map audience opportunities in countries without a local TNT Sports structure reached through regional competitions, and support the evaluation of expansion to new markets.

Commercial, Acquisitions & Strategic Presentations

• Provide local ad sales teams with data on high-performing content and digital packages for advertisers and sponsors, including regional/multi-country packages; support commercial workshops and sales presentations.

• Support the acquisitions team with business cases and BPs for digital rights in the region.

• Build institutional presentations and measure cross-promotion results.

Qualifications & Experienc e

• At least 7 years of experience in digital/social media

• Advanced English and Spanish

• Strong analytical skills: comfortable working with Excel, data visualization and social analytics tools (Sprout Social, Rival IQ or similar)

• Solid knowledge of football and the sports media market in Spanish-speaking Latin America

• Strong storytelling and presentation skills (PowerPoint)

Desirable

• Degree in marketing, communication, business, data or related field (or equivalent experience)

• Portuguese (intermediate)

• Practical use of AI tools

• Experience with sports rights and live streaming

• Experience working in regional or multi-country roles

About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

Some Important Details
We embrace the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit. In line with the laws of the country or region in which the role is based, this includes consideration without regard to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship status, religion or belief, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or protected veteran status, union status or any other category protected by applicable law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

postings.title: Account Manager - E-commerce Marketing Agency
postings.descriptionText:
The main purpose of the Account Manager is to manage their assigned clients and their stores by planning, briefing, monitoring, and executing marketing campaigns aimed at driving conversions and sales.

This includes managing, overseeing, and taking charge of the client-agency relationship for all the clients that have been assigned to you. It also includes developing and executing marketing strategies, handling client communications, writing client reports, and communicating the client's marketing needs to other team members. You will be responsible for supplying the information your team needs to ensure that all marketing campaigns are written, designed, and executed as well as possible. Your goal as an Account Manager is to assist your clients in meeting their revenue goals using the products and services of our company.

The Account Manager will report directly to the Head of Account Managers, the Account Managers' Leads, and the Service Director while working collaboratively with other departments.

About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Account Manager is to be in charge of maintaining a good relationship with your assigned clients while ensuring that our products and services are bringing results for our clients. This will include coming up with innovative ideas for clients' marketing campaigns, monitoring the performance of such marketing campaigns, and keeping an open channel of productive and fruitful communication with our clients.

You will also be responsible for leading teams consisting of professional Copywriters, Designers, and Account Managers' Associates to ensure that your assigned clients' marketing campaigns are executed smoothly. This involves activities such as outlining the client's campaign calendar, briefing new campaigns, delegating creative work, and ultimately overseeing the timely delivery of marketing campaigns.

General Responsibilities:

• Effectively managing, overseeing, and ensuring that the marketing campaigns of your assigned clients are executed and performing well

• Building and maintaining a strong relationship with your assigned clients to ensure peak productivity, open communication, and establishing trust between our clients and Hustler Marketing

• Being in charge of the planning, development, and execution of marketing strategies (consisting of email campaigns, SMS campaigns, pop-ups, and flows) for your assigned clients (meaning that you'll be managing about 40 unique marketing campaigns per month)

• Ensuring that the needs and expectations of your assigned clients are managed and met

• Working to improve the results from email marketing for your assigned clients

• Collaborating with team members to respond to client requests promptly

• Working alongside a team of experienced marketing professionals productively and harmoniously to ensure that the highest quality marketing campaigns are delivered to our clients

• Continuously staying in contact with your assigned clients, including leading and attending regular meetings with your clients

• Collecting and analyzing data to understand the consumers' demographics and trends to forward the clients' marketing agenda and drive better results, setting new goals weekly

• Regularly reporting on the performance of the email marketing campaigns for your assigned clients, including reporting on aspects like revenue from email marketing, best-performing campaigns, results from A/B testing, and the measures taken to improve and optimize client revenue

• Working with the Service Department to maintain high work standards and ensuring that the set targets for your assigned clients are met in terms of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Keeping a tight grip on client churn (especially for your assigned clients), and implementing strategies to prevent clients from leaving the company, with the assistance of the Service Director

• Troubleshooting and assisting with any issues related to clients' satisfaction and the performance of marketing campaigns as developed and executed by our team

• Being able to effectively and productively work with any type of client with minimal supervision

• Working on various tasks as part of the team of Account Managers

• Participating in the Account Managers' group calls

• Participating in the training and skill-building sessions for Account Managers within the Service Department to improve their skills, performance, and overall expertise

• Acting as a liaison between clients and cross-functional teams to ensure the successful implementation of new services and products offered by Hustler Marketing

• Continuously working to identify new opportunities to expand services offered to clients through regular communication and relationship building

• Using data analysis techniques to create targeted campaigns for upselling our services to our client segments, and to present these service offers to clients in a compelling manner

• Continuously working to discover industry-wide best practices and standards and present your findings to the Account Managers' Lead, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director

• Being available to assist with all internal service-related needs from other departments

• Directly reporting to the Account Managers' Leads, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director (in that structural order)

Positions Specs:

• Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours

• An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently

• Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD

• Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement

• Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)

• Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)

• Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months

• Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months

Requirements

About You:

Profile:

The ideal candidate must be someone with extensive working experience in managing client accounts effectively, as well as experience in email marketing. Such experience should include managing a team consisting of marketing professionals (such as Account Managers' Associates, Designers, Copywriters, and other team members) to deliver marketing campaigns that are focused on driving sales.

The Account Manager must be able to act swiftly upon receiving urgent requests from clients and must be able to work consistently with high levels of accountability.

The right person will be professional and also have considerable leadership and managerial experience, as well as strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with clients and internal teams. Having been an Account Manager before, or having any agency experience is a great advantage.

Familiarity with various tools such as Slack, Hubstaff, Asana, Klaviyo, and Google Workspace Suite is a must for this role. The candidate should also feel comfortable working in a remote environment. Availability, accountability, professionalism, responsiveness, and consistency are highly important factors for us, so the Account Manager should display these qualities when it comes to workload commitments and general availability during office hours.

Key Requirements:

• At least 12 months of experience working in a digital marketing role, together with at least 6 months of working experience in an email marketing field (Preference will be given to candidates who have worked with remote teams and team members from different countries or have any account management or agency experience)

• A proven track record of achieving success in a leadership role is a must, especially leading a team of creatives to deliver quality work that meets the needs of clients

• Must have the ability to work independently without compromising on work standards

• Must be highly accountable, responsive, and have an excellent ability to meet deadlines

• Great aptitude for working with people, problem-solving, and thinking critically / analytically, as these skills are essential for meeting the needs of our clients and resolving any issues or queries

• Possesses a growth and results-driven mindset, and can handle and implement constructive criticism

• Any remote work experience is a major advantage

• Excellent interpersonal skills to clearly and effectively communicate with clients as well as marketing professionals in our Service Department

• Must possess great problem-solving skills as it is essential for working with clients and resolving any queries, complaints, or issues

• Must have the ability to learn and adapt quickly, and possess excellent time management skills and high levels of focus, productivity, and efficiency

• Any knowledge or experience with email marketing, e-commerce, or Klaviyo is a huge plus

• Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your time (remote work experience is a plus)

• Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)

• Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (i.e, 140 hours per month)

• Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC, as well as be able to attend virtual video conferences

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. You must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language

• Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it, as well as giving feedback of similar nature productively to your team

postings.title: Consumer Insight & Sensory Manager - Argentina

Throughout its 62 years of existence, Saint George School has become a reference of academic excellence both nationally and internationally, being the only school in the country to offer the prestigious International Baccalaureate program and the first one to receive dual accreditation from the Council of International Schools (CIS), Cambridge International General Certificate of Secondary Education (IGCSE) and the New England Association of School and Colleges (NEASC), with a highly qualified multicultural faculty and staff. Today make up a school community of 43 different nationalities, making Saint George an institution of international stature forming young leaders capable of meeting academic and professional challenges in today's global society.

ADMISSIONS MANAGER

Job Description

LOCATION Saint George School – Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic

JOB PURPOSE: As a key member of the Marketing, Admissions & Communications (MAC) team, the Admissions Manager is responsible for driving student enrolment by ensuring that both prospective and current families receive an exceptional experience at every stage of their journey with the school. The role contributes directly to the school’s growth strategy by strengthening market positioning, increasing enrolment, and supporting retention, while ensuring alignment with Nord Anglia Education standards.

REPORTING TO: Director of Marketing, Admissions & Communications

Internal

• Head of School

• Heads of Primary & Secondary

• Teaching & Administrative Staff

External

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead based in Argentina.

As Website & Lifecycle Marketing Lead, you will own the digital experience that turns visitors into customers and first-time buyers into loyal, repeat customers. You will lead website optimization, lifecycle marketing, email communication, and brand positioning across multiple product lines. Working closely with leadership, product, design, engineering, and marketing teams, you will translate customer insights into compelling messaging and measurable business outcomes. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, experiment with new ideas, and implement improvements from concept to execution. In a fast-paced, fully remote environment, your work will directly influence conversion rates, customer retention, and recurring revenue. This is an opportunity for a hands-on marketing leader who combines analytical thinking, persuasive copywriting, and a strong sense of ownership to drive meaningful growth.

Accountabilities

• Website Strategy and Conversion Optimization: Own the structure, messaging, and conversion performance of the website and key product pages. Develop and execute A/B tests, collaborate with design and engineering teams, and implement improvements that increase conversion rates.

• Lifecycle Marketing: Design and optimize end-to-end customer journeys, including onboarding, reorder triggers, retention campaigns, win-back initiatives, and repeat-purchase flows. Partner with the Head of Marketing to drive recurring revenue and customer lifetime value.

• Positioning and Messaging: Develop clear, differentiated positioning for each product line and customer segment. Maintain a consistent source of truth for messaging across the website, advertising, sales materials, and AI-powered sales tools.

• Email Marketing: Plan, write, launch, and optimize lifecycle and marketing email campaigns that support customer acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention.

• Customer Research and Insights: Gather insights from sales calls, customer conversations, and reviews, translating them into stronger messaging, improved web pages, and actionable experimentation opportunities.

• Performance Measurement and Reporting: Track and analyze business-critical metrics, including conversion rates, repeat revenue, repeat order value, and CRM performance. Use data to prioritize initiatives and demonstrate measurable impact.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with executive leadership and relevant teams to influence product direction, improve customer workflows, and align marketing execution with broader business objectives.

Requirements

• Professional Experience: At least 4 years of experience in B2B or e-commerce marketing, with hands-on ownership of website conversion optimization, messaging, lifecycle marketing, or email programs.

• Customer-Centric Copywriting: Demonstrated ability to create effective copy and landing pages grounded in customer research, market insights, and real-world feedback rather than assumptions.

• Lifecycle Marketing Expertise: Experience building and managing lifecycle or email marketing programs, with measurable results in revenue, activation, retention, or repeat purchases.

• Experimentation and Analytics: Solid understanding of A/B testing principles, including sample sizes, primary success metrics, and minimum detectable or practically meaningful effects. Ability to interpret results and make evidence-based decisions.

• End-to-End Ownership: Proven ability to take initiatives from strategy and planning through execution, testing, launch, and optimization, working independently with minimal supervision.

• Communication Skills: Excellent written English, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and develop persuasive messaging for different audiences.

• Analytical Thinking and Problem-Solving: Strong business acumen, logical reasoning, and the ability to break down ambiguous challenges into practical, high-impact solutions.

• Accountability and Adaptability: A proactive, ownership-driven mindset, combined with the ability to respond quickly to constructive feedback, adapt to changing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-moving environment.

• Preferred Qualifications: Experience with hybrid self-service and sales-led funnels; hands-on knowledge of CRM systems such as HubSpot or Pipedrive and email marketing platforms; experience developing prompts or knowledge bases for AI sales or support agents; and familiarity with custom manufacturing, branded merchandise, or print-on-demand businesses.

Benefits

• Competitive Compensation: A flexible, competitive compensation package tailored to the candidate's experience, capabilities, and expected impact.

• Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere globally, with flexible working hours and no requirement to report to a physical office.

• Full-Time Engagement: An exclusive, full-time independent contractor arrangement offering substantial responsibility and autonomy.

• Direct Leadership Exposure: Work closely with executive leadership, gaining visibility into strategic decisions and opportunities for professional development.

• Strategic Influence: Contribute directly to product development, customer experience improvements, business workflows, and company strategy.

• Autonomy and Ownership: Take responsibility for your domain, lead initiatives end to end, and make decisions with minimal bureaucracy.

• Growth Opportunities: Join a scaling business where you can expand your responsibilities, strengthen your expertise, and accelerate your professional growth.

• Flexible Work Environment: Collaborate with a distributed, international team in a results-oriented environment that values initiative, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

postings.title: Creative Director
postings.descriptionText:
About JumpSeat

JumpSeat is a B2B growth agency and advisory built around a simple belief: the best opportunities rarely come from the obvious signals.

We help go-to-market teams find the non-obvious signals others miss and turn them into highly relevant outreach that earns a response. It's an antidote to the automated, generic outbound buyers have learned to ignore.

Our Signal Intelligence methodology combines prioritized accounts, custom signal libraries, AI-assisted research, and 1:1 messaging based on what's actually happening inside a target account, before everybody else sees it.

We're a remote-first crew across the US and Buenos Aires. We care about bold, ground breaking work, and about the people who make it.

The role

We're looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative department.

This is more than a creative leadership role. You'll lead the people, the capacity, and the way we work: our two full-time creatives, our freelance bench, and the process that gets great work out the door. You'll partner with our delivery team on priorities, and set the vision and standards for the department.

You'll stay hands-on too, leading brand, campaign, web, and pitch work.

And you'll help shape how AI fits into our creative work. That means testing tools, deciding where and when they belong, and making sure they improve both the quality of what we make and the team's experience making it.

This is a senior role for someone with a proven track record leading creative in a fast-paced agency.

What You'll Do

Lead the department.

• Manage, mentor, and grow our two full-time creatives. Clear goals, honest feedback, real development.

• Set the creative vision and the way we work, then champion it across the agency.

• Build a team people want to be on, and a culture where the bar keeps rising.

• Bring the creative point of view to leadership conversations about where JumpSeat goes next.

Run the engine.

• Own capacity planning. Anticipate resourcing needs proactively and balance the load across the team.

• Know when we need more hands. Find, brief, and manage freelancers who meet our bar and our budget.

• Partner with the delivery team to set priorities, timelines, and scope.

• Keep sharpening the creative workflow, from brief to review to client handoff.

• Be the single point of contact for every creative deliverable. On brand, on time, every time.

Raise the creative bar.

• Own the quality of everything we make, across every client and channel.

• Lead brand development work: positioning, messaging, and visual identity.

• Concept and lead campaigns, ABM programs, and digital advertising.

• Oversee website design and development.

• Give clear, useful direction to designers and copywriters.

• Work closely with our strategy and account teams so creative work serves each client's business goals.

• Lead the creative side of new business pitches, from concept to presentation.

Shape How We Use AI.

• Experiment with AI tools across ideation, copy, design, and production.

• Decide where, when, and how AI tools and workflows are adopted in our day-to-day, based on one test: does it make the work better, and the work of making it better?

• Set practical guardrails for quality, brand fit, and client trust.

• Help the team build skill and confidence with new tools, and share what works across JumpSeat.

Who You Are

• A Creative Director, ACD, or Head of Creative from a strong agency, who has led a creative team directly.

• A department builder, not just a project lead. You've owned capacity, resourcing, and process, and you actually enjoy it.

• A true partner to delivery and account teams. Comfortable trading off priorities, scope, and timelines in the open.

• Experienced at bringing in and leading freelance talent.

• A versatile creative across branding, web, campaigns, and digital advertising, who still wants to roll up their sleeves.

• Quick to understand the unique aspects of a client's industry, culture and voice, so you can hit the ground running.

• Someone who loves growing people, and builds teams that stick together.

• Hands-on with AI tools, and clear-eyed about them. You already use them in your creative work, and you have a point of view on where they help and where they get in the way.

• A clear, confident presenter with existing and new clients.

Nice to have

• Fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite. Other design tools are a plus.

• B2B experience. Helpful, not required.

• You've led a team through a change in tools or workflows before.

How We'll Get To Know You

• A conversation with our Talent team.

• A practical case. You'll present how you'd approach a real-world challenge.

• A conversation with senior team members.

What's In It For You

• Real influence. You'll shape a function at the core of our business, and how it works.

• Great people. A team that will challenge you, inspire you, and have your back.

• Remote first. Colleagues across the US and Buenos Aires.

• Balance, for real. Unlimited PTO, Summer Fridays, time off between holidays, and more.

Ready to take the seat?

If you want to build a creative department, not just fill its pipeline, we want to hear from you.

As we scale, we're building a stronger creative-strategy function to help clients find new creative winners — and to turn one-off learnings into repeatable systems that compound across every account.

Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

What You'll Own

This is a senior, strategic role. You won't be editing every asset or running campaigns day-to-day. Your job is to raise the quality of the thinking, research, and strategy behind everything we produce and test.

• Generate net-new creative. Develop original concepts, messaging angles, hooks, formats, and storytelling approaches for video and static ads — not variations on the same three ideas.

• Find the ideas before you have them. Run customer, competitor, and market research to uncover motivations, objections, and pain points that haven't been explored yet. Mine reviews, sales calls, and customer feedback for the insight that makes an ad work.

• Turn performance into strategy. Analyze why creative wins or loses and translate it into clear next steps. Write sharp, actionable briefs grounded in customer insight, direct-response principles, and a defined testing hypothesis — and push iteration beyond surface-level hook and footage swaps.

• Build the system. Create CDM's creative-strategy frameworks, brief standards, testing processes, and a shared learning repository. Spot what's working in one account and determine where it can be adapted across others.

• Level up the whole team. Coach Media Buyers and editors so stronger creative thinking becomes a department-wide capability, not something that lives with one person. Partner with CRO to align messaging, personas, offers, and landing-page experiences. Provide direction for UGC, founder-led, and spokesperson-led formats.

• Use AI as a force multiplier. Build AI-powered workflows and tools that accelerate research, ideation, and production for the entire team — more on that below.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years in performance-focused creative strategy.

• Deep understanding of Meta advertising and direct-response creative.

• Strong direct-response copywriting and short-form storytelling skills.

• A track record of developing concepts from customer research and performance data — not just intuition.

• Fluency with creative metrics (Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CPL) and the judgment to weigh them against lead quality and down-funnel performance.

• Experience across multiple brands, accounts, or verticals.

• A structured approach to testing — hypotheses, iteration strategy, isolating variables.

• Demonstrated ability to build systems, processes, frameworks, or knowledge bases.

• Advanced, practical experience using AI for research, analysis, ideation, workflow design, or creative enablement.

• The ability to explain not just what you'd test, but how you found the opportunity and why you believe it will work.

• Strong communication, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• A bias for speed — you generate learning quickly without over-engineering every test.

What "AI-First" Means to Us

We are not looking for someone who asks AI to spit out scripts and hooks.

We're Looking For Someone Who Uses AI To

• Analyze customer reviews, calls, and feedback at scale.

• Identify creative patterns across many accounts at once.

• Build and maintain shared account context.

• Surface cross-account testing opportunities.

• Automate recurring creative research and reporting.

• Improve the speed and quality of briefs and production workflows.

• Build systems that help the whole team make better creative decisions.

You bring strong, independent creative judgment. AI is how you increase the depth, speed, and scale of that judgment. Familiarity with tools like Motion, Looker Studio, Asana, Slack, and Claude is a plus.

Nice to Have

• Lead generation or high-ticket services experience.

• Home improvement experience.

• CRO and landing-page testing familiarity.

• UGC, founder-led, or spokesperson-led creative experience.

• Hands-on familiarity with editing or design tools.

What Success Looks Like

• CDM consistently introduces genuinely new creative ideas instead of recycling the same concepts and formats.

• Creative iterations are more deliberate, strategic, and evidence-based.

• Media Buyers and editors produce stronger briefs and creative recommendations on their own.

• Learnings are captured, shared, and applied across accounts.

• AI-supported research and creative workflows are adopted department-wide.

• CDM has a repeatable creative-strategy engine that gets stronger with every test.

Benefits

Benefits of Working at CDM

• Competitive base salary + performance-based bonuses

• Flexible remote work environment with option for in-person collaboration (Vaughan, ON)

• Group Benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision, RRSP/401k Plan w/matching, more.

• Company-provided MacBook computer

• Home office budget and Clever merch delivery to get you started

• Work Abroad Policy: Need a new working environment? Our work abroad policy supports this!

• The chance to shape and grow a high-performing Client Success team

• A culture of performance and respect where the best work happens with extreme ownership and accountability meets collaboration.

Clever Digital Marketing values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the team. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of support during the recruitment and selection process. Please note that artificial intelligence (AI) may be utilized during the interview or candidate evaluation process to support the fair and efficient screening, assessment, and selection of applicants.

Responsibilities
TikTok's Global Business Solutions (GBS) regional sales and advertising teams drive revenue growth by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding clients, and running campaigns that deliver measurable results.

Client needs, market trends, and performance expectations shift constantly, and differently in every market. We build strategy accordingly, turning those moving pieces into advertising solutions that work and client partnerships that last.

You will help businesses grow on a global platform, working on the campaigns and relationships that turn advertisers into long-term partners.

We are looking for a Business Partnerships Manager, Financial Services to drive growth with FinServ advertisers across Colombia, Argentina, Peru, Chile. This person will manage a defined set of client relationships, execute against full-funnel growth plans, and help turn platform capabilities into measurable business outcomes for banks, fintechs, payments companies, lending players, wallets, investment platforms, and insurance advertisers.

The right candidate combines solid commercial instincts with hands-on performance-marketing fluency. They can discuss CAC, ROAS, funnel leakage, app acquisition, web conversion, lead quality, creative testing, and measurement with a performance team, and are learning to translate those topics into a clear growth narrative for client stakeholders. They are also building an understanding of digital media partnerships: how platforms, networks, creators, placements, ad products, measurement solutions, incentives, and joint business plans come together to create durable client growth.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who learns aggressively and wants to develop into a senior sales person. They will own client outcomes from day one, while partnering closely with senior BPMs and regional leads on the most strategic conversations, and will be expected to grow from managing accounts well toward thinking about how the broader FinServ industry should grow with TikTok and partner media solution.

Responsibilities
1. Account Growth and Execution
- Manage and grow a defined portfolio of Colombia, Argentina, Peru, Chile FinServ advertisers, with a focus on revenue delivery, forecast accuracy, and strong day-to-day client relationships.
- Execute account plans that connect client business priorities to measurable media outcomes, including user acquisition, funded accounts, loan applications, card acquisition, deposits, app activation, qualified leads, and brand consideration.
- Identify share-of-wallet opportunities in assigned accounts and support entry strategies for accounts where platform adoption is still early.
- Help close quarterly forecast gaps through account-level actions, including upsell opportunities, incentive plans, creative actions, measurement fixes, and partner-product adoption.

2. Performance Marketing Excellence
- Serve as a credible day-to-day performance partner for client marketing and growth teams, media agencies, and internal performance specialists.
- Diagnose campaign performance across funnel stage, objective, optimization event, audience setup, creative volume, bidding, budget allocation, landing-page or app flow, and measurement setup.
- Contribute to and execute scalable performance playbooks for FinServ use cases, including app acquisition, web conversion, lead generation, retargeting, creator-led performance, and branding-to-performance handoffs.
- Help clients move from tactical media buying toward structured test-and-learn programs with clear hypotheses, clean measurement, and repeatable decision rules.
- Surface technical or operational blockers — campaign pauses, event setup, creative shortages, tracking gaps, product readiness — and drive them toward commercial resolution rather than letting them sit outside the revenue plan.

3. Digital Media Partnerships
- Support partnership motions that connect TikTok, Pangle, partner inventory, measurement, creative, incentives, and product adoption into one client growth story.
- Contribute to joint business plans with FinServ clients, including quarterly priorities, product adoption roadmap, investment commitments, operating cadence, and checkpoints.
- Work with internal partner teams to build proposals that reflect how banks, fintechs, lenders, and payments companies actually make media decisions.
- Help clients understand when to use branding, performance, app, web, lead-generation, consideration, and partner-network solutions, and how those motions reinforce each other.
- Represent the FinServ vertical in cross-functional discussions with support from senior BPMs, developing a clear industry point of view on partnerships, measurement, and incentives.

4. Industry Development
- Build a strong view of FinServ trends in Colombia, Argentina, Peru, Chile, including digital banking, credit, payments, wallets, super-apps, lending cycles, regulatory sensitivity, app adoption, and competitive media behavior.
- Translate market changes into practical client actions, for example competitive-response plays, app-growth recovery plans, or wallet-share expansion ideas.
- Help develop repeatable vertical narratives that explain why TikTok and partner media solutions matter for the next phase of FinServ growth.
- Learn FinServ business models, client decision cycles, risk constraints, and the difference between brand, acquisition, and monetization objectives, and start coaching junior or cross-functional stakeholders on them.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- 4+ years in digital advertising, performance marketing, media partnerships, consulting, fintech growth, banking partnerships, or account management.
- Exposure to financial-services advertisers, ideally across fintech, banking, credit, payments, wallets, investment, insurance, or lending; strong candidates from adjacent regulated or performance-driven verticals will also be considered.
- Hands-on experience managing client accounts, quarterly business reviews, planning cycles, and multi-stakeholder relationships, with support on the most senior-level conversations.
- Solid understanding of app marketing and web/lead-generation funnels, including event strategy, conversion quality, measurement limitations, and creative-performance dynamics.
- Experience working with media platforms, ad networks, agencies, measurement partners, or partner-inventory solutions.
- Ability to operate in ambiguity and prioritize across accounts, blockers, and upside opportunities with clear guidance.
- Proficient in English and Spanish to communicate with external stakeholders in LATAM.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​

postings.title: Senior Art Director
postings.descriptionText:
Wripple's financial services client is looking for a Senior Art Director – Marketing Campaigns in Buenos Aires, Argentina to join their team for a 40-hour/week, 12-month contract with the potential to convert to full-time for the right fit.

This is an opportunity to lead the development of integrated creative campaigns and own the creative idea from brief through execution for a leading global financial brand.

We’re looking for a senior conceptual thinker, campaign builder, and creative leader — not simply a highly experienced designer. The ideal candidate knows how to take a complex business or marketing challenge, identify the creative opportunity within it, and develop an original, strategically grounded campaign idea that can come to life across channels.
Working closely with Creative Directors, copywriters, designers, and marketing partners, the Senior Art Director will lead the development of strategic, audience-relevant creative ideas and translate them into compelling visual concepts and integrated campaign systems across digital, social, web, video, print, experiential, and other brand experiences.

What You'll Do
You’ll take a senior role in the creative process, leading work from initial brief and concept development through final execution:

• Lead from the brief. Dig into the business and marketing challenge, audience insights, objectives, and strategy to identify opportunities for compelling creative solutions.

• Develop the big idea. Partner closely with copywriters and other creatives to originate distinctive campaign concepts that solve the brief — rather than simply executing against an established visual direction.

• Define the visual concept. Establish how the campaign idea comes to life through art direction, imagery, typography, composition, motion, and other elements of the brand experience.

• Build integrated campaign systems. Create cohesive visual languages and creative frameworks that can scale across channels, audiences, and formats while maintaining the integrity of the core idea.

• Lead the work through execution. Art direct and oversee creative across digital, social, web, video, print, presentations, experiential, and other marketing touchpoints.

• Provide creative direction and guidance to designers and other creative team members, helping elevate the quality, consistency, and conceptual strength of the work.

• Present and sell creative concepts to Creative Directors, marketing partners, and senior stakeholders, clearly articulating the strategic thinking and rationale behind the work.

• Partner closely with copywriters to ensure visual and verbal storytelling work together as one cohesive campaign idea.

• Navigate stakeholder feedback, determine how best to incorporate it, and protect the strength of the creative idea through rounds of iteration.

• Push the boundaries of the brand thoughtfully, identifying opportunities to evolve the creative while remaining relevant to the audience and aligned with business objectives.

• Develop a strong understanding of the company, its audiences, and global financial markets in order to translate complex subjects into clear, engaging, and memorable creative.

• Manage and prioritize multiple high-visibility projects simultaneously while maintaining a high degree of creative craft and attention to detail.

• Leverage AI and emerging creative tools throughout the creative process to accelerate exploration, expand creative possibilities, and improve efficiency.

What We're Looking For
First and foremost, your portfolio should demonstrate senior-level conceptual campaign thinking and creative ownership. We want to see how you have taken business or marketing challenges and turned them into compelling creative ideas — and how you led those ideas from concept through integrated execution.

The strongest candidates will demonstrate:

• 5–8+ years of experience in Art Direction, including experience operating at a Senior Art Director level , within a creative agency, in-house creative team, or similar environment.

• A portfolio featuring concept-led, integrated marketing campaigns , rather than primarily standalone design, production, or executional work.

• A proven ability to originate and develop creative concepts from a business/marketing brief, strategy, and audience insight , ideally in partnership with copywriters.

• Experience owning creative work from initial concept through final execution and maintaining the integrity of the idea throughout the process.

• The ability to clearly articulate the thinking behind the work — including the challenge, insight, creative idea, visual direction, and how the concept extended across channels.

• Strong visual conceptualization skills and the ability to establish distinctive, sophisticated art direction for major campaigns and brand initiatives.

• Experience creating integrated campaign systems that translate effectively across digital, social, web, video, print, experiential, and other channels .

• Experience providing creative direction, feedback, and mentorship to designers or more junior creatives.

• A strong understanding of storytelling and how imagery, typography, motion, copy, and design work together to communicate a powerful idea.

• Exceptional typography, visual hierarchy, composition, and overall design craft.

• Confidence presenting, defending, and selling creative ideas to senior internal stakeholders and clients.

• The ability to balance creative ambition with business objectives, audience needs, brand standards, timelines, and stakeholder feedback.

• Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator, InDesign, and Photoshop.

• Experience incorporating AI tools into creative ideation, concept development, or execution.

• The ability to work autonomously and take ownership of high-profile assignments while thriving in a highly collaborative creative environment.

• Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills with the ability to lead multiple projects in a fast-moving environment.

• Fluency in English, including the ability to confidently present and defend creative concepts and rationale in English.

• Financial services experience is a plus, but exceptional conceptual campaign experience is more important.

Portfolio Requirement
A portfolio is required for consideration.
We are specifically looking for work that demonstrates senior-level, idea-driven art direction and integrated campaign development. Your portfolio should show examples where you played a meaningful role in originating the creative concept — ideally from a brief, business challenge, or strategic insight — and then led the visual direction and development of that idea across multiple marketing touchpoints.
We want to understand what you personally contributed to the work , particularly your role in developing the concept, defining the art direction, collaborating with copywriters and other creatives, and guiding the campaign through execution.

This role is best suited for a Senior Art Director who can lead the idea, elevate the work, and carry a campaign from brief through execution — not just design the assets.

1. 3+ years of BD/growth experience in crypto exchanges, perp DEXs, forex, or CFD brokerage, specifically in IB/affiliate/volume-growth functions (not general partnerships)

3. Existing network: real, activatable contacts among traders, IBs, or trading communities

+ A brief summary of your existing IB/trader/community network (size, region, activity level).

Bullbit is a perp DEX combining centralized exchange performance with decentralized security, making on-chain trading feel simple and effortless. Bullbit is currently built on Base Layer 2, and will migrate to its sovereign Layer 1, known as BullChain.

No gas fees. No friction.
Log in with your passkey and trade.

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

What does a Interactive PM do at Hogarth?

The Interactive Project Manager works closely with the Clients Producers to work on campaigns. The PM is expected to lead and manage digital projects while bringing together a multi-disciplinary team comprising of internal and external resources as required. They needs to provide an optimum interactive solution for the client that answers the brief within all the necessary specified style and technical guidelines.

As a member of the project management team on this business, you are pivotal to the smooth running of projects. You will be required to have a thorough understanding of the client’s requirements and be responsible for all aspects of your projects. You will build strong client relationships, managing communication through the project team, providing consistent and accurate project reporting, project planning, and ensuring that expectations are managed and delivered.

You will:

• Set and manage client expectations regarding deliverables and timeframe while coordinating and ensuring all parties follow the agreed workflows

• Identify and escalate areas for improvement of existing workflow and processes

• Build strong, trusting relationships and communication with all key stakeholders, function leads, cross functional producers, senior managers, and 3rd party vendors that are directly involved with the work

• Manage the approval of quarterly budgets and proactively manage your projects within time and budget, escalating any risks to project delivery

• Demonstrate ability to write, prepare and present documents, presentations, and reports to support your work

• Ensure your projects deliver consistently against all contractual obligations including SLAs and KPIs

• Act as a brand QC/Guardian – always ensure brand guidelines, QC checklists and procedures are understood and followed by the project team

• Monthly financial reconciliation on projects

Requirements

• Demonstrable project management experience related to the digital space

• Very high competence in project management software such as Microsoft Project and Omniplan

• Experience in costing, quotations, and project scope definition

• Analytical and detailed in project documentation, accountability, and tracking

• Pragmatic team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Prioritization, time management, and attention to detail.

• Excellent communication skills, written and verbal

• Possess technical understanding of mobile and web technologies necessary to run projects and convey details. Examples would be:

• iOS and Android development

• Cloud computing

• HTML5/CSS/Javascript

• eCommerce/Shopping Carts

• Social Media Strategies/Platforms

Why work here:

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data

We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.
