postings.title: AI Lead Creative
postings.descriptionText:
Superside is looking for a Lead Creative with a passion for Generative AI to shape creative excellence across branding, landing pages, ads, social, print, and presentations. You’ll guide a global team of top-tier creatives, combining strategic leadership with hands-on craft to deliver human-centered, high-impact work for leading brands worldwide.

This role sits at the intersection of creativity and innovation, elevating creative quality while helping evolve our capabilities through the thoughtful use of AI tools. You’ll act as both a mentor and a maker, fostering collaboration, empathy, and clarity across every project. You bring curiosity, composure, and humility to your leadership, helping others grow while delivering consistently outstanding creative work.

What You'll Do

• Generate and refine visual concepts using AI tools (e.g., text-to-image, text-to-video, layout automation).

• Experiment with emerging AI workflows, identifying ways to enhance quality, efficiency, and creative expression.

• Integrate AI-assisted assets into creative workflows while preserving brand integrity and human emotion.

• Guide creative direction and ensure every project connects back to strategy and purpose.

• Build trust through thoughtful client communication and calm, solution-oriented leadership.

• Foster a psychologically safe, inclusive environment that encourages shared ownership and diverse perspectives.

• Connect creative ideas to broader business goals, using data and insight to shape storytelling.

• Encourage reflective, intentional decision-making within your team.

• Partner cross-functionally to create holistic, insight-driven creative solutions.

• Coach and inspire designers, balancing encouragement with actionable, growth-oriented feedback.

• Recognize and celebrate creative contributions, strengthening team connection and morale.

• Lead by example: you stay grounded under pressure, approach challenges with curiosity, and uplift others in the process.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Excellent English communication skills, with the ability to express creative ideas clearly and supportively.

• 5+ years of experience as a creative lead or similar, with a strong history of guiding diverse, multidisciplinary teams.

• A strong portfolio showcasing creative excellence across branding, presentations, and advertising, with examples of AI-enhanced work.

• Advanced skills in design tools, including Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and presentation platforms.

• Proficient in using AI tools as part of a thoughtful and intentional creative workflow.

• Experience leading project teams, mentoring peers, and contributing to a shared creative vision.

• A collaborative, ego-free approach with the ability to listen actively, adapt easily, and foster trust through empathy and clarity.

• Comfortable engaging with internal and external partners in both creative and strategic discussions.

• Proven ability to manage multiple projects with attention to detail, creative integrity, and team well-being.

Why join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

• Remote-first. Customer-led. Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

• Global team, local impact. Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

• High performance, low ego. Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

• Impact meets opportunity. We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

• Grow fast. Lead well. You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance.

Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

This role serves as the primary liaison between Lenovo and key technology alliances, translating complex partner programs into actionable business initiatives that drive revenue growth, maximize alliance investments, and strengthen Lenovo’s market position. The position requires a highly autonomous professional capable of managing strategic relationships, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and overseeing more than USD 7M per quarter in alliance-funded programs across the region.

🚀Key Responsibilities:

• Own the strategic relationship with assigned technology and ecosystem partners.

• Develop and execute joint business plans aligning priorities, growth targets, and GTM strategies.

• Drive incremental revenue and pipeline through joint opportunities and co-selling.

• Orchestrate cross-functional execution across Sales, Marketing, Product, Services, Finance, and Operations.

• Maximize partner investments and programs including MDF, incentives, rebates, and enablement.

• Manage performance and executive governance through KPIs, business reviews, and executive engagement.

• Manage and optimize alliance funds, ensuring full utilization and commercial impact across Latin America.

• Translate complex alliance program documentation, product eligibility matrices, and funding structures into clear and actionable guidance for sales and business teams.

• Partner with key alliance providers such as Intel, AMD, Microsoft, Qualcomm, and other strategic technology vendors to develop mutually beneficial growth initiatives.

• Monitor regional and global funding programs, ensuring compliance, visibility, and effective allocation of available investments.

• Identify revenue growth opportunities by aligning alliance priorities with Lenovo’s product, services, and infrastructure strategies.

• Act as the central point of coordination between global alliance organizations, regional leadership, product teams, and country organizations.

• Support business planning, demand generation, enablement, and marketing activities associated with alliance programs.

• Provide regular business updates, performance reporting, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders across the region.

✅ Position Requirements:

• 5-10 years of experience in alliances, sales, business development, or partner management.

• Technology ecosystem and channel expertise ideally across PCs, infrastructure, services, and/or software.

• Solid understanding of technology components, processor architectures, product portfolios, and the broader IT ecosystem.

• Strong communication and negotiation skills with executive-level presentation capability.

• Proven ability to work independently, demonstrate strong ownership, and proactively drive initiatives with limited supervision.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly synthesize complex information and convert it into business actions.

• Advanced English proficiency is mandatory, with the ability to effectively interact with global teams, regional leadership, and external alliance partners.

• Availability to work in a hybrid model: 3 days on-site and 2 days remote.

Preferred Qualifications (considered a Plus):

• Experience working with alliance or partner programs from organizations such as Intel, AMD, Microsoft, Qualcomm, or similar technology vendors is highly desirable.

• Experience managing regional or multinational business relationships across multiple countries is preferred.

• Portuguese proficiency is preferred for candidates based in Argentina; Spanish proficiency is preferred for candidates based in Brazil.

📍The role is open to candidates based at either of Lenovo’s locations in Brazil or Argentina:

• Brazil - São Paulo: Rua Werner Von Siemens, 111, Prédio 1, Lapa de Baixo

• Argentina - Nuñez: Av. Del Libertador 7208.

Candidates may be hired from either location, as both sites are eligible for this position.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

postings.title: Country Manager Argentina y Uruguay
postings.descriptionText:
About Us

Quiénes somos: 

Samsonite es el líder mundial en bolsos, equipaje y accesorios de viaje, que combinan un estilo notable con la última tecnología de diseño y la máxima atención a la calidad y durabilidad. Durante más de 100 años, Samsonite ha aprovechado su rica herencia para crear productos inigualables que satisfacen las necesidades de estilo de vida de viaje de los viajeros conscientes de todo el mundo. Con una cartera de marcas que incluye Samsonite, Tumi, American Tourister, High Sierra, Gregory, Hartmann y Lipault Paris, nuestros productos se venden en más de 100 países de América del Norte, Asia, Europa y América Latina a través de nuestras tiendas propias, sitios web y una variedad de socios minoristas

Misión

JOB DESCRIPTION

• Dirigir y controlar las operaciones de Samsonite en Argentina y Uruguay, proporcionando la orientación y dirección estratégica necesarias para garantizar que la empresa alcance su misión y objetivos.

Ubicación y Modalidad De Trabajo

• Direccion oficina: Dr. Nicolas Repetto 3656, Piso 7, Olivos, Provincia de Buenos Aires.

• Modalidad de lunes a jueves presencial y viernes remoto.

Principales Funciones

• Formular e implementar con éxito la misión de la empresa en Argentina y Uruguay, es decir, estar presente y actuar activamente en las cuatro canales de venta estratégicas de la compañía: Retail, Wholesale, Franquicias y Negocios digitales (E-commerce y Marketplaces). Samsonite en Argentina y Uruguay, se presenta a través de sus propias tiendas y franquicias. Complementar el negocio con un sólido comercio (retail, wholesale y franquicia) y digital en una fase de rápido crecimiento.

• Orientar la estrategia hacia el crecimiento rentable y el funcionamiento de la empresa dentro de las áreas de desempeño mencionadas anteriormente.

• Desarrollar planes de negocio estratégicos que reflejen los objetivos y prioridades a largo plazo establecidos por la Compañía para el mercado de Argentina y Uruguay.

• Asegurarse de que los objetivos operativos y los estándares de rendimiento no solo se comprendan, sino que también sean asumidos por el resto del equipo.

• Supervisar de cerca los resultados operativos y financieros en comparación con los planes y presupuestos, tomando medidas correctivas cuando sea necesario e informando a la gerencia sobre los cambios significativos.

• Asumir la plena responsabilidad de todas las operaciones de la empresa y representarla ante los principales clientes y socios comerciales. Adicionalmente, asegurar el cuidado de los gastos operacionales del funcionamiento de la compañía.

• Crear, desarrollar y mantener un equipo ejecutivo eficaz, dirigiendo y controlando el trabajo y los recursos de la empresa, y asegurando la contratación y retención del personal necesario, motivándolo, capacitándolo y desarrollándolo para garantizar que se alcancen la misión y los objetivos.

• Brindar asesoramiento y orientación estratégica a la gerencia para mantenerlos al tanto de las novedades del sector y garantizar el desarrollo de políticas adecuadas que cumplan con la misión y los objetivos de la empresa. Asimismo, se debe cumplir con todas las leyes y normativas pertinentes.

• Desarrollar y mantener programas de investigación y desarrollo para garantizar que la empresa se mantenga a la vanguardia del sector, aplique los métodos y enfoques más rentables, proporcione productos y servicios de última generación y mantenga su ventaja competitiva.

• Preparar, obtener la aprobación y supervisar la implementación del presupuesto anual para garantizar que se cumplan los objetivos, se maximicen los flujos de ingresos y se minimicen los costos fijos.

• Desarrollar y mantener una estrategia eficaz, con conjunto con la dirección regional de marketing, para promocionar los productos, marca e imagen de la empresa en la comunidad en general.

• Representar a la empresa en las negociaciones con clientes, proveedores y otros contactos clave para garantizar las condiciones contractuales más eficaces.

• Desarrollar y mantener sistemas de gestión de calidad total en toda la empresa para garantizar que se ofrezcan a los clientes los mejores productos y servicios posibles.

• Desarrollar y dirigir la implementación de políticas y procedimientos para garantizar que la empresa cumpla con todas las normas de salud, seguridad, normativa SOX y demás regulaciones legales.

Requisitos

• Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, deseable con MBA.

• 15 a 20 años de experiencia total

• 10 años de expeirnecia en liderazgo corporativo dentro de la industria de moda, retail y wholesale

• Sólidos conocimientos y experiencia en retail, whollesale y ecommerce

• Excel intermedio

• Deseable manejo de SAP

• Inglés fluido y español nativo

About The Team

Por qué te encantará trabajar aquí:

Nuestros empleados importan. Como empresa centrada en las personas, trabajamos duro para ofrecer recompensas y oportunidades de desarrollo a nuestros empleados, reconociendo su rendimiento y creando un entorno de trabajo propicio para ellos, dondequiera que se encuentren.

Cultura vibrante. Estamos comprometidos con una cultura diversa y rica, que acoge a personas de todas las profesiones y condiciones sociales. Nuestro compromiso de larga data con la diversidad y la inclusión nos permite aportar cada día al trabajo nuestro auténtico yo y nuestras diferencias únicas.

Socialmente responsables. Queremos minimizar el impacto de nuestros productos en el medio ambiente y ayudar a crear viajes positivos en todo el mundo. Para ello, creamos los mejores productos utilizando los materiales, métodos y modelos más sostenibles e innovadores.

Lo Que Valoramos

En Samsonite, hacemos más que crear las maletas que se mueven con nuestros clientes, inspiramos y celebramos los momentos que les mueven. Creemos que tenemos una responsabilidad con el mundo en cómo operamos, los productos que vendemos, las comunidades donde vivimos y trabajamos, y cómo tratamos a las personas que trabajan con nosotros. Somos tan diversos como los viajes mismos, y como los viajes, tu viaje con Samsonite presenta la oportunidad de formar parte de algo más grande y explorar tus pasiones. Por eso ofrecemos varios caminos para los profesionales y celebramos los conocimientos y habilidades que aportan a nuestro equipo. Estamos comprometidos con un lugar de trabajo respetuoso que permita a los miembros de nuestro equipo aportar diariamente lo mejor de sí mismos.

Samsonite es una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a promover y mantener un entorno de trabajo en el que todos los solicitantes, asociados, clientes y otras personas sean tratados con dignidad y respeto, libres de acoso, discriminación o represalias.

postings.title: Sales Development Representative LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
RemoFirst is transforming the way businesses hire and manage global teams. Our mission is to enable Freedom of Work by providing an all-in-one global HR platform that simplifies hiring, compliance, payroll, and benefits management. We partner with some of the world's most innovative companies, including Fortune 500 businesses and leading startups.

We are a small but strong team of 200+ people (and growing) hyper-focused on delivering a world-class platform and unparalleled service with our industry-leading partnerships.

As a Sales Development Representative at RemoFirst, you'll be responsible for driving new business for our sales team and establishing relationships with various decision-makers within our target customers. As the face of RemoFirst in the market, you will be critical in driving the hyper-scale new customer acquisition we anticipate.

What you'll be doing:

• Generate new business opportunities through outbound prospecting and book qualified meetings for our Account Executive team

• Work closely with the Outbound Manager to identify target accounts among businesses expanding internationally, using Apollo to research and source the right contacts

• Conduct outbound prospecting in English and Spanish via cold calling, email, and LinkedIn, tailoring your approach to each market

• Collaborate with Account Executives to schedule demos and ensure prospects are properly briefed ahead of handover

• Maintain accurate records of all prospecting activity in HubSpot and report regularly on progress against targets

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our outbound process by testing new messaging and sharing feedback with the wider sales team

• Follow up on inbound leads generated by marketing and partnership activity as required

Requirements

• 1+ year of overall experience in Sales Development representative-related roles in the software industry

• Experience in international HR, Payroll, Global Mobility, or a fast-paced startup environment is a plus. EOR experience is an even more significant plus!

• Ability to work U.S Eastern Time hours 9 A.M - 5 P.M

How you'll work:

• Excellent English & Spanish are a must.

• Excellent communication skills. Working with many people from all over the world, we need to communicate, adapt quickly, and relay information in different ways

• Time Management: You will be participating in meetings and supporting our customers and internal teams. Throw time zones into the mix, and that's quite the day. You must be good at structuring your work day and tasks to ensure you accomplish all those things while maintaining a work-life balance

• Collaborative: We love to work with all sorts of different people in all sorts of different places. Everyone's opinion matters to get the job done.

• Independent and autonomous: as we work, we're naturally independent. As much as we're connected, you will also need to use your initiative to solve problems and get answers; this also means reaching out to us to get help or confirm a solution

• Empathetic: You need excellent people skills to connect and motivate yourself and others. You will use your empathic abilities to handle conversations with multiple audiences

• Motivated: we want our team to be passionate about our mission. Freedom of work applies not only to our customers but to ourselves. Additionally, you will need motivation and initiative to identify and/or support tasks that need to be improved without being asked

Benefits

• Startup environment: RemoFirst is an early-stage startup. You have a voice that can influence and grow rapidly. An opportunity to build a tech unicorn.

postings.title: Recruiting Business Development Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Role

Are you the person who keeps things moving, catches the details others miss, and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks? We’d love to meet you.

At Ami Arroyo, Inc., we believe recruiting should be personal, efficient, and grounded in good information. We’re looking for a Business Development Coordinator to help turn approved account research into thoughtful outreach and real buyer conversations.

You’ll work closely with our founder to keep business development organized and moving. Our founder will lead relationships, discovery, proposal decisions, pricing, and closing. You’ll own the execution and preparation that make those conversations possible.

What You'll Own

• Build clear weekly outreach queues from approved target accounts. Check priorities, existing activity, exclusions, and possible duplicate outreach.

• Verify buyer names, contact information, and business mailing addresses. Flag conflicting or missing details before taking action.

• Prepare approved letters and mailing packets, coordinate printing and mailing with a U.S.-based teammate, and confirm when letters were actually mailed.

• Complete approved follow-ups, surface buyer responses quickly, and help schedule relevant conversations with our founder.

• Organize event contact lists and coordinate approved post-event outreach.

• Assemble proposal documents using approved templates. Check for missing or inconsistent information and send drafts to Ami for review and final approval.

• Keep our CRM accurate and current: actions taken, dates, responses, next steps, owners, and deadlines. Share a concise weekly update on progress and blockers.

What You'll Bring

• At least two years of administrative, sales-support, recruiting-coordination, or client-operations experience, with examples of work you’ve owned through completion.

• A track record of accurate records and reliable follow-through. You’ve managed deadlines, follow-up queues, next actions, and handoffs without repeated reminders.

• Strong professional written and spoken English. You can write clearly, listen closely, ask questions, and summarize next steps with confidence.

• Hands-on experience using a CRM to maintain accurate activity, contact records, and next steps. You’re comfortable learning new digital workflows.

• Independent remote-work habits and the ability to maintain an agreed daily overlap with CST hours.

• Sound judgment. You check details, protect sensitive information, flag missing approvals, and know when a decision belongs with Ami.

• Comfort using AI to support your work, with the discipline to check facts, names, claims, and final output before anything is shared.

Experience That's Helpful

• U.S. client or team experience is a plus, but clear communication matters more than employer names.

• Apollo familiarity is preferred, with training available.

• Staffing or B2B-services experience helps; autonomous vehicle or physical AI expertise isn't required.

What Success Looks Like

• Approved accounts receive accurate, timely outreach.

• Follow-ups happen when they should.

• Buyer replies reach our founder with useful context.

• Relevant meetings take place, records stay clean, and our founder has more time for high-value conversations.

If you love bringing order to moving pieces and take pride in following through, we'd love to hear from you. At Ami Arroyo, Inc., the details matter because people matter, and we're excited to meet someone who brings that same care to their work.

postings.title: Business Associate · Comercial y Operaciones
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre depptö
depptö es la aceleradora comercial del mercado inmobiliario. Ponemos estrategia comercial, inversión publicitaria e inteligencia artificial a trabajar para desarrolladores, inmobiliarias y propietarios independientes. Hoy movemos +300 propiedades en tres ciudades — Buenos Aires, Bahía Blanca y Punta del Este — en Argentina y Uruguay.

Estamos lanzando un nuevo sitio y un nuevo sistema de comercialización, y buscamos a la persona que va a trabajar al lado del CEO para que el negocio crezca y las cosas pasen.

El rol
Vas a trabajar junto al CEO en una empresa chica que se mueve rápido. Un rol comercial y de gestión a la vez: vas a ser responsable de que entren ingresos y, al mismo tiempo, de que todo lo que se decide se ejecute.

En la práctica, eso significa tres cosas:

Hacer crecer los ingresos. Tu foco es que crezca la facturación. Vas a ser dueño/a de las dos puntas del negocio: conseguir propiedades nuevas para gestionar y convertir la demanda que ya generamos en reservas y operaciones cerradas.

Que las cosas pasen. Vas a seguir las prioridades de la semana, empujar los pendientes, ordenar lo administrativo y llegar a cada reunión con la información lista. Si algo está trabado, lo destrabás o lo levantás a tiempo.

Cubrir donde haga falta. En un equipo chico, a veces falta alguien. Cuando pasa, te ponés el puesto que haga falta, entendés cómo funciona y, si se repite, lo dejás mejor de lo que estaba.

Y algo que atraviesa todo: usás la IA como herramienta principal de trabajo. Lo que hoy se hace a mano — armar una propuesta, calificar un lead, preparar un reporte, redactar un seguimiento — queremos que lo resuelvas más rápido y mejor, y que lo dejes armado para que no dependa de nadie.

Qué vas a hacer
Ingresos: captación y ventas

• Prospectar propietarios, desarrolladores y administraciones, y trabajar los leads que entran por el sitio, Meta y referidos.

• Armar, presentar y cerrar propuestas de gestión comercial hechas a medida de cada propiedad: banda de precios por temporada, proyección de ocupación y esquema de cobro.

• Ser dueño/a del funnel de ventas: consultas, cotizaciones, cierres y seguimiento en Airbnb, Booking.com y nuestro canal propio (web, WhatsApp y Meta).

• Medir y reportar cada semana: conversión por canal, tiempo de respuesta, ocupación y facturación.

Marketing

• Validar que la estrategia de marketing esté alineada con los objetivos comerciales: qué campañas corren, qué traen y cuánto cuestan.

• Revisar la performance de la pauta en Meta y los resultados del sitio, y proponer qué escalar, qué ajustar y qué cortar.

Gestión junto al CEO

• Seguir las prioridades y los pendientes del equipo, y empujar para que se cumplan los plazos.

• Llevar el control administrativo del día a día: cobranzas, pagos a propietarios, contratos y documentación.

• Preparar reportes y reuniones, y convertir lo que se decide en tareas con responsable y fecha.

• Detectar cuellos de botella y proponer cómo resolverlos, con procesos o con automatizaciones.

A quién buscamos

• 2 a 4 años de experiencia en roles comerciales, de growth, operaciones, consultoría o en una startup.

• Una persona generalista que se mueve con comodidad entre una llamada de ventas, una planilla y un contrato.

• Que use IA todos los días como forma de trabajar, no como curiosidad. Nos interesa qué automatizaste o construiste con ella.

• Orden, criterio y seguimiento: que lo que tomás, lo cerrás.

• Escritura clara y persuasiva: buena parte del trabajo es escribir propuestas, mensajes y reportes.

• Comodidad con los números: Sheets, métricas de funnel y una proyección de ingresos sin pánico.

• Autonomía y ganas de embarrarse. Vas a tener mucha libertad y poca estructura.

• Español nativo e inglés intermedio o superior.

Suma puntos

• Experiencia en real estate, alquiler temporario, hotelería o marketplaces.

• Meta Ads, CRM y automatizaciones (n8n, Make, Zapier).

• Haber trabajado con Uruguay o con operaciones en más de un país.

Qué ofrecemos

• Trabajar directo con el CEO y ver el negocio completo, de la estrategia a la operación.

• Un rol con impacto directo y medible sobre los ingresos de la empresa.

• Aprendizaje acelerado en un equipo chico, con decisiones rápidas.

• Sueldo fijo más premios por resultados.

• Trabajo presencial en nuestra oficina de San Telmo, con el equipo y el CEO al lado.

postings.descriptionText:
Plus8soft is a global engineering company providing outstaffing and outsourcing services for fast-growing startups and established international companies. We focus on delivering high-quality engineering talent across Web, Mobile, Cloud, AI/ML, and DevOps with a strong presence in the US and global markets.

We are looking for a proactive, results-driven Sales Development Representative (SDR) to drive our top-of-funnel outbound sales engine. Your primary mission is to identify, engage, and book qualified discovery meetings with key US tech leaders and decision-makers.

Key Responsibilities 1. Outbound Prospecting & Pipeline Generation

• Cold Outreach & Sourcing: Run highly customized, multichannel outbound campaigns (LinkedIn, Cold Email, Video outreach) to generate meetings with US founders, CTOs, and VPs of Engineering.

• Warm Lead Conversion: Proactively follow up on warm intros, referral partners, and company-generated leads to turn initial touchpoints into qualified sales opportunities.

• Trigger-Based Prospecting: Monitor business signals—such as funding rounds, tech stack shifts, leadership changes, or hiring surges—to instantly pitch our tech capacity to targeted US companies.

2. Account-Based Intelligence (AI-Native Approach)

• Deep Mining: Use AI tools to build targeted account lists and analyze client "tech landscapes" (e.g., scraping client job boards to identify hidden talent gaps and active tech stacks).

• Stakeholder Mapping: Identify key Decision Makers and Influencers to build maps of mutual influence within target organizations.

• Hyper-Personalization: Leverage LLMs and AI tools to synthesize prospect LinkedIn activity, interviews, or news into high-relevance outreach hooks.

Requirements
• Experience: 1+ year of hands-on SDR / lead generation experience in IT Outstaffing, Staff Augmentation, or Nearshore software development targeting the US market.

• Track Record: Documented success in cold outbound hunting, quota attainment, and running outreach strategies from scratch.

• Language: Bilingual or Native-level English (C2) with exceptional written and verbal communication skills tailored to US tech executives.

• Tech & AI Savvy: Fast comprehension of complex tech stacks (SaaS, Cloud, AI/ML) and daily hands-on experience using modern outreach/AI tools (Clay, Apollo, ChatGPT, Perplexity, HubSpot/Salesforce) to automate and scale outreach workflows.

• Soft Skills: High level of persistence, strategic empathy, grit, and strong self-organization.

Conditions
• Contract Type: B2B contract (Long-term).

• Work Setup: 100% Remote.

• Compensation: Base salary + performance bonuses. Payment in USD.

postings.title: Full-Time MVA Legal Intake and Retainer Conversion Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
MVA Legal Intake & Retainer Conversion Specialist Accident Recovery Network | Full-Time & Part-Time Opportunities | English & Spanish Speakers

Position Overview Accident Recovery Network is seeking experienced, results-driven MVA Legal Intake & Retainer Conversion Specialists to engage prospective clients, qualify motor vehicle accident (MVA) cases, conduct inbound and outbound calls, and convert qualified leads into signed retainers and successful live transfers.
This is a sales-focused role, not simply a phone-answering or administrative intake position. Success depends on the ability to build trust quickly, follow up consistently, handle objections, overcome hesitation, and guide qualified prospects toward taking the next step in the legal representation process.
We are looking for confident communicators who understand that generating interest is only the beginning. The real value comes from moving qualified prospects through the pipeline and turning opportunities into completed intakes, successful transfers, and signed retainers.
We welcome both full-time and part-time applicants , including qualified Spanish-speaking and bilingual English/Spanish callers who can communicate naturally and confidently with prospective clients.
Candidates with a strong background in MVA, personal injury (PI), legal intake, retainer conversion, or performance-driven outbound calling are encouraged to apply.

Employment Type & Schedule
• Full-time and part-time opportunities available

• Schedules based on availability, campaign needs, and performance requirements

• Monday through Friday, with occasional Sunday availability depending on campaign needs

• Coverage may include Eastern and Pacific Time zones

• Daytime and evening calling schedules may be available

• Consistent attendance, punctuality, and schedule adherence are required

• Candidates must be available during their assigned calling and follow-up windows

Please specify your preferred employment type and availability when applying.

Primary Responsibilities
1. Sales-Focused Intake & Client Engagement
• Handle inbound calls from prospective MVA and personal injury clients.

• Establish trust and rapport while maintaining control of the conversation.

• Ask structured questions to understand the accident, injuries, treatment, and circumstances.

• Identify qualified prospects and explain the next steps in the case-review process.

• Build confidence and help eligible prospects move forward with consultations, transfers, or retainer signing.

• Recognize opportunities to advance a qualified lead rather than simply record information and end the call.

2. Outbound Calling, Follow-Up & Conversion
• Make outbound calls to new, aged, incomplete, and previously contacted leads.

• Re-engage prospects who have not completed intake or signed their retainers.

• Follow up on unsigned agreements, missing information, and incomplete documentation.

• Handle objections, hesitation, confusion, and common concerns professionally.

• Use persuasive, empathetic communication to help qualified prospects make informed decisions about the next step.

• Follow approved call scripts and follow-up cadences while communicating naturally.

• Maintain consistent follow-up through telephone, SMS, and email where authorized.

• Work toward measurable conversion targets instead of focusing solely on call volume.

3. MVA Case Qualification Evaluate potential cases against established qualification criteria, including:

• Accident date and applicable jurisdiction

• Liability and fault

• Injury type and severity

• Medical treatment and treatment timelines

• Gaps in medical treatment

• Insurance coverage and police-report availability

• Vehicle and property damage

• Existing attorney representation or prior attorney rejection

• Potential statute-of-limitations concerns

• Commercial vehicles, rideshare, pedestrian, motorcycle, bicycle, and hit-and-run cases

• Other campaign-specific qualification and disqualification criteria

Accurate qualification is essential. Candidates must balance conversion performance with compliance and case quality, without misrepresenting eligibility or promising legal outcomes.

4. Retainer Conversion & Live Transfers
• Guide qualified prospects through the electronic retainer-signing process.

• Explain the process and next steps clearly without providing unauthorized legal advice.

• Send retainers, forms, and required documentation.

• Confirm document receipt and completion.

• Follow up persistently on unsigned retainers.

• Facilitate warm, properly qualified live transfers to the appropriate legal team.

• Introduce the caller and summarize the case before transferring.

• Confirm successful connections and recover missed or failed transfers through timely follow-up.

• Help move qualified opportunities through the pipeline toward signed retainers and completed handoffs.

5. CRM & Pipeline Management
• Maintain accurate lead records, call notes, dispositions, and case statuses.

• Update pipeline stages, follow-up dates, and tasks promptly.

• Document qualification decisions and disqualification reasons.

• Track outstanding prospects and prevent qualified leads from being neglected.

• Identify stalled opportunities and prioritize appropriate follow-up.

• Follow confidentiality, data-security, and communication procedures.

Required Experience Candidates should demonstrate:

• At least five years of legal intake experience preferred, with substantial direct MVA experience strongly desired.

• Hands-on experience with motor vehicle accident and personal injury inquiries.

• Experience conducting inbound and outbound calls.

• A track record of converting qualified prospects into signed retainers, consultations, or successful live transfers.

• Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills.

• Experience working toward measurable sales, conversion, or productivity targets.

• Familiarity with MVA qualification and disqualification criteria.

• Experience managing high volumes of prospective-client inquiries.

• Strong CRM and pipeline-management skills.

• Experience with electronic retainer and document-signing platforms.

• The ability to communicate effectively with injured, distressed, hesitant, or uncertain callers.

Candidates with mass tort intake experience, personal injury law firm experience, or legal intake call-center/BPO experience will be particularly relevant.

Language & Communication Requirements We are interested in candidates for both English-speaking and Spanish-speaking calling needs.

English-speaking roles

• Fluent spoken and written English.

• Clear, professional telephone communication and strong listening comprehension.

• Ability to understand different speaking styles and regional dialects.

• Confidence explaining information in simple, understandable language.

• Accurate call documentation and professional written communication.

Spanish-speaking roles

• Strong spoken Spanish and the ability to communicate naturally with Spanish-speaking prospects.

• Confidence conducting intake, follow-up, qualification, and retainer-conversion conversations in Spanish.

• Ability to understand prospects' concerns, explain next steps clearly, and handle objections professionally.

• English proficiency appropriate to the assigned campaign and internal reporting requirements.

Bilingual English/Spanish candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. Please identify your language proficiency and the languages in which you can confidently conduct full telephone conversations.
An accent alone is not disqualifying. Clear communication, listening comprehension, professionalism, and the ability to avoid repeated clarification are what matter.
Applicants may be asked to complete a recorded voice assessment, mock intake call, outbound sales call, or language assessment.

Preferred Qualifications
• GoHighLevel (GHL) or other legal CRM experience

• Power-dialer or predictive-dialer experience

• Automated SMS and email follow-up experience

• Personal injury law firm or legal intake call-center experience

• Experience with multistate MVA campaigns

• Familiarity with signed-retainer and qualified-transfer campaigns

• Experience with attorney referral or case-acquisition networks

• Demonstrated success improving lead-to-retainer conversion rates

Core Competencies The ideal candidate demonstrates:

• Sales confidence and ethical persuasion

• Strong objection handling and closing skills

• Empathy without losing control of the conversation

• Active listening and emotional intelligence

• Confidence asking sensitive questions

• Persistence without being aggressive

• Excellent telephone presence

• Strong follow-up discipline

• Attention to detail and accurate documentation

• Ability to prioritize qualified, high-potential opportunities

• Comfort working toward measurable performance goals

• Coachability and willingness to improve through feedback

• Professional judgment and discretion

Performance Expectations Performance will be evaluated using measurable indicators, including:

• Outbound call volume and contact rate

• Speed-to-lead and inbound answer rate

• Completed intake and qualification rates

• Consultation-booking and live-transfer rates

• Retainer-send and signed-retainer conversion rates

• Follow-up completion and recovery of stalled prospects

• CRM accuracy and call quality

• Schedule adherence and attendance

• Prospect experience and compliance with established procedures

The priority is quality conversion, not activity alone. Candidates are expected to balance productivity with accurate qualification, professional communication, and consistent follow-through.

Compensation Compensation will be based on experience, demonstrated skills, employment type, schedule availability, and prior performance.
Specific compensation and incentive details will be discussed during the hiring process.

Application Requirements Please submit:

• Your current résumé.

• A brief description of your inbound and outbound calling experience.

• Any available performance metrics, such as signed retainers, conversion rates, or successful transfers.

• Your availability, including relevant Eastern and Pacific Time coverage.

Full-time and part-time candidates are welcome. English-speaking, Spanish-speaking, and bilingual English/Spanish callers are encouraged to apply.

postings.title: Account Executive
postings.descriptionText:
Account Executive

Location
Hybrid - Buenos Aires, Argentina (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

SHAPE THE FUTURE OF PRIVACY WITH USERCENTRICS
Usercentrics is a global leader in the field of consent management platforms (CMP). We follow our company vision to build a world where user privacy enables a thriving digital ecosystem. Our mission is to provide privacy solutions that empower organizations to embrace data privacy while building trust with their users through freedom of choice. With our product, businesses can collect, manage and document user consents on websites and apps, and achieve full compliance in accordance with global privacy regulations while facilitating high consent rates and building trust with their customers.

Usercentrics is looking for a driven, full-cycle Account Executive who can also operate effectively at the top of the funnel. This hybrid role combines traditional SDR responsibilities with AE ownership, offering the opportunity to manage the complete sales journey - from lead generation to closed-won revenue. Ideal for a hands-on seller who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment.

Your Tasks

Top-of-Funnel / Sales Development:

• Identify and engage key decision-makers at target accounts using outbound outreach (cold calling, email, and LinkedIn)

• Qualify inbound leads from marketing and move them into active sales conversations

• Conduct discovery calls to assess fit and align on customer pain points and needs

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through strategic prospecting and market segmentation

• Collaborate with Marketing to optimize campaign follow-up and lead handoffs

Full-Cycle Sales Execution:

• Manage the entire sales process from discovery to proposal, negotiation, and close

• Deliver engaging product demonstrations and tailor the solution to customer requirements

• Build trusted relationships with legal, marketing, and compliance teams within target organizations

• Strategically pursue mid-market and enterprise accounts across regulated industries

• Provide accurate sales forecasting and CRM hygiene through HubSpot (or similar tools)

• Work closely with Customer Success and Product to ensure smooth onboarding and feedback sharing

Requirements

• 2+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, ideally with exposure to privacy, martech, or legaltech

• Demonstrated success in both outbound prospecting and closing new business

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts

• A consultative sales approach focused on value creation and long-term client success

• Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, SalesLoft, or similar CRM/Sales engagement platforms

• Self-starter with high accountability and a growth mindset

Benefits

BENEFITS INCLUDE

• 401K plan contribution

• Vacation days

• Health insurance

• Hybrid workplace

• Online yoga sessions

• Events - Team Buildings, happy hours, parties/get togethers, occasional company covered breakfasts/lunches, in/across offices, online/in person etc

• Gifts - We celebrate life & work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new bom babies and similar)

• Snacks, fruits, coffee and drinks in the office

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Usercentrics we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Why join Usercentrics?

• Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

• Company culture is important to us - we strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

• Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all department enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

• Your work-life balance is important to us too - we offer flexible working hours, hybrid working and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

• We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our other office locations in Munich, Prague, Lisbon, Copenhagen, Odense and Buenos Aires or online

• You are the most valuable asset to our company which is why we're happy to offer awesome benefits

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

At Salesforce, we understand the challenges facing small businesses. That’s why we are so passionate about helping small businesses succeed. The Salesforce Small Business Account Specialist will ensure our prospective and current customers have an exceptional experience that reflects our level of dedication to making them successful. In this role, you will leverage multiple sources of information to stay current on product features, technology changes, and events that affect customers. As a driver of a new sales model, our Account Specialists are very important to our success. You’ll provide an outstanding customer experience as a trusted advisor by understanding business needs, identifying solutions that map to those needs, and preparing contract proposals. You’ll also drive online sales and educate customers on self-service resources. This is a fast-paced, performance-based environment where customer interactions may be supervised, recorded, and assessed. Account Specialists are measured based on revenue attainment and customer satisfaction surveys in addition to other performance based metrics.

Responsibilities

• Engage with prospective and current customers to qualify product fit via multiple channels

• Understand the prospect’s business needs, challenges, and the outcomes they are looking to achieve to act as a trusted advisor and provide best practices

• Consistently work towards our goal of increasing our customer satisfaction level and providing an exceptional customer experience

• Become a Salesforce product expert to articulate feature functionality and how it maps to customer needs

• Present and demo business value of various products to customers clearly and confidently, tailoring individual demos to their needs

• Act as the frontline for technical issues and route to Support when appropriate

• Handle initial billing and licensing questions and issues and raise as appropriate

• Partner with existing distribution teams efficiently to ensure customer success pre and post sale

• Identify and make recommendations to drive improvements across product and process

• Field, address, and detail inbound inquiries from customers via telephone, chat, cases, and email

• Ensure customers adopt and drive maximum value during the trial and onboarding phase

• Negotiate contract terms and assist customers with online purchases, contract restructures, and contract modifications

• Help contribute to our team goals of driving time to value

• Actively take part in specialised projects

• Redirect and raise technical and billing inquiries as needed

• Be innovative and identify and make recommendations to drive improvements across product and process

• Record customer interactions in Salesforce CRM software

• Contribute to the high performing culture

Qualifications

• A willingness and ability to “dive right in”, self-learn, be effective, make a difference and retain product knowledge

• Determination to meet and exceed sales and customer satisfaction goals month over month

• Basic troubleshooting skills, perseverance, empathy, and persistence

• Communicate and empathize with all levels of customers, executives, end users, and developers

• Effectively multi-task and balance priorities

• Top-notch written and verbal skills—English required

• Ability to thrive in ambiguity and work in a fast-paced, changing environment

• Effective time-management skills

• Flexibility to support multiple customer service channels and deliver effective resolutions

• Demonstrates high degree of determination and accountability

Education & Experience

• Undergraduate degree or equivalent work experience preferred

• 2+ Years Sales or relevant customer-facing experience

• CRM experience is a plus

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

postings.title: Ejecutivo/a Comercial - Prospección y Desarrollo de Cliente - CABA
postings.descriptionText:
Hay oportunidades que llegan. Y otras que se crean.

En Medifé buscamos un/a Ejecutivo/a Comercial con iniciativa, autonomía y ganas de desarrollar nuevos clientes individuales y corporativos.

Tu desafío no será solamente comercializar un plan de salud, sino acompañar a personas y empresas en una decisión importante elegir cómo cuidar su salud y la de quienes las rodean.

Si disfrutás generar conversaciones, construir confianza y transformar contactos en oportunidades, queremos conocerte. 🧡

¿Qué vas a hacer?

🔍 Prospectar nuevos clientes a través de redes sociales, referidos, contactos, acciones presenciales y canales digitales.

🤝 Escuchar cada necesidad y asesorar sobre el plan de cobertura médica más adecuado.

🚀 Gestionar el proceso comercial completo contacto, propuesta, negociación, cierre y documentación para el alta.

📲 Recibir y gestionar leads, complementándolos con acciones de prospección propia para ampliar tu cartera.

💻 Registrar y dar seguimiento a las oportunidades en CRM.

📊 Observar el mercado y aportar información que ayude a potenciar la estrategia comercial.

Este rol puede ser para vos si…

Tenés iniciativa para generar oportunidades desde cero.

Disfrutás relacionarte con personas, escuchar y construir vínculos de confianza.

Te organizás con autonomía y sostenés el seguimiento hasta alcanzar el resultado.

Te motivan los objetivos comerciales y los desafíos.

¿Te reconocés en este desafío?

Buscamos experiencia comercial, pero también iniciativa, constancia y capacidad para construir relaciones.

Porque vender también es escuchar.

Porque asesorar también es cuidar.

Postulate y contanos sobre una oportunidad comercial que hayas construido desde cero🚀

El próximo match puede empezar con esa historia. 🧡

Requisitos

🎯 Experiencia mínima de tres años en venta de servicios o productos intangibles. Excluyente.

👥 Contar con cartera propia será valorado. De no tenerla, necesitaremos que puedas demostrar experiencia en prospección y generación de nuevos clientes.

🎓 Estudios secundarios completos.

📱 Manejo profesional de redes sociales, WhatsApp y herramientas de venta digital.

💻 Conocimientos de CRM y notebook propia.

⏰ Disponibilidad full-time.

Beneficios

👩‍⚕️ Plan de cobertura médica para vos y tu grupo familiar.

📚 Capacitación continua mediante programas y talleres.

🏠 Modalidad remoto–presencial con flexibilidad para organizar horarios.

🎓 Convenios educativos UCES, UADE, San Andrés, Siglo 21, CUI , entre otros.

🛍️ Beneficios como Wellhub, Samshop, Colonia Express, Fiat, Club de Beneficios Unilever , entre otros.

👶 Licencias extendidas por maternidad y paternidad.

🤱 Hora de lactancia extendida (1 h 30).

🧒 Reintegro de gastos de guardería.

🧾 Servicio de asistencia al colaborador/a (legal, financiera e impositiva).

📱 Celular corporativo.

Somos una institución prestadora de servicios de salud, con 40 años de trayectoria y experiencia en la administración de aportes y contribuciones de obra social del personal de dirección de empresas. Conocemos cuáles son tus necesidades, por eso nos orientamos a brindar cobertura médica a nivel nacional por medio de las redes prestadoras más importantes del país. Somos una obra social sólida y dinámica que prioriza el bienestar de 350.000 afiliados que confían en nosotros.

Descripción del puesto

#TuMejorVersión #EstoyDondeQuieroEstar

Estamos buscando ASESOR COMERCIAL para el equipo de MORON.

Quien ocupe dicha posición deberá:

• Planificar, ejecutar y concretar la comercialización de los productos ofrecidos.

• Captar a potenciales clientes, realizar el ofrecimiento de los productos de la empresa y concretar la venta.

• Desarrollar estrategias para la captación de nuevos Asociados.

• Cumplimentar en tiempo y en forma con los objetivos de venta definidos.

• Consolidación de la cartera de potenciales asociados.

Si tenes una fuerte orientación a los resultados, contas con excelente proactividad para la venta de intangibles, te perfilas hacia la innovación en nuevos métodos de trabajo y te interesan los desafíos ES TU OPORTUNIDAD!

Queremos que aquí seas #TuMejorVersión.

Requisitos

• Experiencia en venta de intangibles (salud, seguros, ART, etc.)

• Predisposición para la venta en terreno, telefónica y por redes sociales.

Beneficios

• Ser parte de uno de los principales Grupos de Medicina Privada y Grupo Empresario a escala nacional que, a través de sus diferentes unidades de negocio, brinda soluciones y desarrolla productos enfocados en proteger el bienestar de los argentinos.

• Ser protagonista de tu desarrollo profesional. ¡A través de nuestra propia Universidad Corporativa acompañamos tu formación!

• Trabajar con pasión, compromiso, cercanía e innovación sin perder de vista nuestros orígenes, para ofrecer servicios de excelencia.

En SanCor Salud #EstoyDondeQuieroEstar

Detalles

Nivel mínimo de educación: Secundario (Graduado)

postings.title: Asesores/as Comerciales - Santa Rosa, La Pampa
postings.descriptionText:
La posición tiene como objetivo gestionar el proceso de comercialización de planes de salud, acompañando a potenciales clientes en todo el proceso de asesoramiento, con foco en la concreción de ventas y el cumplimiento de objetivos mensuales.

Buscamos perfiles con fuerte orientación comercial, habilidades de comunicación y vocación de servicio, que puedan brindar una experiencia de atención de calidad y excelencia.

• Modalidad de Contratación Relación de dependencia (sueldo básico + atractivo esquema de comisiones)

Principales responsabilidades

• Generar y gestionar contactos con potenciales clientes interesados en nuestros planes de salud.

• Asesorar de manera integral sobre las distintas opciones disponibles.

• Concretar ventas, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos comerciales.

• Registrar y dar seguimiento a las oportunidades a través de CRM.

• Brindar atención y asesoramiento tanto a clientes externos como internos.

Requisitos

• Experiencia previa en ventas (preferentemente en servicios o intangibles).

• Manejo de herramientas digitales (CRM, celular, etc.).

• Perfil comercial con orientación a resultados.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y negociación.

• Proactividad, autonomía y capacidad de organización.

• Disponibilidad para trabajar por objetivos.

• Residir en Santa Rosa - La Pampa o zonas aledañas.

• Movilidad propia (deseable)

Beneficios

🎉 ¡Tu cumpleaños es tu día libre!

🏖 Vacaciones adicionales para que disfrutes más tiempo libre.

✨ Beneficio de guardería para apoyar a tu familia.

📚 Descuentos exclusivos en ofertas académicas para potenciar tu desarrollo profesional.

💰 Descuentos exclusivos en nuestro moderno centro deportivo.

postings.title: Appointment Setter (Real Estate Lead Follow-Up)
postings.descriptionText:
To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.

Job Title: Appointment Setter (Real Estate Lead Follow-Up)

About The Company

Our client is a Southwest Florida real estate team that helps people buy and sell homes. They have a large database of leads that they want to use more effectively. They are looking for someone to build rapport with potential clients and book more meetings.

Job Description

Our client needs a dedicated Appointment Setter to follow up with their existing leads. You will make warm calls to people who are interested in buying or selling homes. Your main goal is to qualify these leads and book appointments for the real estate agents. You will use provided scripts and guides to have quality conversations. You will also keep detailed records of your calls and outcomes.

You will work with a daily list of about 50 leads through a restricted system. Success in this role means building rapport, booking meetings, and managing your leads effectively.

Responsibilities Of The Role

• Make warm calls to existing leads, including expired listings, for sale by owner properties, and pre-foreclosures.

• Qualify leads and book appointments directly on the agent’s calendar.

• Use provided scripts and rebuttal guides.

• Focus on quality conversations over call volume.

• Log every outcome in a timely and detailed way.

• Keep organized records of your work.

• Work from a daily list of about 50 leads through a restricted system.

Required Experience And Qualifications

• Punctual and business-minded.

• Resilient and not easily offended by firm feedback.

• Clear and concise communication skills.

• Willingness to follow scripts.

• Reliable record keeping abilities.

• Comfortable and professional on video calls.

• C1 or C2 English level.

Preferred Skills

• Real estate experience.

• Cold calling experience.

• CRM experience.

Personality

• You are business-minded and value punctuality.

• You focus on quality conversations and detailed records.

• You can handle firm feedback and are not easily offended.

• You communicate clearly and concisely.

Software & Tools

• Lofty CRM (limited access).

• Simple restricted shared system for lead lists and call logging (e.g., SharePoint).

• Calendar booking tools.

• Scripts and rebuttal guides.

Schedule

Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday

Flexible hours: 10 AM - 2 PM Eastern Time

20 hours per week

Salary And Benefits

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

postings.title: Ejecutivo Comercial de Comercio Exterior (Impo y Expo)
postings.descriptionText:
Ubicación: Ituzaingó, Provincia de Buenos Aires
Modalidad: híbrido
Tipo de empleo: Jornada completa
Nivel de experiencia: Intermedio
Aptitudes: comercio exterior, importación, exportación, freight forwarding, logística internacional, ventas B2B, prospección comercial, incoterms, negociación, CRM.

Descripción
En C&M movemos importaciones y exportaciones para empresas de toda la Argentina desde hace más de 25 años. Somos un operador logístico independiente: no tenemos flota propia ni dependemos de una sola naviera, y eso nos deja armar la solución que le sirve a cada carga, no la que nos conviene a nosotros.
Buscamos comerciales de comercio exterior para sumar al equipo. Tu especialidad puede ser importación, exportación o las dos.

Qué vas a hacer
Desarrollar tu propia cartera: salir a buscar clientes nuevos y hacer crecer los que ya tenés asignados.
Entender el negocio de cada cliente antes de cotizarle: qué produce, a qué mercados vende, con qué estacionalidad trabaja.
Armar la propuesta junto a pricing y después defenderla frente al cliente.
Sostener la relación cuando las cosas se complican. Va a haber roleos, demoras y falta de espacio: la diferencia la hace el que avisa a tiempo y llega con una alternativa.
Detectar dentro de cada cuenta lo que hoy no le estamos moviendo: otros orígenes, otros destinos, aéreo, terrestre, refrigerado.

Qué buscamos
Experiencia comprobable en comercio exterior, ya sea en un freight forwarder, una naviera, un despachante o el área de comex de una empresa que importa o exporta.
Que sepas cómo se arma un flete de verdad: incoterms, tipos de contenedor, tránsitos, cut off y documentación.
Que prospectes. Acá nadie espera a que suene el teléfono.
Inglés para trabajar con agentes del exterior.
Manejo de CRM y orden en el seguimiento.
Qué ofrecemos
Ser independientes como argumento de venta: podés ofrecerle al cliente cualquier naviera, cualquier ruta y cualquier modo.
Red propia de agentes en más de 150 países y procesos certificados ISO 9001.
Contacto directo con la dirección. Las decisiones se toman rápido y sin comités.
Sueldo fijo más variable por resultados.
Oficina en Parque Leloir, Ituzaingó, con esquema híbrido.

postings.title: Account Executive (SMB SaaS)
postings.descriptionText:
About MyPlace
Hi! I'm the founder of MyPlace, the guest engagement platform for hospitality. MyPlace captures every guest automatically through WiFi and other touchpoints, then turns visits into five-star reviews and repeat business. We serve 500+ locations worldwide, mostly restaurants, bars, hotels, and entertainment venues in the US.

We're a small company. In 2023, we were accepted into the TinySeed accelerator program and raised seed funding. We're growing, our customers stay with us, and we're now making our first sales hire.

MyPlace is a fully remote company. This role is 100% remote, based in Latin America and working US hours. All internal meetings and customer calls happen online.

Why You Should Apply
This is a chance to join as team member #5 and our first Account Executive . You'll work directly with the founder and take over the sales conversations he runs today.

You won't start from zero. Leads are already coming in, we have a sales process in place, and the tools are built. Your job is to take ownership of the opportunities, run great sales conversations, and close deals.

You'll also help us improve the sales process as we grow. As you prove the model, we'll increase lead flow and build the sales team around you.

About the Role
We're looking for an experienced SMB Account Executive who loves selling over the phone, works fast, and knows how to close.

Our outbound email engine and SDR book meetings onto your calendar, while inbound demo requests and free trials come in every week. Your job is to run the calls, manage your pipeline, follow up, and close.

Our customers are restaurant owners, marketing managers, and operators. Plans start at $49 per location per month. Some deals are a single location, while others involve larger groups with multiple locations.

This is a high-volume, phone-first sales role. Many deals can close after a single 15–30 minute conversation, without ever needing a screenshare. Others require a focused demo, additional follow-ups, or conversations with multiple decision-makers.

You need to be comfortable with both. We want someone who can keep simple deals moving quickly, but also knows how to manage more involved opportunities without losing momentum.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities
There are four main parts to the role:

• Sales Conversations: Run 15–30 minute calls, primarily over the phone. Ask good questions, understand how the business operates, uncover problems worth solving, and explain how MyPlace can help. You'll need to be comfortable selling without a screen and confident asking for the sale when the customer is ready.

• Demos and Deal Management: Know when a conversation is enough and when a customer needs to see the product. Run focused screenshare demos when needed, handle objections, and work with multiple stakeholders on larger opportunities. Every deal is different, and you'll need to adapt your approach.

• Follow-Up and Closing: Establish clear next steps, send useful recap emails, and follow up by phone and email to keep opportunities moving. You'll own each deal from the first conversation through to a decision, rather than relying on prospects to come back to you.

• Pipeline and Handover: Manage a high volume of opportunities, keep our CRM (Attio) up to date, and hand won deals over to our onboarding lead. Our dialer, call notes, and AI-drafted follow-ups are already built to help you spend more time selling and less time on admin.

Requirements
You'll have the leads, process, and tools you need, along with weekly call reviews and direct coaching from the founder.

Here's what we're looking for:

• 2+ years of closing experience selling SaaS or other B2B solutions to small businesses, with responsibility for your own quota and pipeline.

• Strong phone-selling skills. You're confident running discovery, explaining value, handling objections, and closing deals without relying on a presentation or lengthy demo.

• Experience with high-volume, short-cycle sales. You're comfortable managing lots of smaller opportunities simultaneously and know how to keep deals moving quickly.

• Good commercial judgment. You can recognize when a customer is ready to buy, when they need a demo, and when a deal requires more conversations or decision-makers.

• Excellent follow-up habits. You don't let deals go quiet. You're proactive about booking next steps, following up, and getting decisions.

• Highly organized and process-driven. You keep your CRM current, manage your time well, and use technology and AI tools to work efficiently.

• Native or near-native English. You'll be speaking with US restaurant owners and operators every day.

• Coachable and open to feedback. You're comfortable reviewing your calls, learning from them, and continuously improving.

• Reliable, fast internet connection and a suitable remote working environment.

Nice to Haves

• Experience selling to restaurants, hospitality businesses, or other owner-operated local businesses.

• Experience selling both single-location and multi-location solutions.

• Based in a time zone that overlaps fully with US business hours.

• Strong SDRs looking to move into an AE role are welcome, provided you've already gained meaningful experience running sales conversations and closing your own deals.

• Experience selling an unknown product, at a small startup brand, in a competitive market

Benefits

• $3,000–$5,000 USD per month OTE, depending on experience.

• Fully remote, full-time, long-term role.

• Foundational position as our first Account Executive, working directly with the founder.

• Steady lead flow from inbound and outbound, with room to scale as you grow.

• Established sales process, dialer, CRM, and AI tools so you can focus on selling, not admin.

• Weekly coaching and call reviews to develop your skills.

• 20 days PTO.

How to Apply
We'd love to hear about your actual sales experience, not just read a résumé.

Along with your application, tell us a little about the types of customers you've sold to, the typical deal sizes and sales cycles you've managed, and how much of your selling was done over the phone.

We're especially interested in people who've consistently closed small-business deals through strong conversations, good follow-up, and a well-managed pipeline.

We're passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region's competitiveness. We're ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Sales Lead to accelerate the growth of Clara Global and strengthen Clara's presence in Argentina. This is a strategic, hands-on Individual Contributor role that combines enterprise sales, business development, and market expansion. You'll be responsible for generating new business, closing high-value opportunities, and helping position Clara as a leading financial technology solution for companies operating across borders.

You'll work closely with our teams in Mexico to identify growth opportunities, develop the market, and build a scalable commercial pipeline.

In this role, you will:

• Own the end-to-end sales cycle for Clara Global, from prospecting and qualification to product demos, negotiation, and closing.

• Drive new business acquisition, identifying and engaging companies that can benefit from Clara's global reimbursement and financial solutions.

• Build and execute a strong outbound strategy, generating a high-quality pipeline through targeted prospecting, referrals, and multi-channel outreach.

• Develop relationships with CFOs, Finance Directors, HR leaders, and other key decision-makers, positioning Clara as a strategic partner.

• Help drive Clara's positioning and expansion in Argentina, identifying market opportunities, building strategic relationships, and increasing brand awareness within the business ecosystem.

• Identify opportunities within our existing customer base to drive product adoption, expansion, and Total Payment Volume (TPV).

• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, Partnerships, and other teams to support go-to-market initiatives and accelerate growth.

• Bring valuable market insights, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to help refine Clara's commercial strategy and product positioning.

• Leverage AI and automation to improve prospecting, account research, outreach personalization, and sales productivity.

• Manage your pipeline and forecasts through HubSpot, using data to prioritize opportunities, track performance, and improve conversion.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

• 5+ years of experience in B2B Sales, Enterprise Sales, Account Executive, or Business Development roles, ideally within fintech, SaaS, payments, or financial services.

• Proven track record of generating pipeline, managing complex sales cycles, and consistently achieving commercial targets.

• Experience selling to C-level executives and senior decision-makers, particularly within Finance, HR, or Operations.

• Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Experience developing new markets, territories, or customer segments, with the ability to build opportunities from scratch.

• Strong understanding of B2B sales processes, pipeline management, and forecasting.

• Hands-on experience with HubSpot or similar CRMs, and prospecting tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Amplemarket, or Apollo.

• Experience using AI tools and automation to improve prospecting, productivity, or commercial workflows.

• Strong analytical mindset, high ownership, and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication skills in Spanish and English.

The Role

As part of a rapidly growing Growth team, we at Reap are looking for a driven, resourceful, and curious New Business & Partnerships to support our LATAM South Cone AmericaS sales and partnership efforts.

As a New Business & Partnerships Manager, you will be generating new business opportunities, leading and developing sales opportunities with clients globally. From comprehending customer requirements to spearheading the growth of Reap’s client base and revenue you will be able to recognize client needs and accordingly provide our value proposition to the client. You will collaborate closely with all internal departments and have direct access to strategic and business decision makers. If you have a business development background, thrive in dynamic environments, and have a passion for building strong relationships with clients, pitching, and driving revenue, we invite you to join us on this meaningful journey.

You will have exposure to global markets (APAC, LATAM, EMEA) and to Reap’s core product lines (Cards-as-a-Service, Payments, Connect). This is an opportunity to learn how modern fintech sales functions operate — from data-driven prospecting to enterprise outreach and market intelligence.

You Will

• Drive revenue for Reap, owning the entire sales cycle from prospecting and lead generation all the way to client launch.

• Understand the pain points and needs of a diverse client base and convey Reap’s multi-pronged value proposition to different stakeholders and decision makers.

• Develop strategies to more effectively qualify leads and close high-quality opportunities

• Grow client base and meet assigned KPIs while forecasting sales revenue accurately and maintaining a strong sales pipeline

• Use CRM software to track and manage lead activities, update customer information, and report on lead generation and conversion metrics

• Adequately represent Reap with a deep understanding of our APIs and product offering while bringing in new product innovation insights from key clients

• Identify emerging markets and market shifts while being fully aware and up to date with new products and competition status

• Build long-term relationships with new and existing customers for upsell opportunities

• Work closely with Implementation Team, Relationship Management and Customer Success teams to ensure a smooth handover and long-term client success.

• Collaborate and drive cross-functional projects that contribute to a better client journey overall.

We Are Looking For Someone With

• Minimum 4 years' of proven success in business development

• Fluency in English and Spanish

• Familiarity with sales performance metrics

• Strong negotiation, presentation and communication skills

• Consistent track record of hitting or exceeding sales targets in a fast-paced environment

• Strong process improvement, cross-functional alignment and follow up skills

• Background in crypto/web3 would be a PLUS

• Experience in selling SaaS or API products would be a PLUS

• Organized and detail-oriented; able to manage multiple tasks and priorities.

• Comfortable working independently and proactively in a fast-paced, remote-friendly environment

• Familiarity with tools such as LinkedIn, Google Sheets, or HubSpot is an advantage.

Nice To Have

• Experience with lead generation, sales operations, or startup internships.

• Knowledge of crypto, digital assets, or blockchain-based financial products.

• Passion for technology and a strong learning mindset.

• A sense of curiosity and initiative — you’re not afraid to figure things out from first principles.
