postings.title: Especialista de Producto - Upgrades
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description Summary

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

Modalidad: Híbrida

Job Description

El Especialista de Producto de Upgrades será responsable de impulsar la venta de actualizaciones tecnológicas para la base instalada de equipos de GE HealthCare en distintos países, enfocado en soluciones por imagen, pricipalmente Resonancia Magnética. Estas soluciones permiten modernizar equipos médicos instalados, incorporar nuevas capacidades tecnológicas y extender su vida útil, brindando al cliente una alternativa de valor frente a la compra de un equipo completamente nuevo.

La persona será el referente técnico-clínico del portafolio y trabajará de manera cercana con los equipos comerciales para identificar equipos con potencial de actualización, comprender las necesidades de los clientes, generar propuestas de valor, desarrollar y presentar propuestas de soluciones y presupuestos, y responder a las preguntas de los clientes para cerrar con éxito ventas de soluciones clínicas/técnicas cada vez más complejas.

Responsabilidades Claves

• Rendimiento financiero (P&L)

• Es responsable de lograr los pedidos de productos / soluciones / servicios y el objetivo de OP de ventas para los territorios asignados.

• Proporcionar información para la estrategia de precios de las transacciones y garantizar el cumplimiento de los precios para las oportunidades del segmento.

• Mantener actualizado el forecast de órdenes y ventas, y realizar seguimiento desde la firma del contrato hasta la entrega de la solución.

• Contribuir al retention rate, promoviendo soluciones que permitan a los clientes actualizar sus equipos GE HealthCare

• Gestión de cuentas y territorios

• Crear planes de negocios para territorios/cuentas asignadas que incluyen, entre otros, desarrollo de oportunidades, estrategias competitivas y objetivos.

• Construir relaciones comerciales sólidas y formular estrategias y planes de cuentas para fortalecer continuamente las relaciones dentro de las cuentas / territorio asignados. Identifique y responda a las necesidades de los responsables de la toma de decisiones departamentales y técnicas de cuentas clave y mantenga registros de contacto con los clientes en las herramientas de CRM relevantes.

• Desarrollar y mejorar continuamente una red de líderes de opinión clave dentro del territorio asignado.

• Rastrear y comunicar las tendencias del mercado hacia / desde el campo, incluidos los datos de la competencia, y desarrollar y liderar contraestrategias efectivas.

• Trabajar con los equipos comerciales para priorizar cuentas, organizar visitas y desarrollar oportunidades en Argentina y los demás países asignados.

• Experiencia en productos y mercados

• Mantener actualizado un conocimiento detallado de las soluciones de upgrades, principalmente de Resonancia Magnética, Tomografía y Rayos X.

• Presentar los beneficios técnicos, clínicos y financieros de las actualizaciones tecnológicas en términos relevantes para cada cliente.

• Mantener actualizado el conocimiento del mercado y de la competencia relacionado con sus soluciones/servicios.

• Actualizar continuamente su comprensión de los problemas y desafíos clínicos y/o operativos cambiantes de los clientes.

• Diseñar configuraciones viables que modernicen los equipos, extiendan su vida útil y mantengan un margen óptimo para GE.

• Representar a la empresa en conferencias médicas y exposiciones técnicas relevantes para promover el producto / solución y la empresa.

• Gestión de oportunidades

• Identificar y crear nuevas oportunidades y trabajar con los líderes de ventas y los equipos de cuentas (cuando corresponda) para aumentar continuamente el embudo de clientes potenciales.

• Impulsar el proceso de licitación, incluida la calificación de las necesidades, la selección de proveedores, la cotización y el cierre de sus oportunidades para cumplir con los pedidos, las ventas y los objetivos de margen, así como para maximizar la satisfacción del cliente en el territorio asignado.

• Liderar el proceso técnico-comercial, desde la identificación de necesidades y configuración de la solución hasta la presentación, negociación y cierre.

• Crear y mantener oportunidades en funnel en SalesForce.com.

• Asegurar la exactitud de las configuraciones y de la información técnica registrada al momento de ingresar una orden.

• Estimar la fecha de entrega al cliente con base en el conocimiento de los programas de producción y entrega de la compañía, asegurando que el cumplimiento del pedido esté de acuerdo con las expectativas del cliente y mejore la satisfacción del cliente.

Requisitos Obligatorios

• Experiencia previa en la industria de la salud.

• 5 años de experiencia técnica o clínica trabajando directamente con soluciones de diagnóstico por imágenes (foco en RM)

• Nivel de inglés intermedio (B1 o B2), verbal y escrito.

• Manejo intermedio de Excel (tablas dinámicas)

• Título universitario en Ingeniería Biomédica, Ingeniería Electrónica, Bioimágenes, Diagnóstico por Imágenes o carreras afines.

• Contar con licencia de conducción vigente

• Tener disponibilidad para viajar aproximadamente un 30% del tiempo

Calificaciones preferidas (Plus)

Account Manager – Argentina
Location: Greater Buenos Aires, Argentina
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Model: Hybrid, with regular travel within Argentina

About Sigenergy
Sigenergy develops intelligent solar, energy storage and EV charging solutions for residential, commercial and industrial applications. Our technologies integrate energy storage, power electronics, digital platforms and artificial intelligence to deliver safe, efficient and user-friendly energy solutions.We are looking for a results-oriented Account Manager to help launch and grow Sigenergy’s business in Argentina.

The Role
The Account Manager will be responsible for developing customers, channel partners and a qualified sales pipeline across Argentina. This is a hands-on business-development position for someone who understands the local solar and energy market and can convert relationships into orders and sustainable partnerships.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and develop distributors, wholesalers, EPC companies, installers, integrators and strategic customers.
- Build and manage a qualified pipeline across residential, commercial and industrial segments.
- Achieve agreed sales, revenue and partner-development targets.
- Conduct customer visits, product presentations, commercial negotiations and partner reviews.
- Develop key accounts and establish long-term relationships with decision-makers.
- Support partner onboarding, training, product launches and joint marketing activities.
- Work closely with technical teams to develop appropriate solutions for customer requirements.
- Prepare quotations, commercial proposals, forecasts and regular pipeline reports.
- Monitor competitors, pricing, market trends and customer feedback.
- Support payment collection and manage commercial risk within company policies.
- Represent Sigenergy at trade shows, conferences and customer events.

Qualifications
- At least four years of successful B2B sales or business-development experience.
- Relevant experience in solar PV, energy storage, inverters, electrical equipment or related technologies.
- Demonstrable sales results and experience developing customers in Argentina.
- Existing relationships with distributors, EPCs, installers or energy-sector customers are strongly preferred.
- Ability to understand technical products and translate their value into commercial benefits.
- Strong prospecting, negotiation, account-management and closing skills.
- Self-motivated, structured and comfortable working in a market-entry environment.
- Native or fluent Spanish and professional working proficiency in English.
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or a related field is preferred.
- Availability to travel regularly within Argentina.

What We Offer
- The opportunity to play a central role in launching Sigenergy in Argentina.
- An innovative and competitive clean-energy product portfolio.
- Direct exposure to regional and global teams.
- Career growth based on demonstrated results and leadership potential.
- Competitive compensation with performance-based sales incentives.
If you know Argentina’s solar and energy ecosystem and enjoy creating business from the ground up, we would like to hear from you.

Ubicación: Gran Buenos Aires, Argentina
Modalidad de contratación: Tiempo completo
Modalidad de trabajo: Híbrida, con viajes frecuentes dentro de Argentina

Acerca de Sigenergy
Sigenergy desarrolla soluciones inteligentes de energía solar, almacenamiento y carga de vehículos eléctricos para aplicaciones residenciales, comerciales e industriales. Nuestras tecnologías integran almacenamiento, electrónica de potencia, plataformas digitales e inteligencia artificial para ofrecer soluciones energéticas seguras, eficientes y fáciles de utilizar.
Buscamos un Gerente de Ventas orientado a resultados para contribuir al lanzamiento y crecimiento de Sigenergy en Argentina.

El rol
La persona seleccionada será responsable de desarrollar clientes, canales comerciales y un pipeline de oportunidades calificadas en Argentina. Es una posición práctica de ventas y desarrollo de negocios para alguien que conozca el mercado solar y energético local y pueda convertir relaciones en pedidos y alianzas sostenibles.

Responsabilidades principales
- Identificar y desarrollar distribuidores, mayoristas, empresas EPC, instaladores, integradores y clientes estratégicos.

- Cumplir los objetivos acordados de ventas, ingresos y desarrollo de socios.

- Apoyar la incorporación y capacitación de socios, lanzamientos de producto y acciones conjuntas de marketing.
- Trabajar con los equipos técnicos para desarrollar soluciones adecuadas a las necesidades de cada cliente.
- Preparar cotizaciones, propuestas comerciales, pronósticos de ventas e informes periódicos del pipeline.
- Monitorear competidores, precios, tendencias de mercado y feedback de los clientes.
- Colaborar en la gestión de cobranzas y riesgos comerciales de acuerdo con las políticas de la empresa.
- Representar a Sigenergy en ferias, conferencias y eventos con clientes.
Requisitos
- Al menos cuatro años de experiencia exitosa en ventas B2B o desarrollo de negocios.
- Experiencia relevante en energía solar, almacenamiento, inversores, equipamiento eléctrico o tecnologías relacionadas.
- Resultados comerciales demostrables y experiencia desarrollando clientes en Argentina.
- Se valorará especialmente contar con relaciones existentes con distribuidores, EPCs, instaladores o clientes del sector energético.

About the Role

We're looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Compliance Operations Coordinator to support Postscript's Compliance team. In this role, you'll provide the operational foundation for our compliance audit program by coordinating documentation, tracking audit progress, managing deliverables, and ensuring effective communication across internal stakeholders.
You'll partner closely with Compliance Specialists to keep audits organized, accurate, and on schedule. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in process-driven environments, takes pride in precision, and is interested in building expertise in compliance operations within a fast-growing technology company.

What You'll Do
Audit Documentation & Coordination

• Collect, organize, and maintain audit documentation, including screenshots of opt-in experiences and other merchant-facing compliance elements, using internal tools and manual processes as needed.

• Create and manage structured Google Drive folders for each audit engagement, ensuring documentation is clearly labeled, accessible, and current.

• Prepare and maintain audit materials using standardized templates to ensure consistency and accuracy across all engagements.

• Review audits against established checklists, identify missing information or discrepancies, and escalate findings to the assigned Compliance Specialist.

• Support audit execution by ensuring all required documentation and deliverables are completed on time.

Customer Deliverables & Reporting

• Create clear, professional audit outcome reports and presentations based on findings provided by the Compliance Specialist team.

• Ensure customer-facing materials meet Postscript's quality standards for accuracy, organization, and presentation.

• Maintain version control and proper filing of finalized audit deliverables and supporting documentation.

Communication & Project Support

• Coordinate with internal teams to initiate audits, gather required information, and drive completion of outstanding action items.

• Track progress across active audit engagements and proactively communicate delays, blockers, or at-risk items.

• Serve as a primary point of contact for routine audit-related inquiries, escalating more complex questions to the appropriate Compliance Specialist.

• Help maintain visibility into audit timelines, priorities, and deliverable status.

Process Improvement

• Execute established audit workflows and procedures with a high degree of accuracy and consistency.

• Identify process gaps, documentation issues, or workflow inefficiencies and escalate recommendations for improvement.

• Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of audit templates, tracking systems, documentation standards, and operational processes as the team grows.

What We're Looking For
Required Qualifications

• Minimum 3 years of experience in an operations coordinator, administrative support, project coordination, or similar role.

• Experience in SaaS, ecommerce, compliance, legal operations, or a related environment is a plus.

• Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.

• Proficiency with Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Slides, and Sheets), including managing documentation and folder structures at scale.

• Strong written communication skills with the ability to draft professional emails and follow-up communications for internal and external stakeholders.

• Comfortable working within structured processes, checklists, and workflows while proactively identifying issues and escalating when appropriate.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and maintain visibility across several ongoing projects.

• Quick learner who is comfortable adopting new tools and navigating web-based platforms to gather and organize information.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience creating customer-facing presentations in Google Slides or Microsoft PowerPoint with strong formatting and visual organization skills.

• Familiarity with compliance, legal, regulatory, risk, or audit-related functions.

• Experience in a customer-facing support, onboarding, account coordination, or operations role.

• Experience working successfully within a remote or distributed team environment.

postings.title: Operations Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
Job Description: Operations Coordinator OPERATIONS COORDINATOR
at AtlasBrands | Remote - Worldwide

About AtlasBrands We’re building and scaling high-velocity DTC brands. In just a few months, we scaled from $0 to $3M MRR and from a team of 3 to a team of ~30. We’re now pushing toward 9 figures — and building a world-class team of A+ talent that can support, sustain, and accelerate that level of growth. At this stage, growth is no longer just about products or marketing. It’s about people. The next phase of this company will be defined by who we bring in — the quality of talent, the speed at which we hire, and the systems we build around it.
Role Objective We are seeking a highly organized, proactive Operations Coordinator to serve as the direct right hand to our Head of Operations & Finance. In this role, you will act as the operational glue that keeps our logistics, supply chain, back-office finance, and legal documentation running flawlessly.
This position requires a rare blend of extreme attention to detail and radical resourcefulness. You will own the follow-through on complex workflows, ensuring data never slips through the cracks and tasks keep moving seamlessly across international vendors and cross-functional teams.
What You’ll Do
• Supply Chain & Logistics Execution: Stay entirely on top of high-volume order fulfillment, global shipments, and proactive inventory follow-ups. Own daily communications with our suppliers and third-party fulfillment (3PL) partners to guarantee seamless operational loops.

• Finance & Payroll Support: Administer critical back-office operations including tracking vendor invoices, reconciling operational expenses, and preparing payroll or vendor payments for final executive approval.

• Legal Coordination & Compliance: Serve as the internal traffic controller for legal workflows. Coordinate contract routing, secure digital signatures, organize corporate documentation, and manage ongoing follow-ups with our external legal counsel.

• Data Architecture & Tracker Governance: Build, optimize, and ruthlessly maintain project trackers. Ensure data integrity across multiple systems so that leadership has absolute visibility into inventory, timelines, and legal statuses.

• Independent Problem Solving: Act as an internal investigator. When a shipment delays or an invoice mismatches, you will independently research the root cause, propose practical solutions, and see the fix through to completion with minimal oversight.

Required Skills and Qualifications
• Experience: Proven track record in an operations, logistics, or project coordination role—ideally within a fast-moving e-commerce or startup environment.

• Data & Technical Tools: High proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets. You must be entirely comfortable working with complex formulas, large datasets, and rigorous data reconciliations.

• Execution & Follow-Through: Elite organizational skills. A natural ability to manage multiple moving parts simultaneously without losing momentum or dropping details.

• Communication & Drive: Exceptional written and verbal English communication. You are a proactive, zero-friction communicator who knows how to get answers from global vendors and internal team members alike.

• Mindset: A resourceful "finder of answers." You don't just point out operational roadblocks—you dig into the details, suggest structural solutions, and take pride in total ownership.

Working Hours & Culture
• Role Timeline: Full-time hire (~40 hours per week).

• Async-First: Global, remote-first team setup requiring core daily overlap with US EST business hours for team syncs and cross-functional alignment. For offshore hires, you must be willing to overlap at least 4+ EST hours (between 9am–5pm EST).

How to Apply & What to Expect At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.
Here is exactly how our application workflow operates through our platform:

• Step 1: Submit Your CV
Click the "Apply Now" button below to submit your CV along with a brief overview of the operational systems or inventory trackers you have managed.

• Step 2: Initial Screening & Video Intro
Our recruiting team will conduct a brief initial screening call to evaluate your communication style, structural organization frameworks, and problem-solving agility.

• Step 3: Paid Assessment
Complete a paid operational or data assessment that the hiring team will use to assess core skills and determine final steps.

• Step 4: The 45-Minute Strategic Deep Dive
Selected candidates will join two members of our leadership team for 45-minute conversational interviews.

No third party or agency submissions will be accepted.
AtlasBrands is an equal opportunity employer.

Job Description
As a Back Office Analyst, you will be helping to reduce risk exposure by verifying the identities of new customers. You will be preventing unscrupulous individuals from using financial businesses for illegal transactions.

Your Responsibilities

• Monitor and analyze incoming customer financial transactions in accordance with AML (Anti-Money Laundering) regulations, ensuring adherence to local and international compliance standards.

• Investigate and resolve payment-related issues, including failed deposits, delays, and duplicate transactions.

• Perform customer account reviews and verify player identities through KYC (Know Your Customer) procedures.

• Collect, validate, and archive KYC and SOF (Source of Funds) documentation in line with regulatory and internal policies.

• Identify, investigate, and escalate suspicious activity, potential fraud, and chargebacks to relevant teams.

• Conduct ongoing risk assessments of customer accounts, payment behaviors, and transactional anomalies.

• Process deposits, withdrawals, and internal transfer requests promptly and accurately, ensuring all transactions meet security and policy standards.

• Provide support to Customer Support and Compliance teams on cashier-related queries and escalations.

• Ensure full confidentiality, accuracy, and compliance in handling customer data and financial information, in line with GDPR and PCI DSS standards.

What we are looking for:

• Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

• Capable of performing well under pressure and consistently meeting tight deadlines.

• Exceptional attention to detail and keen observational abilities.

• Highly analytical, with the capacity to interpret data and detect patterns or anomalies.

• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with a proactive mindset.

• Confident in making sound decisions based on available information and risk assessment.

• Flexibility to work in rotating shifts, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.

• Proficient in computer use, with the ability to quickly adapt to new tools and systems.

• Demonstrates high levels of trustworthiness, accountability, and conscientiousness in handling sensitive financial and personal data.

What's in it for YOU?

• Excellent work environment

• Attractive salary package

• Annual incentive Bonus

• Monetary vouchers on Birthdays and other special occasions

• Options to enroll in Company's medical insurance plan

• Exciting company activities including monthly lunches, monthly corporate gatherings, competitions, daily snacks and many other activities.

• Casual Dress Code

• A chance to advance professionally inside one of the world's largest iGaming organisations.

What it's like to work at SkillOnNet!
SkillOnNet believes that people come first, and our "family-oriented" global culture is what drives us. We care about our employees and make certain that they have access to the most relevant and helpful tools, benefits.

postings.title: Associate Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Overview Of Position

The Associate Operations Analyst supports client and community onboarding for Assurant’s Renters business, helping move requests from intake through production launch. In this role, you will configure information across internal systems, coordinate with Business, Operations, and IT partners, test solutions, troubleshoot issues, and help ensure each implementation is accurate and delivered on time.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional who is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and interested in developing skills across operations, systems, testing, analytics, and stakeholder management.

What makes us different?

• Your work has direct business impact: faster, accurate onboarding helps communities go live and supports premium growth.

• You will gain cross-functional exposure by partnering with Business, Operations, IT/development, and Global Housing leaders.

• You will receive structured, hands-on training from the manager and experienced team members.

• You can build practical experience with operational analytics, testing, troubleshooting, process improvement, and production support.

• You will join a collaborative team that encourages questions, recognizes improvement ideas, and supports long-term career development within Assurant.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

• Support the end-to-end onboarding of clients and communities, from request intake through production launch.

• Review onboarding requests and accurately configure community and client information across multiple internal systems and applications.

• Manage tickets, priorities, and deliverables while meeting service-level expectations and escalating risks or blockers early.

• Partner with Business, Operations, IT/development, and other internal teams to clarify requirements and resolve implementation or production issues.

• Perform user acceptance testing, regression testing, peer reviews, audits, and maintenance activities to support high-quality launches.

• Troubleshoot service and system issues, identify root causes, recommend solutions, and coordinate timely resolution.

• Maintain clear documentation and status updates, and contribute to onboarding reporting for leadership.

• Participate in daily team huddles, training, knowledge sharing, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

• Up to 2 years of relevant professional experience in operations, implementation, production support, business analysis, systems support, quality assurance, or a related environment. Equivalent internship or early-career experience will be considered.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with US-based and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple requests in a high-volume environment.

• Strong computer literacy and working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel.

• Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and communicate recommended actions.

• Ability to work with urgency, maintain accuracy under deadlines, and take ownership of tasks through completion.

• Ability to learn new systems, applications, processes, and technical concepts quickly.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

• A bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Exposure to SQL, Postman, SOAP UI, system integrations, APIs, or application-support tools.

• Experience with user acceptance testing, regression testing, requirements documentation, ticket management, or production support.

• Experience in insurance, insurtech, financial services, property-management technology, SaaS, shared services, or another technology-enabled operational environment.

• Experience working with performance measures, service-level agreements, operational KPIs, standard operating procedures, or process-improvement initiatives.

• A collaborative mindset, curiosity, adaptability, and confidence asking questions or escalating issues when needed.

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?

General office demands. This Argentina-based position supports a US business team and requires schedule alignment with US operating hours. The final work arrangement and specific schedule will be communicated during the recruiting process.

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World

Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?

Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Company Overview

Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

AI and Biometric Usage

Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

Job Scam Alert

Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords. Learn more about what to look out for and how to report a scam here.

postings.title: Associate Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Overview Of Position

The Associate Operations Analyst supports client and community onboarding for Assurant’s Renters business, helping move requests from intake through production launch. In this role, you will configure information across internal systems, coordinate with Business, Operations, and IT partners, test solutions, troubleshoot issues, and help ensure each implementation is accurate and delivered on time.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional who is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and interested in developing skills across operations, systems, testing, analytics, and stakeholder management.

What makes us different?

• Your work has direct business impact: faster, accurate onboarding helps communities go live and supports premium growth.

• You will gain cross-functional exposure by partnering with Business, Operations, IT/development, and Global Housing leaders.

• You will receive structured, hands-on training from the manager and experienced team members.

• You can build practical experience with operational analytics, testing, troubleshooting, process improvement, and production support.

• You will join a collaborative team that encourages questions, recognizes improvement ideas, and supports long-term career development within Assurant.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

• Support the end-to-end onboarding of clients and communities, from request intake through production launch.

• Review onboarding requests and accurately configure community and client information across multiple internal systems and applications.

• Manage tickets, priorities, and deliverables while meeting service-level expectations and escalating risks or blockers early.

• Partner with Business, Operations, IT/development, and other internal teams to clarify requirements and resolve implementation or production issues.

• Perform user acceptance testing, regression testing, peer reviews, audits, and maintenance activities to support high-quality launches.

• Troubleshoot service and system issues, identify root causes, recommend solutions, and coordinate timely resolution.

• Maintain clear documentation and status updates, and contribute to onboarding reporting for leadership.

• Participate in daily team huddles, training, knowledge sharing, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

• Up to 2 years of relevant professional experience in operations, implementation, production support, business analysis, systems support, quality assurance, or a related environment. Equivalent internship or early-career experience will be considered.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with US-based and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple requests in a high-volume environment.

• Strong computer literacy and working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel.

• Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and communicate recommended actions.

• Ability to work with urgency, maintain accuracy under deadlines, and take ownership of tasks through completion.

• Ability to learn new systems, applications, processes, and technical concepts quickly.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

• A bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Exposure to SQL, Postman, SOAP UI, system integrations, APIs, or application-support tools.

• Experience with user acceptance testing, regression testing, requirements documentation, ticket management, or production support.

• Experience in insurance, insurtech, financial services, property-management technology, SaaS, shared services, or another technology-enabled operational environment.

• Experience working with performance measures, service-level agreements, operational KPIs, standard operating procedures, or process-improvement initiatives.

• A collaborative mindset, curiosity, adaptability, and confidence asking questions or escalating issues when needed.

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?

General office demands. This Argentina-based position supports a US business team and requires schedule alignment with US operating hours. The final work arrangement and specific schedule will be communicated during the recruiting process.

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World

Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?

Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Company Overview

Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

AI and Biometric Usage

Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

Job Scam Alert

Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords. Learn more about what to look out for and how to report a scam here.

postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

Wholesale Lending Services (WLS) serves Asset & Wealth Management, the Consumer & Community Bank and the Commercial & Investment Bank as an integrated partner, delivering end-to-end product support for syndicated and bilateral loan operations. We utilize our deep industry knowledge and unrivaled experience to help clients navigate federal regulations, ensuring compliance at origination, funding and throughout the life of the loan.

Currently present in over 30 locations, WLS is planning an expansion into Buenos Aires and is looking for candidates who can support this strategic initiative and manage the functions in scope.

This position offers opportunity for career growth and skill enhancement, as you collaborate with a dynamic team to ensure the integrity of our loan portfolio. Join us to make a significant impact and advance your career in a supportive and innovative environment. As a Collateral Services Analyst within our team, your work ensures the smooth functioning of our lending services, contributing to the overall loan lifecycle. You will engage with internal and external stakeholders, leveraging your skills in conflict management and critical thinking to resolve potential issues and deliver quality results.

Our team is dedicated to maintaining the quality of our loan portfolio through meticulous collateral management. You will be part of a collaborative environment that values resilience, time management, and stakeholder engagement.

Job Responsibilities

• Process and maintain loan collateral documentation by adhering to established guidelines and procedures, ensuring accuracy and compliance.

• Update and reconcile deal details across applicable systems; ensure information is entered timely and accurately.

• Assist with attestations and updates to procedures and supporting documents pertaining to team functions.

• Review closed loan packages for WLS-supported business to confirm required documentation is present and aligns with regulatory and compliance requirements.

• Participate in staff and partner meetings.

• Identify documentation exceptions and communicate with internal and external partners; track items through resolution.

• Understand and adhere to Bank policies and procedures. Adhere to compliance and regulatory requirements.

• Participate in projects and working groups as required.

• Provide continuous improvement ideas to the overall Upload/DR/Doc Collection review process.

• Customer service oriented – must be comfortable communicating with internal/external clients on the phone and via email; possess a desire to own and resolve issues.

• Communicate any inadequacies or issues to Manager, supporting proactive management and resolution.

• Other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• Advanced level of English.

• Bachelors degree.

• Experience in conflict management, resolution of issues and maintaining positive stakeholder relationships.

• Critical thinking skills, enhancing the ability to analyze situations and make informed decisions.

• Attention to detail and organizational skills for efficient loan processing and management.

• Sense of urgency; seek out and adapt to best practices and improvement

• Strong internal and external customer service skills. Team Oriented- Readily shares information with peers and managers; can teach others; willing to assist wherever needed; works toward team success and goals.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• Knowledge in commercial lending loan documentation, enabling understanding and processing of agreements is preferred, but not mandatory.

• 1-2 years of prior operations experience in a banking or financial services industry is preferred.

• Stakeholder management and emotional intelligence, fostering strong relationships and effective collaboration.

• Ability to manage time effectively and maintain resilience in challenging situations, ensuring consistent performance and productivity.

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. • Demonstrated experience managing complex calendars, scheduling priorities, domestic and international travel arrangements, itineraries, and executive meeting logistics

• Experience supporting executives, including managing expenses, travel budgets, confidential correspondence, and day-to-day administrative priorities

• Strong executive communication skills, including drafting correspondence, preparing briefing materials, meeting agendas, executive summaries and presentation content for senior stakeholders

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and Teams, with the ability to prepare executive presentations and reporting materials.

• Understanding of budget coordination, expense tracking, and financial administration processes with strong attention to accuracy and detail

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build trusted relationships and work collaboratively with executives, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. Responsibilities

Working closely with the Office Manager and regional functions across Human Resources/People, Finance and Procurement, you will be part of a collaborative, service-oriented team that takes pride in delivering a great employee experience and contributing to a well-organised, efficient and welcoming workplace.

Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Calendar & Scheduling

• Manage the owner's calendar with consistent color coding, time blocking, and protected focus time

• Confirm every meeting's time, attendees, link, and purpose at least 24 hours in advance

• Use Claude's calendar connector to prepare daily and weekly calendar summaries, then check them against the real calendar before they go out

• Coordinate personal appointments and travel where the placement includes it

Inbox & Communication

• Triage the inbox daily: handle routine items, draft what needs the owner's voice, and escalate what needs their decision

• Draft outbound email through Claude in the practice's brand voice and review every draft before sending

• Follow a defined escalation matrix with set response windows for urgent, same-day, and routine items

Tasks, Projects, Meetings & Reporting

• Build meeting agendas in Claude from what's open on the tracker

• Create presentations and slide decks for the owner's meetings, trainings, and partner conversations

• Turn meeting notetaker transcripts into same-day recaps with action items assigned to the right people

• Deliver a Daily Summary and Weekly Summary so the owner never has to ask what happened

• Pull reports from the practice's CRM, EMR, or spreadsheets and spot-check the numbers before they go anywhere

Practice Coordination & Administrative Support

• Follow up with patients and clients after interactions and close the loop

• Support referrals, waitlists, and scheduling-related workflows

• Handle invoices, PTO tracking, vendor coordination, and compliance reminders

• Write and maintain SOPs for recurring work

• For practices that include it, monitor social platforms and Google and Yelp reviews, and draft responses for the owner's approval

Claude Environment

• Keep the practice's brand voice file current as the practice changes

• Bring real drafts to weekly coaching calls and refine the environment based on what's working

• Maintain strict HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality at all times. Claude never contacts a patient or staff member without your review

Requirements

Required

• Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or similar role supporting a business owner or leader

• Hands-on experience using AI tools for real work

• Strong project coordination and task management skills, with a track record of moving work from assigned to done

• Excellent time management and the ability to prioritize competing deadlines without dropping anything

• Strong presentation skills, including building clear, polished slide decks

• Excellent written English. You'll review and send communication in a business owner's voice every day

• Strong judgment about what to handle on your own and what to escalate

• Comfort working in Google Workspace or Microsoft 365

• Ability to work independently and keep steady communication with the practice owner

• Willingness to complete Rockstar's confidentiality and compliance training before your start date

Preferred

• Familiarity with EMR platforms such as Prompt, WebPT, or Raintree, or CRMs such as HubSpot or Zoho

• Experience with project management tools such as Asana or Monday.com

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

• Judgment: you know what to handle, what to draft, and what to escalate, and you don't escalate out of caution

• Follow-through: if it's not written down and tracked, it isn't handled. You close every loop

• Discretion: you handle the owner's information and patients' information with care, and only share it with the people who need it

postings.title: Executive Assistant (Inflection Club)
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Inflection Club is a private co-investment community for accredited investors, operators, and family offices who want direct access to pre-IPO deals in the companies shaping the future. Built under Catalyst Capital Holdings, we provide curated access from early to late-stage opportunities that traditionally only flow to endowments, pension funds, and institutional allocators - names like Anthropic, Polymarket, Kraken, and Lovable.

Our thesis is simple: the biggest returns of the next decade will come from companies built on the cost curves of artificial intelligence, robotics, longevity, and next-generation infrastructure. Every deal goes through institutional-grade diligence and is executed as a Reg D 506(c) SPV. No blind pools. No lock-ups. Just rigorous deal flow, presented with conviction.

The Role

The Executive Assistant supports the Director of Community & Operations and the Director of Investments - the two leaders who run the member experience and the investment engine. You will own their calendars, inboxes, follow-ups, and meeting logistics so they spend their time on members and deals, not on coordination.

This is not an order-taking role. We need someone who anticipates what each Director needs next, keeps projects moving without being chased, and protects their time with sound judgment. You will work across both seats, balancing competing priorities and surfacing conflicts early. You will handle confidential member and deal information with complete discretion.

You are not the decision-maker on investments, member policy, or legal matters. You are the person who makes sure the people who decide are prepared, on time, and never dropping a thread.

What You'll Own

• Calendar & Inbox Management

• Manage both Directors' calendars: scheduling, prioritizing, resolving conflicts, and protecting focus time

• Triage inboxes: draft replies, flag what needs a decision, and close loops on follow-ups

• Coordinate across time zones with members, founders, co-investors, and counsel

• Meeting & Roundtable Support

• Prepare agendas, briefing notes, and materials ahead of Investment Committee sessions, member calls, and Roundtable events

• Take notes, capture decisions and action items, and distribute them the same day

• Track every action item to completion, with owners and dates

• Project & Task Coordination

• Keep each Director's priorities, deadlines, and open items visible and current in ClickUp and Slack

• Follow up with team members, outside counsel, and vendors on deliverables

• Support deal logistics for the Director of Investments: diligence request lists, document collection, and IC and SPV-close timelines. You coordinate; legal sits with outside counsel

• Member & Community Operations Support

• Support the Director of Community & Operations with member communications, onboarding logistics, event coordination, and member requests

• Keep member-facing scheduling and follow-ups on time and on brand

• Maintain accurate member and meeting records in HubSpot with the CRM Coordinator

• Reporting & Briefings

• Prepare a weekly priorities and open-items brief for each Director

• Compile summaries, trackers, and updates for leadership - signal, not noise

• Travel, Events & Admin

• Arrange travel, offsites, and in-person member events

• Handle expenses, subscriptions, and administrative requests accurately and on time

• Supporting directors with special projects/ ad-hoc queries e.g. reaching out to podcast guests, partners, research etc

• Supporting the team with ad-hoc queries if needed

Requirements

Who You Are

• 3+ years as an executive assistant, chief of staff associate, or operations coordinator supporting senior leaders - ideally more than one at once

• You operate with urgency. Our customers rely on us to always meet our deadlines

• You anticipate. You notice what is coming next week and have already prepared for it

• You write clearly and concisely - emails and briefs people act on without a second read

• You are expert in Google Workspace, Slack, and calendar management across time zones; comfortable learning ClickUp and HubSpot quickly

• You exercise discretion. You handle confidential member, financial, and deal information with complete care

• You are async-first and reliable in a fast-moving, distributed team. You do not need to be chased, and you over-communicate status

• You exercise judgment on priorities and escalate the right things at the right time

Bonus Points

• Experience supporting leaders in venture capital, private equity, financial services, or private membership organizations

• Familiarity with Web3, DeFi, or crypto-adjacent audiences

• Exposure to investor relations, SPV workflows, or regulated communications

• Experience with ClickUp, Slack automation, n8n, or AI-assisted workflows

Benefits

Benefits

• Fully remote - work from anywhere

• Flexible, async-first culture with deep focus time built in

• Competitive independent contractor rate commensurate with experience

• Direct exposure to institutional-grade deal flow and a high-calibre investor community

• Ground-floor opportunity in a private co-investment club being built to scale

Are You Ready?

This is a rare opportunity to sit at the center of a private investment community that is growing fast and playing for the long game, working side by side with the leaders who run it. If you are the kind of person who is three steps ahead of the calendar and wants to be part of something built to last - we want to hear from you.

Apply with your CV in English, along with a brief note on how you manage competing priorities for more than one executive and one process you improved end-to-end. We move quickly and will be in touch with shortlisted candidates within two weeks.

The two founders, best friends, were running businesses that needed great talent fast. So, they started building remote teams across countries like the Philippines, Colombia, and India. That’s where you come in.

You thrive on structure in a changing environment, you’re comfortable escalating a question before it becomes a problem, and you don’t let a referral slip through the cracks. Why ClearDesk?
Because we believe work should be meaningful, even from home.
At ClearDesk, you’ll work with clients who respect your time and value your skills. You’ll join a remote-first team that genuinely supports you, and you’ll see the impact of your work in real, tangible ways that matter to the people you work with.
We don’t just want you to do your job. We want you to grow with us, stay with us, and feel proud of the difference you’re making.

Here’s what you can expect from us:

Ready to be part of something that matters?
Apply now and start your journey with ClearDesk.

The single goal of this role is to buy back the CEO's time.

This role is focused on the business. Household and family logistics are handled by a separate on-site Life Manager.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Calendar and priorities
- Own and defend the CEO's calendar. Build the day around his highest-value work (content, high-value sales calls, consultations) and hold him to it.
- Run a daily priority list so nothing important gets pushed aside by noise.
- Triage the inbox and messages: handle what you can, flag what needs him, and close loops.

Removing bottlenecks
- Track every deliverable, approval and decision waiting on the CEO, including creative strategy for client ad accounts, and drive turnaround so client work does not stall.
- Act as the single intake point for company reporting: collect, review and present short digests instead of passing raw reports through.
- Coordinate follow-ups across the team so approvals and decisions keep moving.

Sales, content and offers support
- Schedule and prepare high-value sales calls, consultations and coaching calls: briefing notes beforehand, CRM updates and follow-ups afterwards.
- Keep the social media content pipeline on schedule: recording blocks, coordination with editors and the team, and the publishing calendar.
- Support the launch and delivery of new offers (coaching, consultations): scheduling, documents and logistics.

Travel and administration
- Book business travel and build itineraries.
- Handle business admin: documents, agreements, expense tracking.

Systems and tools
- Build and maintain the operating layer: trackers, SOPs, checklists and recurring process documentation.
- Expected fluency: Google Workspace, Slack, a project management tool (ClickUp, Notion or equivalent), a CRM, spreadsheets, and daily use of AI assistants.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In the first 90 days you have taken the calendar, inbox triage and reporting flow off the CEO's plate, there is a live tracker of everything waiting on him, and client creative work no longer sits on his desk for weeks.
By 6-12 months you are the CEO's right hand: the business runs on a weekly rhythm you built, nothing depends on him remembering it, and his time goes to content and high-value sales.

Requirements

IDEAL CANDIDATE
- 3+ years as an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff or equivalent to a founder, CEO or senior executive, ideally in a fast-growing or entrepreneurial company.
- Proven remote experience: you have run an executive's day without being in the room.
- Fluent professional English, written and spoken.
- Able to work US Eastern Time business hours consistently, with reliable internet and a quiet workspace.
- Strong administrative and operational backbone. You build systems, you don't just follow them.
- Exceptional discretion with confidential business and financial information.
- Tech-savvy: you master Google Workspace, Slack, a project management tool (ClickUp, Notion or equivalent), a CRM, spreadsheets, and daily use of AI assistants.

You will thrive here if
- You are direct, unflappable and comfortable with a straightforward, high-energy, fast-moving principal. Feedback is candid and immediate, and nothing is personal.
- You are willing to push back and tell the CEO what he needs to hear. He wants a partner who holds him accountable, not someone who waits for instructions.
- You are energized by walking into disorder and creating structure.

Nice to have
- Experience in a marketing agency, paid ads or creative production environment.
- Social media or content operations experience.
- Experience supporting a founder who sells coaching, consulting or premium offers.

Benefits

WHY THIS ROLE

- Employment type: full-time 1099 independent contractor
- Paid Time Off and fully remote
- Growth: direct mentorship from the CEO and a clear path to grow into a Chief of Staff position
- Network: exposure to high-impact leaders

Complete discretion and confidentiality are required. The people who succeed in this seat enjoy managing complexity and operate with a high level of ownership in a dynamic, sometimes chaotic environment.

Description

Patient Reimbursement Coordinator (Argentina Based)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.

• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

• Manage either travel logistics or reimbursement processing for patients participating in assigned clinical trial projects.

• Collaborate with PCS Project Managers, the Patient Concierge Services Manager, and internal teams tounderstand study requirements and implement appropriate patient support services.

• Support the setup of new projects, including mailbox creation, portal access, SharePoint folders, and the preparation of study-specific documentation.

• Review andvalidate patient enrolment information and approve patient access to the designateddigital platforms (e.g.,PatientGO®).

• Serve as a primary point of contact for patient requests submitted through the app, email, or phone, ensuring timely and compassionate responses.

• Coordinate flight, train, accommodation, or ground transport bookings as required, using approved systems or travel providers.

• Review and verify patient reimbursement requests, ensuring compliance with study-specific Travel & Reimbursement Policies.

• Approve, reject, or escalate reimbursement or stipend submissions as appropriate, based on study criteria and internal policies.

• Communicate with patients or caregivers to confirm logistics, provide reimbursement updates, and resolve any queries or concerns.

• Liaise with clinical sites to provide guidance or resolve issues related to reimbursement or patient travel coordination.

• Ensure timely processing of patient payments, stipends, or travel confirmations using approved systems andvendor platforms.

• Manage the allocation and tracking of patient payment cards when required by the project.

• Maintain accurate documentation by updating patient information, visit records, and service logs in real-time.

• Assist with or complete reimbursement submissions on behalf of patients, when needed.

• Contribute to ongoing service improvements by identifying operational gaps, sharing feedback, and supporting internal initiatives.

• Support financial tracking activities by providing relevant data andupdates for monthly reporting.

• Ensure strict patient confidentiality and compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), data protection regulations, and company SOPs.

• Participate in client meetings, site initiation visits, and investigator meetings when requested, representing PCS services.

• Stay current on tools, technologies, and processes related to patient travel and reimbursement coordination.

• Support internal team projects and initiatives as needed to contribute to the growth and improvement of the PCS function.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

Summary

The Patient Concierge Coordinator supports patients participating in clinical trials by managing either travel logistics or patient reimbursement activities, depending on the assigned focus area. The role ensures patients have a smooth, supportive experience while participating in studies by coordinating timely, compliant, and personalized services. Coordinators work closely with patients, sites, vendors, and internal stakeholders and are responsible for upholding the highest standards of confidentiality, accuracy, and service.

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Payroll Advisor to join ExxonMobil Buenos Aires. In this role, you will support payroll operations by ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely payroll services while collaborating with HR, Finance, Data Management, business stakeholders, and external payroll providers.

This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates who are interested in developing expertise in payroll, HR operations, data analytics, and employee services within a global organization.

What You Will Do

• Administer payroll processes with accuracy and compliance.

• Process payroll-related employee transactions, including earnings, deductions, taxes, and adjustments.

• Validate payroll-impacting transactions and ensure payroll readiness.

• Analyze payroll data, identify trends, and resolve discrepancies.

En Central Puerto somos la empresa líder en la producción de energía eléctrica a nivel nacional. Nuestro objetivo es producir energía en forma eficiente, sustentable y en armonía con el medio ambiente, contribuyendo al abastecimiento de la demanda eléctrica con calidad y generando valor tanto para la compañía como para la sociedad en su conjunto.

Actualmente, contamos con un portafolio energético diversificado compuesto por 16 centrales distribuidas en todo el país, que abarcan distintas tecnologías de generación térmica, hidroeléctrica, eólica y solar. Nuestros activos representan una potencia instalada de 6.933 MW , con una generación anual aproximada de 18.603 GWh , lo que equivale a una participación de mercado del 15,9% , posicionándonos como el principal grupo privado de generación eléctrica a nivel nacional.

A su vez, somos el mayor accionista privado de la sociedad Central Vuelta de Obligado S.A. y contamos con participación en Termoeléctrica José de San Martín S.A. y Termoeléctrica Manuel Belgrano S.A.

En línea con nuestra estrategia de crecimiento, continuamos ampliando nuestra capacidad instalada tanto en generación térmica como renovable, a través de nuevas inversiones, respaldados por una sólida posición financiera. Como parte de esta estrategia de diversificación, en 2026 ingresamos al negocio de Oil & Gas a través de la adquisición de los bloques Aguada del Chivato y Aguada de Bocarey, en Neuquén, con potencial de hidrocarburos no convencionales en la formación Vaca Muerta. También estamos desarrollando 2 proyectos de almacenamiento de energía mediante baterías (BESS), por un total de 205 MW , en nuestras centrales Puerto y Costanera.

En paralelo, somos uno de los principales grupos inversores del sector forestal en la Argentina. A través de nuestra subsidiaria Forestal Argentina, poseemos y operamos más de 160.000 hectáreas de plantaciones forestales ubicadas en distintos puntos del país.

Central Puerto también participa en proyectos de minería bajo el formato de Corporate Venture Capital, impulsando el desarrollo de iniciativas estratégicas vinculadas a nuevas cadenas de valor energético.

postings.title: Sr. Analyst, Treasury
postings.descriptionText:
SOBRE NOSOTROS

SC Johnson lleva 140 años liderando con propósito, desarrollando productos de alta calidad y marcas icónicas presentes en hogares, escuelas y empresas en prácticamente todos los países del mundo, entre ellas OFF!®, Raid®, Glade®, Windex®, Ziploc®, Baygon®, Mr Músculo®, Pato®, Lysoform® y muchas más. Las 13.000 personas que forman parte de nuestra compañía familiar global, actualmente en su quinta generación, están comprometidas con hacer del mundo un lugar mejor, hoy y para las futuras generaciones.

SOBRE EL ROL

Como Sr. Analyst, Treasury en SC Johnson vas a tener la responsabilidad de gestionar y optimizar la posición de caja y la planificación financiera, asegurando la disponibilidad de liquidez, la precisión de los pronósticos de flujo de fondos y el cumplimiento de los controles internos. Impulsar la eficiencia mediante análisis financiero, automatización, inteligencia artificial y mejora continua.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES

• Cash Management & Cash Position: Monitorear la posición diaria de caja y gestionar la liquidez, excedentes y necesidades de fondos.

• Cash Flow Forecasting & Budgeting: Elaborar forecasts de caja a corto, mediano y largo plazo, analizar desvíos y proponer mejoras.

• Internal Controls, Audit & Compliance: Asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas corporativas y controles internos de Tesorería.

• Continuous Improvement, Automation & AI: Impulsar la mejora continua y automatización de procesos, incorporando IA y herramientas digitales para optimizar análisis y reportes.

EXPERIENCIA REQUERIDA

• Profesionales o estudiantes de Finanzas, Administración de Empresas, Contabilidad, Economía o carreras afines.

• Experiencia previa en Tesorería, Cash Management, Corporate Finance o Financial Planning.

• Inglés avanzado, oral y escrito (excluyente), para interactuar en entornos internacionales.

• Portugues (deseable).

EXPERIENCIA Y COMPETENCIAS DESEADAS

• Conocimiento de SAP y experiencia en auditorías y controles internos.

• Manejo de herramientas digitales, IA y mejora continua de procesos.

• Pensamiento analítico, resolución de problemas, proactividad y autonomía (ownership).

• Comunicación efectiva, organización y capacidad de priorización.

• Orientación al negocio, adaptabilidad, innovación, integridad y confidencialidad.

REQUISITOS

• Full-Time (Tiempo Completo)

• Trabajo remoto de una vez por semana para empleados eligibles

• Contrato por tiempo indeterminado

• Este puesto no es eligible para Relocalización

BENEFICIOS

Súmate a SC Johnson y forma parte de una de las mejores empresas para trabajar de Latinoamérica con:

• Innovadoras oficinas y plantas productivas certificadas como LEED, diseñadas con espacios abiertos que inspirarán tu creatividad, equipadas con las herramientas necesarias para que disfrutes tu día a día.

• Oportunidades de desarrollo que potenciarán tu carrera profesional en un entorno laboral dinámico, donde podrás desplegar tu potencial en una empresa global, líder en consumo masivo.

• Días adicionales de descanso para que puedas recargar energías.

Acceso a un programa integral de beneficios con foco en el bienestar personal, familiar y económico de cada colaborador que promueve el equilibrio entre la vida persona

Inclusion & Diversity

We’re a global business, with people from every culture, ethnicity, race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age and ability. We recognize the breadth of human experience, and we work to celebrate it. It is our goal to build a diverse, inclusive and supportive work environment where all people can thrive.

We’re committed to ongoing efforts that help us attract, hire, and retain diverse talent who want to build a positive, inclusive environment. Read more about our ongoing initiatives at https://jobs.scjohnson.com/inclusion.

postings.title: Government Accountant - Buenos Aires
postings.descriptionText:
About The Role

CKH Group is hiring a full-time, Philippines-based Government Accountant with hands-on Bisan ERP experience and a background in U.S. governmental accounting. The role is dedicated to a single international public-sector engagement for approximately 12 to 14 months, with potential extension and future engagements. You will support a national government finance ministry, funded by a multilateral development bank, that reports under U.S. governmental accounting standards (GASB) and runs its general ledger in Bisan ERP. The work covers:

• Reconciling fiscal year 2026 balances and clearing a reconciliation backlog;

• Helping government-owned component units reconcile open balances;

• Preparing audit schedules; and

• Helping ministry staff use Bisan.

You will be the team member who works in Bisan every day, reporting to a U.S.-based Engagement Manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Reconcile general ledger balances in Bisan to bank statements, subsidiary ledgers, and third-party support, and document each reconciliation in a clear, reviewable workpaper.

• Clear backlogged monthly and year-end reconciliations, research reconciling items, and draft proposed adjusting journal entries with support for client approval.

• Produce a reconciled year-end trial balance ready for financial statement preparation and audit.

• Work with finance staff at government-owned entities to reconcile and resolve open balances across multiple fiscal years, including amounts due to and from the primary government.

• Prepare audit schedules from the auditor's request list for the accounts you reconcile, and help answer auditor questions.

• Pull reports, trace transactions, and use Bisan's general ledger, banking, fixed asset, and reporting functions to support the work.

• Show client staff how to record journal entries, run reconciliations, and produce reports in Bisan. Client staff make all postings.

• Help the U.S. team build working knowledge of Bisan.

• Join a weekly client call and regular check-ins with the Engagement Manager.

• Maintain the open-items list, contribute to monthly status reports, and track time accurately

Required Qualifications

• At least 1 year of hands-on use of Bisan ERP's financial modules, including journal entries, bank reconciliation, financial reports, and transaction drill-down.

• At least 3 years of accounting experience under U.S. GAAP, including work for U.S.-based clients or a U.S. firm's offshore team.

• Working knowledge of GASB fund accounting, including governmental and proprietary funds, interfund balances, and component units.

• Demonstrated ability to clear reconciliation backlogs and resolve aged or unexplained balances.

• Experience preparing audit schedules and responding to external auditor requests.

• Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and reconciliation templates.

• Fluent written and spoken English, and confidence explaining accounting steps to client staff.

• Bachelor's degree in accounting or a closely related field.

Preferred Qualifications

• Philippine CPA license, or progress toward a U.S. CPA or CMA.

• Experience with U.S. state or local government clients, or with GASB 34 financial statements.

• Familiarity with federal grants compliance (Uniform Guidance, 2 CFR 200).

• Experience on projects funded by the World Bank, Asian Development Bank, or other development partners.

• Experience training ERP end users or supporting an ERP implementation or data cleanup.

• Familiarity with other public-sector ERPs, such as Tyler, OpenGov, or Caselle.

Working Conditions

• A quiet home office, reliable broadband with a backup connection, and backup power.

• Work only on a CKH-provided or CKH-approved secure device, following CKH's IT security and remote work policies.

• A confidentiality agreement and background check are required.

• Short trips to the client site are possible but not expected.

How To Apply

Send your resume with a short note/cover letter describing:

• Your Bisan experience: which modules you used, in what role, and for how long.

• Your experience with U.S. GAAP or GASB clients.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief practical exercise.

Why CKH is the best choice?

CKH Group is a full-service CPA and advisory firm based in Atlanta, Georgia, ranked among INSIDE Public Accounting's Top 500 firms. Its Government Accounting practice serves cities, counties, special districts, and other public entities. We are a boutique accounting & financial services firm that provides local expertise aided by global experience. We have presence in Atlanta, South Africa, Ukraine, Poland, Azerbaijan, Germany, Spain and Greece.

Our Tree Logo Is Representative Of CKH's Ideals

• The roots of the tree remind us to stay grounded and humble.

• The trunk represents the support we have for each other, making our team strong. But we also like to shake the tree!

• Churning up new ideas and positive change as the world around us grows.

• The fruit our tree grows reminds us to never stop growing, producing the best quality service for our clients.

• The treetop helps us reach higher, always stretching to new heights and goals.
