postings.title: Accounting & Finance Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.

Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role.

Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion.

Working here means:

• High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients

• Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better

• Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential

• High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected

• Mission-driven teamwork: we're passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another

If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it.

Learn more about what it's like to work with us here: politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers

The Role

In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.

The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firm's financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.

This role serves as the firm's first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firm's systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations.

Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support.

The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firm's needs, but will include a combination of the following:

Financial Operations Management

• Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time

• Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly

• Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.

• Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.

• Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.

• Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.

• Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time

Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and Forecasting

• Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time

• Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.

• Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.

• Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed

• Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.

• Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.

• Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.

• Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.

Billing, Collections, and Accounts Receivable

• Own and continuously improve the firm's billing and collections process.

• Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.

• Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.

• Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.

• Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.

• Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.

• Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firm's financial interests.

• Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.

• Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances

• Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.

Trust Accounting and Compliance

• Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.

• Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.

• Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.

• Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.

• Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.

• Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.

Internal Controls and Risk Management

• Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.

• Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.

• Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.

• Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.

• Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.

• Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.

Finance Team and Vendor Oversight

• Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.

• Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.

• Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.

• Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.

• Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.

• Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.

• Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows

• Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows

• Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.

• Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.

Financial Analysis and Business Support

• Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.

• Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.

• Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.

• Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.

• Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.

• Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.

Requirements

Who You Are

We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings:

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

• Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, preferably in a law firm, professional services firm, or other service-based business.

• Strong understanding of general accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, A/R, A/P, payroll, and month-end close.

• Experience managing or reviewing trust/IOLTA accounting and reconciliations.

• Experience with billing systems, client payment plans, collections, and accounts receivable management.

• Strong proficiency with accounting software, legal billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial reporting tools

• Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve accounting or finance workflows, with a working understanding of APIs, scripts, and how data moves between systems

• Ability to identify improvement opportunities, define clear financial requirements, collaborate with technical colleagues on implementation, and validate the accuracy and reliability of results. Advanced coding skills are not required

• Ability to prepare accurate financial reports and explain them clearly to non-financial leaders.

• Demonstrated ability to identify financial risks, implement controls, and resolve discrepancies.

• Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment

Preferred Qualifications

• CPA, MBA, advanced finance/accounting credential, or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years of accounting, controller, or finance operations experience.

• Microsoft Excel Expert Certification preferred

• Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.

• Prior experience in a law firm or legal services environment.

• Experience with systems such as QuickBooks Online, Clio, MyCase, Time Matters, PracticePanther, Smokeball, Lawmatics, Infusionsoft/Keap, or similar platforms.

• Experience designing dashboards, centralized KPI reporting, balanced scorecards, or financial pe

postings.title: People Operations Generalist
postings.descriptionText:
Slate is the #1-rated nationwide commercial cleaning company in the US, specializing in overnight and recurring janitorial services for premium client sites. We use standardized checklists, photo documentation, and app-based quality control to deliver consistent, high-quality results — every location, every shift, every time. We do not operate as a franchise. Every team member is a direct Slate employee, and our culture is built on accountability, excellence, and mutual respect.

About The Role

The People Operations Generalist runs the HR operations engine for Slate. You'll own the employee lifecycle and the accuracy of employee data, executing to the standards the People Operations Manager sets.

What You'll Do

Run the employee lifecycle day to day: status and pay changes, leaves of absence, transfers, and offboarding coordination, documented to the People Operations Manager's standards

Own employee and new-hire follow-up end-to-end: proactively contact employees, resolve blockers, coordinate with Operations when needed, document outcomes, and close the loop.

Investigate employee cases thoroughly before escalation by reviewing available records, communications, timekeeping, and documentation; escalate to the People Operations Manager with clear findings, actions taken, and the specific support needed.

Take ownership of assigned cases through resolution rather than handing off actionable tasks; escalate only when manager input or policy/compliance review is required.

Work the HR ticket queue: respond to employee and manager tickets, resolve what you can, and escalate policy, employee relations, or compliance issues to the People Operations Manager

Own payroll preparation, audits, and disputes: collect and audit hours, process pay-rate and status changes, investigate discrepancies, and reconcile payroll data before submission, escalating exceptions to the People Operations Manager

Resolve payroll inquiries (missing hours, rate questions, deductions, final pay) that the HR Coordinator logs and escalates, coordinating with Operations on timekeeping issues

Audit new-hire files for completeness before day one, in coordination with the Onboarding Coordinator

Maintain HRIS data integrity: employee records, changes, and terminations entered accurately and on time

Provide documentation support to the People Operations Manager on employee relations: gather facts, timekeeping records, and prior documentation, and maintain investigation files

Produce standard HR reports (headcount, turnover, overtime, payroll summaries) for the People Operations Manager

Support multi-state compliance tasks: required notices, wage statements, and state-specific paperwork

What You'll Need

4+ years in HR

Bilingual (English & Spanish) required

Exceptional attention to detail: you catch the missing signature and the payroll error before they go out

Strong organization; comfortable tracking many employees through multiple touchpoints and pay periods

Proficient with HRIS, payroll, and e-signature systems; strong Excel or Google Sheets

Reliable availability on payroll processing days

Calm, clear communicator with employees and managers

Familiarity with I-9/E-Verify and multi-state wage and hour rules is a plus

First 90 Days

Lifecycle checklists (onboarding, changes, offboarding) documented and in use

Payroll running on schedule with a pre-submission audit checklist

Payroll inquiry log in place with response-time tracking

HRIS audit completed and data cleaned

postings.title: Accounting & Finance Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.

Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role.

Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion.

Working here means:

• High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients

• Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better

• Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential

• High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected

• Mission-driven teamwork: we're passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another

If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it.

Learn more about what it's like to work with us here: politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers

The Role

In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.

The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firm's financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.

This role serves as the firm's first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firm's systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations.

Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support.

The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firm's needs, but will include a combination of the following:

Financial Operations Management

• Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time

• Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly

• Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.

• Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.

• Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.

• Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.

• Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time

Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and Forecasting

• Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time

• Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.

• Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.

• Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed

• Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.

• Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.

• Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.

• Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.

Billing, Collections, and Accounts Receivable

• Own and continuously improve the firm's billing and collections process.

• Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.

• Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.

• Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.

• Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.

• Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.

• Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firm's financial interests.

• Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.

• Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances

• Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.

Trust Accounting and Compliance

• Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.

• Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.

• Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.

• Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.

• Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.

• Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.

Internal Controls and Risk Management

• Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.

• Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.

• Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.

• Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.

• Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.

• Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.

Finance Team and Vendor Oversight

• Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.

• Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.

• Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.

• Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.

• Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.

• Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.

• Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows

• Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows

• Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.

• Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.

Financial Analysis and Business Support

• Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.

• Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.

• Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.

• Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.

• Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.

• Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.

Requirements

Who You Are

We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings:

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

• Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, preferably in a law firm, professional services firm, or other service-based business.

• Strong understanding of general accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, A/R, A/P, payroll, and month-end close.

• Experience managing or reviewing trust/IOLTA accounting and reconciliations.

• Experience with billing systems, client payment plans, collections, and accounts receivable management.

• Strong proficiency with accounting software, legal billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial reporting tools

• Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve accounting or finance workflows, with a working understanding of APIs, scripts, and how data moves between systems

• Ability to identify improvement opportunities, define clear financial requirements, collaborate with technical colleagues on implementation, and validate the accuracy and reliability of results. Advanced coding skills are not required

• Ability to prepare accurate financial reports and explain them clearly to non-financial leaders.

• Demonstrated ability to identify financial risks, implement controls, and resolve discrepancies.

• Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment

Preferred Qualifications

• CPA, MBA, advanced finance/accounting credential, or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years of accounting, controller, or finance operations experience.

• Microsoft Excel Expert Certification preferred

• Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.

• Prior experience in a law firm or legal services environment.

• Experience with systems such as QuickBooks Online, Clio, MyCase, Time Matters, PracticePanther, Smokeball, Lawmatics, Infusionsoft/Keap, or similar platforms.

• Experience designing dashboards, centralized KPI reporting, balanced scorecards, or financial pe

postings.title: Gerente de Contabilidad y Control de Gestión
postings.descriptionText:
En Strategy LATAM nos encontramos en búsqueda de un/a Gerente de Contabilidad y Control de Gestión para nuestro cliente, importante grupo empresario nacional de servicios.

Reportando al CFO, será responsable de liderar la gestión contable y el control de gestión de las distintas empresas del Grupo, garantizando información financiera confiable para la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

Principales responsabilidades

• Liderar los cierres contables y la consolidación de estados financieros de las empresas del Grupo, asegurando el cumplimiento de las normas contables e impositivas.

• Diseñar y supervisar los procesos de control de gestión, incluyendo presupuestos, forecasts y análisis de desvíos.

• Analizar la rentabilidad por empresa y unidad de negocio, elaborando reportes para el CFO y la Dirección.

• Coordinar la relación con auditores externos, asesores impositivos y organismos de control.

• Supervisión de la gestión impositiva.

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights‑driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart ®.

About The Role

We are seeking a Site Payment Lead to join our team in a remote capacity The Site Payment Lead is responsible for coordinating with the team members and their activities across studies, liaising with the project teams to ensure set-up and site payments are effectively managed; and is accountable for the management of payments for the assigned studies. This includes the accountability for payment setup and modifications within the investigator payment system for expenses aligned to budget templates.

Working independently, they will show an elevated level of ownership assisting the project team project planning, decision making process and timely payments to investigator sites. As a dedicated team player, the Site Payment Lead provides excellent proactive support across projects and tasks as assigned with supervision, identifying risks, their impact, and potential resolutions.

Key Accountabilities

Overall Accountabilities:

• Be the accountable Lead for Site Payment Services related queries on assigned studies and point of contact for project teams.

• Proactively and effectively solves customer problems and accepts responsibility for actions.

• Work closely with Project Leadership, Global Site Contracts, eClinical Business Implementation, Global Clinical Operations, and other internal Site Payment Services team members to obtain additional information required to perform tasks, when applicable.

• Participate as the Lead representative of the Investigator Payment team in study start-up meetings, including payment strategy meetings, to ensure initial funds setup requirements are documented for seamless payment processing.

• Lead and follow-up on audits/inspections

• Knowledge of clinical trial pricing/budgeting tools and how to reflect operational changes within the tools

• Thorough knowledge of Parexel’s SOPs, Operational Guidelines and Work Instructions procedures.

• Complete routine administrative tasks in a timely manner (e.g. timesheets, metrics, and expenses).

• In depth understanding of the set-up and payment process; including ability to analyze agreements.

• Collection of information from all teams/systems/tools wherever needed on a timely and proactive basis.

• Analyze and present data to various stakeholders.

• Trains team members within the Site Payment Services.

• Discover and implement opportunities for process efficiencies.

End To End Management Of Site Payments

• Keeps internal and external team members aware of site payment status and issues.

• Accurately authorize study setups before starting payments.

• Resolve escalated second line helpdesk issues for assigned portfolio.

• Assist in the preparation of project status reports as needed.

• Works with IFA and project team to ensure appropriate funding prior to administering payments.

Skills

• Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.

• Ability to make decisions and advise other staff even in ambiguous situations.

• Ability to conduct root cause analysis in problem solving and process development.

• Strong customer focus, ability to interact professionally.

• Patient, Quality and Client focused approach to work.

• Ability to manage multiple and varied tasks with enthusiasm and prioritize workload with attention to detail.

• Expert in using MS Excel for spreadsheet analysis.

• Strong proficiency in use of MS Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, and Word.

• Analytical mind with strong attention to detail.

• Commitment to high quality work and consistent performance.

Knowledge And Experience

Who We Are

That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role.

Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion.

Working here means:

• High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients

• Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better

• Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential

• High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected

• Mission-driven teamwork: we're passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another

If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it.

Learn more about what it's like to work with us here: politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers

The Role

In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.

The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firm's financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.

This role serves as the firm's first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firm's systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations.

Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support.

The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firm's needs, but will include a combination of the following:

Financial Operations Management

• Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time

• Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly

• Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.

• Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.

• Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.

• Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.

• Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time

Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and Forecasting

• Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time

• Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.

• Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.

• Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed

• Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.

• Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.

• Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.

• Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.

Billing, Collections, and Accounts Receivable

• Own and continuously improve the firm's billing and collections process.

• Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.

• Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.

• Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.

• Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.

• Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.

• Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firm's financial interests.

• Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.

• Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances

• Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.

Trust Accounting and Compliance

• Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.

• Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.

• Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.

• Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.

• Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.

• Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.

Internal Controls and Risk Management

• Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.

• Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.

• Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.

• Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.

• Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.

• Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.

Finance Team and Vendor Oversight

• Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.

• Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.

• Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.

• Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.

• Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.

• Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.

• Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows

• Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows

• Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.

• Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.

Financial Analysis and Business Support

• Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.

• Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.

• Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.

• Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.

• Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.

• Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.

Requirements

Who You Are

We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings:

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

• Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, preferably in a law firm, professional services firm, or other service-based business.

• Strong understanding of general accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, A/R, A/P, payroll, and month-end close.

• Experience managing or reviewing trust/IOLTA accounting and reconciliations.

• Experience with billing systems, client payment plans, collections, and accounts receivable management.

• Strong proficiency with accounting software, legal billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial reporting tools

• Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve accounting or finance workflows, with a working understanding of APIs, scripts, and how data moves between systems

• Ability to identify improvement opportunities, define clear financial requirements, collaborate with technical colleagues on implementation, and validate the accuracy and reliability of results. Advanced coding skills are not required

• Ability to prepare accurate financial reports and explain them clearly to non-financial leaders.

• Demonstrated ability to identify financial risks, implement controls, and resolve discrepancies.

• Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment

Preferred Qualifications

• CPA, MBA, advanced finance/accounting credential, or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years of accounting, controller, or finance operations experience.

• Microsoft Excel Expert Certification preferred

• Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.

• Prior experience in a law firm or legal services environment.

• Experience with systems such as QuickBooks Online, Clio, MyCase, Time Matters, PracticePanther, Smokeball, Lawmatics, Infusionsoft/Keap, or similar platforms.

• Experience designing dashboards, centralized KPI reporting, balanced scorecards, or financial pe

postings.title: Alcohol Compliance Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Location: Remote / Flexible
Reports to: Accountant Team Lead
The Mission: Keep our clients licensed, labeled, and legal, so they can focus on selling.

About Cultivar We are the financial operations partner for growing CPG brands. We go beyond standard bookkeeping to deliver insight-driven, channel-smart financial management and advice, including accounting, FP&A, sales tax, inventory costing, and beverage alcohol compliance.
Our bev-alc clients are wineries, distilleries, and RTD brands, mostly between launch and $25M in revenue. Many sell direct-to-consumer, through distributors, and online at the same time. That means a lot of filings, a lot of states, and very little room for error.
We bring order to chaos, calm to uncertainty, and clarity to the bottom line. We're a remote-first team obsessed with the operational details most people overlook, because we believe structure creates freedom.

The Role We're hiring an Alcohol Compliance Specialist to own federal and state compliance for a portfolio of beverage alcohol clients. You'll file the reports, keep the licenses current, register the labels, and be the person our clients trust to say "you're covered."
This is a hands-on execution role , not a leadership position. We need a specialist who doesn't just file forms on time, but understands why the numbers on a TTB report have to tie to the books, the inventory system, and the shipping data. You'll work closely with our accountants and Account Managers, because at Cultivar compliance is connected to the financials, not a separate silo.

What You'll Do Federal Compliance (TTB)
• Operations Reports: Prepare and file monthly, quarterly, or annual TTB Reports of Operations (wine premises, brewery, and distilled spirits plant reports).

• Federal Excise Tax: Calculate, prepare, and file federal excise tax returns, including small-producer tax credits.

• Labels & Permits: Submit and track COLA applications, and keep federal permits and amendments current through TTB's online systems.

State Compliance
• State Reporting: File state excise tax, production, and shipment reports — including California CDTFA and ABC filings and out-of-state equivalents.

• Direct-to-Consumer (DTC): Maintain DTC shipping licenses and file monthly/quarterly shipment reports in every state a client ships to.

• Brand & Label Registrations: Manage out-of-state brand and label registrations, renewals, and price postings for distributor (three-tier) sales.

• License Calendar: Track every license, permit, bond, and renewal date across your client portfolio so nothing lapses.

Data Integrity & Reconciliation
• Tie It Out: Reconcile compliance reports against QuickBooks Online, inventory systems, and DTC/e-commerce platforms before anything is filed.

• Root Cause Analysis: When production, inventory, or shipping data doesn't match, find and fix the source — don't just force the report to balance.

Client & Agency Communication
• Agency Liaison: Communicate with TTB and state agencies on clients' behalf, including responding to notices, inquiries, and audits.

• Client Guidance: Explain compliance requirements in plain language and flag risks early — new states, new products, new channels.

Process Optimization
• Document Everything: Build and maintain clear, repeatable procedures and checklists for every filing type.

• Standardize & Improve: Spot inefficiencies in our compliance workflow and help us deliver faster and more accurately with each cycle.

Must-Have Requirements
• Experience: 2–5+ years of hands-on beverage alcohol compliance experience at a winery, brewery, distillery, importer, or compliance/accounting firm.

• Federal Filings: Proven experience preparing TTB Reports of Operations and federal excise tax returns independently.

• Multi-State Knowledge: Working knowledge of state-by-state DTC shipping rules, state excise reporting, and brand/label registration.

• Accounting Foundation: Comfortable reading financial statements and inventory reports, and tying compliance data back to the books.

• Organization: Ability to manage dozens of recurring deadlines across multiple clients and jurisdictions without anything slipping.

• Communication: Clear written and spoken English for agency correspondence and client guidance. Spanish is a plus — our team works in Spanish internally.

Technical Knowledge Deep-Dive
• Production-to-Tax Logic: Understanding how bulk and bottled inventory movements, removals, and bond transfers flow into TTB reports and excise tax.

• Channel Awareness: Knowing how DTC, wholesale (three-tier), and e-commerce sales each trigger different licensing and reporting obligations.

• Systems Fluency: Experience pulling data from QuickBooks Online, inventory management systems, and DTC platforms — and knowing what to do when they disagree.

• Troubleshooting Mindset: Seeing a report that won't tie out as a puzzle to solve at the root, not a number to adjust.

Nice to Haves
• Experience with compliance software such as Sovos ShipCompliant or similar.

• Experience with DTC/winery platforms (e.g., Commerce7, WineDirect) or spirits/brewery production software.

• Experience across more than one category — wine, beer, spirits, and RTD.

• Exposure to import/export compliance or federal basic permit applications.

• Experience working in a client-facing professional services firm.

Success Metrics (KPIs)
• Zero Missed Deadlines: Every federal and state filing submitted on time, tracked in Karbon.

• Zero Penalties: No late fees, lapsed licenses, or agency penalties caused by our work.

• Accuracy: Compliance reports tie to the books and inventory data before filing; minimal amendments.

• Capacity Efficiency: Consistently delivering high-quality work within budgeted hours.

Why This Role Matters
• Protect the Business: A missed filing or lapsed license can stop a client from shipping or selling. You're the safeguard.

• Enable Growth: When a client wants to enter a new state or channel, you make it possible — quickly and correctly.

• Autonomy: You own your portfolio and your process, with the responsibility to make it bulletproof.

postings.descriptionText:
ACCOUNTING MANAGER

at AtlasBrands | Remote - Worldwide

Compensation Range

About AtlasBrands

We’re building and scaling high-velocity DTC brands. In just a few months, we scaled from $0 to $3M MRR and from a team of 3 to a team of ~30. We’re now pushing toward 9 figures — and building a world-class team of A+ talent that can support, sustain, and accelerate that level of growth. At this stage, growth is no longer just about products or marketing. It’s about people. The next phase of this company will be defined by who we bring in — the quality of talent, the speed at which we hire, and the systems we build around it.

Role Objective

We are seeking an autonomous, forward-thinking Accounting Manager to transition our financial operations from an external bookkeeping agency to an internal, in-house function. In this role, you will take complete ownership of the books, month-end close, and financial reporting across our entire parent company and its portfolio of Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) brands.

You will combine deep, hands-on e-commerce accounting knowledge with team oversight and process improvement. You will manage a dedicated Bookkeeper who handles day-to-day data entry, ensuring their work is accurate, establishing internal controls, and leveraging AI tools to build scalable, automated reporting systems as we continue to acquire and launch new brands.

What You’ll Do

• In-House Transition & Strategy: Lead the migration of accounting functions away from our current external agency; establish baseline financial controls, workflows, and a scalable architecture for growth.

• Multi-Entity & Parent Company Accounting: Oversee accounting across all brands and legal entities, expertly managing intercompany transactions, shared expenses, and complex payment allocations.

• Team Supervision & Review: Manage, coach, and review the work of an internal Bookkeeper. Audit daily bookkeeping for absolute precision, resolve discrepancies, and outline clear operational guidelines.

• E-Commerce & DTC Reconciliations: Handle specialized high-volume e-commerce workflows, ensuring seamless reconciliation of inventory tracking, COGS, Shopify sales loops, and payment processors (e.g., Stripe, PayPal).

• Month-End Close & Reporting: Own the entire month-end close process to deliver timely, accurate GAAP financial statements broken down by specific entity, individual brand, and consolidated group performance.

• AI-Driven Automation: Actively use modern AI engineering tools (such as Claude Code) to build dynamic financial dashboards, optimize reporting speeds, and automate data plumbing across our systems.

Required Skills And Qualifications

• Experience: 5+ years of accounting experience, featuring clear success in managing accounting for a parent company with multiple legal entities and working extensively within the DTC/e-commerce sector.

• People Management: Direct experience managing, training, and reviewing the daily outputs of a Bookkeeper or Junior Accountant.

• Technical & AI Skills: High proficiency with QuickBooks Online and advanced Excel/Google Sheets. Proven practical application of AI tools (e.g., Claude Code) to improve processes and build workflows.

• Core Accounting Competence: Deep familiarity with handling multi-state sales tax nexus, intercompany eliminations, landing costs, and multi-warehouse inventory valuations.

• Mindset: An entrepreneurial "builder" mentality. Someone who can seamlessly balance high-level strategic oversight with rolling up their sleeves to troubleshoot a data discrepancy.

Working Hours & Culture

• Role Timeline: Full-time hire.

• Async-First: Global, remote-first team setup requiring core daily overlap with US EST business hours for team syncs and cross-functional alignment. Also for any offshore hires, must be willing to overlap at least 4+ EST hours (between 9am-5pm EST)

• Compensation: Competitive monthly salary scaling with operational scope and multi-brand experience.

How To Apply & What To Expect

At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.

Here is exactly how our application workflow operates through our platform:

• Step 1: Submit Your CV Click the "Apply Now" button below to submit your CV along with a brief overview of the brand portfolios or cross-functional teams you have managed.

• Step 2: Initial Screening & Video Intro Our recruiting team will conduct a brief initial screening call to evaluate your communication style, organizational frameworks, and multi-brand account management experience.

• Step 3: Paid Assessment Complete a paid assessment that the hiring team will use to assess core skills and determine final steps.

• Step 4: The 45-Minute Strategic Deep Dive Selected candidates will join two members of our leadership team for 45-minute conversational interviews.

No third party or agency submissions will be accepted.

AtlasBrands is an equal opportunity employer.

This role is core to that mission: it's the person who makes sure that once a customer says yes, everything after that — delivery, compliance, commissioning — happens without a single dropped detail.

Who We're Looking For

This role is the critical link between AnvilGrid's internal teams — Finance, Project Management, Engineering, and Logistics — and our external suppliers. Nothing about an order moves without passing through this person. You'll be the one keeping three moving targets in sync on every single order: the delivery schedule, the contract terms, and what was promised to the customer.

We're looking for someone with 3+ years of experience in supplier management, procurement, operations, or project coordination — ideally from an industry with long lead times and real compliance stakes (industrial manufacturing, mining, oil & gas, energy infrastructure, or similar).

Above all, we're looking for a communicator first . This role sits at the center of a web of suppliers, engineers, logistics teams, finance, and customers — the person who thrives here is the one who can build rapport quickly, track small details without dropping any of them, and pick up the phone the moment something needs a human conversation instead of an email thread.

Why You Should Join Us

• Direct access and real ownership. You'll work alongside our founder and full leadership team from day one, this isn't a role buried in a large organization, it's a seat close to the decisions that matter.

• A company built for the long term. We design for decades, not projects, and we're building the team the same way.

• A mission worth showing up for. You'll be part of delivering resilient power to businesses and communities that can't afford downtime, real infrastructure, real impact.

• Flexible, trust-based collaboration. Weekly check-ins and clear communication cadence, not micromanagement, we hire people we trust to own their work.

•

Role Responsibilities

Post-Award Project & Program Support

• Drive internal alignment across Finance and other functional teams for projects at award stage or later.

• Serve as the primary operational point of contact for supplier alignment, ensuring suppliers understand and meet AnvilGrid's requirements throughout the order lifecycle.

Order & Invoice Management

• Track and manage supplier invoicing in coordination with Finance, ensuring accuracy and alignment with contract terms and payment milestones.

• Monitor and track order acknowledgements from suppliers, confirming timely receipt and resolving discrepancies.

• Fully utilize internal tools — Notion, Google Drive, and AI-assisted workflows — to follow established processes.

Contract Compliance & Delivery

• Ensure ongoing compliance to contractual scope, terms, specifications, and commercial conditions across all active purchase orders.

• Monitor delivery performance against customer commitments and proactively flag risks to on-time delivery.

• Maintain and update ship outlooks across the order portfolio in Notion dashboards.

• Pick up the phone when a customer or vendor conversation needs to happen — proactively, not reactively.

Variance Management & Corrective Action

• Identify variances in orders, materials, and schedules relative to contractual and program baselines.

• Drive root-cause analysis and lead or support corrective action plans with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Reporting & Operational Cadence

• Prepare and present order status, ship outlooks, variances, and recommendations at the weekly operations meeting.

• Provide clear, data-driven updates that enable timely escalation and resolution.

Our Values

• See It Through — We finish what we start and stand behind every outcome.

• Make It Right — No ego, no blame, only solutions.

• Build Something Big — We design for decades, not projects.

• Transparency Always — Clear, honest communication drives trust and performance.

• We Win When They Win — Customer uptime and success define ours.

Skills & Experience

Required

• 3+ years of experience in supplier management, procurement, operations, or project coordination.

• Strong understanding of purchase order lifecycle management, contract compliance, and invoicing processes.

• Excellent cross-functional communication skills — this is the single most important factor for this role.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify variances, assess risk, and recommend corrective actions.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

• Comfortable working with Notion, Slack, and Gmail as core daily tools.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

Strongly Preferred

• Background in an industry with long lead times and compliance requirements — industrial manufacturing, mining, oil & gas, or industrial equipment sectors.

• Familiarity with international supplier logistics, incoterms, or shipping/customs processes.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on experience with ERP/procurement systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar).

• Experience within Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), renewable energy, or broader energy infrastructure.

• Experience supporting or leading recurring operations reviews with senior stakeholders.

Key Traits

• Detail-oriented with strong organizational and follow-through skills.

• Comfortable managing multiple concurrent orders/programs in a fast-paced environment.

• Builds rapport quickly and drives alignment across diverse stakeholders.

• Solutions-oriented approach to supplier relationships — collaborative, not transactional.

Compensation & Employment Type

Type: Remote Independent contractor, Full-time (40 hours/week)
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM PST
Central or South America preferred (for time zone alignment)
Compensation: starting at $1,800/month depending on experience
Timeline: Immediate hire, targeting 30–45 days

Application Process

Please email the following to Operations+ Anvilgrid @allsikes.com:

• Resume: As a PDF titled [Lastname.Firstname.Ops.Specialist.pdf]

• Cover letter Including: a) What intrigues you about working with us, b) Specific experiences that prove you're the right person for this role, c) The last books you've read, d) What you do for fun.

• Short examples of when you’ve:

• Turned messy inputs into clear task plans

• Identified something that needed to be done, fixed, or improved and took ownership to make it happen

﻿
Well-structured, thoughtful applications will stand out. If you have questions, feel free to include them in your message.

Estamos en la búsqueda de un Especialista de Reabastecimiento , para sumarse al equipo de Reabastecimiento, Comercial.

Buscamos un perfil analítico, organizado, con atención al detalle, capacidad para resolver contingencias en tiempo real, buena comunicación, y con excelente capacidad de articulación entre Comercial, Logística (CEDIS) y Operaciones de Tiendas.

postings.title: Regional Cost & Supply Finance Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
PedidosYa forma parte de Delivery Hero, empresa líder mundial en servicios de delivery con presencia en ~65 países. PedidosYa es la empresa de tecnología líder en delivery y quick-commerce en Latinoamérica. Es una plataforma simple, rápida y accesible que conecta a millones de personas usuarias, empresas y repartidores con una amplia variedad de productos y servicios. PedidosYa opera en 15 países en latinoamérica, y en 2020 lanzó PedidosYa Markets, el primer mercado 100% digital que entrega alimentos y artículos para el hogar en 15 minutos. Delivery Hero cotiza en la Bolsa de Frankfurt desde 2017 y forma parte del índice bursátil MDAX.

Descripción del empleo

• Liderar los procesos de Best Estimate y Budget en cooperación con el equipo de Finanzas y los equipos locales, costeando y presupuestando los supuestos operativos esperados para los distintos períodos.

• Liderar, junto con los equipos locales, el entendimiento post-mortem del costo logístico y sus componentes, llevando la granularidad analítica a un nivel que permita capitalizar aprendizajes y detectar oportunidades.

• Construir información y metodologías de gestión estandarizadas para toda la región, elevando la consistencia y comparabilidad entre mercados.

• Liderar la construcción de business cases y acompañar a los equipos locales en los procesos de licitación.

• Dar soporte a los equipos locales en la gestión de warehouse allowance de proveedores, liderando la agenda y asegurando el avance en conjunto con los equipos comerciales de cada mercado.

• Liderar el supply finance planning, integrando la visión financiera en la planificación de Supply Chain.

Requisitos

• Formación en Ingeniería, Economía, Administración, Finanzas o afines.

• 5+ años de experiencia en control de gestión, FP&A, costos, o performance en Supply Chain / Logística / Retail.

• Experiencia previa en empresas de tecnología, e-commerce, quick-commerce o retail con operación multi-país. Conocimiento de operación logística: 3PLs, centros de distribución, última milla.

• Sólido manejo de modelado financiero y de costos, y procesos de presupuestación (budget, forecast, best estimate).

• Manejo avanzado de análisis de datos: SQL (idealmente BigQuery) y planillas de cálculo a nivel experto.

• Inglés intermedio-avanzado (entorno regional e interacción con casa matriz).

Información adicional

• Crear valor para un gran ecosistema de negocio.

• Jugar en equipo, siempre: Pensar soluciones y construir colaborativamente, con buena energía.

• Moverte a la velocidad de tus ideas y emprender.

• Aprender, desarrollarte y reinventarte: Permitirte equivocarte, aprender haciendo, iterar y adaptarte a los cambios.

• Generar impacto positivo en las personas y el planeta.

• Trabajar de otra manera, en #ModoPeYa: no importa el tiempo ni el lugar desde donde trabajas, lo que importa es la agilidad con la que tomas decisiones, la flexibilidad para adaptarte y los resultados que alcanzas en equipo.

En PedidosYa, el impacto no se mide solo en resultados sino en cómo los alcanzamos. Buscamos al mejor talento: personas que vibren con nuestros valores, la forma en la que pensamos, decidimos y colaboramos todos los días.

Lo que lográs es clave, pero el “cómo” lo hacés es lo que nos define. Jugando en equipo, hacemos que el negocio y nuestro ecosistema sigan creciendo, mientras le simplificamos el día a día a millones de personas.

👉 Conocé nuestros valores aquí.

La diversidad de talento potencia nuestra Cultura y nuestra organización. Jugamos en equipo en todo lo que hacemos, y lo que más nos gusta de eso es que promovemos la creación de equipos diversos e inclusivos que puedan aportar diferentes perspectivas a PedidosYa. Nuestras oportunidades laborales están abiertas a todas las personas, independientemente de su identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, religión, edad, discapacidad y/o otras características individuales.

En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o accesibilidad particular para tener la entrevista, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación. Además, siéntete libre de indicarnos tus pronombres (él/ella/elle) desde el primer contacto.

#CulturaPeYa #LaDiversidadNosPotencia

postings.title: Analista de Costos
postings.descriptionText:
Tareas a realizar

• Desarrollar estimaciones de CAPEX para proyectos industriales, desde etapas conceptuales y de factibilidad hasta proyectos EPC.

• Elaborar presupuestos multidisciplinarios que incluyan obras civiles, estructuras metálicas, montajes mecánicos, piping, equipos, instalaciones eléctricas de alta y media tension, instrumentación y control.

• Realizar cómputos y estimaciones de cantidades de materiales (MTO), a partir de documentos de ingeniería.

• Desarrollar análisis de precios unitarios, contemplando materiales, mano de obra, equipos, rendimientos, productividad y costos indirectos.

• Estimar costos de construcción, montaje, logística, movilización, obradores y servicios auxiliares.

• Elaborar bases de estimación, identificando supuestos, exclusiones, contingencias y riesgos.

• Desarrollar y mantener bases de datos de precios, rendimientos y costos históricos de proyectos.

• Analizar y comparar ofertas técnico-económicas de contratistas y proveedores.

• Evaluar desvíos de precios, cantidades y alcances respecto de los presupuestos de referencia.

• Colaborar en la definición de paquetes de contratación y estrategias de ejecución.

Requisitos

Requisitos

• Formación universitaria en Ingeniería Civil, Mecánica, Electronico, Electromecánica, Industrial.

• Experiencia laboral mínima de 10 años en proyectos de construcción de obras industriales o de infraestructura de gran envergadura.

• Experiencia comprobable en empresas constructoras, contratistas EPC, empresas de ingeniería o áreas de presupuestos y licitaciones de grandes proyectos.

• Experiencia directa en elaboración de presupuestos y estimaciones de costos multidisciplinarios.

• Dominio de cómputos métricos, estimación de cantidades de materiales y análisis de precios unitarios.

• Conocimiento de metodologías constructivas, rendimientos de mano de obra, costos de equipos y recursos de montaje.

• Experiencia en interpretación de documentación de ingeniería y especificaciones técnicas.

• Conocimiento de contratos de obra, modalidades de contratación y evaluación económica de ofertas.

En Central Puerto somos la empresa líder en la producción de energía eléctrica a nivel nacional. Nuestro objetivo es producir energía en forma eficiente, sustentable y en armonía con el medio ambiente, contribuyendo al abastecimiento de la demanda eléctrica con calidad y generando valor tanto para la compañía como para la sociedad en su conjunto.

Actualmente, contamos con un portafolio energético diversificado compuesto por 16 centrales distribuidas en todo el país, que abarcan distintas tecnologías de generación térmica, hidroeléctrica, eólica y solar. Nuestros activos representan una potencia instalada de 6.933 MW , con una generación anual aproximada de 18.603 GWh , lo que equivale a una participación de mercado del 15,9% , posicionándonos como el principal grupo privado de generación eléctrica a nivel nacional.

A su vez, somos el mayor accionista privado de la sociedad Central Vuelta de Obligado S.A. y contamos con participación en Termoeléctrica José de San Martín S.A. y Termoeléctrica Manuel Belgrano S.A.

En línea con nuestra estrategia de crecimiento, continuamos ampliando nuestra capacidad instalada tanto en generación térmica como renovable, a través de nuevas inversiones, respaldados por una sólida posición financiera. Como parte de esta estrategia de diversificación, en 2026 ingresamos al negocio de Oil & Gas a través de la adquisición de los bloques Aguada del Chivato y Aguada de Bocarey, en Neuquén, con potencial de hidrocarburos no convencionales en la formación Vaca Muerta. También estamos desarrollando 2 proyectos de almacenamiento de energía mediante baterías (BESS), por un total de 205 MW , en nuestras centrales Puerto y Costanera.

En paralelo, somos uno de los principales grupos inversores del sector forestal en la Argentina. A través de nuestra subsidiaria Forestal Argentina, poseemos y operamos más de 160.000 hectáreas de plantaciones forestales ubicadas en distintos puntos del país.

Central Puerto también participa en proyectos de minería bajo el formato de Corporate Venture Capital, impulsando el desarrollo de iniciativas estratégicas vinculadas a nuevas cadenas de valor energético.

postings.title: Finance Business Partner – D2C/ CPG/ Ecommerce
postings.descriptionText:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. Founded in 2023 and backed by a $4 million seed round led by Harlem Capital, MAVI was recently featured in TechCrunch.

Our professionals join in-house finance teams in full-time, long-term roles, not short-term projects. The companies we work with range from venture- and PE-backed businesses to public companies and CFO advisory firms, including Athena Club, MotherDuck, and Within.

The work centers on judgment. As AI takes over more transactional accounting, the people who review the output, question it, and own the result matter more than ever. MAVI professionals work alongside US finance leaders, using AI tools to do more and applying the judgment to catch what those tools get wrong. At one client, an AR dashboard now used across the organization was built almost entirely by MAVI talent.

We stay involved throughout, from role alignment and interview preparation to onboarding and long-term career development.

The Role

We are seeking a Finance Business Partner to connect the accounting numbers with the people who run the business at a high-growth US consumer brand selling across ecommerce and marketplace channels, working remotely from Argentina.

You will partner with department heads on their budgets, forecasts, and spend, and make sure what they plan ties back to what is actually recorded. A strong accounting foundation is what makes the role work: you will support the close for your areas, so your analysis starts from numbers you understand and trust.

What You'll Own

Business Partnering and FP&A

• Budget owners. Act as the finance partner to department heads, helping them plan, track, and explain their spend and headcount.

• Budget and forecast. Build and maintain departmental budgets and the rolling forecast, and feed them into the company plan.

• Variance analysis. Explain budget-versus-actual results each month, with clear root causes and recommended actions.

• Reporting and KPIs. Build reporting packages and dashboards that give leadership a reliable view of performance.

Accounting Support

• Close support. Prepare accruals, prepaids, and reclasses for your areas, and review department-level P&L coding before the close is finalized.

• Spend control. Work with AP and procurement on vendor spend, approvals, and cost allocation.

• Data integrity. Reconcile planning data to the general ledger so forecasts and actuals stay consistent.

CPG and Ecommerce

• Sales and payouts. Reconcile sales and payouts from Shopify, Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, and other storefronts to the general ledger, using tools such as A2X.

• Inventory. Maintain inventory roll-forwards and reconcile inventory systems (such as Cin7, Finale Inventory, or Fishbowl) and 3PL reports to the general ledger.

• Margin analysis. Build gross margin analysis by channel and SKU to inform pricing, promotions, and forecasts.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of experience across accounting and FP&A, with a solid accounting foundation

• Experience in accounting for CPG, ecommerce, or retail businesses, including multichannel sales reconciliation and inventory

• Experience building budgets, forecasts, and budget-versus-actual analysis

• US GAAP or IFRS experience, with substantial exposure to clients or entities in the US, UK, Canada, or Australia

• Strong financial modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets

• Experience working directly with non-finance stakeholders and explaining numbers in plain terms

• Experience with a major ERP or accounting system, such as NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks Online, or Xero

• Strong written and spoken English for daily work with US teams

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or an equivalent professional qualification

Preferred

• CPA, Contador Público, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent preferred

• Experience using AI tools in finance workflows, with the judgment to review and correct AI-generated output

• Experience with planning or BI tools such as Adaptive, Pigment, Mosaic, Power BI, or Looker

• Experience with DTC, wholesale, or retail channel planning

• Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed company

Who This Role Is For

A finance professional who is equally at home in the general ledger and in a budget review, and who would rather help a department head make a better decision than simply report what they spent.

Why Join Through MAVI

• Partner directly with department heads and finance leadership at a high-growth US consumer brand

• Build a combined accounting and FP&A profile, the foundation for senior finance roles

• Full-time, long-term placement, with MAVI handling cross-border contracts, compliance, and payroll

• USD-denominated compensation aligned with experience and scope

• Progress toward Senior Finance Manager, FP&A Manager, and Finance Manager opportunities through MAVI

Work Arrangement

This is a fully remote role with a single client company for the duration of the engagement. Full-time roles require a minimum of 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time (ET); part-time roles require a minimum of 2 hours.
