postings.title: Senior Technical Trainer — AI / DevOps
postings.descriptionText:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Trainer — AI / DevOps based in Argentina.

As a Senior Technical Trainer, you will combine hands-on DevOps expertise with a passion for teaching to develop practical, engaging courses on AI-powered engineering workflows. You will help engineers understand how to apply AI agents, coding assistants, and modern AI tools to real-world infrastructure and automation challenges. Working alongside a curriculum team and experienced technical educators, you will design lessons, develop hands-on lab specifications, and record clear, compelling instructional videos. This remote freelance opportunity begins with a paid course project, typically lasting around three months, with the potential for ongoing projects or a full-time position. You will have the flexibility to work alongside existing commitments while contributing your technical knowledge to a global engineering community. The ideal candidate is a practising DevOps engineer who can simplify complex concepts, communicate confidently on camera, and create learning experiences that make advanced technologies accessible.

Accountabilities

• Design and develop technical courses

• Collaborate with the curriculum team to define course structure, learning objectives, lesson sequences, and practical lab exercises focused on AI for DevOps.

• Develop content that demonstrates how engineers use AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM-based automation in real infrastructure environments.

• Ensure lessons are technically accurate, relevant, practical, and aligned with the needs of working engineers.

• Create engaging instructional content

• Write concise, story-driven video scripts designed to explain technical concepts clearly, with individual lessons typically lasting around six minutes.

• Use AI tools where helpful during drafting while ensuring the final scripts reflect your own voice, expertise, and teaching style.

• Narrate and present lessons confidently in English, making complex technical topics approachable for learners at different experience levels.

• Develop and validate hands-on labs

• Write detailed specifications for practical labs that demonstrate real-world DevOps and AI workflows.

• Collaborate with the dedicated labs team responsible for building the lab environments.

• Test completed labs, validate technical accuracy, and ensure exercises deliver the intended learning outcomes.

• Record demonstrations and walkthroughs explaining how to complete lab exercises and solve practical challenges.

• Collaborate on quality and editorial development

• Work closely with curriculum and production teams throughout the course development process.

• Incorporate structured editorial feedback, particularly during the initial course section, to align content with established teaching standards.

• Participate in regular team syncs and maintain communication through collaboration tools such as Slack.

• Focus on technical expertise, teaching, scripting, and recording while the production team manages video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and publishing.

Requirements

• Hands-on DevOps and infrastructure experience

• Strong practical knowledge of Linux, containers, Kubernetes, at least one major cloud platform, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (IaC).

• Experience building, operating, and maintaining infrastructure rather than relying solely on theoretical knowledge.

• The ability to demonstrate real engineering workflows and translate practical experience into effective learning materials.

• Current experience with AI technologies

• Practical experience using AI tools in engineering work, including AI agents, coding assistants, and LLM-based automation.

• Genuine curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and a commitment to staying current with new tools and techniques.

• The ability to explain how AI can support infrastructure engineering and DevOps workflows; deep specialization in AI research is not required.

• Teaching and communication skills

• A demonstrated passion for teaching, supported by experience creating courses, publishing tutorials, delivering talks or workshops, mentoring colleagues, or sharing technical knowledge with a community.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly, naturally, and confidently on camera.

• Strong storytelling skills and the ability to break down complex technical concepts into simple, structured explanations.

• Empathy for learners, particularly beginners, and an understanding of how to make technical material engaging and accessible.

• Collaboration and adaptability

• Willingness to follow an established teaching methodology and incorporate constructive editorial feedback.

• Ability to work independently, organize deliverables, and meet an agreed project schedule.

• Comfort working remotely with a distributed team, including participation in weekly syncs and some time-zone overlap with colleagues based in Europe and Asia.

• Additional qualifications considered an advantage

• Previously published online courses on platforms such as Udemy or Pluralsight, or experience authoring a technical book.

• Experience speaking at conferences or meetups, maintaining a technical YouTube channel or blog, or contributing to technical communities.

• Community credentials or roles such as CNCF Ambassador, AWS Community Builder, or Microsoft MVP.

• Relevant Kubernetes certifications, including CKA, CKAD, or CKS, or recognition such as Kubestronaut.

• Cloud certifications from providers such as AWS or Microsoft Azure.

Benefits

• Competitive fixed fee per course, agreed upfront based on course length and topic complexity, with higher compensation for advanced topics and exceptional instructors.

• Paid freelance project that can be completed alongside an existing job, with no fixed weekly-hour requirement.

• A typical initial project duration of approximately three months, with a mutually agreed delivery plan.

• Potential to progress to a full-time role or take on additional course projects based on mutual fit.

• Fully remote working arrangements with flexible hours.

• Opportunity to collaborate with a global technical education team and reach a community of more than one million engineers.

• Dedicated production support for video editing, animation, lab infrastructure, and course publishing, allowing you to focus on teaching and technical content.

• Opportunity to share your expertise in AI, DevOps, cloud, and Kubernetes through practical, hands-on education.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

postings.title: Customer Onboarding Specialist - AgTech / Tecnología Agrícola
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About The Role

As a South American Launch Specialist, you'll be one of the first people on the ground establishing Halter's presence across the region — and you'll own what it means to bring Halter to producers in Argentina, Uruguay, and Brazil for the first time.

You'll lead the rollout of Halter on new operations end-to-end: training cattle and operators, solving problems in the field, and supporting producers as they get started. You'll work directly with ganaderos and pecuaristas — on the estancia, on the fazenda, in the campo — building the onboarding experience that every future customer in the region will inherit.

This role is partially field-based. Expect roughly a 70/30 split toward time on the ground, with regular travel across Argentina, Uruguay, and Brazil. You'll be with customers where they run their cattle, and the quality of what you build depends on you being there and understanding their operations deeply..

It's practical, hands-on, and highly ownership-driven. Every operation is different, and you'll tailor each deployment to help producers build confidence with Halter. Because we're early here, your read on what's working — and what local producers actually need — feeds straight back into how we build. You'll work closely with our Product team to make sure Halter meets the realities of South American ranching, not a playbook borrowed from somewhere else.

What Your Day Could Look Like

• Own deployments from sales handoff through a smooth transition to the broader customer team

• Travel to estancias and fazendas across Argentina, Uruguay, and Brazil to deploy Halter in person

• Work directly with producers to bring Halter into their operation and support day-to-day use

• Lead training that fits the operation: practical, straightforward, and useful

• Act as the main point of contact during deployment, giving customers a clear, reliable owner

• Partner closely with Sales, Support, Product, and Operations to keep deployments coordinated across borders

• Keep deployments on track by managing timelines, aligning resources, and clearing blockers

• Solve problems quickly and adapt plans as conditions change — language, terrain, and infrastructure will all vary

• Spot patterns in the field and feed them directly to Product to shape how Halter works for the region

• Set customers up with the confidence and foundation needed for long-term success with Halter

• Whatever else it takes: This is an early-stage market entry. You’ll do what needs doing to make Halter succeed in South America.

Who Are We Looking For

• Experience working with customers: whether onboarding, supporting, deploying, or managing complex rollouts

• Genuine comfort with travel and field work

• Fluency in Spanish and English, Portuguese is a bonus.

• Confidence operating independently and keeping priorities organized

• The ability to coordinate moving pieces and keep things progressing without constant oversight

• A practical, solutions-focused mindset when challenges come up

• Comfort working cross-functionally: pulling in the right people and keeping everyone aligned

• Clear, straightforward communication

• Good judgment and the ability to adapt when plans change

• A genuine care for the people we serve and the quality of the work

• Agriculture or cattle ranching experience, especially with extensive grazing systems

English proficiency is a requirement for this role. The recruitment process will include interviews conducted in English, and a significant part of the day-to-day work will also be conducted in English. Candidates should feel comfortable communicating, participating in professional conversations, and working effectively in English. If you are not comfortable having professional conversations in English, this role may not be the right fit for you.

NICE TO HAVES

• Familiarity with the South American beef sector across one or more of Argentina, Uruguay, or Brazil

• Startup or high-growth environment experience

• Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Intercom, or similar systems

• Experience working in ag-tech

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

Job Description

NOTE: This is a FULLY remote role, but the candidate must be within LATAM to collaborate with their team, peers, and internal customers. You do not have to be in the specific country or city shown in this listing, but please only apply if you are physically based within LATAM.

Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth.

Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental PMS unicorn 🦄. Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here .

We are looking for a Customer Onboarding Specialist to join our LATAM team. You will be instrumental in the first stages of our customer’s journey. You will ensure that new clients are transitioned smoothly and effectively onto our platform, setting them up for success from day one. This position requires a deep understanding of customer engagement and a passion for delivering outstanding service. You will also become an expert user of all Hostaway products.

About The Role

• Implement effective onboarding processes for new customers, ensuring a seamless transition and a solid foundation for their success.

• Conduct initial training sessions and demonstrations tailored to customer needs, promoting a deep understanding of our product features and capabilities.

• Develop customized onboarding materials and resources in Spanish & English

• Maintain clear, consistent, and proactive communication with new customers throughout the onboarding process.

• Collaborate with the sales and customer success teams to identify opportunities for customer satisfaction improvement and to streamline the onboarding process.

• Monitor and report on the effectiveness of onboarding initiatives, using customer feedback and onboarding metrics to drive continuous improvement.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for new customers during the onboarding phase, addressing any issues and ensuring they are resolved promptly.

Job Requirements

• Between 1-3 years of experience in customer onboarding or customer success roles within the SaaS industry.

• Fluent proficiency in English and Spanish is mandatory to communicate with customers. English is also our company language used internally. Any additional languages will be a plus.

• Proven ability to manage multiple onboarding projects simultaneously, while maintaining sharp attention to detail.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to create a positive first impression with new customers.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and training skills.

• Ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and continuously update skills in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically.

What we offer

• Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant.

• 100% Remote: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence—be it a co-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one).

• Equity: Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success.

• Values-Driven Leadership: Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions.

• Professional Growth: Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities.

• Annual Paid Leave: The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract-specific norms.

• Geographic Specific Benefits: As an international employer, we offer different country-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant.

• Dynamic Team Culture: As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here).

Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied.

postings.title: Implementation Consultant I
postings.descriptionText:
SOVOS

Implementation Consultant I

Sovos·Full-Time·Argentina

Build Your Future With Us

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

The Role

At Sovos, we're looking for an Implementation Consultant I to guide new clients through the onboarding journey, from kickoff to successful go-live. You'll manage project plans, complete configurations, deliver training, and ensure a smooth transition to our ongoing support teams, all while building strong client relationships and contributing to continuous process improvement.

More Specifically, You Will

• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the implementation process, managing project plans, timelines, risks, and issues to ensure on-time delivery and high satisfaction.

• Complete configuration tasks and document all setup details in comprehensive Client Procedures documents that support long-term success.

• Lead collaborative work sessions with clients to understand their business logic, translate requirements into technical specifications, and deliver technology-based solutions to their compliance challenges.

• Provide training to clients and execute seamless, well-documented transitions to Client Support or Compliance Services teams upon project completion.

• Leverage AI tools and identify process improvements across implementation workflows, documentation, reporting, and tooling to enhance the client onboarding experience.

• Continue service activities for clients as needed, especially during peak processing periods, ensuring continuity and support beyond initial implementation.

What You Bring to Sovos

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, highly preferred.

• You've built experience in service-related roles, ideally 1-2 years, where you've managed multiple projects, timelines, and client relationships.

• Foundational understanding of tax compliance software, SaaS implementations, or related product offerings.

• Strong time management, organizational, and decision-making skills with the ability to balance competing priorities across multiple client engagements.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with the ability to comprehend and explain complex concepts clearly.

• Comfort with AI-assisted workflows and technology platforms including project management tools, CRM systems, and collaboration software.

• Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

The Process

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

1

Pre-Employment Assessment

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.

2

Video Interview

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

3

Meeting with a Recruiter

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.

4

Live Interviews with the Hiring Team

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.

Life at Sovos

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

• Global Mentoring Programs

• AI Tools and Technology from Day 1

• Continuous Learning and Development

• Language Learning Support

• Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs

• Global Parental Leave Policy

• Comprehensive Health Insurance

• Life Insurance

• Monthly Meal Vouchers

• Gym Membership Subsidy

Equal Opportunity Employer

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.

More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.

Ready to make your move?

We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application

Position Overview
The Clinical Sales Manager is responsible for driving clinical adoption of Edge Medical’s robotic surgical system by supporting surgeons, training operating room staff and increasing robotic procedure volume while supporting long-term clinical success following system installation.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide clinical support during robotic surgical procedures.

• Deliver product training for surgeons, nurses and operating room staff.

• Support product demonstrations, evaluations and clinical trials.

• Assist hospitals during system installation, first clinical cases and robotic program launch.

• Support customer onboarding and ensure a smooth transition from system installation to routine clinical practice.

• Support surgeons throughout the customer journey, from product evaluation to routine clinical use.

• Drive clinical adoption and increase robotic procedure volume.

• Promote disposable products and support recurring business growth.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with surgeons, KOLs and hospital clinical teams.

• Collect customer feedback and communicate market requirements internally.

• Work closely with Capital Sales throughout the customer journey.

• Participate in workshops, cadaver labs, conferences and scientific meetings.

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Biomedical Engineering, Medicine or related disciplines.

• Experience supporting robotic surgery or advanced surgical devices.

• Strong understanding of operating room workflow.

• Experience training surgeons and clinical teams.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Fluent English.

• Willingness to travel extensively.

Preferred Experience
Experience with one or more of the following is highly preferred:

• Intuitive Surgical

• CMR Surgical

• Medtronic Hugo

• Robotic Surgery

• Surgical Navigation

• Advanced Surgical Devices

postings.title: Customer Engineer (BigQuery)
postings.descriptionText:
Rabbit helps enterprises cut their GCP spend — and the difference between a customer who saves millions and one who churns is the engineer standing next to them during adoption. We’re hiring a Customer Engineer to be that person for our customers across the US and the broader Americas.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing engineering role. Your focus is making customers successful: gluing Rabbit into each customer’s GCP environment, getting them onboarded and integrated, and keeping them unblocked so the product delivers real savings on their workloads. You’ll work closely with the core engineering team, but your center of gravity is the customer, not the roadmap.

Initial domain: BigQuery cost optimization — slot management, reservation models, job-level optimization, query analysis at petabyte scale. As Rabbit’s optimization scope expands across GCP, so will yours.

What You’ll Actually Do

• Own technical adoption for a portfolio of enterprise customers — onboarding, configuration, and integrating Rabbit into their GCP setup until they hit first measurable savings

• Be the go-to technical contact when something breaks — investigate, debug, and fix issues across data anomalies, pipelines, and BigQuery cost questions

• Advise customers on GCP cost strategy — BigQuery reservation models, slot management, billing mechanics — and how Rabbit fits in

• Run technical Q&A, troubleshooting sessions, and hands-on workshops with customer teams

• Relay field signal back to Product and Engineering — you’ll have more customer context than anyone, and the core team builds on what you surface

• When the product genuinely can’t cover a customer need, build a custom solution to bridge the gap — but the goal is always to fold that need back into the platform, not to maintain bespoke one-offs

How We Work — AI-First, Agentic by Default

Rabbit is an AI-first company. Agentic development practices are mandatory, not optional — Claude Code, Cursor, and agent-driven workflows are how we move. You’ll use them to integrate, debug, and unblock customers in hours, not days.

You Should Have

Must-have:

• 5+ years in a technical, customer-facing role — Customer/Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, TAM, or similar — with real hands-on engineering, not just advisory

• Deep BigQuery expertise — slots, reservations, pricing models, INFORMATION_SCHEMA, query optimization. Hard requirement; we’ll test for it.

• Strong SQL, and comfort in backend code (any language) — enough to integrate, script, and debug in a customer’s environment

• Hands-on GCP experience — you’ve worked with production workloads on Google Cloud

• Customer-facing instinct — you can run a technical conversation with an enterprise team without an Account Executive holding your hand

• Fluent with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) on real production work — not just demos

• Autonomy — small team, no middle management, you own customer outcomes

Strong plus:

• GCP cost management, FinOps, or cloud billing optimization background

• Familiarity with BigQuery reservation models, slot pricing, and workload management

• Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform on GCP)

Why This Role

• Direct customer impact. You see your work land in dollars saved on real workloads, customer by customer.

• Hard problems, hands-on. BigQuery optimization at petabyte scale, real-world anomalies, messy integrations — not generic SaaS onboarding.

• Short path to the product. What you surface from the field shapes what the core team builds next.

• Own the relationship. Small team, real ownership over whether your customers succeed.

Why Join Rabbit

• Ownership from day one: Design your own pipelines, choose your own tools, architect your own solutions. We trust senior engineers and managers to make senior decisions

• Work with cutting-edge at scale: BigQuery optimization at petabyte scale, real-time anomaly detection, cost prediction algorithms — these are hard, unsolved problems.

• Learn and grow fast: Work alongside data architects and senior engineers who will challenge you. Shipping to Fortune 500 companies will level you up faster than any course ever could

• Not for everyone. Perfect for you if: You're driven by impact, not comfort. You'd rather tackle hard problems with smart people than easy problems alone. You want your work to matter.

In Return We Offer

• the opportunity to maintain a healthy work-life balance with financial initiatives to support physical and mental health and green commuting, including support for remote work, commuting, and eyeglasses (depending on the location)

• continuous training and learning opportunities with yearly allocated learning hours from working time, including language learning (English and German)

• social activities for everyone (team building events, company breakfasts, Christmas, Halloween, and alumni parties, sport events, professional meetups, darts tournaments)

...last but not least, a great community and an international environment. :)

postings.title: Partner Solutions Engineer - LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

Role Overview

The Partner Solutions Engineer (PSE) at DevRev is a customer-obsessed technical professional who plays a key role in driving partner-led growth and adoption. You will serve as the technical bridge between DevRev and our ecosystem of resellers, OEMs, system integrators, and strategic alliances.

In this role, you will lead pre-sales discovery, design custom solutions, enable technical teams at partner organizations, and act as a trusted advisor across the full partner lifecycle. You’ll collaborate closely with DevRev’s Sales, Product, and GTM teams, empowering partners to independently position, implement, and scale DevRev solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Partner Enablement & Technical Leadership

• Articulate the features, benefits, and business value of the DevRev platform.

• Translate partner business models and objectives into DevRev-aligned solutions.

• Support partner solution discovery, architecture, and proposal creation during the sales cycle.

• Deliver technical enablement programs including:

• Tailored product and solution updates

• Hands-on bootcamps, SE shadowing, and technical workshops

• Joint solution and service co-creation

• Enable partners to deliver independent pre-sales motions and contribute to regional revenue growth.

Sales & Evaluation Support

• Support demos, technical presentations, and PoCs for partner-led sales cycles.

• Guide and manage technical evaluations and proof-of-value engagements.

• Collaborate with DevRev support and product teams to resolve technical roadblocks.

• Capture and relay product feedback, partner insights, and customer pain points.

Technical Enablement Planning

• Co-create enablement plans with partner sales leaders, including:

• Certification pathways and role-based training modules

• Joint technical goals and milestone tracking

• Lead certification bootcamps and instructor-led enablement tracks.

• Host Expert Sessions to update partner SEs on product releases and best practices.

• Optimize reach and impact by scaling enablement across partner organizations.

Partner Relationship & Technical Account Management

• Develop strategic relationships with partner architects and C-level leaders.

• Conduct roadmap alignment sessions and technical QBRs.

• Build and maintain partner org charts and communication matrices.

• Champion DevRev inside partner orgs to drive mindshare and product positioning.

• Identify, qualify, and support partner-driven upsell and cross-sell motions.

• Collaborate with DevRev Field SEs and Solution Architects for co-selling and support.

Community Engagement & Thought Leadership

• Build and foster a technical partner community:

• Organize roundtables, regional events, and community forums.

• Mentor technical champions within partner orgs and elevate them through enablement tracks.

• Maintain active visibility via LinkedIn, blog posts, forums, and content contributions.

• Support media and co-marketing efforts, including reference case development and campaign support.

Qualifications & Experience

An ideal candidate for this role would bring the following background:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• A minimum of 10 years of experience at B2B SaaS or platform vendor(s) in technical pre-sales or solutions engineering roles, of which a minimum of 5 years of experience in a partner focused role.

• Proven track record delivering technical demos, workshops, and tailored solution proposals.

• Strong technical acumen with the ability to explain complex concepts to both technical and business audiences.

• Excellent communication, storytelling, and interpersonal skills.

• Experience conducting competitive analysis, identifying partner white-space, and influencing roadmap direction.

• Willingness to travel up to 75% depending on business and partner needs, including out of country or overseas travel.

Skills & Proficiency Requirements

To thrive in this role, a DevRev Partner Solutions Engineer should have the following capabilities:

Soft Skills & Consultative Capabilities

• Consultative mindset; skilled at mapping business problems to technical solutions.

• Clear communicator with confidence presenting to technical and executive stakeholders.

• Strong partner enablement and mentoring capabilities.

• Cross-functional collaborator; works well with GTM, Product, and Customer Engineering.

• Relationship builder across C-level, solution architect, and SE personas.

Ecosystem & Platform Experience

• Familiarity with:

• DevOps & Agile: Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins

• CRM & CX: Salesforce, Zendesk, Intercom, ServiceNow, HubSpot

• Incident Management: Datadog, PagerDuty, Sentry

• Collaboration Tools: Slack, Notion, Confluence

Technical Hands-On Proficiency

• Proficient in: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Bash

• Experienced in using: REST APIs, webhooks, OpenAPI/Swagger

• Skilled with CLI tools, Git, JSON/YAML, log parsing, and basic SQL.

• Tools: Postman, Beeceptor, Docker, VS Code, GitHub.

• Exposure to low-code platforms and workflow builders.

• Frontend familiarity (React, Tailwind, Flask, HTML/CSS).

Modern Script Development & AI Tooling

• Able to rapidly prototype using:

• Cursor, Claude Code, MCP

• Comfortable with prompt design and LLM-based workflows.

• Experience with GenAI use cases like:

• Conversational AI

• Ticket deflection & triage

• AI assistants & agents

Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps Familiarity

• Working knowledge of:

• Cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, Azure

• App architecture: middleware, APIs, frontend/backend layers

• Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes

• CI/CD: GitHub Actions, CircleCI, GitLab

• Networking basics: HTTP, DNS, auth, proxies

Application & Solution Development

• Experience modeling AI-driven workflows and SaaS use cases.

• Able to design solutions around:

• Incident resolution loops

• Product feedback cycles

• End-to-end service operations

• Co-creates embedded offerings with partners leveraging DevRev’s building blocks.

How do we work?

Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger

Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly

We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome

Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

That’s DevRev!

DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

Worker Operations is the team that owns end-to-end operations and support for the supply-side (the workers) of our marketplace. We are over 200 team members who serve the 400,000+ (and growing) active professionals on our marketplace. As a Worker Operations Team Lead your primary role is to be an exceptional coach for your team.

Your responsibility is to provide agents with constructive feedback, identify the root causes of performance issues, and train them to address and correct those problems. • Closely monitoring agent performance, primarily in terms of quality, productivity, and attendance metrics, with a primary goal of maintaining quality assurance scores above 90%

Hiring Process

Quick Note On Scammers

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

Influencer Hero is looking for a technically-minded Integration Consultant to lead our clients through the onboarding and implementation process of our influencer marketing software.

You will play a key role in ensuring a smooth and effective experience for new users—from initial setup to technical integration and optimization. This role requires a strong ability to understand e-commerce technology, communicate clearly, and think critically to solve challenges and maximize client success.

Compensation range: USD 3-6K

What You'll Do

• Manage the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring timely and effective implementation

• Conduct platform walkthroughs and technical onboarding sessions tailored to each client’s needs

• Provide advice & consultation on clients’ influencer marketing strategy & implementation

• Identify integration requirements, provide configuration guidance, and ensure successful deployment

• Respond to client inquiries via Intercom chat, ensuring quick and accurate resolution of technical questions

• Collaborate with our development team to troubleshoot issues, report bugs, and provide feedback for continuous improvement

• Create and improve internal documentation and implementation workflows to enhance the client experience

What We're Looking For

• 1+ year of experience in a customer-facing role involving technical onboarding or implementation

• English fluency (oral and written)

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly grasp how systems work

• Excellent communication skills—you’re clear, confident, and articulate

• Highly organized and capable of managing multiple implementation timelines simultaneously

• Tech-savvy and able to understand eCommerce workflows, integrations, and troubleshooting across common tools (Shopify, Klaviyo etc.)

• Able to translate technical concepts into clear customer-facing guidance (eCommerce stack, integrations, data flows, and process setup)

• A proactive team player who takes initiative and enjoys working cross-functionally

Why Join Influencer Hero?
At Influencer Hero, you’ll play a key role in helping D2C brands succeed with our technology. We value people who are curious, driven, and able to think both strategically and technically. If you enjoy solving real-world problems and working closely with both clients and product teams, we’d love to hear from you.

Kindly submit your CV in English.

postings.descriptionText:
Role Summary

Support the operation, governance, adoption, and continuous improvement of the enterprise electronic Quality Management System (eQMS). Serve as an eQMS super user and operational partner to Quality process owners, site teams, IT, Digital, and system users across the global network.

Key Responsibilities

• Support daily eQMS administration, including user access, security roles, account changes, documentation, routine maintenance, and release readiness.

• Provide first-level user support, troubleshoot system issues, coordinate complex issues with technical teams or vendors, and facilitate office hours and post-go-live support.

• Partner with module owners to coordinate governance activities, business requirements, enhancement requests, testing, deployment milestones, metrics, and action tracking.

• Deliver and maintain training, job aids, onboarding resources, and super-user support; monitor training completion, user adoption, and recurring support needs.

• Develop dashboards and analyze system usage, workflow performance, open issues, and adoption trends to identify opportunities for simplification, automation, and improved user experience.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Quality, Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.

• At least 3 years of experience supporting quality systems, business systems, enterprise software, shared services, or related operations.

• Experience providing end-user support, troubleshooting, training, system testing, or project coordination.

• Strong analytical, organizational, communication, customer-service, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience administering or supporting an eQMS or another regulated enterprise platform.

• Knowledge of quality management systems, regulated environments, system governance, software implementation, or change management.

• Experience as a system administrator, super user, business analyst, or process support specialist in a global or virtual organization.

• Experience with Power BI, reporting, analytics, workflow automation, or digital quality improvement.

postings.title: Ingeniero de Procesos Sr.
postings.descriptionText:
A Lear para Vos

Trabajamos arduamente por las personas que trabajan con nosotros. Defendemos a nuestros equipos y promovemos la colaboración, la inclusión, el respeto y la excelencia. Porque queremos ofrecer más para vos.

Un camino hacia una mejor carrera. Un mejor futuro.

Nuestros equipos desarrollan tecnologías innovadoras, fabrican millones de productos y han conquistado una larga lista de reconocimientos. Año tras año, somos nombrados entre las empresas más admiradas del mundo.

Ellos son el secreto de nuestro éxito: empoderados, innovadores e inclusivos. Apasionados por lo que hacen. Motivados para alcanzar resultados. Porque ganamos juntos.

¿Estás listo/a para una mejor carrera? ¿Un mejor futuro?

Sobre la posición

Buscamos un/a profesional de Ingeniería con orientación al cliente y sólida capacidad técnica para actuar como nexo estratégico entre las operaciones de planta, los equipos de ingeniería de procesos y el cliente. Como parte del equipo de ingeniería, será responsable de coordinar actividades relacionadas con cotizaciones, análisis técnicos, seguimiento de prototipos, reuniones de avance y planes de implementación. Principales Responsabilidades

Sus actividades incluirán, pero no estarán limitadas a:

• Gestionar el soporte al cliente en actividades de cambios de ingeniería, cotizaciones y seguimiento de proyectos.

• Analizar, junto con Ingeniería de Procesos, la factibilidad técnica y operativa de modificaciones solicitadas por el cliente.

• Coordinar reuniones técnicas con clientes y equipos internos para asegurar la correcta ejecución de cambios.

• Implementar y dar seguimiento a planes de acción asociados a lanzamientos, cambios de producto y mejoras de proceso.

• Monitorear actividades de montabilidad de prototipos y producción piloto en instalaciones del cliente.

• Desarrollar reportes técnicos y presentaciones ejecutivas sobre el avance de proyectos y gestión de cambios.

• Colaborar con áreas de Manufactura, Calidad, Ingeniería y Program Management para garantizar el cumplimiento de objetivos.

• Garantizar el cumplimiento de los KPIs asignados a la posición y proponer acciones correctivas cuando sea necesario.

• Conducir actividades de mejora continua orientadas a optimizar procesos, costos, calidad y satisfacción del cliente.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de las políticas de Calidad, Medio Ambiente, Salud y Seguridad de Lear.

Requisitos Obligatorios

Formación Académica

• Técnico o Ingeniero en Ingeniería Mecánica, Electromecánica, Industrial o carreras afines.

• Título técnico o universitario finalizado.

Experiencia Profesional

• Experiencia previa en entornos industriales o automotrices.

• Experiencia en gestión de cambios, soporte al cliente o ingeniería de procesos.

• Experiencia trabajando con equipos multidisciplinarios y contacto directo con clientes.

Competencias Técnicas

• Conocimientos de procesos productivos, manufactura y ensamble.

• Capacidad de análisis técnico y resolución de problemas.

• Conocimiento de metodologías de mejora continua.

• Interpretación de documentación técnica y especificaciones de ingeniería.

Conocimientos de Sistemas

• Manejo de PC y herramientas de Microsoft Office.

• Dominio de Excel para análisis y seguimiento de indicadores.

• Experiencia con sistemas de gestión industrial será valorada.

Idiomas

• Inglés intermedio o avanzado, con capacidad para participar en reuniones y gestionar documentación técnica.

Diferenciales

• Experiencia en industria automotriz y relación con OEMs.

• Conocimiento de líneas de armado y ensamble automotriz.

• Experiencia trabajando de manera residente en planta cliente.

• Conocimiento de APQP, PPAP, Lean Manufacturing o herramientas de calidad.

• Experiencia en gestión de prototipos y validaciones de montabilidad.

• Habilidades destacadas de liderazgo, comunicación y negociación.

Lo que ofrecemos

• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional y crecimiento dentro de una organización global líder en la industria automotriz.

• Participación en proyectos estratégicos con clientes de primer nivel.

• Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo, dinámico e impulsado por la innovación.

• Exposición internacional y trabajo con equipos multidisciplinarios.

• Cultura basada en la diversidad, inclusión y respeto por las personas.

• Desafíos constantes que permiten desarrollar competencias técnicas y de liderazgo.

Collaboration

Tableau (Business Intelligence Software)

Advocacy

Governance

Project Planning

Kaizen Methodology

SAP Applications

Define Measure Analyze Improve And Control (DMAIC)

SQL (Programming Language)

Process Design

Diversidad e Inclusión

Lear Corporation está comprometida con prácticas de empleo justas, basadas en el mérito y la igualdad de oportunidades.

Ofrecemos adaptaciones razonables de acuerdo con la legislación aplicable. Para obtener asistencia durante el proceso de postulación, comuníquese directamente con su reclutador.

Los candidatos deberán enviar sus currículums para evaluación a través de nuestro sistema de seguimiento de candidatos. Debido al alto volumen de postulaciones recibidas, solamente los candidatos seleccionados para entrevistas serán contactados.

postings.title: Microsoft Dynamics GP Support Consultant
postings.descriptionText:
Ware seeking a Microsoft Dynamics GP Support Consultant to support clients using Microsoft Dynamics GP across multiple versions and environments. This role is focused on functional support, client setup and configuration, troubleshooting, issue diagnosis, and user support across the core GP application.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics GP, understands how GP has evolved across several versions, and is comfortable troubleshooting both application-level issues and GP client workstation/environment issues.

Requirements:

Key Responsibilities

• Provide day-to-day support for Microsoft Dynamics GP clients.

• Diagnose and resolve functional issues across core GP modules.

• Triage support cases, gather relevant details, and identify root causes.

• Assist clients with configuration questions, transaction processing issues, posting errors, reporting questions, and month-end/year-end processes.

• Use SQL queries where appropriate to investigate data, validate transactions, and support issue diagnosis.

• Escalate technical or development-related issues with clear documentation and supporting evidence.

• Work with clients to reproduce issues and confirm resolution steps.

• Document findings, resolutions, and recommendations in the support case system.

• Support GP upgrades, environment reviews, and post-upgrade issue resolution as required.

• Collaborate with consultants, developers, and infrastructure teams when issues span multiple areas.

• Configure and support Microsoft Dynamics GP client workstation installs.

• Troubleshoot GP client launch, login, dictionary, connectivity, ODBC, and environment access issues.

• Assist with GP client setup for new users, new workstations, upgrades, and environment changes.

• Support configuration of GP client components, including shared dictionaries, forms/reports dictionaries, launch files, and workstation-specific settings.

• Diagnose issues related to GP client connectivity to SQL Server, company databases, Dynamics database, and application servers.

• Work with infrastructure teams on GP client dependencies, including Windows permissions, mapped drives, file shares, ODBC configuration, service packs, and runtime components.

• Support issues related to client/server version mismatches, missing dictionaries, broken shortcuts, application crashes, and login/security problems.

• Document repeatable GP client install, configuration, and troubleshooting procedure

Required Skills And Experience

• Hands-on experience supporting Microsoft Dynamics GP.

• Familiarity with multiple GP versions, including older versions still in active use.

• Strong functional understanding of core GP modules, including:

• General Ledger

• Accounts Payable

• Accounts Receivable

• Inventory

• Purchasing / Purchase Order Processing

• Ability to troubleshoot posting, batch, transaction, setup, and reporting issues.

• Comfortable communicating with end users, accounting teams, controllers, and client stakeholders.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to clearly document issues, findings, and recommended next steps.

• Strong customer service mindset and ability to manage support priorities.

Preferred Technical Skills

• Ability to write and interpret basic to intermediate SQL queries for diagnosis and triage.

• Familiarity with GP database structure and common GP tables.

• Experience reviewing transaction status, batch records, posting interruptions, distributions, and master records using SQL.

• Ability to distinguish between functional setup issues, data issues, user process issues, and technical defects.

﻿

Additional Experience Considered An Asset

Experience with any of the following would be valuable:

• Experience setting up and troubleshooting Microsoft Dynamics GP client installations.

• Understanding of GP client architecture, including local workstation components, shared dictionaries, SQL connectivity, launch files, and ODBC setup.

• Ability to troubleshoot common GP client issues across user workstations, terminal servers, Citrix/RDS environments, and local installs.

• Familiarity with GP security, company access, user setup, and login-related troubleshooting.

• Fixed Assets

• Analytical Accounting

• Management Reporter / Financial report writing

• SmartList Designer / SmartList Builder

• Integration Manager

• eConnect

• Modifier / VBA

• Workflow

• Manufacturing

• Project Accounting

• Field Service

• Collections Management

• Electronic Funds Transfer / EFT

• Third-party GP modules and ISV products

• Reporting tools such as SSRS, Power BI, or Excel-based reporting

• GP integrations with external systems

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a practical, client-focused GP consultant who can quickly assess issues, ask the right questions, and determine whether the problem is functional, data-related, technical, or process-driven. They should be comfortable supporting mature GP environments where customizations, older versions, third-party products, and historical configuration choices may all be part of the support landscape.

They do not need to be a developer, but they should be comfortable enough with SQL and GP data structures to support effective triage and provide developers or senior consultants with clear, useful diagnostic information.

• Asegurar que los partners tengan los recursos que necesitan (capacitaciones, herramientas, incentivos y soporte) para alcanzar y superar sus objetivos.

• Monitorear de forma continua el desempeño y la calidad de los servicios de las agencias, y proponer mejoras y programas de capacitación que aseguren la excelencia.

• Trabajar con el equipo de Partners de Tiendanube en campañas de venta, webinars y eventos.

• Aportar a la evolución de la propuesta de valor del programa para que las agencias con tengan mejor posicionamiento, beneficios y acceso.

• Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios (Sales, Growth, Marketing, Producto, Customer Success) para asegurar alineamiento estratégico y ejecución integrada de las iniciativas que impactan a los partners.

• Ser la voz del partner hacia adentro: traer insights de mercado, necesidades del ecosistema y tendencias para la evolución del programa y del producto.

Lo que buscamos

• Experiencia en ventas (hunter y/o farmer) en empresas de tecnología, SaaS o similares.

• Capacidad para definir y operacionalizar iniciativas comerciales de go-to-market.

• Perfil comercial orientado a la gestión de ventas, a la administración de una cartera de partners y a la buena interlocución con stakeholders.

• Habilidades de relacionamiento, negociación e influencia con niveles de gestión.

• Mindset estratégico con alta capacidad de ejecución hands-on en entornos dinámicos.

• Disponibilidad para trabajar con una modalidad híbrida al menos 1 vez a la semana (estamos ubicados en Nuñez - CABA).

Es un plus

• Conocimiento del mercado de e-commerce, en especial de plataformas de e-commerce.

• Conocimiento del mercado de agencias digitales en Argentina y/o México.

• Experiencia con herramientas de email marketing, marketing automation y CRM.

Nuestro proceso

Queremos que tengas la mejor experiencia posible a lo largo de nuestro proceso de selección. Después de que te postules, el equipo de Talent Acquisition va a analizar tu perfil con atención e, independientemente del resultado, vas a recibir una respuesta.

Las etapas y los plazos pueden variar según cada vacante, pero no te preocupes — vamos a mantenernos en contacto con vos durante todo el proceso.

Lo que te proponemos

• Cobertura de salud OSDE 310 para el grupo familiar (cónyuge + hijos);

• Clases de portugués 100% cubiertas;

• Reintegro del servicio de Internet;

• Descuentos en cursos de Coderhouse;

• La asistencia de guardería es un beneficio que tiene como objetivo apoyar a los colaboradores en la provisión de un entorno seguro para sus hijos desde los 45 días de vida, hasta los 3 años de edad, durante tu jornada laboral;

• Licencia familiar extendida a 21 días corridos para personas no gestantes o adoptantes;

• 15 días hábiles de vacaciones a lo largo del año;

• Además de las vacaciones, disponemos de una semana de descanso para recargar energías entre final/principio de nuevo año;

• Una Tiendanube gratuita para vos o alguien de tu entorno;

• Somos #remotefirst, priorizamos el trabajo remoto dentro del país de contratación, siempre que el rol lo permita;

• Es un entorno de desafío constante, propósito y protagonismo — acá la innovación nace de pensar en grande y tener actitud gigante.

Política de Privacidad

Tiendanube se compromete a proteger la privacidad y garantizar la seguridad de las personas indicadas para las vacantes que ofrecemos.

Para analizar tu solicitud, tendremos acceso a parte de tu información que será revisada antes de continuar. Utilizaremos estos datos para realizar los procesos de reclutamiento y selección. Además, cuidamos muy en serio a nuestras personas y solo compartimos información realmente necesaria. En última instancia, solo los mantendremos en nuestro sistema durante el tiempo que realmente lo necesitemos.

Para obtener más información sobre cómo manejamos los datos, incluidos tus derechos según la ley, simplemente accedé a nuestra Política de Privacidad.

Empresa internacional con sede en Dubái, Emiratos Árabes Unidos , busca incorporar un Especialista en Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram), Marketing Digital y Lead Generation , con experiencia comprobable en campañas publicitarias orientadas a resultados comerciales.
Buscamos un profesional estratégico, analítico y orientado a resultados, capaz de transformar la inversión publicitaria en leads calificados, clientes potenciales de alto valor y oportunidades reales de negocio en mercados internacionales, principalmente Latinoamérica y Estados Unidos .

Principales responsabilidades:

• Gestión avanzada de Meta Ads: Diseñar, implementar, administrar y optimizar campañas en Facebook e Instagram enfocadas en la generación de leads calificados y conversiones.

• Estrategia de marketing digital: Desarrollar estrategias publicitarias para posicionar nuestros servicios en mercados internacionales.

• Segmentación de audiencias: Investigar y desarrollar públicos objetivos mediante segmentación geográfica, demográfica, intereses, audiencias personalizadas y similares ( Lookalike Audiences ).

• Optimización y escalamiento de campañas: Realizar pruebas A/B, identificar anuncios ganadores, redistribuir presupuestos y escalar campañas rentables.

• Análisis de métricas y resultados: Monitorear indicadores clave como CPL, CTR, CPC, CPM, tasa de conversión, calidad de leads y costo de adquisición de clientes (CAC).

• Creatividad publicitaria: Desarrollar conceptos, mensajes comerciales, copys persuasivos y estrategias de comunicación para anuncios gráficos y audiovisuales.

• Generación de oportunidades comerciales: Implementar estrategias para captar potenciales clientes con una intención real de contratación, priorizando la calidad de los contactos por encima de la cantidad.

• Informes de rendimiento: Elaborar reportes semanales con resultados, análisis de desempeño y propuestas concretas para mejorar la rentabilidad de la inversión publicitaria.

• Planificación estratégica: Crear un calendario mensual de contenidos alineado con los objetivos comerciales, la identidad de marca y las tendencias del mercado.

• Posicionamiento de marca: Desarrollar estrategias para aumentar la visibilidad, el reconocimiento y la autoridad de la empresa en redes sociales.

• Gestión de redes sociales: Planificar y coordinar la publicación constante de contenidos en Instagram, Facebook a través de Meta.

• Contenido de tendencia: Investigar tendencias, formatos virales, temas relevantes y oportunidades de contenido para mantener una presencia digital actual y competitiva.

• Creación de reels y videos: Proponer y desarrollar ideas, guiones y conceptos audiovisuales para generar alcance, interacción y confianza.

• Diseño de carruseles y publicaciones: Crear o coordinar diseños modernos, atractivos y profesionales, adaptados a la identidad visual de la marca.

• Copywriting: Redactar textos persuasivos, títulos, descripciones, llamados a la acción (CTA) y mensajes orientados a generar interacción y conversiones.

• Contenido educativo y comercial: Desarrollar publicaciones que comuniquen el valor de nuestros servicios, respondan preguntas frecuentes y generen confianza en potenciales clientes.

• Coherencia visual y editorial: Mantener una identidad de marca consistente en todos los canales y formatos de comunicación.

• Engagement: Mejorar la interacción mediante contenidos relevantes, historias, encuestas, preguntas y otros formatos participativos.

• Gestión de interacciones: Supervisar comentarios y mensajes directos, y coordinar respuestas oportunas a consultas de potenciales clientes.

• Desarrollar conceptos creativos para anuncios gráficos y audiovisuales.

• Adaptar contenidos orgánicos a campañas publicitarias de alto rendimiento.

• Diseñar estrategias de remarketing y embudos de conversión .

• Identificar qué contenidos generan mayor interacción, confianza y oportunidades comerciales .

• Coordinar la estrategia de contenidos con los objetivos de captación de clientes.

• Elaborar reportes semanales y mensuales sobre el rendimiento de campañas y contenidos.

• Analizar métricas de publicidad, alcance orgánico, engagement, crecimiento de comunidad y generación de leads.

• Identificar oportunidades de mejora y proponer nuevas estrategias.

• Presentar un calendario de contenidos y una planificación de acciones para el período siguiente.

• Tomar decisiones basadas en datos para mejorar tanto el posicionamiento de marca como los resultados comerciales.

REQUISITOS DEL PERFIL:

• Residencia en Argentina.

• Mínimo 3 años de experiencia comprobable en Meta Ads .

• Experiencia en generación de leads para empresas de servicios.

• Dominio de Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversion API (CAPI) y seguimiento de conversiones.

• Experiencia en planificación de calendarios editoriales y estrategias de contenidos para redes sociales.

• Conocimientos de diseño para redes sociales, tendencias digitales, reels, videos y carruseles.

• Experiencia en copywriting, storytelling y creación de contenidos orientados a objetivos.

• Conocimientos de marketing estratégico, embudos de conversión y remarketing.

• Capacidad para analizar métricas, optimizar campañas y medir resultados.

• Habilidad para combinar creatividad, estrategia y análisis de datos.

• Organización, autonomía, proactividad y capacidad para trabajar de forma remota.

MODALIDAD DE CONTRATACIÓN Y REMUNERACIÓN:

• Modalidad de trabajo: 100% remoto desde Argentina.

• Empresa empleadora: Empresa internacional con sede en Dubái, Emiratos Árabes Unidos.

• Remuneración: Ofrecemos un salario mensual.

• Mercados objetivo: Latinoamérica y Estados Unidos.

¿CÓMO POSTULARSE?
Los interesados deberán enviar su CV actualizado , junto con su portfolio o ejemplos de trabajos realizados y resultados obtenidos.
La postulación deberá incluir:

• Experiencia comprobable en campañas de Meta Ads.

📧 Enviar CV, portfolio y pretensión salarial a: info@dubaiconnecting.com

postings.title: Paid media
postings.descriptionText:
Buscamos Paid Media Specialist | Meta Ads para médicos estéticos

Cuando una campaña genera mensajes, ¿te interesa saber cuántos terminan en una consulta y qué pasa con los que no avanzan?

En Cess Agency buscamos una persona que conecte publicidad, mensajes y resultados comerciales. Alguien que investigue, proponga y quiera entender qué necesita cada médico para hacer crecer su consultorio.

🔗 Sobre el rol

Somos una agencia especializada en medicina estética. Nuestro programa SpinSelling tiene como objetivo ayudar a médicos estéticos a conseguir entre 20 y 50 pacientes nuevos en 90 días mediante publicidad, contenido y acompañamiento estratégico.

Tu misión será gestionar campañas de Meta Ads, desarrollar mensajes publicitarios y mejorar la calidad de las oportunidades de consulta.

Trabajarás junto a un Account Manager y un editor. Tu aporte incluirá analizar qué ocurre desde el anuncio hasta la consulta, detectar oportunidades de mejora y convertirlas en acciones concretas con el equipo.

⚙️ Qué vas a hacer

Crear, gestionar y optimizar campañas de Meta Ads según los objetivos y el presupuesto de cada cliente.

Investigar los tratamientos, las preguntas frecuentes y las objeciones de los pacientes para desarrollar distintos enfoques publicitarios.

Escribir textos y guiones de anuncios, coordinando con el equipo el material necesario para producirlos.

Evaluar la inversión, el costo y la calidad de las consultas generadas.

Revisar con el Account Manager los datos disponibles sobre conversaciones, turnos y asistencias para detectar dónde se frena la conversión.

Proponer pruebas con una hipótesis clara y registrar qué aprendiste.

Comunicar resultados, problemas y próximos pasos de una manera que el equipo y el médico puedan entender.

Trabajar con la metodología de Cess y aportar mejoras respaldadas por evidencia.

💼 Qué buscamos en vos

Experiencia práctica creando y optimizando campañas de generación de leads en Meta Ads.

Capacidad para explicar tus decisiones: qué observaste, qué cambiaste y qué resultado obtuviste.

Habilidad para escribir anuncios y guiones a partir de una investigación del servicio y su público.

Interés por entender cómo una consulta se convierte en un paciente.

Organización para trabajar con varias cuentas, cumplir acuerdos y anticipar necesidades de material.

Apertura para recibir feedback, aprender una metodología y ajustar tu forma de trabajar.

Valoramos especialmente la experiencia trabajando con médicos, clínicas o negocios de servicios que venden mediante consultas. También la experiencia acompañando a clientes para que comprendan sus resultados y mejoren su seguimiento comercial.

💡 Vas a encajar bien si…

Cuando baja el rendimiento, investigás y proponés un próximo paso.

Te preguntás qué calidad tienen los mensajes, además de cuánto cuestan.

Podés transformar una duda frecuente del paciente en una idea de anuncio.

Explicás los números con claridad y reconocés cuándo falta información.

Te interesa integrarte a un equipo y construir una relación de trabajo sostenida.

💰 Compensación

El modelo es de USD 100 mensuales por cliente activo gestionado.

Una cartera de 15 a 20 clientes equivale a USD 1.500 a USD 2.000 mensuales. El ingreso depende de la cantidad de clientes activos asignados; ese rango no implica una cartera inicial garantizada.

🌎 Cómo trabajamos en Cess

Nuestra cultura se basa en velocidad, excelencia, bienestar y obsesión por el cliente.

Buscamos personas que se involucren, compartan aprendizajes y ayuden a mejorar tanto las campañas como la forma en que trabajamos.

📩 Cómo postularte

Esta búsqueda se realizará exclusivamente por LinkedIn. Únicamente revisaremos los CV enviados por este canal.

In This Role, You’ll Get To:

• Own Thrive's paid acquisition end to end: strategy, build, launch, optimization and budget pacing across Thrive's own Google Ads account, with targets set on qualified leads and pipeline.

• Close the loop with sales: feed CRM lead stages back into Google Ads, set realistic conversion values, and move to value-based bidding when volume supports it.

• Protect budget from junk: spam and bot filtering, search partner testing, negative keyword lists and weekly search-term reviews.

• Build and test offers and funnels with sales and web: landing pages, lead magnets (such as our free website offer), CRO and A/B tests.

• Report weekly on pipeline, not vanity metrics: spend, leads, SQLs, cost per SQL, pipeline and revenue influenced, with a clear view of what changed and why.

• Be the in-house expert: turn outside advice into a clear, prioritised plan and document changes so the team stays aligned.

• Use AI well: adopt AI agents and automation for audits, reporting, search-term reviews and ad copy, keeping human judgment on decisions that matter.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Associate - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle - translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance - while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

• Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.

• On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.

• You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages

• On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.

• You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.

• You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.

• Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.

• Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Associate to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

• You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.

• You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.

• You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.

• You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.

• You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

• You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

• 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.

• Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.

• Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.

• Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

What It's Like To Work At Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

• Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

• Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

• Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

• Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace, we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just two years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 160 dedicated professionals.
