postings.title: Service Delivery Manager - EY Global Delivery Services
postings.descriptionText:
The opportunity

Security Technology Services (STS), part of Information Security, enables more than 425,000 people across 150+ countries to access systems and information securely. As the Information Security IT Cloud Service Owner, you will operate with a Product Owner mindset and be accountable for the vision, roadmap, adoption, performance and value of enterprise cloud security posture and workload protection services delivered through cloud SaaS technologies such as Wiz, Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Aqua Security.

You will define customer outcomes, prioritize the backlog, align investment to enterprise risk and cloud strategy, and partner with engineering and operations teams to deliver secure, reliable and easy-to-consume capabilities across multi-cloud environments. The role connects business customers, cloud and DevOps teams, architecture, strategy, risk, compliance, internal audit and vendors to move the service from strategy through delivery and continuous improvement.

Your key responsibilities

• Own the product vision, roadmap and end-to-end lifecycle for cloud security posture and workload protection services, including CSPM, CNAPP, CWPP, KSPM, infrastructure-as-code scanning and automated guardrails.

• Define customer outcomes and measurable value, linking roadmap investments to risk reduction, coverage, adoption, resilience, customer experience and cost efficiency.

• Maintain and prioritize the product backlog using business value, customer need, regulatory commitments, strategy, risk and delivery capacity.

• Translate stakeholder needs into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release priorities and adoption plans in partnership with strategy, engineering, and operations.

• Lead customer discovery, product evaluations, RFPs, proof-of-value engagements, pilots, launches and feedback loops that make services easier to consume.

• Act as the single point of accountability for the service, balancing demand transparently and communicating priorities, trade-offs, dependencies and delivery commitments.

• Define service offerings, onboarding journeys, support models, SLOs, SLAs, KPIs, operational workflows and customer-facing service communications.

• Monitor service health, reliability, coverage and performance; drive continual improvement, reduce technical debt and ensure incident, problem, recovery and change practices are documented and tested.

• Oversee onboarding, platform governance, integrations, upgrades, migrations and retirements across Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, cloud workloads, containers and serverless workloads while minimizing disruption.

• Own service risk, control alignment, audit readiness, exception governance and remediation of service-related findings.

• Develop business cases, investment asks, budgets and benefits tracking; forecast demand, licensing and capacity; and improve unit cost and platform utilization.

• Lead vendor performance, roadmap, support, renewal and commercial discussions, while reducing unnecessary capability duplication.

• Present product performance, risk, roadmap progress, investment needs and measurable outcomes to senior leaders in clear business terms.

• Drive adoption through clear service offerings, paved paths, documentation, enablement and customer feedback loops.

Skills and attributes for success

• Product ownership expertise, including vision, outcome and roadmap definition, value-based backlog management and transparent prioritization.

• Strong customer focus, using discovery, feedback and data to improve service usability, adoption and value.

• Deep understanding of CSPM, CNAPP, CWPP, CIEM, KSPM, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, vulnerability management and risk prioritization.

• Experience connecting requirements and releases to measurable adoption, risk, reliability, customer experience and cost outcomes.

• Ability to define service operating models, onboarding criteria, configuration standards, policies, service levels, KPIs, runbooks and escalation paths.

• Experience managing service incidents, problems, recovery, changes, risks, findings, exceptions and remediation workflows.

• Executive communication skills, with the ability to explain product choices, technical risk, performance and investment needs in business terms.

• Ability to influence without authority and align global, cross-functional teams around shared outcomes and delivery commitments.

• Commercial acumen across budgets, unit economics, licensing, vendor performance, renewals and return on investment.

• Data-driven approach to continual improvement using product, operational, financial and customer measures.

• Ability to assess overlapping cloud security capabilities and product interfaces to strengthen integration, interoperability and cost-effective service decisions.

To qualify for the role you must have

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Five or more years of experience in information security, cloud security, cybersecurity engineering or technology service management.

• Three or more years owning or managing security products, platforms or enterprise services.

• Demonstrated experience with CNAPP or cloud security posture platforms; experience with Wiz, Microsoft Defender for Cloud or Aqua Security is strongly preferred.

• Experience supporting services across Azure, AWS or Google Cloud and cloud-native technologies such as Kubernetes, containers and serverless workloads.

• Experience owning product or technology roadmaps and delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives in a global environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical risk and product performance to non-technical executives.

Ideally, you'll also have

• Experience as a Product Owner, Service Owner, Platform Owner or Technology Manager in a global, regulated or highly matrixed enterprise.

• Experience with agile product delivery, backlog management, customer discovery, release planning and adoption measurement.

• Budget planning, vendor management, capability rationalization and benefits-realization experience.

• Experience with ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, CMDB integrations, automation, SIEM platforms or executive reporting.

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, ITIL, CSPO, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or cloud and container security credentials.

What we look for

• Strategic and critical thinking with a structured approach to solving complex problems.

• Strong product judgment, customer empathy and the ability to make decisions amid ambiguity and change.

• Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation and presentation skills.

• Good judgment, tact and decision-making ability.

• Experience working effectively across global, virtual and cross-cultural teams.

• The ability to work autonomously while building alignment and accountability across teams.

What we offer

You will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. Your recruiter can provide details about benefits available in your country.

• Continuous learning: Develop the mindset and skills to navigate what comes next.

• Success as defined by you: Use the tools and flexibility provided to make a meaningful impact.

• Transformative leadership: Build the insight, confidence and capabilities to lead change.

• Inclusive culture: Bring your perspective and help others contribute theirs.

EY provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals and supports flexible working arrangements. Please contact your recruiter for details relevant to the role and location.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Join us in building a better working world.

postings.title: Analista Técnico-Institucional
postings.descriptionText:
Para CARBAP, Confederación de Asociaciones Rurales de Buenos Aires y La Pampa, seleccionaremos un/a profesional que se desempeñe como Analista Técnico-Institucional.

CARBAP es una institución con más de 90 años de historia referente en la defensa de los productores agropecuarios y de la propiedad privada.

En CARBAP se vive una agenda activa en un entorno dinámico donde conviven lo técnico y lo político-institucional reuniones con funcionarios y productores, diálogo con entidades del agro y trabajo coordinado con las Asociaciones Rurales de base.

El objetivo del puesto consiste en elaborar informes técnicos, económicos y de coyuntura vinculados al sector agropecuario y al accionar institucional de CARBAP, contribuyendo a la toma de decisiones, la comunicación pública y el posicionamiento gremial de la entidad.

Las principales responsabilidades serán

• Análisis técnico y económico.

Relevar y analizar información sobre producción agropecuaria, infraestructura, mercados, precios y políticas públicas.

Elaborar informes sobre el impacto económico de medidas impositivas o regulatorias, realizando comparativos históricos, proyecciones y escenarios.

• Redacción de informes e insumos institucionales.

Redactar documentos, informes, presentaciones y comunicados institucionales, transformando información compleja en contenidos claros para dirigentes, medios y productores.

• Seguimiento normativo y político.

Monitorear proyectos de ley, ordenanzas, resoluciones y programas que afecten al sector, elaborando resúmenes ejecutivos y análisis de su impacto político y productivo.

• Apoyo a la gestión institucional

Preparar material de soporte para reuniones, asambleas y exposiciones, y coordinar con las entidades de base para recabar información del territorio.

• Comunicación y presentación.

Colaborar en documentos de posición, comunicados de prensa y contenidos para redes institucionales, participando eventualmente en reuniones técnicas o institucionales en representación de CARBAP.

Orientamos nuestra búsqueda a profesionales de las carreras de Economía Agraria, Administración, Agronomía o afines, preferentemente con al menos 2 años de experiencia en redacción de informes, análisis de datos o trabajo institucional, siendo requisitos ideales, no excluyentes. Buscamos una persona con interés genuino por la realidad agropecuaria y el rol gremial, excelente redacción, capacidad de síntesis, pensamiento analítico y criterio político.

Se valorarán conocimientos sobre políticas agropecuarias, estructura productiva argentina, análisis económico y fiscal, manejo de fuentes estadísticas y redacción institucional. Asimismo, se valorará el dominio de Excel, PowerPoint y Word, herramientas de diseño básico como Canva y herramientas de inteligencia artificial.

Modalidad de trabajo Es básicamente híbrido. Si será presencial en oficinas de Buenos Aires cuando se reúne la Comisión directiva los últimos miércoles y jueves de cada mes.

El trabajo es de dedicación plena y la remuneración será acorde a la responsabilidad y experiencia del candidato/a.

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. As part of optimizing the online shopping experience, Sezzle constantly monitors users and transactions for abusive or fraudulent behavior. Our Fraud Operations team reviews suspicious activity flagged by Sezzle’s fraud detection system or escalated from Customer Support agents. Fraud Operations Analysts will block users deemed fraudulent or risky, and clear false positive flags from our automated systems and support agents. We monitor for new trends in fraudulent behavior and continuously evolve our policies and procedures to stay one step ahead. We are looking for a teammate who can work one of the shifts listed below full-time:

• Monday -Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - local time (Central time zone).

This will be a non-exempt/hourly position. Due to the requirements of the position, only English resumes will be accepted.

Compensation

What You'll Do

• Monitor real-time transactions and other customer behaviors flagged for fraud and abuse for manual review.

• Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to determine if the transactions are fraudulent or not.

• Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.

• Research fraud and user behavior to contribute to machine learning models, rules and other detection systems.

• Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our fraud prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.

• Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.

• Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.

• Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.

What We Look For

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution

• Minimum 1 year of experience in investigating and resolving fraud incidents

• Experienced in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment

• Attention to detail and ability to multitask

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

• Strong business judgment and communication skills

• Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training

• Able to work through holidays

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Qualifications

• Minimum 1 year of experience in investigating and resolving fraud incidents

• Work experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, or financial institutions is a plus

• Degree in statistics, math, finance, economics, or related quantitative discipline; graduate degree a plus

• Experience in using database query language (e.g. SQL, etc), and data processing and analytics tools such as Python / R / SAS is a plus

• Ideal candidate will be available to start within two weeks following an offer

About You

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working At Sezzle Awesome

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

postings.descriptionText:
Salesforce CPQ Developer

Position Type: Full-Time

Schedule: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday

Time Zone: Eastern Time (ET)

Location: Remote

Apply here: https://operationsarmy.com/application

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CPQ Developer with strong technical expertise in Salesforce administration, configuration, data management, CRM process improvement, and revenue-related Salesforce solutions.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working extensively in Salesforce and is comfortable managing complex datasets, improving CRM processes, configuring Salesforce functionality, and maintaining accurate, reliable sales data.

Experience with Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud is required , along with the ability to support complex quoting, pricing, and revenue processes within Salesforce.

This role requires strong Salesforce expertise, technical proficiency, attention to detail, and the ability to work within structured processes.

Key Responsibilities

Salesforce Data Management & Cleanup

• Audit, maintain, and clean Salesforce data, including accounts, contacts, and opportunities.

• Identify and resolve duplicate, incomplete, and inconsistent records.

• Standardize fields, naming conventions, data structures, and pipeline information.

• Support CRM consolidation, migration, and data cleanup initiatives.

• Maintain data accuracy and integrity across Salesforce.

CRM Configuration & Process Implementation

• Configure Salesforce objects, fields, workflows, and related CRM functionality.

• Implement and maintain CRM processes based on defined business requirements.

• Configure and support Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud functionality.

• Support quoting, pricing, product, and revenue-related processes within Salesforce.

• Support customer segmentation and Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) structures.

• Improve pipeline management, reporting, and data quality processes.

• Troubleshoot Salesforce-related issues and recommend practical solutions.

Revenue & GTM Operations Support

• Support revenue and go-to-market (GTM) operational processes.

• Assist with reporting, forecasting, and revenue planning workflows.

• Build and maintain Salesforce dashboards and operational reports.

• Support CPQ and Revenue Cloud processes related to quoting, pricing, and revenue operations.

• Help improve CRM processes to support accurate and reliable revenue data.

• Collaborate with relevant teams to identify opportunities for process improvement.

Documentation & Operational Support

• Create and maintain documentation and SOPs for CRM processes and workflows.

• Document Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud processes and configurations as needed.

• Promote consistent Salesforce usage and data-management practices.

• Follow established procedures while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.

• Support ad hoc CRM, sales operations, and RevOps initiatives as needed.

Required Qualifications

• Strong hands-on Salesforce expertise is required.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ is required.

• Experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud is required.

• Solid understanding of Salesforce fundamentals, including objects, reporting, data management, and data hygiene.

• Experience configuring and supporting Salesforce CRM processes and workflows.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

• Strong technical and analytical problem-solving skills.

• High attention to detail and accuracy when working with large datasets.

• Ability to follow structured processes and document workflows clearly.

• Strong organizational and communication skills.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in Revenue Operations (RevOps) or Go-to-Market (GTM) Operations.

• Experience supporting sales or revenue teams in a high-growth environment.

• Experience with CRM migrations, consolidations, or integrations.

• Experience supporting complex quoting, pricing, product configuration, or revenue processes.

• Familiarity with automation and workflow tools such as Zapier, Clay, or similar platforms.

• Experience developing or improving CRM processes and reporting frameworks.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is highly proficient in Salesforce, experienced with CPQ and Revenue Cloud, technically capable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with data and CRM processes .

The successful candidate should be able to take ownership of Salesforce-related tasks, identify data or process issues, and implement practical solutions while maintaining accuracy and consistency. They should also be comfortable supporting quoting, pricing, revenue, and GTM processes within Salesforce , including Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud.

Apply here: https://operationsarmy.com/application

What if knowing your city's backstreets, hidden landmarks, and local business scene could directly improve how AI navigates the world? This is a fully remote, flexible contract role open to anyone with a sharp eye for detail and familiarity with their local area. No GIS certification or geography degree required — just genuine awareness of how places actually look and work on the ground.

• Organization: Alignerr

• Type: Hourly Contract

• Location: Remote

• Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

• Verify AI-generated addresses, place names, and geographic data for accuracy

• Evaluate the quality of location-based search results and map recommendations

• Flag incorrect, outdated, or misleading location information

• Apply your regional knowledge to provide context and corrections AI simply can't replicate

• Complete structured, task-based assignments using maps and web-based location tools

• Work independently and asynchronously on your own schedule

Who You Are

• Familiar with your local area — streets, neighborhoods, landmarks, and businesses

• Naturally detail-oriented with a consistent, systematic approach to spotting errors

• Comfortable using digital maps and web-based tools (Google Maps, etc.)

• Clear and concise written communicator

• Self-motivated and reliable when working independently

• No GIS, cartography, or geography experience required

Nice to Have

• Experience in logistics, delivery, travel, urban planning, or local services

• Familiarity with map platforms or location-based apps as a frequent user

Why Join Us

• Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs

• Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you

• Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task-based work

• Contribute to AI development that shapes how technology understands the physical world

• Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

About CSL Seqirus

CSL Seqirus is one of the world's largest influenza vaccine companies and a global leader in pandemic preparedness. As part of the CSL Group, we operate at the intersection of cutting-edge science and meaningful human impact — protecting millions of lives every year. When you join CSL Seqirus, you join a team where quality is not a department, it's a commitment.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Global Head of External Quality , the Manager, CMO Quality plays a critical role in ensuring the integrity, compliance, and continuity of our external manufacturing network. You will be the primary quality partner for assigned Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) — overseeing outsourced production activities including API, Fill/Finish, and Packaging — and serve as the trusted bridge between CSL Seqirus and our global CMO partners.

This is a high-visibility, globally connected role where your decisions directly protect product supply, patient safety, and regulatory standing across multiple markets.

What You'll Do

CMO Relationship & Quality Oversight

• Serve as the primary regional quality interface for assigned CMOs, fostering strong, trust-based partnerships

• Ensure CMO quality systems are aligned with CSL Seqirus standards and applicable regulatory requirements

• Represent CSL Seqirus Quality in Joint Operational Meetings, Business Reviews, and on-site CMO visits

At AspenView, we’re more than a nearshore IT partner—we’re a people-first, purpose-driven company that believes great culture drives great outcomes. We’re passionate about connecting talent and technology to deliver measurable value for clients—and meaningful career paths for our people.

Working from AspenView's secure delivery suites in Bogotá, Medellín or Buenos Aires , you will lead roughly eighteen analysts and engineers across two cities, three tiers and three shifts. The client is regulated under NYDFS Part 500, GLBA, SOX and PCI DSS, so this role goes beyond keeping the lights on. You will make sure every investigation record stands up to examination, on the night shift as well as in the monthly report. You will report to a US-based SOC / Cyber Operations Lead and act as the operational link between the floor, partner governance and the client's security operations team.
What you will do:
Coverage & Team Operations

• Own rosters, coverage and handovers across three 8-hour shifts and two sites, including leave, sickness and training cover, so no shift runs short.

• Lead hiring, onboarding and coaching, and build the Tier 1 to Tier 3 career path that keeps the team together.

• Enforce the secure suite rules, including clean-desk policy and VDI-only access to the client environment.

Performance, Quality & Reporting

• Track operational performance live, including response times, escalation quality and case documentation, instead of discovering problems at month end.

• Ensure every ServiceNow case carries the hypothesis tested, the evidence, the reasoning and the disposition, so an auditor can follow it without asking.

• Build daily, weekly and monthly operational reports from the client's own ServiceNow and Elastic data.

Escalation & Change Control

• Own the escalation path from Tier 2 shift leads to partner governance and the client's security operations team, always escalating with evidence and a recommendation.

• Coordinate with the Incident Response Lead during major incidents.

• Run operational change control for detection rules, playbooks and escalation thresholds, which change only with client approval.

Tools & Technologies:

• SIEM & Case Management: Elastic, Abstract Security and ServiceNow SecOps.

• Endpoint & Identity: CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender and Okta.

• Reporting: ServiceNow reporting and Power BI or an equivalent dashboard tool.

• Automation (Bonus): Automation or GenAI tools that reduce analyst toil without hiding work from the audit trail.

What you bring:

• Experience: Proven experience running or deputy-running a SOC, or a 24/7 NOC with security scope, against contractual service levels. You have kept a roster whole through attrition, holidays and sudden resignations, and you can spot a slipping metric before it becomes a missed one.

• Communication / Leadership: Direct people management experience, including hiring, hard conversations and performance plans, not only mentoring. English at B2 or above, strong enough to explain a missed target and its root cause to a US VP of security operations without an intermediary.

• Mindset: Accountable, structured and audit-minded. You treat documentation and change control as part of the job, and you follow and enforce security rules consistently.

• Availability: On-site work in Bogotá, Medellin or Buenos Aires during US Eastern business hours, plus your share of the management on-call rotation. Access requires identity, criminal background, employment and education checks, repeated periodically.

• Bonus Qualifications: Security operations experience in banking, lending, insurance or payments; exam or audit support under NYDFS Part 500, FFIEC, GLBA, SOX, PCI DSS or SOC 2; leading a team across two sites or countries; ITIL v4, CISSP, CISM or GCIH certification; and Spanish, since the floor is bilingual.

postings.title: Life Sciences Program Manager/Program Executive
postings.descriptionText:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Life Sciences Program Executive

Brazil or Argentina | Remote

Job Description

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About The Role

The Life Sciences Program Executive (PE) is a senior, executive-facing individual contributor (IC) within the Global Life Sciences Acceleration Hub at Salesforce. As an IC, Program Executives hold no direct reports, and yet expertly lead large numbers of our most senior talent across our most complex Life Sciences customer engagements: multi-workstream transformations, strategic accounts, and enterprise implementations where the margin for error is narrow and the consequences of failure are visible at the C-suite.

The PE is fully allocated to a single flagship Life Sciences transformation program or a set of strategic accounts. They own the end-to-end program P&L, lead the Salesforce project team, run the steering committee, manage the executive customer relationship, manage scope, govern the budget, and surface risk before it becomes an escalation. The ideal candidate brings a deep background in Life Sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech, or related sectors) combined with IT or management consulting delivery experience, leveraging that industry credibility as a strategic advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams across Salesforce.

Life Sciences Program Executives sit at the helm of AI and Agentforce transformations that accelerate drug commercialization, streamline field engagement, and modernize clinical and commercial operations through intelligent, autonomous agents. They lead cross-functional teams deploying digital workforces that bridge the gap between complex Life Sciences data and actionable business outcomes, driving the next frontier of Life Sciences innovation.

Their success is defined by what they deliver, what they prevent, and the customer confidence they command.

Your Impact

• AI and agentic delivery are embedded in how you work: you actively leverage AI tooling and agentic workflows to optimize how your program teams deliver. You reduce manual overhead, accelerate insight, and model the productivity gains Life Sciences customers are investing in Salesforce to achieve.

• Engagement success is well-defined and honored: you create the program strategy, management approach, governance, and guide the customer at the executive and program level to align on objectives, outcomes, and KPIs.

• Customer outcomes are owned with clear accountability: you are the executive-facing delivery contact for your engagement and are responsible for communications with the client and within Salesforce up to the CxO level regarding expectations, performance, governance, and issue escalation and resolution. You earn trust through consistently accurate forecasting, honest risk communication, and follow-through.

• The delivery team performs at a higher level because you're in it: you effectively lead, inspire, and uplift Salesforce Professional Services team members, coaching them to perform at a higher level while contributing to the internal processes, artifacts, and methodologies that raise the floor for service delivery across our most strategic Life Sciences accounts. What you learn and implement travels.

• The full engagement is yours to deliver: you are accountable for overseeing end-to-end service delivery and meeting every contractual commitment. Bid-versus-delivered margin is your financial accountability.

• Value delivered translates into real adoption and consumption: you drive the transformational changes, especially around AI and agentic capabilities, needed to achieve customers' objectives, informed by deep Life Sciences industry and product expertise. You align IT strategy, governance, processes, and stakeholder decisions to ensure adoption and consumption directly deliver measurable customer impact.

• Risk is managed before it manages you: you anticipate, mitigate, and manage risk to Salesforce and the customer, taking decisive program action to address risk profiles. You raise signals with a recommended path, not just a problem statement. Surfacing a risk is success; being surprised by one is not.

• White space becomes pipeline and internal alignment sustains it: you proactively build and expand business relationships which enable Salesforce to support, transform and win business that delivers mutual value, working hand in hand with Sales, Success, Technology and Product, and Support to drive customer adoption initiatives and maintain alignment as One Salesforce.

Minimum Requirements

• Demonstrated experience applying AI productivity tools, automation, or agentic workflows within a professional services or program delivery context, with measurable impact on delivery efficiency or customer outcomes

• 12+ years of professional services or consulting delivery experience, with direct accountability for program execution across financials, risk, scope, and customer outcomes

• Demonstrated track record leading large, complex programs ($10M+) with measurable outcomes

• 5+ years of direct Life Sciences industry experience (pharma, biotech, medtech, or related sectors) sufficient to engage credibly at the executive level on commercial, regulatory, and operational priorities

• 5+ years leading large, cross-functional delivery teams across multiple geographies and workstreams, including third-party system integrators, without positional authority

• Direct experience managing program financials at the engagement level, including forecasting, revenue control, earned value analysis, and delivered-versus-bid margin

• End-to-end knowledge of system development, implementation, and operational readiness within Life Sciences environments, including familiarity with regulated industry requirements

• Proven ability to lead steering committee and executive-level customer relationships, including difficult data-driven conversations around budget, resources, timelines, and outcomes

• Outstanding executive presence and communication skills, verbal and written, with the ability to tailor messaging across technical, commercial, and regulatory audiences

• Must be able to operate as a fully billable IC

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience delivering Agentforce or equivalent AI platform implementations at the enterprise level, with the ability to credibly advise Life Sciences customers on agentic transformation

• Deep knowledge of Life Sciences commercial operations: field engagement, HCP engagement, territory management, sampling, MSL workflows, compliance controls, and data-driven customer insights

• Experience with Life Sciences Cloud or equivalent CRM platforms purpose-built for pharma and biotech

• PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification, or equivalent demonstrated program management discipline applied at scale

• Salesforce platform certifications (Admin, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud); certifications are a requirement of the role and available through the global education reimbursement program

• Experience operating in outcomes-based or fixed-fee delivery models where margin is set at the proposal and protected through execution discipline

• Demonstrated ability to negotiate and resolve conflict in a delivery context, including change order negotiation, scope dispute resolution, and steering committee decision-forcing

Additional Information

• Travel approximately 25%, with variation based on customer need

• Bachelor's degree required

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

The PRC team works closely with business leadership and internal functions to drive adoption of PRC products and services and co-develop pursuit self-help materials to meet the content needs of the business. • Acts as a brand ambassador to ensure that GDH pursuit self-help strategy meets the needs of pursuit teams they work with

• Work with PRC Leadership to increase awareness and adoption of EY’s pursuit self-help products and services with domain teams and requestors

• Contributes to and maintains EY’s curated global library of best practice pursuit content, PRC tools, and enablers, as well as providing high-touch pursuit support

• Works with PRC leadership and others to deliver initiatives and on day-to-day delivery

• Ensure inputs to KPI's/metrics are updated and without error

• Identify and share opportunities for continuous improvement, including ways to innovate, optimize, and enhance EY’s pursuit self-help resources

Supervision Responsibilities:

postings.title: Supervisor de Calidad de Montaje - Realico
postings.descriptionText:
✨ ¡Sumate a 360 EPC SOLAR! 🌞🔋
Somos la nueva compañía constructora del Grupo 360Energy. Nos creamos para liderar la ejecución de proyectos de energías renovables, combinando excelencia operativa, innovación y sostenibilidad.

🚀 Buscamos un/a Supervisor/a de Calidad de Montaje para sumarse a la construcción de un parque solar fotovoltaico con sistema de almacenamiento en baterías (BESS) en Realico, La Pampa.

Tu desafío será asegurar la calidad de los trabajos de montaje electromecánico durante las distintas etapas de ejecución del proyecto, verificando el cumplimiento de las especificaciones técnicas, los procedimientos y los estándares de calidad establecidos.

🔎 ¿Cuál será tu desafío?
Vas a reportar a la Coordinación de Calidad de Obra y trabajar en conjunto con los equipos de Montaje, Ingeniería y Calidad para garantizar la correcta ejecución de los trabajos en campo.

Entre tus principales responsabilidades estarán:

• Ejecutar las inspecciones y ensayos de montaje electromecánico conforme al Plan de Inspección y Ensayos (PIE).

• Verificar que los trabajos de montaje se realicen de acuerdo con los planos, las especificaciones técnicas y los procedimientos establecidos.

• Compilar la documentación necesaria para la liberación de las tareas constructivas de su disciplina.

• Detectar desvíos y hallazgos en campo, documentarlos y participar en el análisis y seguimiento de las acciones correctivas.

• Supervisar las inspecciones y verificaciones de descarga de materiales, asegurando el cumplimiento de los requisitos de calidad.

• Controlar la distribución y el uso en campo de la documentación técnica Apta para Construcción (APC).

• Realizar el seguimiento de las modificaciones en los planos APC y asegurar su actualización en los planos Conforme a Obra (CAO).

• Mantener registros de inspecciones, ensayos, no conformidades y acciones correctivas, y elaborar informes de seguimiento.

🎯 ¿Qué buscamos?

• Ingenieros/as eléctricos/as o mecánicos/as.

• Al menos 2 años de experiencia en construcción de proyectos fotovoltaicos, dentro de la disciplina de montaje mecánico.

• Conocimiento de normativa aplicable a obras de montaje electromecánico y sistemas fotovoltaicos, especialmente IEC 62446-1.

• Experiencia en ensayos y pruebas electromecánicas y de materiales.

• Manejo avanzado de Microsoft 365, especialmente Excel, Word y Power BI. Se valorará conocimiento de SharePoint.

• Perfil detallista y metódico, con capacidad de planificación, organización, trabajo en equipo y resolución de problemas.

• Disponibilidad para trabajar bajo la modalidad y el roster del proyecto.

📍 ¿Dónde y cómo?

• Lugar: Realico, La Pampa

• Modalidad: Presencial.

• Jornada: Lunes a viernes full time, con disponibilidad para trabajar los sábados medio día si es necesario.

• Duración: Por proyecto, de noviembre de 2026 a septiembre de 2027, con posibilidad de extensión.

• Beneficio: Servicio de vianda 🍽️

Si te interesa ser parte de proyectos de gran escala en el sector de energías renovables, ¡queremos conocerte!

📩 ¡Postulate y sumate a 360 EPC SOLAR! 🚀

postings.title: Operations Team Leader (Crisis Response)
postings.descriptionText:
About The Role

As a Crisis Team Lead , you will make an impact by leading a team responsible for managing critical customer situations and ensuring service excellence in a fast-paced operational environment. You will oversee team performance, drive operational outcomes, and foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and exceptional customer care.

You will be a valued member of the operations leadership team, collaborating with stakeholders, clients, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support while developing and empowering team members to achieve their full potential.

In This Role, You Will

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of support professionals to achieve operational goals and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

• Own team performance management, including monitoring operational metrics, schedule adherence, productivity, and quality standards.

• Conduct regular coaching sessions, performance reviews, and development planning to support employee growth and success.

• Identify performance trends, analyze root causes, and implement corrective actions to improve team outcomes.

• Develop and execute action plans to maintain and improve operational performance and customer satisfaction.

• Prepare reports, root cause analyses (RCAs), and operational insights to support decision-making and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Present performance results, recommendations, and progress updates to internal and client stakeholders.

• Respond to client requests and operational escalations in a timely and professional manner.

• Foster a positive and engaging team environment that promotes collaboration, accountability, and high performance.

• Ensure compliance with Cognizant policies, processes, and operational procedures.

Work model

Hybrid

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring attendance at a Cognizant or client office as needed.

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

Schedules

4 AM to 1 PM: Tuesday to Saturday

8 PM to 5 AM: Tuesday to Saturday

12 PM to 9 PM : Sunday to Thrusday

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

• 2+ years of experience leading customer support, customer service, contact center, or operations teams.

• Demonstrated experience in performance management, coaching, mentoring, and employee development.

• Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate teams and drive operational excellence.

• Experience analyzing performance metrics and implementing improvement initiatives.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate challenging conversations professionally and effectively.

• Proven problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.

• Experience creating and delivering presentations to leadership teams and stakeholders.

• Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.

These will help you stand out

• Experience supporting crisis management, escalation management, or high-priority customer support operations.

• Previous experience in a contact center environment supporting phone, email, and chat channels.

• Knowledge of Agile methodologies and continuous improvement practices.

• Experience using collaboration and productivity tools such as Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Calendar, and related platforms.

• Strong stakeholder management and client-facing experience.

• Experience leading teams in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

postings.title: Especialista en Riesgos Tecnológicos (RiskIT) - Personal Pay
postings.descriptionText:
Quienes Somos
Cada vez más Personal
Somos Personal, una empresa que acompaña y potencia la vida de las personas a través de la tecnología. Nuestra propuesta está pensada para que cada persona, comunidad y organización pueda avanzar, conectarse, disfrutar y transformar su realidad.
En el equipo de Riesgos No Financieros, estamos sumando un Especialista en Riesgos Tecnológicos (RiskIT) para liderar la gestión del riesgo tecnológico, de seguridad de la información, de continuidad del negocio y de proveedores críticos de Personal Pay , como segunda línea de defensa.
Tenemos el orgullo de ser protagonistas de la evolución tecnológica y social del país y por eso te necesitamos en nuestro equipo.

Misión del Puesto
Ejercer, dentro de la Gerencia de Riesgos No Financieros (RNF) y con independencia de las áreas de Tecnología de la Información y de Seguridad de la Información, la segunda línea de defensa sobre el riesgo tecnológico integral de Personal Pay: tecnología, seguridad de la información, continuidad del negocio y proveedores críticos, desafiando el diseño y la efectividad de los controles.

Principales Responsabilidades

• Aplicar y mantener la metodología de gestión de riesgos de tecnología y seguridad de la información, incluyendo la evaluación previa a la incorporación de nuevos productos, procesos, sistemas o tecnologías.

• Identificar, evaluar y monitorear los riesgos tecnológicos y de seguridad de la información de la entidad, y mantener actualizada la matriz de riesgos de TI/SI con los aportes de Tecnología de la Información y de Seguridad de la Información.

• Evaluar el diseño y la eficacia de los controles existentes de Tecnología y de Seguridad de la Información, y proponer recomendaciones de mejora.

• Definir, junto con Tecnología de la Información, y monitorear indicadores clave de riesgo (KRI) de tecnología y seguridad de la información.

• Ejercer la responsabilidad metodológica del Análisis de Impacto al Negocio (BIA) y coordinar el relevamiento, mantenimiento y pruebas anuales del Plan de Recuperación ante Desastres (DRP).

• Ejecutar due diligence de riesgo sobre proveedores críticos — tecnológicos y no tecnológicos —, antes y durante la relación contractual.

• Coordinar evaluaciones periódicas de proveedores críticos, y mantener el registro de concentración y criticidad de terceros.

• Dar seguimiento a los planes de tratamiento de riesgos Alto/Crítico y a las medidas correctivas derivadas de hallazgos de auditoría e inspecciones regulatorias; registrar los eventos de pérdida operacional de origen tecnológico.

• Reportar periódicamente el perfil de riesgo tecnológico, de seguridad de la información y de terceros críticos a la Gerencia de RNF y a las instancias de gobierno vigentes (comités, Directorio).

• Evaluar y monitorear los riesgos asociados a la gestión y al gobierno de datos y a la adopción de inteligencia artificial, en procesos de negocio y de tecnología.

Buscamos Protagonistas Que Se Animen a

• Ejercer la segunda línea de defensa sobre el riesgo tecnológico integral de Personal Pay: tecnología, seguridad de la información, continuidad del negocio y proveedores críticos.

• Evaluar y monitorear los riesgos tecnológicos y de seguridad de la información, manteniendo actualizada la matriz de riesgos de TI/SI.

• Desafiar, con criterio técnico, el diseño y la efectividad de los controles de Tecnología y de Seguridad de la Información.

• Sostener el marco de continuidad del negocio (BIA/DRP) y coordinar sus pruebas anuales.

• Gestionar el riesgo de nuestros proveedores críticos — due diligence, notificaciones al BCRA, evaluaciones periódicas — en coordinación con Gobierno IT, Legales y Compras.

• Evaluar y monitorear los riesgos de gestión de datos y de la adopción de inteligencia artificial, agentes autónomos y automatización de procesos (RPA) en nuestros procesos de negocio y de tecnología.

• Reportar el perfil de riesgo tecnológico y de terceros a la Gerencia de RNF y a las instancias de gobierno (comités, Directorio).

Y Cuenten Con Estas Experiencias y Habilidades

• 5+ años de experiencia combinando riesgo tecnológico / seguridad de la información con gestión de riesgo de terceros, en entidades financieras, fintechs o proveedores de servicios de pago (PSP).

• Conocimiento de la Sección 10 de la RMGCTI (Com. “A” 8401) sobre tercerización, y de la normativa del BCRA aplicable a riesgo tecnológico y ciberseguridad (RMGCTI — Com. “A” 7724/8401/8398 — y RMRTSD — Com. “A” 7783).

• Conocimiento de marcos de gestión de riesgo TI/SI (ISO/IEC 27001/27002, COBIT, NIST o similares).

• Experiencia en continuidad de negocio (BIA/DRP) y en due diligence y gestión contractual de proveedores críticos.

• Experiencia trabajando con áreas Legales, Compras, Tecnología de la Información y Seguridad de la Información.

• Perfil de segunda línea: capacidad de desafiar con criterio técnico el diseño y la efectividad de controles ajenos.

• Conocimiento de riesgos vinculados a la gestión y gobierno de datos (calidad, privacidad, gobierno de datos) y a la adopción de inteligencia artificial, agentes autónomos y automatización de procesos (RPA) en entornos financieros o fintech.

• Deseable: formación en Sistemas, Ingeniería, o afines; certificaciones CISA, CISM, CRISC o similares.

🌏 Modalidades de trabajo flexible
🏆 Bono por performance
✈️ Una semana extra de vacaciones
📱 Descuentos y bonificaciones exclusivas en nuestras marcas Personal y Flow (internet, conectividad móvil y entretenimiento) para vos y tu familia
🏥 Prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar a cargo
📕 Acceso libre a la plataforma digital de contenidos de aprendizaje
🎓Bonificaciones especiales en universidades de primer nivel

postings.title: Help Desktop Support
postings.descriptionText:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Role Overview

We are looking for an Desktop Support to provide reliable and professional technical support to end users in a fast-paced corporate environment.

The role will primarily focus on Level 1 desktop and end-user support, covering hardware, operating systems, applications, connectivity, user access, and workplace technology. The position will support a mixed technology environment, including macOS and Windows devices, while working closely with Level 2 and specialist IT teams when required.

The successful candidate will combine strong technical troubleshooting skills with a customer-focused approach, ensuring that users receive an efficient and professional IT support experience.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide Level 1 technical support through service desk, phone, email, chat, and in-person channels.

• Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, operating system, software, connectivity, peripheral, and user access issues across macOS and Windows environments.

• Configure, deploy, maintain, and replace laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, mobile devices, and other IT equipment.

• Support common business applications, including Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, browsers, VPN clients, and creative applications.

• Troubleshoot Wi-Fi, VPN, basic network connectivity, authentication, MFA, and account-related issues.

• Manage incidents and service requests through the organization's ITSM / ticketing platform, documenting troubleshooting and resolutions accurately.

• Escalate more complex issues to Level 2 or specialist teams with appropriate diagnostic information.

• Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including device preparation, equipment allocation, collection, and access-related requests.

• Assist with device management, software deployments, operating system updates, security policies, and IT asset management.

• Provide support for meeting rooms, video conferencing, presentation equipment, and other workplace technologies.

• Contribute to IT projects, hardware refreshes, technology rollouts, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Maintain a high level of customer service and ensure issues are handled professionally and within agreed service levels.

Required Skills & Experience

• Previous experience in IT support, desktop support, service desk, or a similar IT role.

• Good practical knowledge of macOS and Windows operating systems and common desktop troubleshooting techniques.

• Experience supporting laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers, monitors, docking stations, and other IT peripherals.

• Familiarity with common business applications, particularly Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools.

• Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN troubleshooting.

• Familiarity with user account, authentication, MFA, and access management.

• Experience working with an ITSM / ticketing system and understanding of incident and service request management.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent customer service and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users.

• Ability to prioritize multiple incidents and requests in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable Skills

• Experience with Apple device management or MDM platforms, such as Jamf Pro, Intune, Kandji, or Mosyle.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory and endpoint management.

• Experience supporting Adobe Creative Cloud or other professional/creative applications.

• Familiarity with Apple Business Manager and automated device enrollment.

• Experience supporting iPhone and iPad devices.

• ITIL Foundation certification or familiarity with ITIL practices.

Personal Attributes

• Customer-focused, approachable, and service-oriented.

• Strong ownership and accountability when managing technical issues.

• Structured and methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Comfortable working with both technical and non-technical users.

• Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with wider IT teams.

• Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to IT and security procedures.

Education & Certifications

• Degree, diploma, or equivalent experience in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Apple, or Microsoft certifications are desirable.

Why work here:

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data

We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

postings.title: Gerente de Riesgos y Controles CSC
postings.descriptionText:
En Cencosud, buscamos a nuestro/a próximo/a Gerente de Riesgos y Controles para el Centro de Servicios Compartidos (CSC), con base en Argentina y alcance sobre los procesos centralizados de la región.

Si tienes experiencia en control interno, auditoría, sólidos conocimientos de COSO/SOX y te motiva liderar el modelo de gobernanza operativa de un CSC regional este desafío es para ti 🚀

🎯 ¿Cuál será tu misión?

Diseñar, implementar y supervisar el marco de control interno y gobernanza operativa de los procesos del CSC de Cencosud, en coordinación con el área de Control Interno Regional, asegurando la integridad financiera, el cumplimiento de políticas corporativas y la gestión de riesgos de los procesos centralizados de todos los países donde opera el grupo.

🔍 Principales responsabilidades

🔹 Marco de Control y Riesgos

• Diseñar y mantener los controles de los procesos del CSC, en línea con el Modelo de Control Interno corporativo adaptado a la operativa del CSC.

• Identificar, evaluar y mitigar riesgos operativos y financieros de los procesos centralizados, diseñando los controles para su mitigación.

• Documentar y mantener actualizadas las matrices de riesgos y controles (RCM) de los procesos del CSC (P2P, O2C, R2R, entre otros).

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de Segregación de Funciones (SoD) en los procesos del CSC y gestionar la remediación de conflictos conforme a la matriz corporativa.

• Velar por el cumplimiento de políticas corporativas y normativas locales e internacionales en la ejecución de los procesos del CSC.

🔹 Autoevaluación y Monitoreo de Controles

• Planificar y ejecutar periódicamente las autoevaluaciones de controles (CSA) del CSC, evaluando el diseño y la efectividad operativa de los controles.

• Definir, junto con los Service Delivery Owners, Planes de Acción Correctora (CAP) ante las deficiencias identificadas en las autoevaluaciones o en las pruebas de Control Interno Regional y/o Auditorias, y hacer seguimiento hasta su cierre.

• Impulsar la automatización de las autoevaluaciones y del monitoreo de controles mediante herramientas de análisis de datos.

🔹 Soporte a Auditorías y Cultura de Control

• Actuar como punto de contacto del CSC ante requerimientos de auditoría interna y externa, en coordinación con Control Interno regional y auditores internos y externos, facilitando evidencias e información.

• Asesorar a los Service Delivery Owners en el rediseño de procesos sin comprometer el control.

• Promover la cultura de riesgo, prevención de fraude y cumplimiento en el CSC

👀 ¿Qué buscamos?

• Formación en Contador Público, Administración de Empresas, Economía o carrera afín.
• 4 – 7 años de experiencia en Control Interno o Auditoría Interna/Externa en puestos de Liderazgo.
• Experiencia en Centros de Servicios Compartidos o procesos transaccionales centralizados.
• Dominio de COSO/SOX, SAP u Oracle, y herramientas de análisis de datos (ACL, Power BI, SQL).
• Inglés bilingüe (excluyente).
• Visión E2E de procesos, orientación a la ejecución y mejora continua, pensamiento analítico, comunicación asertiva y liderazgo de equipos.

💡 ¿Por qué este rol es único?

Porque el CSC de Cencosud está consolidando su modelo operativo y el control interno es una de sus piedras angulares. Tendrás la oportunidad de diseñar y monitorear los controles de procesos con alcance en 6 países, trabajando en coordinación con la Gerencia CSC, Control Interno Regional y equipos de Auditoria Corporativa.

Electrical QA/QC Specialist – BIM & VDC

About the Role

We are looking for a highly technical Electrical QA/QC Lead to support our BIM/VDC team and ensure the quality, accuracy, and technical compliance of electrical deliverables for U.S.-based projects.

This is a technical QA/QC position. The primary focus will be reviewing electrical submittals, shop drawings, BIM content, and models to ensure they are accurate, coordinated, and aligned with project requirements and U.S. electrical standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Review electrical shop drawings, submittals, and technical documentation for accuracy and compliance.

• Review electrical BIM models and verify that model content is properly updated based on approved submittals.

• Review and validate Revit families and electrical BIM content for consistency and accuracy.

• Identify discrepancies, omissions, or technical issues between submittals, documentation, and BIM models.

• Ensure electrical deliverables align with applicable U.S. standards, codes, and NEC requirements .

• Perform quality control reviews of electrical BIM deliverables before final submission.

• Work closely with the BIM/VDC team to communicate QA/QC findings and required corrections.

• Use Revit and Navisworks as needed to inspect models, review model information, and identify coordination or quality issues.

• Maintain a consistent QA/QC process and help identify recurring quality issues within electrical deliverables.

• Independently manage assigned QA/QC tasks and meet established deadlines and quality standards.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or a closely related field , or equivalent professional experience.

• Professional experience working with electrical systems and construction documentation .

• Previous experience with U.S.-based construction, engineering, or MEP projects .

• Strong knowledge of NEC and U.S. electrical standards/codes .

• Experience reviewing electrical shop drawings, submittals, and technical documentation .

• Strong understanding of electrical design and construction practices.

• Experience with BIM/VDC workflows and the relationship between electrical documentation, submittals, and BIM models.

• Ability to identify technical discrepancies and quality issues with a high level of attention to detail.

• Working knowledge of Revit (Plus)

• Basic to intermediate knowledge of Navisworks .

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience performing QA/QC for electrical BIM or VDC deliverables.

• Experience reviewing Revit electrical families and model content.

• Experience with electrical coordination and clash review.

• Experience working with U.S. contractors, engineers, architects, or MEP firms.

• Experience in commercial, industrial, or other technically complex construction projects.

What We're Looking For
The ideal candidate is a strong electrical technical professional who has an eye for quality and understands how electrical design and construction requirements translate into BIM deliverables .

This role does not require extensive project management or people-management experience. We are prioritizing technical electrical expertise, U.S. project experience, NEC knowledge, and QA/QC capabilities over management skills.

Revit and Navisworks proficiency is important, but the candidate does not need to be an expert modeler or coordinator. The ability to navigate the platforms, inspect models, and understand BIM deliverables is sufficient, with additional training available as needed.

Policy, Risk and Control (PRC) Methodology Specialist

Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 950 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting, and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

The opportunity

The Technology Assurance, Risk, and Policy (TARP) function within Information Security strives to create and promote a holistic Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) program by creating a robust, resilient, and proactive governance framework, supported by a strategic risk management approach and stringent compliance structures. It aims to integrate and align its GRC initiatives in line with the global firm's objectives and emerging threats within the cybersecurity landscape.

Furthermore, the Policy, Risk, and Controls (PRC) Enablement & Awareness team aims to establish policies and procedures that reflect the value we place on safeguarding our digital environment, while ensuring that these policies are effectively communicated and enforced across all levels of the organization. The PRC Methodology Program is part of the Global Information Security Policy & Methodology team within PRC Enablement & Awareness and supports the GRC program and its tooling by integrating and aligning the IT PRC Framework operating model to ensure that policies, standards, processes, risks, and controls remain consistent with the principles and data structure of the core GRC platform.

Your Key Responsibilities

The PRC Methodology Specialist will administer and enhance the IT PRC Framework, which underpins the Policy and Risk Management Programs through the structured integration of IT risk domains, risk categories, processes, control objectives, common controls, IS documents, and authoritative sources derived from industry standards, control frameworks, and regulatory mandates. The PRC Methodology Specialist will partner closely with the Global Methodology Program Lead to advance the Methodology Program's service offerings, strategy, goals, and objectives, including those related to IT Risk Management and associated methodologies. The Specialist will serve as a key contributor to the implementation, maintenance, and evolution of the PRC Framework operating model while facilitating its adoption and integration across relevant team and organizational projects, programs, and emerging initiatives.

A successful applicant will possess strong analytical judgement, be collaborative, and be an effective communicator with the ability to apply methodology expertise across complex risk and control environments. This role will partner with the Policy, Risk, Control, and Compliance teams, as well as global and cross-functional stakeholders, to identify, evaluate, and recommend innovative solutions and approaches that enhance the IT PRC Framework operating model and strengthen risk and control methodologies. The role will also require building and maintaining effective relationships with stakeholders across multiple organizational levels, including Information Security, Client and Enterprise Technology, Global and Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Audit, and Legal, to support the alignment, adoption, and continuous improvement of methodology-related initiatives.

Key responsibilities include:

• Serve as a subject matter expert in IT risk management, governance, compliance, and control frameworks, leveraging practical experience and applied knowledge to promote consistency in the interpretation, application, and adoption of the IT PRC Framework and related methodologies.

• Lead the continuous improvement of the IT PRC Framework operating model through research into industry trends, emerging risks, and regulatory changes, and the integration of best practices into methodology enhancements.

• Identify and recommend process improvements, innovative practices, and operational efficiencies that enhance the effectiveness and scalability of the Methodology Program, while developing and maintaining related documentation, processes, procedures, and program artifacts throughout their lifecycles.

• Develop and refine cross-mappings of PRC common controls against Information Security policies and standards and applicable regulatory and industry requirements to establish a consistent mapping model, strengthen traceability and control coverage, and provide visibility into the organization’s security and compliance posture.

• Partner with Risk, Control, Compliance, and Assessment teams to support control gap assessments and methodology-related initiatives, strengthen control coverage, and drive alignment among risks, controls, and regulatory requirements.

• Support the integration, adoption, and effective use of GRC technologies and tools, including the Unified Compliance tool, to strengthen assessment activities, control alignment, and risk management processes.

• Help facilitate stakeholder engagement and cross-functional working sessions to influence methodology adoption, reinforce consistent risk and control practices, and advance strategic program objectives.

• Help promote a culture of risk awareness by supporting the Information Security & Awareness team’s risk-focused promotional campaigns and expanding organizational understanding of risk responsibilities and expectations.

Skills And Attributes For Success

• Demonstrated knowledge of Information Security principles, IT risk management practices, and GRC methodologies and frameworks.

• Strong analytical judgment, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences.

• Ability to build collaborative partnerships and work effectively across cross-functional teams and organizational levels.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to shifting demands, and perform effectively in ambiguous environments.

• Ability to leverage automation and technology solutions to improve efficiency, streamline processes, and enhance repeatable activities.

• Proven aptitude for learning and applying new technologies, tools, and methodologies.

To qualify for the role you must have

• 3 - 5 years of progressive experience in Information Technology, Information Security, Security Compliance, IT Audit, IT Risk Management, or related disciplines.

• Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Risk Management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

• Demonstrated knowledge of GRC principles and their application within technology, information security, and risk management environments, along with familiarity with Archer or comparable GRC platforms and tools.

• Working knowledge and practical experience with industry standards and control frameworks, including but not limited to ISO, NIST, COBIT, PCI DSS, and the Unified Compliance Framework, as well as regulatory requirements such as GDPR, DORA, CRA, and SOX.

• Experience applying risk and control concepts to evaluate control effectiveness, support methodology development, and recommend process or control improvements.

• Ability to interpret and apply regulatory, policy, control, and framework requirements within business and technology environments.

• Experience working effectively within global, cross-functional, and virtual teams.

• Strong English language skills, including excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication abilities.

Ideally, you’ll also have

• Experience supporting methodology, governance, policy, or control framework initiatives.

• Experience working within highly regulated or compliance-driven environments.

• Experience in communicating to all levels of management, clients and vendors.

• Ability to appropriately balance internal functional needs with business impact and benefit.

• Experience developing and delivering executive-level presentations and briefings.

• Knowledge of policy governance activities, including the development, review, approval, publication, and lifecycle management of policies and standards.

• Skilled in Microsoft Office and M365 products; primarily Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, PowerApps, Power BI and Generative AI technologies.

What We Offer

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:

• Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

• Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.

• Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

• Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.
