postings.descriptionText:
Lead Inventory Specialist Driving Inventory Excellence Through Strategic Planning and Supply Chain Optimization Do you enjoy driving operational efficiency through inventory management and supply chain excellence?

Partner with the best

Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company serving customers in more than 120 countries. Our Supply Chain organization plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient flow of materials and products across our global operations. By leveraging advanced planning processes, inventory optimization strategies, and cross-functional collaboration, we enable operational excellence, improve asset utilization, and support business growth while delivering value to our customers.

Fuel your passion

The Lead Inventory Specialist is responsible for driving inventory optimization strategies that support business objectives while balancing customer requirements and operational efficiency. This role partners closely with supply chain, manufacturing, planning, and regional teams to ensure optimal inventory levels, reduce excess and aging inventory, improve inventory turns, and support business continuity through effective planning and execution.

As a Lead Inventory Specialist, you will be responsible for:

• Monitoring inventory levels and ensuring weekly inventory fluctuations align with business requirements and operational targets

• Implementing inventory stocking strategies to optimize product availability while minimizing carrying costs

• Developing and executing methods and programs to maximize inventory utilization and operational efficiency

• Monitoring safety stock levels, global inventory, and aging inventory while partnering with regions and manufacturing plants to address risks and opportunities

• Providing updates on inventory projections and developing mitigation plans to address potential gaps or excess inventory

• Reviewing Slow Moving Inventory (SMI) with regional stakeholders and collaborating with cross-functional teams to minimize inventory-related risks

• Forecasting inventory reserves and creating action plans to mitigate inventory exposure

• Partnering with Demand Planning teams to develop and maintain effective net demand plans

• Collaborating with Supply Planning teams to implement stocking strategies for local suppliers and service providers

• Working with regional teams to support new product introductions and develop plans for managing replaced or obsolete inventory effectively

To be successful in this role you will:

• Have a Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Logistics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Have a minimum of 5 years of experience in inventory management, supply chain operations, demand planning, or related disciplines

• Have experience in inventory optimization, order management, asset utilization, and inventory control processes

• Have strong knowledge of SAP systems and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) functionality

• Have the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across multiple functions and regions

• Demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

• Be able to balance strategic thinking with effective tactical execution while operating with a sense of urgency

• Have APICS, CPIM, CSCP, or similar supply chain certifications considered an advantage

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

• Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

• Comprehensive private medical care options

• Safety net of life insurance and disability programs

• Tailored financial programs

• Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Manufacturing Specialist - Materials Management

About Us:

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us:

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

postings.title: Senior Project Planner- Site Salta 14 x14
postings.descriptionText:
Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

Senior Project Planner / Scheduler

Principal Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and control Project Execution Schedules, including Level 1, 2, and 3 schedules, ensuring alignment with overall project objectives.

• Ensure schedule assumptions are fully aligned with cost engineering, cost estimation, risk management, and project management disciplines.

• Implement Company schedule and planning requirements, cascading these requirements to contractors and ensuring compliance.

• Identify schedule trends, risks, and potential slippages, proactively reporting findings to Project Engineers and Project Managers.

• Produce regular progress and performance reports, including analysis and reporting of Schedule Performance Index (SPI).

• Develop, implement, and maintain consistent, realistic project plans and control structures.

• Ensure compliance with approved planning and progress monitoring procedures.

• Perform monthly progress updates, including forecasting, critical path analysis, and trend analysis for assigned project elements, incorporating interface impacts.

• Prepare, update, and maintain schedule status reports, providing regular and comprehensive updates to Project Engineers.

• Assess and integrate the impact of approved changes, deviations, and productivity performance against key project targets and milestones.

• Identify and evaluate alternative approaches to optimize schedules and improve project outcomes.

• Liaise with and challenge Project Engineering teams to ensure clear understanding of key schedule drivers and sensitivities.

• Ensure effective resource loading and leveling within project schedules.

• Participate in the evaluation of bid schedules, reviewing and assessing contractor plans to support contract award recommendations.

• Develop and review contractual planning, progress monitoring, and reporting requirements.

• Review, verify, and assess contractor-reported progress, ensuring accurate reflection in the integrated project schedule.

• Track critical path(s), monitor float consumption, and assess overall schedule criticality.

• Provide input to and participate in benchmarking activities.

• Contribute to project close-out activities, including lessons learned and project data compilation to support knowledge retention.

What You Will Bring

• University degree or equivalent professional experience in Engineering, Construction, or related disciplines.

• Minimum 10 years of experience as a Project Planner / Scheduler on projects.

• Strong experience working with Primavera P6 and/or MS Project.

• Experience across multiple industries (Mining and associated Infrastructure experience is an advantage).

• Proven background in Capital Projects and EPCM environments.

• Solid experience in site and construction planning, including progress measurement.

• Strong technical capability for review, analysis, and assessment of contractor schedules.

• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.

If you need any accessibility adjustments, please make sure to mention it in your application.

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

Ready to engineer what’s next? Apply today.

About The Job

En Danone , buscamos un/a Analista Stock Controller para sumarse al equipo de Supply Chain, en nuestra unidad de negocios de Nutrición de Especializada, con base en la planta de Kasdorf, Garín.

Para trabajar en equipo por nuestro propósito brindar salud a través de alimentos y bebidas, a la mayor cantidad de personas posible, cuidando el planeta.

Tus responsabilidades principales serán

• Garantizar la integridad de inventarios en depósitos de terceros dentro de la red

de Kasdorf.

• Garantizar el máximo control de los stocks buscando disminuir las diferencias.

entre sistema propio e integraciones con sistemas de los operadores.

• Garantizar todos los controles de auditoría (DANGO) referentes a control de stocks en terceros.

• Monitoreo y resolución de IDOCs y desbloqueo de transacciones en depósitos de terceros.

• Elaboración, realización y actualización de procedimientos para control de inventarios, capacitación y monitoreo.

About You

¿Qué necesitamos de vos?

• Estudiantes avanzados o graduados de Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en Alimentos, Ingeniería Química, Logística, Administración o carreras afines.

• Experiencia de al menos 1 o 2 años en posiciones vinculadas a control de inventarios, logística, supply chain, operaciones o análisis de stock (excluyente).

• Conocimientos en Excel avanzado (excluyente), SAP (excluyente).

• Idioma Inglés, intermedio (deseable).

¿Qué podrá diferenciarte?

• Autonomía.

• Capacidad analítica.

• Orientación al detalle.

• Capacidad de influencia.

• Trabajo en equipo.

• Comunicación efectiva.

About Us

#PRESENCIAL

Nuestros beneficios

• Danone es bienestar apoyamos la salud física y mental de nuestros Danoners con prepaga, asistencia médica y nutricional, apoyo de almuerzo, Gympass y productos saludables Danone.

• Danone es desarrollo personal promovemos formación "on the job", con oportunidades de entrenamiento, mentoreo y desarrollo de las habilidades del futuro.

• Danone es acompaña a las familias con licencias extendidas para cuidadores primarios y secundarios, lactario en oficinas y apoyo en gastos de guardería, alimentos y kits escolares.

• Danone es trabajar con propósito perseguimos un doble propósito empresarial de promover el éxito del negocio siempre de la mano del progreso social. Promovemos un espacio de trabajo diverso, inclusivo, sustentable y con compromiso con la comunidad.

¡POSTULATE!

En Danone valoramos la diversidad y fomentamos la inclusión, reconociendo, respetando y aprovechando las diferentes opiniones, perspectivas y características, alentando a los Danoners, a ser su mejor versión. Todas las decisiones relacionadas con el reclutamiento, contratación, promoción, compensación, decisiones de desarrollo de los empleados como capacitación y todos los otros términos y condiciones del empleo, se tomarán sin importar la edad, etnia, color, género, origen nacional, religión, discapacidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género.

postings.descriptionText:
Para nuestro cliente, importante empresa agroindustrial, buscamos un Planner de Proyectos de Acopio que tendrá a cargo la transformación y optimización de las operaciones en los acopios de la región de Villa Mercedes. Su misión será diseñar, coordinar y supervisar el ciclo completo de cada proyecto, garantizando que se ejecuten en tiempo, forma y presupuesto, y siempre alineados a los altos estándares de calidad y valores de la empresa.

Principales responsabilidades:

• Organizar y coordinar la planificación de tareas, trabajos y actividades en cada etapa de los proyectos en los acopios.

• Definir, estructurar y actualizar cronogramas específicos para cada fase, asegurando una alineación precisa con las necesidades de todas las áreas involucradas.

• Supervisar el avance de cada proyecto, garantizando el cumplimiento de plazos y presupuestos, anticipando posibles desviaciones.

• Elaborar y analizar casos de negocio que justifiquen las inversiones y modificaciones en los procesos de los acopios.

• Determinar los alcances junto con la asignación de presupuestos, optimizando el uso de los recursos y asegurando el ajuste en función de los requerimientos de cada proyecto.

• Coordinar y dirigir con el área de compras el proceso de licitaciones para la adquisición de activos y la contratación de servicios, asegurando competencia y transparencia.

• Colaborar con el área de compras para establecer y negociar términos con proveedores y contratistas de manera transparente, facilitando la ejecución de trabajos en tiempo y forma, pero siempre de manera segura.

• Mantener un contacto constante, eficiente y efectivo con las áreas de operaciones, compras, comercial, logística y de mantenimiento mediante email, Microsoft Teams y aplicaciones varias de teléfono.

• Cooperar estrechamente con jefes de planta y auxiliares en cada acopio para la correcta ejecución de las actividades y la rápida resolución de incidencias, como así también con el resto de las áreas donde pueda aportar valor.

• Establecer y mantener relaciones diarias con contratistas y proveedores, asegurando que comprendan las necesidades específicas de cada tarea y que ejecuten los trabajos cumpliendo los estándares de calidad, tiempo y seguridad.

Competencias requeridas:

• Comunicación efectiva

• Resolución de problemas

• Trabajo en equipo

• Gestión del tiempo

• Actitud y proactividad

Requisitos:

• Ingeniero industrial, electromecánico, eléctrico o mecánico.

• Se valorarán habilidades analíticas, organizativas y la disposición para aprender y adaptarse en un ambiente dinámico.

Si consideras que reunís los requisitos para el puesto y te gustan los desafíos, no lo dudes…
¡Envíanos tu CV!

postings.title: Product Supply Lead for Biofuel - Crop Science Cono Sur
postings.descriptionText:
At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where, Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.

When you show proactivity and ambition, we’ll harness it through a variety of opportunities and challenges in the diverse areas of our business – all with a strong and meaningful purpose. Where do you want to go? What do you want to do? How do you want to make a difference? The choice is yours, and we’ll help you get there. Be better together. Be Bayer.

Main Purpose

• Lead seed supply strategy and execution for Bayer's Biofuel Crops portfolio in Argentina, with future expansion into Paraguay, Uruguay, and Chile.

• Ensure reliable, cost-effective, and compliant production of pre-commercial and commercial seed, safeguarding genetic quality, germplasm integrity, and long-term supply continuity.

• Enable successful product advancement, commercialization, and business scaling through robust seed production systems and operational excellence.

Your mission Will be to

Production strategy:

• Design and implement seed production strategies to support product development, market advancement, and commercial growth.

• Define optimal production, conditioning, storage, and logistics models leveraging internal and external capabilities.

• Ensure compliance with seed quality, regulatory, stewardship, and business requirements.

• Maintain end-to-end inventory visibility and stewardship of germplasm across the product pipeline.

Production Research & Scale-Up:

• Lead seed production and process improvement trials to improve yield, quality, reliability, and cost efficiency.

• Generate technical recommendations to support product advancement and commercial scale-up.

• Establish production standards and best practices to ensure consistent seed quality and supply.

Supply Planning & Operational Excellence

• Develop and execute pre-commercial and commercial crop plans aligned with demand forecasts and business objectives.

• Monitor key performance indicators and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the supply chain.

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and cost competitiveness.

Cross-functional Collaboration:

• Partner with global and regional Product Supply, Breeding, Agronomic Systems, Regulatory Affairs, and Biofuel Crops teams to align priorities and execution plans.

• Contribute to the development of operational standards, knowledge sharing, and scale-up strategies across markets.

Compliance:

• Ensure compliance with all procedures of the Integrated Management System (Quality and SHEE) and Bayer’s stewardship policies.

Unlock your Potencial

Education

• Degree in Agronomy, Engineering degree, or related

Experience

• 8 yrs of experience in seed production, crop production, supply operations, or process improvement.

Skills

• Strong operational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to balance quality, supply reliability, cost, and business objectives.

• Strong planning, prioritization, and execution capabilities.

• Proven ability to influence and collaborate across functions.

• Agile, results-oriented, and compliance-focused mindset

Languages

• Fluent in Spanish and English

YOUR APPLICATION

This is your opportunity to tackle the world’s biggest challenges with us: Maintaining our health, feeding growing populations and slowing the rate of climate change. You have a voice, ideas and perspectives and we want to hear them. Because our success begins with you. Be part of something big. Be Bayer.

Bayer welcomes applications from all individuals, regardless of race, national origin, gender, age, physical characteristics, social origin, disability, union membership, religion, family status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression. We are committed to treating all applicants fairly and avoiding discrimination.

Período de aplicación: 16/10/2026 - 1/11/2026 Código de referencia: 892618

División: Crop Science Ubicación: Argentina : Buenos Aires : Munro || Argentina : Buenos Aires : Pergamino || Argentina : Buenos Aires : Rojas

Área funcional: Marketing

Tipo de empleo: Permanente Tiempo de trabajo: Full time - 70% viajes / recorridos a campo

postings.title: Principal Project Planner - SIte -Salta 14 x 14
postings.descriptionText:
Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

Job Title

Senior Project Planner / Scheduler

Sistema 14x14 – Salta

Principal Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and control Project Execution Schedules, including Level 1, 2, and 3 schedules, ensuring alignment with overall project objectives.

• Ensure schedule assumptions are fully aligned with cost engineering, cost estimation, risk management, and project management disciplines.

• Implement Company schedule and planning requirements, cascading these requirements to contractors and ensuring compliance.

• Identify schedule trends, risks, and potential slippages, proactively reporting findings to Project Engineers and Project Managers.

• Produce regular progress and performance reports, including analysis and reporting of Schedule Performance Index (SPI).

• Develop, implement, and maintain consistent, realistic project plans and control structures.

• Ensure compliance with approved planning and progress monitoring procedures.

• Perform monthly progress updates, including forecasting, critical path analysis, and trend analysis for assigned project elements, incorporating interface impacts.

• Prepare, update, and maintain schedule status reports, providing regular and comprehensive updates to Project Engineers.

• Assess and integrate the impact of approved changes, deviations, and productivity performance against key project targets and milestones.

• Identify and evaluate alternative approaches to optimize schedules and improve project outcomes.

• Liaise with and challenge Project Engineering teams to ensure clear understanding of key schedule drivers and sensitivities.

• Ensure effective resource loading and leveling within project schedules.

• Participate in the evaluation of bid schedules, reviewing and assessing contractor plans to support contract award recommendations.

• Develop and review contractual planning, progress monitoring, and reporting requirements.

• Review, verify, and assess contractor-reported progress, ensuring accurate reflection in the integrated project schedule.

• Track critical path(s), monitor float consumption, and assess overall schedule criticality.

• Provide input to and participate in benchmarking activities.

• Contribute to project close-out activities, including lessons learned and project data compilation to support knowledge retention.

What You Will Bring

• University degree or equivalent professional experience in Engineering, Construction, or related disciplines.

• Minimum 10 years of experience as a Project Planner / Scheduler on projects.

• Strong experience working with Primavera P6 and/or MS Project.

• Experience across multiple industries (Mining and associated Infrastructure experience is an advantage).

• Proven background in Capital Projects and EPCM environments.

• Solid experience in site and construction planning, including progress measurement.

• Strong technical capability for review, analysis, and assessment of contractor schedules.

• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.

• you need any accessibility adjustments, please make sure to mention it in your application.

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change

Ready to engineer what’s next? Apply today.

postings.title: Analista Agrícola
postings.descriptionText:
Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un Analista Agrícola para sumarse a nuestro Negocio Agropecuario en el interior de Buenos Aires. (Zona Magdala - Pehuajó)

Será responsable de

• Monitorear y evaluar el desempeño de los cultivos, asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares técnicos y definiendo acciones de manejo agronómico.

• Coordinar y supervisar las labores agrícolas de siembra, pulverización y cosecha, garantizando una correcta ejecución y uso eficiente de los recursos.

• Realizar seguimiento de indicadores productivos, relevamientos a campo y mediciones de suelo y agua para optimizar rendimientos.

• Gestionar información agrícola mediante herramientas digitales y sistemas de gestión, asegurando la calidad y actualización de los datos.

• Colaborar en la elaboración y análisis de mapas agrícolas (GIS) y prescripciones agronómicas para apoyar la toma de decisiones.

• Elaborar reportes e indicadores que permitan identificar oportunidades de mejora en productividad y sostenibilidad.

• Administrar insumos, órdenes de trabajo y registros operativos vinculados a la actividad agrícola.

• Será responsable de la gestión y operación de cosecha. Coordinando despachos, documentación y registración de información en los sistemas; logística de camiones, altas de contratistas, ingreso a planta de silos propia y demás tareas vinculadas a la logística de cosecha.

Requisitos

• Ser graduado de secundario Técnico agropecuario (deseable) y contar con formación universitaria en Ingeniería agrónoma (deseable).

• Contar con experiencia en posiciones similares y conocimiento en operatoria agrícola (deseable)

• Tener conocimiento en manejo de SAP/Cencerro, SIMA, Paquete Office (deseable).

• Residir en Pehuajó o zonas aledañas. (excluyente)

Beneficios

• Prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar 👩‍⚕️

• Días adicionales de vacaciones 🙌

• ¡Y mucho más! 👏

Somos una empresa agroindustrial Argentina con más de 100 años de historia , líder en la producción de azúcar y papel, y con una importante participación en los mercados de frutas y jugos cítricos, alcohol, bioetanol, carne y cereales.

Empleamos a cerca de 7.000 personas que en su mayoría trabajan en Jujuy, provincia en la que nació Ledesma y donde tenemos 40.000 hectáreas destinadas a la cosecha de nuestra principal materia prima la caña de azúcar. Este cultivo se renueva anualmente y se aprovecha por completo.

Producimos con la mejor calidad, preservamos los ecosistemas que nos rodean y cuidamos el bienestar de nuestros colaboradores y de las comunidades donde estamos presentes.

packaging space with strong international expansion plans, is looking for a unique candidate that can

continuously move the business forward. The incumbent will support our development in South America
& internationally while improving organizational efficiency and profitability. Reporting to the Director of

effectiveness to guarantee clients receive a timely and excellent client experience. The ideal candidate is
business savvy, dynamic, hands-on, detail-oriented, hardworking, self-motivated, and determined to
succeed and grow within our organization.

products. Our mission is to offer innovative world-class products and solutions that have a positive
impact on our customers and their environment. Customer centricity, integrity, quality, innovation,
growth, and sustainability are our fundamental values. Headquartered in Montreal, with offices in
Argentina and India, we market our products in North America and internationally with national
distribution across Canada and USA.

receivable processes

to nurture customer loyalty

delivery.

lading, and commercial invoice

 Conduct vendor management and negotiation to support supply chain efficiency
 Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
 Oversee inventory management activities
 Provide coaching and training to team members

BUSINESS SYSTEMS ANALYST
 Maintain and provide ongoing support for Microsoft Dynamics - Great Plains
 Develop an in-depth understanding of business processes

 Oversee the ERP (Microsoft Dynamics - GP) and technology needs of the organization and
manage IT service providers
 Maximize efficiency through ongoing process review and process improvement implementation

 Recommend changes that leverage best usage of the application
 Define project plans, including scoping, scheduling, and implementation
 Advise on technical issues involving configuration, development, and integration
 Create or update programs and applications according to specifications
 Research and resolve inquiries or issues
 Lead and support project management initiatives

FINANCIAL & OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT
 Month-end reporting
 KPI reporting, trend analysis, and auditing
 Data analysis
 Inventory Management
 Inventory reconciliation
 Analyze account activities
 Other ad-hoc reports

QUALIFICATIONS
 Bachelor’s degree in Business
 A minimum of 5 years of experience working in logistics, operations or in similar role
 Experience with Microsoft Dynamics-GP and Business Central required
 Experience with implementation of new software systems and inventory management WMS
 Proficient in Microsoft Excel and office suite
 Exceptional attention to detail with proven analytical and problem-solving abilities
 Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills
 Self-motivated - learning new skills without prompting is expected
 Strong verbal and written communications skills in English

• *Salary range between 2500 and 2800 USD/month

postings.title: Operations Team Leader | Zona Norte
postings.descriptionText:
PedidosYa forma parte de Delivery Hero, empresa líder mundial en servicios de delivery con presencia en ~65 países. PedidosYa es la empresa de tecnología líder en delivery y quick-commerce en Latinoamérica. Es una plataforma simple, rápida y accesible que conecta a millones de personas usuarias, empresas y repartidores con una amplia variedad de productos y servicios. PedidosYa opera en 15 países en latinoamérica, y en 2020 lanzó PedidosYa Markets, el primer mercado 100% digital que entrega alimentos y artículos para el hogar en 15 minutos. Delivery Hero cotiza en la Bolsa de Frankfurt desde 2017 y forma parte del índice bursátil MDAX.

Descripción del empleo

• Brindar soporte a la Gerencia de Operaciones en el seguimiento diario de la Operación.

• Colaborar con Store Managers en la coordinación de turnos y correcta asignación de recursos en las tiendas, de acuerdo a la demanda.

• Coordinar diferentes proyectos de mejora en tiendas, relativos a reformas, cambios de layout, implementación nuevas verticales de negocio. Ayudar a cubrir las necesidades de la operación en materia de infraestructura, sistemas, equipamiento, insumos, etc.

• Asegurar la correcta implementación de nuevos procesos en cada una de las tiendas y controlar su continuidad en el tiempo.

• Contribuir en la correcta implementación en tienda de las dinámicas comerciales (Promociones, Samplings, otras acciones).

• Monitorear la correcta aplicación de los procedimientos de manejo de inventarios haciendo de nexo entre Store Managers y el área de Control de Inventarios.

• Realizar relevamientos en tiendas y elevar informes a la gerencia.

Requisitos

• Graduadas/os y/o estudiantes avanzadas/os en carreras Ingeniería, Ciencias Económicas y/o afines.

• Experiencia en puestos similares liderando equipos de trabajo.

• Conocimientos de herramientas paquete Office (Excel, Word, Powerpoint), Looker y Tableau.

• Compromiso, iniciativa, trabajo en equipo, buena comunicación y organización.

• Creatividad y curiosidad.

• Orientación a la acción y alta capacidad de resolución.

Información adicional

En PedidosYa, el impacto no se mide solo en resultados sino en cómo los alcanzamos. Buscamos al mejor talento: personas que vibren con nuestros valores, la forma en la que pensamos, decidimos y colaboramos todos los días.

Lo que lográs es clave, pero el “cómo” lo hacés es lo que nos define. Jugando en equipo, hacemos que el negocio y nuestro ecosistema sigan creciendo, mientras le simplificamos el día a día a millones de personas.

👉 Conocé nuestros valores aquí.

La diversidad de talento potencia nuestra Cultura y nuestra organización. Jugamos en equipo en todo lo que hacemos, y lo que más nos gusta de eso es que promovemos la creación de equipos diversos e inclusivos que puedan aportar diferentes perspectivas a PedidosYa. Nuestras oportunidades laborales están abiertas a todas las personas, independientemente de su identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico, religión, edad, discapacidad y/o otras características individuales.

En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o accesibilidad particular para tener la entrevista, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación. Además, siéntete libre de indicarnos tus pronombres (él/ella/elle) desde el primer contacto.

#CulturaPeYa #LaDiversidadNosPotencia

postings.title: ANALISTA GESTION OPERATIVA
postings.descriptionText:
Sumá tu energía a la compañía que contribuye al desarrollo de nuestro país.
En YPF buscamos personas que quieran ser parte de un gran equipo que transforma desafíos en oportunidades y que actúa con excelencia para generar valor. Con más de cien años de historia, somos la compañía energética líder de la Argentina, impulsando el desarrollo y la innovación tecnológica del país.

¡Sumarte a YPF es unirte a un proyecto que combina experiencia, pasión y la energía necesaria para seguir construyendo nuestro futuro!

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos una persona proactiva, autónoma y con alta capacidad de toma de decisiones y adaptación a contextos dinámicos. Se necesitan habilidades de trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva para desempeñarse en el rol de analista de gestión operativa dentro de la VP MIDSTREAM Y DOWNSTREAM.

¿Cuáles serán tus desafíos con nosotros?

Serás responsable de evaluar, analizar e implementar las técnicas de ingeniería de confiabilidad, por medio de las mejores prácticas de aplicación de estrategias de corto, mediano y largo plazo haciendo foco en la reducción de fallas en sistemas y/o equipos dinámicos involucrados en los procesos con la finalidad de aumentar la disponibilidad y confiabilidad de los activos.
También de reducir costos de mantenimiento contribuyendo a la sustentabilidad y la competitividad de la empresa cumpliendo con la política de Seguridad y Medio Ambiente de YPF.

¿Cuáles serán sus principales responsabilidades?

Gestionar y controlar el sistema de gestión de activos, sus criticidades y la gestión de datos de los diferentes sistemas soporte a fin de contribuir en la toma de decisiones.

Aplicar metodologías de Confiabilidad (RCM, FMEA) en equipos críticos.

3Análisis causa raíz (ACR) ante fallas frecuentes y/o catastróficas, generando recomendaciones de acuerdo con los resultados de los análisis y controlando la aplicación de las mismas.

Analizar alternativas de aplicación de nuevas tecnologías y/o materiales para mejorar la vida útil de los activos.

Desarrollar y gestionar los planes de mantenimiento predictivo y preventivo de los activos y asegurar que todos los activos tengan un plan de mantenimiento de acuerdo con los modos de fallas esperados para los mismos.

Supervisar y adecuar las tecnologías predictivas y preventivas utilizadas para la definición de estrategias de mantenimiento.

Determinar malos actores de su área de incumbencia, elevar los mismos para una evaluación global y recomendaciones asociadas, realizando el seguimiento del avance e implementación de las recomendaciones realizadas a malos actores definidos dentro de su área de incumbencia.

Realizar el seguimiento de los KPIs de confiabilidad y recomendaciones asociadas que puedan surgir de los mismos.

¿Qué Valoramos?

• Formación académica: Ingeniero de Materiales o Ingeniero Metalúrgico (preferentemente) o afines, graduados.

• Experiencia : 4 - 6 años de experiencia en refinerías de petróleo en las áreas de mantenimiento industrial, en el área de inspección de equipos estáticos, experiencia en soldadura demostrable.

• Certificado API 510, 570 y 653, 571 y 577 son de alto valor para las funciones de la posición. Otras certificaciones son deseables.

• Conocimientos Informáticos: Paquete Office, Power Bi, SAP.

• Conocimientos Específicos: Conocimiento de Procesos de Refinación de Petróleo, diseño e inspección de tanques, Diseño e inspección de líneas de proceso y servicio, Diseño e inspección de recipientes de proceso, Metodologías de Confiabilidad Operacional (RCFA / RBI, RCM / LCC), Adecuación para el Servicio, Manejo de Normas y Códigos Internacionales (ASME secciones V, VIII, III entre otras.)

Información del puesto

Reporte directo: JEFE INSPECCION OPERATIVA
Lugar de trabajo: REF. LUJAN CUYO
Diagrama: de lunes a viernes
Encuadre gremial: Fuera de convenio
Disponibilidad para viajar: eventualmente

Si sos una persona que:

• Trabaja con excelencia y profesionalismo.

• Da lo mejor cada día, valora la meritocracia y busca siempre la milla extra.

• Vive los desafíos como oportunidades para innovar y aprender.

• Disfruta del trabajo en equipo y del intercambio de distintos puntos de vista.

• Encara los proyectos con pasión y compromiso.

• Promueve un buen clima de trabajo, con empatía, escucha activa y respeto.

¡Este puesto es para vos!

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Un entorno donde podés aportar lo más valioso que tenés: tu energía. Esa energía que impulsa, que se adapta, que aprende, que suma, que transforma.
Sumarte a la #ExperienciaYPF es:
🤩 Impulsar tu desarrollo al siguiente nivel con nuevas oportunidades de aprendizaje.
💡 Crear soluciones innovadoras que impactan en el país.
🤝 Formar parte de una empresa comprometida con la equidad y la inclusión.
🧘 ♀️ Disfrutar del acompañamiento integral del Programa Be #BeneficiosYExperiencias.

Programa Be (Beneficios y Experiencias)

• Descuentos exclusivos en combustibles, gimnasios y muchos otros productos y servicios.

• Iniciativas para estar cerca en los momentos familiares claves: ayuda escolar, licencias parentales extendidas y regalo de nacimiento.

• Cobertura médica para vos y tu familia.

• Descuentos especiales en universidades orientados a impulsar estudios de especialización y posgrado.

• Servicios de refrigerio, frutas, snacks y comedor (según locación).

• Día libre de cumpleaños

• Esquema de vacaciones adicionales

¡Te esperamos para seguir generando valor y construyendo juntos el futuro energético de nuestro país!

postings.descriptionText:
Job Description

Start building your career while you complete your degree. The Drive the Future Program in Argentina offers structured training, meaningful work, and exposure to how JPMorganChase operates.

You will collaborate with experienced professionals and contribute to initiatives that support teams across the firm. We value curiosity, strong collaboration, and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

As a participant in the Drive the Future Program, you'll collaborate with our expert professionals to influence and shape initiatives that support our businesses across the firm.

In Argentina, DTF opportunities are open to students from all universities in Buenos Aires. If you are looking to gain professional experience while pursuing your degree, this could be the beginning of something great. Take into consideration that participants are hired for an initial 6-month period, with the possibility of extension up to 12 months based on participant performance, feedback, and business needs. This role requires part-time, availability in Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires.

Program Details

Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina

Program Length: Up to 18 months

Work Schedule: 19 hours per week

Career Area: Operations (multiple opportunities available)

Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities

These opportunities are intended for advanced university students of Business Administration / Actuarial Science / Translate/ Industrial Engineering / Economy or related careers, who have approximately one year or a little more remaining until graduation in:

• Advanced university students of Business Administration / Actuarial Science / Translate/ Industrial Engineering / Economy or related careers.

• Intermediate to Advanced English proficiency

• Availability to work 19 hours per week

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Highly organized and disciplined, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently

• Team-oriented, with strong collaboration and emerging leadership skills

• Proactive and dynamic, with the ability to perform well under pressure

• Strong analytical skills and commercial acumen

• Strong data skills, including proficiency in Excel and working knowledge of Power BI and/or SQL, to analyze and interpret data to support decision-making

• Exposure to AI-enabled tools and willingness to adopt emerging technologies that support process improvement and operational excellence

What's Next?

After you click Apply, please ensure you fully complete your application.

If you meet the minimum requirements, you may be invited to complete a HireVue video interview (or a similar virtual assessment). If required, your application will not be reviewed further until this step is completed.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we strongly encourage you to complete any requested assessments within one week of receiving the invitation. Please note that your video submission (if applicable) must be completed in English, unless advised otherwise.

To be eligible for this program, you must be authorized to work in Argentina. We do not offer employment-based immigration sponsorship for this program.

About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

postings.title: Patient Support Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
About The Job

En Danone buscamos un/a Patient Support Analyst para nuestro servicio Best Care (soporte nutricional domiciliario) en pos de trabajar en equipo por nuestro propósito brindar salud a través de alimentos y bebidas, a la mayor cantidad de personas posible, cuidando el planeta.

Tu misión estará enfocada en realizar seguimiento profesional, especializado y personalizado de pacientes pediátricos, con diversas patologías. Además de realizar la gestión administrativa de los procesos internos del equipo de nutrición especializada.

Tus responsabilidades principales son

• Realización de evaluaciones y seguimiento nutricional completo mensual de pacientes pediátricos.

• Confección y actualización de planes nutricionales individualizados conforme a la evolución del paciente, su patología de base y sus necesidades específicas.

• Detección temprana de desviaciones del crecimiento, signos de riesgo clínico/nutricional y activar los circuitos correspondientes.

• Diseñar, actualizar y estandarizar protocolos clínicos y procedimientos operativos para el seguimiento nutricional y médico de patologías pediátricas complejas.

• Redactar material educativo y guías para familias, adaptadas a cada patología, fomentando la comprensión del tratamiento.

• Contribuir en la creación de flujogramas internos, criterios de derivación y documentos de buenas prácticas.

About You

Tu perfil

• Formación académica Licenciada/o en Nutrición con matrícula nacional (excluyente) con sólida experiencia en el manejo integral de pacientes pediátricos, especialmente en contextos de alta complejidad clínica.

• Manejo probado de patologías pediátricas frecuentes y complejas, idealmente incluyendo APLV y otras alergias alimentarias, trastornos digestivos, parálisis cerebral, epilepsia, TEA, trastornos neurológicos del desarrollo, así como también manejo de pacientes con gastrostomía, sonda nasogástrica o soporte nutricional enteral (excluyente).

• Experiencia en educación a familias, con capacidad para comunicar de manera clara y empática indicaciones clínicas y nutricionales.

• Experiencia en seguimiento nutricional longitudinal de pacientes controles periódicos, ajustes de planes, registro clínico y trabajo interdisciplinario.

• Conocimientos en Excel (excluyente), Salesforce (deseable).

¿Qué podría diferenciarte?

• Habilidades de comunicación, trabajo en equipo, proactividad, orientación a resultados, capacidad analítica, habilidades interpersonales. Habilidades de gestión del tiempo, autonomía en el trabajo y capacidad de operar con éxito en entornos desafiantes.

About Us

Nuestros beneficios

• Danone es flexible. Organice su propio horario con horarios confiables y hasta 60 días de trabajo desde cualquier lugar. Somos una empresa que prioriza la oficina y alentamos a todos los empleados a que visiten regularmente su oficina local.

• Danone es flexible promovemos un esquema de trabajo híbrido, con horarios flexibles, viernes flex, el beneficio "working from anywhere" para trabajar desde cualquier parte del mundo. Nuestras oficinas son puntos de encuentro opcionales para los equipos.

• Danone es tiempo libre adicional ofrecemos días off "WellDan", semana off entre fiestas, semana adicional de vacaciones, día de cumpleaños.

• Danone es bienestar apoyamos la salud física y mental de nuestros Danoners con prepaga, asistencia médica y nutricional, apoyo de almuerzo, Gympass y productos saludables Danone.

• Danone es desarrollo personal promovemos formación "on the job", con oportunidades de entrenamiento, mentoreo y desarrollo de las habilidades del futuro.

• Danone es acompaña a las familias con licencias extendidas para cuidadores primarios y secundarios, lactario en oficinas y apoyo en gastos de guardería, alimentos y kits escolares.

• Danone es trabajar con propósito perseguimos un doble propósito empresarial de promover el éxito del negocio siempre de la mano del progreso social. Promovemos un espacio de trabajo diverso, inclusivo, sustentable y con compromiso con la comunidad.

¡POSTULATE!

En Danone valoramos la diversidad y fomentamos la inclusión, reconociendo, respetando y aprovechando las diferentes opiniones, perspectivas y características, alentando a los Danoners, a ser su mejor versión. Todas las decisiones relacionadas con el reclutamiento, contratación, promoción, compensación, decisiones de desarrollo de los empleados como capacitación y todos los otros términos y condiciones del empleo, se tomarán sin importar la edad, etnia, color, género, origen nacional, religión, discapacidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género.

postings.title: SR. RESERVOIR ENGINEER
postings.descriptionText:
En Pluspetrol potenciamos el desarrollo energético sostenible para el bienestar de las actuales y futuras generaciones.

Somos la empresa privada líder en producción de hidrocarburos de Latinoamérica y día a día buscamos alcanzar los objetivos de crecimiento y sostenibilidad con visión de largo plazo. Aplicamos creatividad y compromiso para afrontar las complejidades de nuestras operaciones.

Te invitamos a sumarte a nuestro equipo, estamos buscando un INGENIERO SR. DE RESERVORIOS .

Dentro del rol, serás el protagonista de desarrollar y ejecutar actividades de ingeniería de reservorios orientadas a maximizar el valor de los activos mediante la optimización de la producción, el monitoreo continuo del desempeño de pozos y reservorios, la generación de pronósticos de producción y la gestión de estudios técnicos que soporten la toma de decisiones operativas y estratégicas.

Los desafíos con los que te vas a encontrar serán:

• Liderar la estrategia de optimización de producción del activo maximizando valor bajo restricciones operativas, de facilidades y comerciales.

• Definir y monitorear estrategias de producción, incluyendo manejo de drawdown.

• Liderar el monitoreo continuo de la producción y el desempeño de pozos y reservorios mediante técnicas de surveillance y análisis de datos.

• Mantener, calibrar y asegurar el correcto funcionamiento de los modelos de Virtual Flow Metering (VFM).

• Elaborar forecasts de producción mensuales, ramp-ups diarios y escenarios de producción a demanda para soporte de decisiones operativas y económicas.

• Confeccionar y actualizar estimaciones de reservas y MAP de la base productiva.

• Participar en la elaboración y seguimiento del presupuesto de producción (BGT).

• Asegurar la calidad de los datos operativos mediante el seguimiento de KPIs asociados a mediciones físicas, controles de producción y sistemas de monitoreo.

• Evaluar la performance de pozos mediante análisis de datos de producción y técnicas de Rate Transient Analysis (RTA).

• Planificar, coordinar y ejecutar estudios técnicos definidos por áreas especialistas, incluyendo ensayos de interferencia, estudios PVT, muestreos geoquímicos y otras campañas de adquisición de datos.

• Generar análisis e informes técnicos que permitan identificar oportunidades de mejora y maximizar el desempeño de los activos.

• Las responsabilidades y/o funciones son sólo enunciativas y no tienen carácter limitativo.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Graduados en la carrera de Ingeniería en petróleo / Química o carreras afines.

• Posgrado de Especialización en Ing. de Reservorios (deseable).

• Experiencia mínima de 10 años en Ingeniería de Reservorios, preferentemente en campos No Convencionales.

• Dominio Avanzado de Inglés.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Ofrecemos a nuestros colaboradores diferentes tipos de beneficios para cuidar de su bienestar físico, emocional y financiero. En nuestra propuesta incluimos:

+Valor

Plataforma de descuentos, reintegros por guardería y cuidadores, préstamos, seguro de vida adicional, obsequios por eventos especiales y nuestro programa de idiomas.

+Balance

Modalidad híbrida y flexibilidad en el horario de ingreso / egreso, vacaciones y licencias adicionales, licencias familiares extendidas y día de cumpleaños.

+Vitalidad

Gimnasio y planes de wellness on site.

Si crees que esta oportunidad es para vos, no dudes en aplicar.

¡Postúlate y anímate a vivir la experiencia Pluspetrol!

postings.descriptionText:
BÚSQUEDA LABORAL

ANALISTA SÉNIOR DE OPERACIONES COMERCIALES INTERNACIONALES
Back Office Comercial | Compras y Ventas Mayoristas B2B
Estamos buscando una persona organizada, proactiva y resolutiva para gestionar operaciones comerciales internacionales, en contacto diario con marcas, proveedores y clientes del exterior.
El rol requiere atención al detalle, criterio comercial y autonomía para anticipar problemas, resolver diferencias y asegurar que cada operación avance en los plazos y condiciones acordados.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES
• Procesar y dar seguimiento a órdenes de compra y venta internacionales.
• Controlar proformas, facturas, precios, cantidades y condiciones comerciales.
• Realizar el seguimiento de pagos, anticipos, saldos y fechas de entrega.
• Mantener una comunicación fluida con marcas, proveedores y clientes del exterior.
• Actuar como nexo entre Administración, Finanzas y Comercio Exterior para coordinar el avance de las operaciones.
• Preparar y enviar ofertas comerciales, listas de precios y reportes de disponibilidad.
• Gestionar reclamos, diferencias comerciales, errores de facturación y demoras, acompañando cada caso hasta su resolución.
• Organizar múltiples operaciones simultáneas, priorizando tareas y manteniendo la información actualizada.

REQUISITOS
• Inglés avanzado, oral y escrito. EXCLUYENTE.

postings.title: Revenue Operations Manager - Argentina & Uruguay
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About The Role

Halter is heading to South America. Argentina and Uruguay are two of the most exciting cattle markets in the world, and we're starting from scratch: no customers, no pipeline and no local processes yet. That's exactly why this role matters.

As our first Revenue Operations Manager in region, you'll lay the foundations the whole market will grow on. That means working out how deals actually move from first conversation to installed customer, getting the market set up properly in Salesforce, and shaping local pricing and deal desk with our Global Pricing & Packaging Manager. You'll also bring our first sales hires up to speed and build the reporting that tells us how the launch is going. Once things are up and running, the job shifts to keeping the market on plan and helping it grow.

You'll sit in our Revenue Operations & Enablement team, reporting into Auckland, with plenty of room to make your own calls. You'll quickly become someone senior leaders lean on, not just in sales and customer, but in finance, supply chain and right across the business

What your day could look like

As we get set up, your tasks may look different to when the market is fully established. Initially, it could look like…

• Working out how a deal will realistically move from first conversation to installed customer in Argentina and Uruguay, and ensure our globalised funnel stages and handover processes align with what is needed in region.

• Setting up the market in Salesforce with our Ecosystem team, including territories, currency, quoting and reports.

• Working with our Global Pricing & Packaging Manager on local pricing and discount rules, taking currency and inflation into account

• Starting weekly pipeline reviews and forecast calls with the first sales hires, and agreeing what each stage means

• Training new sales team members on our tools and processes as they join

• Making sure launch and support are ready before the first customer signs, with our Customer Revenue Operations Manager

• Letting the team in New Zealand know what's different about this market and where our current approach needs to change

Then, once things are up and running your day could look like…

• Running pipeline reviews with sales leaders and checking deals and stages are accurate

• Looking into why conversion drops between stages and fixing the cause

• Building reports that give leadership a clear view of the market without them having to ask

• Supporting with the sales teams adoption of new tooling, or a feature that our Ecosystem team have just launched.

• Writing up what you've built so the next market launch has something to start from

• Feeding structured commercial intelligence back to HQ: what's working, what's not, what the market needs that our current playbook doesn't address

What we're looking for

Your background matters less than how you work. You might have come from sales or business operations, consulting or a customer-facing role, or been the person at a startup who kept everything running.

You may have built something from scratch before, whether that's a new market, team or function. You can move quickly without leaving a mess behind, and you set things up for scale, with the intention of giving these processes away when they are operationalised.

You care about data quality and the processes that drive it. In a new market, the habits set in the first few months are the ones we live with for years, so getting it right early matters to you. When something doesn't look right (whether it’s numbers or a customer experience), you look into it, find the root cause, resolve it, and reviewed that the fix actually worked.

People come to you for your opinion. You'll be a trusted partner to senior leaders across sales and customer, and well beyond them too, including finance, supply chain and other key parts of the business. You form a clear view, back it up with data, and help people make better decisions.

You're comfortable working autonomously, a long way from the rest of the team. Auckland is many hours ahead, so you'll sometimes need to make calls on your own from first principles.

You communicate clearly in Spanish and English with everyone from Territory Managers on farm to our Vice President of Sales, and you're happy to be direct.

You'll crush this role if you

• Enjoy starting from nothing. There's no funnel, data or habits yet, and you find that exciting

• Set things up to scale. What you build should work at 10 customers and at 10,000

• Hold people to the plan. You'll push back when execution drifts from it

• Spot where revenue is slipping before it shows up clearly in the data

• Get good habits in early. It's much easier than fixing bad ones later

• Share what you're learning. You give the team in New Zealand clear, useful insight about the market

• Write things down. You document as you go so others can reuse your work

• Already use AI day to day and keep looking for new ways it can help

• Can influence people you don't manage. A lot of what you need sits with other teams, so you get things done through relationships and good insight

Bonus points if

• You've launched a new market, region or business unit for a scaling company

• You've worked in agriculture, ag-tech, SaaS, or hardware-led businesses where the sales motion is complex

• You've operated in a multi-market or remote-from-headquarters setup before

• You've worked with pricing or deal approvals in a high-inflation or multi-currency environment

Our Benefits

• Delicious snacks and drinks are available for your daily flow.

• Healthy body, healthy mind. We're partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

• We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

• Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

• Our time to recharge is valued, we're offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

• Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Our Office First Approach

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

postings.title: Senior Operations Manager
postings.descriptionText:
ABOUT US :
Tire Capital is an investment firm driving innovation in the $60B U.S. replacement tire market through technology and disruptive business models. Since 2020, Tire Capital has built and acquired a portfolio of tire-focused e-commerce, trading, and wholesale businesses and is now entering a phase of rapid expansion. The leadership team brings deep operational and technical expertise from hedge funds, consulting, private equity, and healthcare, with a shared commitment to building agile, tech-forward platforms that outperform traditional private equity models.
One of our core portfolio companies, Tires Easy , is a scaled e-commerce platform focused on the replacement tire market, with deep capabilities across tire sourcing, pricing, logistics, and fulfillment. Building on this foundation, we launched Garage Hub , a new subsidiary focused on the auto parts aftermarket, designed to leverage Tires Easy's infrastructure and ecosystem expertise while building a dedicated platform for rapid supplier onboarding and category expansion.
Together, Tires Easy and Garage Hub represent a diversified and growing automotive aftermarket platform, operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a strong emphasis on operational excellence, accountability, and disciplined growth. We are building a team capable of owning results, scaling complex businesses, and driving execution across a multi-entity platform.

SUMMARY :
Reporting to the Managing Director, the Senior Operations Manager owns the end-to-end order fulfillment experience for Garage Hub — from the moment an order is transmitted to a supplier through delivery at the customer's door — and is responsible for managing the supplier performance and order execution that sit behind it.
Beyond running the day-to-day, this person will take on special projects and cross-functional strategic initiatives alongside the Managing Director, moving the organization from reactive problem-solving to proactive risk management and identifying where automation and AI can remove manual work. Garage Hub is scaling quickly, and much of the job is making sure nothing breaks as it does.
This role manages one Operations Clerk today, with a clear trajectory to help build out the team as volume scales, and works closely with the Managing Director, COO, and President.
The right person will be a self-starter with a bias for action, ready to roll up their sleeves on cross-functional projects while also comfortable managing people, and will have a track record for building new processes from the ground up and getting things done.
The culture is startup-paced and intellectually honest. We work hard, we debate ideas at the whiteboard and make decisions the same day. If you want a slow-moving environment with lots of process, this isn't it. If you want to build something real, fast, with people who are just as bought in as you are — this is exactly it.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES :

• Owns the health of order transmission to suppliers and manages supplier performance, driving accountability for on-time processing and shipping against goals, with clear improvements of key cancellation and late order KPIs.

• Owns the daily cancellation process and the levers behind it, driving the rate down against goal.

• Owns late-order performance against our channel partners' standard, and can tell a real improvement from one with manual workarounds.

• Owns the returns-to-supplier workflow (RMA retrieval and tracking), coordinating with the Operations Clerk and the Returns Center Manager on the physical handoff.

• Owns the operational preconditions that make a claim recoverable working with Finance.

• Owns warehouse onboarding process execution — turning the current ad hoc handoffs into a defined, gated process with clear ownership at each step, so no location sits idle while each party believes it is waiting on someone else.

• Runs the operating cadence: the weekly warehouse performance review, the reporting behind it, and the follow-through between meetings.

• Manages the Operations Clerk, with the mandate to help grow the team as the function scales.

• Leads special projects and cross-functional strategic initiatives alongside the Managing Director and other leaders.

• Leads process optimization and automation, partnering with technical teams to apply AI and systems-based solutions that cut manual work and cycle times — including piloting agents against the highest-volume manual work and measuring what they actually save.

• Identifies structural and process inefficiencies across the fulfillment organization, developing and implementing targeted improvement initiatives in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

• Proactively identifies points of potential failure across the order lifecycle and puts safeguards in place before issues occur.

• Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS :

• Must be able to work until 2:00 PM PT

• Full professional fluency in written and spoken English

• 4-6 years of operations management experience, including some experience managing people or functions

• Experience owning supplier, logistics/carrier, or fulfillment relationships is strongly preferred

• A demonstrated track record of building or improving processes and SOPs, ideally in a fast-growing or startup environment — this person should be genuinely crafty about finding ways to make things more efficient and automated, not just execute an existing playbook

• Self-driven, comfortable in dynamic, fast-growing environments and able to implement solutions independently (start-up experience preferred)

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to anticipate issues before they surface

• Analytical mindset with a focus on data-driven decision-making, and the discipline to trust a number only once you understand how it was produced

• Business acumen with the ability to relate financial and operational data to decisions

• Comfortable using AI tools as part of the job, not just aware of them

• Excellent communication skills to facilitate collaboration across teams

• Proficient in Google Suite products and data processing/reporting tools

• Bachelor's degree required

TRAVEL :

• Limited to no travel will be required for this position.

postings.descriptionText:
About Sezzle

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a talented and motivated Chargeback Operations Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Chargeback Operations Intern , you will be responsible for analyzing and responding to card and ACH disputes filed against Sezzle. Working closely with our fraud/risk team and our customer disputes team, you will navigate issues on a case by case basis to determine the best course of action to help our customers get unstuck. Analysts will also make recommendations to our management on how to improve and scale our processes.

We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time Monday through Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - Central Time. This will be a paid internship.

What You'll Do

• Investigate disputed credit card, debit card, and ACH transactions and take suitable action to resolve those disputes within the allowed timeframes.

• Work cross functionally with relevant departments (fraud, disputes) to determine next steps on a case to case basis.

• Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to identify patterns or trends.

• Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.

• Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our loss prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.

• Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.

• Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.

• Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

What We Look For

• Experience in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment

• Attention to detail and ability to multitask

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

• Strong business judgment and communication skills

• Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training

About You

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working At Sezzle Awesome

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

postings.title: Executive Operations & AI - CEO Right Hand
postings.descriptionText:
We're looking for a highly proactive Operations professional who can become a true right hand to leadership .

This role is for someone who understands how a business operates, keeps priorities and projects moving, solves problems proactively, and creates structure where needed. You'll work closely with leadership to coordinate workflows, manage follow-ups and deadlines, improve internal processes, and make sure important tasks don't fall through the cracks.

This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant role . We're looking for someone who takes ownership, thinks ahead, and can turn high-level or sometimes unclear requests into organized next steps and execution.

Key Responsibilities:

• Coordinate day-to-day operations, projects, priorities, and deadlines.

• Work closely with founders and executives to keep key initiatives moving.

• Track action items, follow-ups, deliverables, and outstanding decisions.

• Build, document, and improve workflows, processes, and SOPs.

• Identify operational bottlenecks and implement practical solutions.

• Maintain CRMs, project management tools, databases, and internal documentation.

• Coordinate with team members, clients, vendors, and other stakeholders.

• Support executive priorities, meetings, research, calendar, and communications when needed.

• Use AI and automation tools to improve productivity and reduce repetitive work.

• Research problems independently and bring possible solutions.

• Support other areas of the business as needed, including client operations, marketing operations, finance/admin, and internal projects

Requirements

• Experience in Business Operations, Executive Operations, Project Coordination, Process Improvement, or a similar role.

• Strong ownership mentality with the ability to work independently and proactively.

• Experience working directly with founders, CEOs, executives, or senior leadership is highly valued.

• Excellent organization, prioritization, and follow-through.

• Experience building or improving workflows, SOPs, and internal processes.

• Comfortable managing multiple projects and changing priorities.

• Tech-savvy and able to learn new tools quickly.

• Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar in day-to-day work.

• Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, AI agents, or other automation tools is a strong plus.

• Familiarity with Notion, ClickUp, Monday.com, Asana, Airtable, HubSpot, or similar platforms.

• Professional written and spoken English (C1/C2).

• Experience working remotely with U.S.-based teams is a plus

Benefits

• Compensation: $1,200-$1,500 USD/month, depending on experience.

• 100% remote position.

• Full-time contractor opportunity.

• Work directly with U.S.-based businesses and leadership teams.

• Opportunity to take real ownership and have a direct impact on business operations.

• Exposure to AI, automation, and modern business systems.

• 10 PTO days per year.

• 3 sick days per year.

• 6 U.S. federal holidays

• Manage the day-to-day operations of UK holiday lets and serviced accommodation properties.

• Oversee Airbnb and Booking.com accounts.

• Manage guest messaging automation platforms such as ChargeAutomation.
