Proven experience with:

• Airbnb

• Booking.com

• Lodgify or similar channel management software.

• Dynamic pricing tools (PriceLabs or equivalent).

• Guest messaging automation platforms (ChargeAutomation or similar).

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple properties simultaneously.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Calm and professional when handling urgent situations, including guest complaints, maintenance emergencies, and lockouts.

• High attention to detail, especially regarding compliance, documentation, and operational accuracy.

• Comfortable using spreadsheets and reporting tools to monitor property performance and costs.

• Trustworthy and discreet when handling sensitive financial and owner information.

• A proactive, solutions-focused mindset that identifies problems and recommends effective solutions.

Why Join Us?

• Fully remote position.

• Work with a growing UK holiday let portfolio.

• Long-term opportunity with room for growth.

• Supportive and collaborative team environment.

• Opportunity to make a direct impact on operations and guest experience.

If you have the experience and operational mindset we're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

postings.title: Sales Operations & Retail Support Coordinator (NetSuite)
postings.descriptionText:
Overview
Our client is looking for a highly organized and proactive Sales Operations & Retail Support Coordinator (NetSuite) to serve as a key operational partner to their U.S. sales team and Chief Revenue Officer. In this role, you will own the end-to-end sales operations supporting retail accounts, from item setup and purchase order coordination to cross-functional project tracking and record maintenance. You will keep global teams across the U.S., Australia, and Asia seamlessly aligned on retailer requirements, deliverables, and critical deadlines while acting as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts. The ideal candidate brings prior experience supporting U.S. retail accounts, communicates confidently on operational topics, and proactively spots potential risks before they impact an order or launch. While NetSuite experience is a helpful plus, comprehensive training will be provided to ensure your success.

Schedule:

• Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Pacific Time (30 hours per week)

Responsibilities

• Retailer Setup and Cross-Functional Project Management: Own end-to-end item setups, portals, and compliance (e.g., WERCS), while building timelines and coordinating with global cross-functional teams (Sales, Ops, Legal, Finance) to keep projects on track using Monday.com and Airtable.

• Retailer Records, Grids, and Submissions: Maintain an organized library of retailer templates, complete assortment and promotional grids (UPCs, specs, pricing), and ensure product/customer data stays synchronized across retailer portals and internal ERP records.

• Purchase Order Coordination: Review customer POs for accuracy against approved items, pricing, and ship windows, resolve routine discrepancies directly, and maintain clear status tracking so Sales can focus on commercial matters.

• Customer Communication and Account Support: Serve as a direct contact for retailer inventory teams and assistant buyers on routine operational matters, display execution, and ship window updates, while escalating commercial decisions to Sales.

• Samples and Shipping Coordination: Manage sample/mockup needs, track inventory, issue twice-monthly stock updates, and coordinate FedEx shipments (preferring Minneapolis–St. Paul candidates if local handling is required, or coordinating with a U.S. partner for offshore hires).

• Sales Operations Records and Spend Tracking: Track trade spend, shopper marketing commitments, and approved program budgets to support routine sales reporting.

• ERP and Data Maintenance: Maintain product, customer, and order data in NetSuite and run Excel tracking files (utilizing lookups and pivot tables for accuracy).

Requirements

• Experience supporting U.S. retail accounts or working with U.S. retailer requirements.

• Experience with retailer item setup , product submission requirements, portals, or item grids.

• Experience reviewing and processing retailer purchase orders.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the judgment to manage routine customer communication professionally.

• Strong project coordination skills, including managing timelines, follow-ups, dependencies, and multiple deadlines.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort working with structured product and customer data.

• Familiarity with Monday.com, Airtable , or similar workflow and project tracking tools.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to identify missing or inconsistent information.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment and collaborate across time zones.

• PowerPoint and NetSuite experience are helpful but not required. Training will be provided.

Independent Contractor Perks

• Permanent work from home

• Immediate hiring

Note
Please click the " APPLY " button to complete your application, including the assessment questions, technical check, and voice recording. Your hourly pay rate will be established based on your performance in the application process; submissions with all requirements fulfilled will receive priority review.

One application, multiple possibilities: When you apply, our team reviews your background against all current openings, not just this one! If a different role fits your skills, we'll get in touch! We also encourage you to keep exploring our job board and apply directly to any position that excites you.

postings.title: Queue Lead - AR
postings.descriptionText:
Queue Lead

Start date: TBC

End Date: TBC

Location: Remote

Type of contract: Freelance

Languages required: English

Hourly Rate: Include the rate you are comfortable with on your CV.

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Role

We are seeking a Queue Lead to join a high-priority initiative in partnership with a leading AI company. This is an operational, hands-on role, you will own day-to-day execution for one or more annotation queues on a live AI training/eval program: managing throughput, running quality calibrations, tracking contributor performance, and building out reporting systems that keep stakeholders informed in real time.

You will have experience running queues and quality on AI data programs. The selected candidate will be able to speak to specific projects, calibration processes they've built, and contributor performance systems they've run.

What you'll be doing

Queue Operations & Task Management

• Own work queues: intake, triage, prioritization, task assignment, and SLA delivery

• Monitor task queue and backlog control

• Identify and troubleshoot bottlenecks (unclear policy, tooling issues, supply gaps)

Quality Assurance & Performance Management

• Monitor quality at project and individual annotator or contributor level.

• Perform QA tasks such as making corrections, providing annotator feedback, flagging systematic confusion and suggestions to team lead.

• Manage annotator or contributor performance by performing tasks like unassigning underperformers, identifying and retaining high-performers.

Reporting & Dashboards

• Build and maintain dashboards to track throughput, disagreement rates, defect or rework rates, and contributor performance.

• Turn raw queue data into clear, actionable reporting for stakeholders.

• Provide feedback for process improvements based on data trends.

Training & Support

• Oversee dedicated Slack channels by answering participant questions, providing support, and escalating complex issues to the Client Delivery Lead.

• Train new annotators or contributors on project guidelines.

• Conduct live or recorded webinars as new participants join projects.

• Host "office hours" for participants.

• Oversee dedicated Slack channels by answering questions, providing support, escalating complex issues to Client Delivery Lead.

What you'll bring

• Proven, direct experience running queues and quality on AI data programs, ideally at a competitor.

• 3+ years in high-throughput ops (data labeling, trust & safety, BPO, content ops, CX ops), with recent, specific AI data ops experience

• Able to identify shallow, low-effort, AI-generated, or phoned-in responses.

• Proven ability to design and run calibration processes from scratch.

• Ability to track record by building or maintaining dashboards or reporting systems (spreadsheets is required, SQL/BI/Looker/Tableau a strong plus)

• Experience managing contributor performance at scale including making retention or removal decisions.

• Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities on live programs.

What "good" looks like for us:

• Scale up to running a full AI end-to-end data program, owning pipeline, throughput, calibration, and contributor performance at program level.

• Operates as an AI training consultant, you are comfortable advising on processes and methodology.

Bonus

• Experience with ML data or LLM eval workflows (ranking, rubric-based judging, gold sets, calibration)

• Distributed team coordination across time zones; vendor or contract workforce experience

• Consulting-style experience of advising clients on AI training methodology.

Success looks like

Predictable SLA delivery, a stable backlog, improving quality and reducing rework, and proactive dashboards reporting that give stakeholders real-time visibility.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube

Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

postings.descriptionText:
Job Overview

This position will put you at the forefront of Patient Safety. As a PV Intake agent, you will have daily direct contact with Health Care Professionals (HCPs) and patients (the very people we are working to help), this is a highly visible and important role within IQVIA and essential to our core goal of patient safety. You will perform PV Intake activities, PV follow ups and PV reconciliations to help optimize the safety profiles of products across various therapeutic areas.

You will benefit from joining the largest safety department in the world and working within an industry-leading, best-practice environment. To ensure you contribute to the business and grow your career, you will also benefit from ongoing training and development from our in-house safety experts to plan and progress your career. 

This role requires fluency in English; proficiency in French is considered a strong asset.

Main Responsibilities

Responsibilities include receiving and documenting incoming telephone calls, voicemails, chats, faxes or emails from investigative sites or other sources reporting Lifecycle Safety Data.

Additional Responsibilities Include

• PV mailbox triage

• PV intake activities, PV follow ups and PV reconciliations.

• Translation of content where necessary.

• Receiving and documenting incoming safety information from external customers such as patients and/or healthcare providers and responding to their enquiries about products. Summarizing these reports based on information identified as vital to the project.

• Triage, identify and transfer out of scope inquiries to local point of contact, as provided by the client.

• Disseminate clear, accurate information to healthcare professionals and patients based on the approved call scripts and/or other approved resources related to the use of client products.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Life sciences or a related field (mandatory)

• Fluency in English (mandatory) (will be evaluated)

• Previous PV experience (required)

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

postings.descriptionText:
Overview/General Description

The Supervisor, Capability Center Operations - GCC Global Home IT, is the people manager who is in charge of leading the end-to-end operational performance for assigned insurance operation workstreams. This role ensures consistent achievement of quality, production, and client SLA targets while fostering strong talent development, operational discipline, and continuous improvement. The Supervisor partners closely with global stakeholders to deliver compliant, cost-effective, and scalable operations that support Assurant’s strategic objectives and client commitments.

Essential Functions

Manages day to day operations making sure associates Quality and productivity are up to standard.

Leads performance conversations with associates. Creating short/long term goals for his/hers work group.

Coaches for performance leading the team for success and communicating the departamental performance appropriately.

Manages communication with leadership and peers on a clear and proactive way. Maintains stakeholders on the loop of challenges, opportunities and operational success.

Manages change within the group.

Works with local managers proposing action plans to work on operational gains and improvements.

Enforces all corporate/operational/departmental policies and values

Ensures that controls exist to monitor existing performance for all department assignments and managing financial risk to the clients and Assurant by effectively managing controls to prevent losses and poor customer support.

Provides coaching and direction to all associates within department that promote continued improvement in performance.

Knowledge/Skills/Experience Required

• Experience: Two or more years of supervisory experience required. Experience in mortgage servicing, customer service, retail banking or hazard insurance processing is desirable.

• Knowledge: Good verbal and written communications skills, analytical skills. An understanding of human resource policies and procedures.

• Skills: Well developed interpersonal skills promoting team participation with assigned staff. Motivational methods to improve and develop assigned staff. Ability to engage co-workers and peers in cross-functional teams. Multi-task and perform to multiple goals/objectives.

Soft Skills

Be able to work on multiple projects simultaneously, keeping up with deadlines, and meeting client compliance goals/standards.

Be able to make quick decisions even when not all the information is at hand.

Be able to think creatively and implement process improvements.

Be a motivator.

If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World

Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

What’s the culture like at Assurant?

Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Company Overview

Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

AI and Biometric Usage

Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

Job Scam Alert

Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords. Learn more about what to look out for and how to report a scam here.

postings.title: Operations Manager
postings.descriptionText:
About the role
Zenit Corp is an ecommerce group operating print-on-demand businesses. We are hiring an Operations Manager to take responsibility for day-to-day execution, lead the operational team and improve how work moves through the business.

Your mission is to turn the CEO’s objectives into clear plans and completed results. You will work directly with the CEO, agree on priorities and decision-making boundaries, and take ownership of execution within them. This is a hands-on role: you will lead people, resolve problems and personally move work forward when needed.

What you will ownExecution planning and team leadership

• Build execution plans from business objectives, with owners, deadlines, dependencies and expected outcomes.

• Set priorities across the team, delegate clearly and follow through until commitments are completed. Adjust plans when circumstances change.

• Give direction and feedback, remove blockers and address gaps in execution rather than allowing work to stall.

• Help recruit and onboard operational team members, clarify responsibilities and make sure they understand the processes they will use.

Order flow and provider coordination

• Coordinate customer support, illustration and design, production, fulfillment and external providers across the order journey.

• Make sure each handoff has the information, owner and next step needed to keep orders moving and resolve customer issues.

• Own the resolution of provider delays and quality issues, agree on corrective actions and verify that the problem is resolved.

Processes and operational improvement

• Review existing SOPs and operating guides, identify unclear or inefficient steps, and update documentation as workflows change.

• Investigate recurring errors and bottlenecks, implement practical improvements and verify that the team adopts them.

• Identify opportunities to simplify or automate repetitive work, including appropriate uses of AI. Check accuracy and reliability before making changes part of the process.

Performance, quality and risk

• Define useful indicators for the areas you oversee and use them to review execution quality and progress against agreed objectives.

• Detect risks, delays and capacity constraints early, decide what needs attention first and track corrective actions to completion.

• Give the CEO a concise view of progress, risks and decisions needed. Escalate issues outside your authority with context and a recommendation.

What success looks like

• Priorities move from objectives to completed deliverables, with clear ownership and fewer unresolved dependencies.

• Recurring operational problems lead to lasting process improvements, rather than the same issue being addressed repeatedly.

• The CEO stays informed and can focus on business priorities without having to manage daily follow-up.

Required experience and skills

• Experience owning a comparable operation end to end and leading a team across multiple functions.

• Examples of plans you created, decisions you made and operational problems you resolved, with evidence of the results.

• Practical experience using operational data, improving processes and holding people accountable for commitments.

• Sound judgment when priorities compete, clear communication and willingness to combine management with detailed execution.

• Operational English at B2 level or above for suppliers, tools and documentation.

Valuable additional experience

• Ecommerce or print-on-demand operations. We also consider other sectors where responsibility and operational complexity are comparable.

• Using automation or AI tools to improve operational workflows.

• Spanish communication skills. Our team works primarily in Spanish, so Spanish is preferred; we also consider candidates who work in English.

Up to $40,000 annually
USD 2,500 fixed per month, plus an annual bonus of up to USD 10,000, conditional on meeting objectives. Maximum annual compensation is USD 40,000 if the full bonus is earned.

Description

Our last-mile delivery partners are crucial to our service, and we work closely with them to make sure deliveries large and small get to where they need to be. As a Senior Delivery Partner Manager, you’ll make sure we have the best relationship possible with our partners. You’ll build connections, help them put processes in place for efficient delivery, and smooth out any issues they experience, all with the aim of creating a partnership that’s successful for many years.

Key job responsibilities

• Manage a portfolio of customer accounts by analyzing performance data and key performance indicators, segmenting and prioritizing accounts, and developing plans with clear, measurable success criteria that align with shared goals.

• Build and maintain trusted relationships with stakeholders—both internal and external—by understanding their priorities, aligning on strategies, and providing tailored recommendations that improve the account and customer experience.

• Audit, monitor, and review business performance across your accounts, proactively identifying risks and opportunities while adjusting project plans to keep outcomes on track.

• Educate accounts on available tools, processes, and resources, and leverage generative artificial intelligence and other technologies to augment productivity and the quality of your insights.

• Collaborate with partner teams to clear blockers, drive timely decisions, and suggest process improvements that strengthen operational excellence across the organization.

A day in the life

You’ll be based at one of our sites. Being on site allows you to stay close to every part of the delivery process and means you have visibility of everything to guide our logistics partners. You’ll look after all elements of our partner relationships, from getting the contracts in place to keeping track of performance.

This role requires regular travel (minimum once per week) across your portfolio of delivery stations, primarily by train and rental car, with all travel expenses fully reimbursed.

About The Team

We belong to the international DSP Team and as Delivery Partner Managers own the relationship with our Delivery Service Providers in MEU (DE/AT/NL). We operate in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where every team member contributes ideas that shape how we serve our customers. As we continue to expand, we are focused on raising the bar for the account experience and building scalable practices that benefit customers across our portfolio. If you are excited about making a tangible difference for businesses while growing your own career at Amazon, we would love to hear from you.

postings.title: Senior Counsel
postings.descriptionText:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.

Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.

Dow has an exciting and challenging opportunity for a Senior Legal Counsel to serve as a trusted legal and business adviser supporting Dow's operations in Argentina.

About You And This Role

In this role, you will partner closely with business, manufacturing and functional leaders to help enable safe, compliant and successful operations while managing legal risk and protecting Dow's interests. You will lead complex and sensitive matters, establish legal strategies and provide practical, values-driven advice while adapting to evolving business and organizational priorities.

Responsibilities

• Provide timely, practical and risk-based legal advice aligned with business objectives, functional priorities and Dow values in Argentina.

• Independently manage a diverse portfolio of complex matters, establish priorities and escalation paths, and take ownership through resolution.

• Advise on environmental, health and safety laws and regulations, operational compliance, permitting, inspections, incident response and remediation.

• Provide strategic advice on employment and labor matters, including union engagement, organizational changes, workplace investigations, terminations and disputes.

• Support interactions with regulators, governmental authorities and industry associations, as appropriate.

• Manage outside counsel and other service providers, including legal strategy, performance, budgets and alignment with business objectives.

• Partner closely with the Bahía Blanca site, traveling there at least once per month and additionally as business needs require.

• Collaborate across functions and organizational levels to influence decisions, build consensus and support effective decision-making in complex or sensitive situations.

• Support compliance initiatives, investigations, litigation management and other legal matters affecting Dow's businesses and sites as needs evolve.

• Drive legal operations and continuous improvement initiatives, including process simplification, knowledge management and effective legal service delivery.

• Deliver legal training and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative Legal team through knowledge sharing, mentorship and support.

Qualifications

• Law degree and active qualification to practice law in Argentina, with at least eight years of relevant legal experience.

• Experience in a leading law firm, in-house legal department, or a combination of both, with demonstrated success independently managing complex, high-impact matters.

• Experience advising clients in the energy, chemicals, petrochemicals, manufacturing, natural resources or other highly regulated industries is strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience managing employment, labor, environmental, regulatory and operational legal matters.

• Strong drafting, negotiation, analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

• Fluent Spanish and English, written and spoken, are required. Portuguese language skills are a plus.

• Ability and willingness to travel to Bahía Blanca at least once per month and additionally as business needs require.

Your Skills:

• Uncompromising integrity, high ethical standards and sound, values-based judgment.

• Independent ownership, accountability and consistent follow-through.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust across businesses, sites, functions and cultures.

• Business acumen and the ability to balance legal risk, operational realities and strategic priorities.

• Ability to influence without authority, navigate ambiguity and communicate clear, actionable recommendations.

• Demonstrated commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued and respected.

• Commitment to collaboration, respect and teamwork.

• Ability to coach, influence and contribute positively to team development, regardless of formal reporting relationships.

• Agility, resilience and flexibility to manage competing priorities and adapt to evolving business needs and role responsibilities.

To apply:

• Sign in or create your account.

• Make sure your resume is accessible. Easily link your LinkedIn Profile to load your resume when logging into apply.

Benefits – What Dow Offers You

We invest in you.

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.

Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:

• Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.

• Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.

• Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

• Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

• Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).

• Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

• Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.

• Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.

• Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.

• Competitive yearly vacation allowance.

• Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).

• Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.

• Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.

• Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.

• On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).

• Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.

• Additionally, some of our locations might offer:

• Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)

• Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)

• Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)

Join our team, we can make a difference together.

About Dow

Dow (NYSE: DOW) is one of the world’s leading materials science companies, serving customers in high-growth markets such as packaging, infrastructure, mobility and consumer applications. Our global breadth, asset integration and scale, focused innovation, leading business positions and commitment to sustainability enable us to achieve profitable growth and help deliver a sustainable future. We operate manufacturing sites in 30 countries and employ approximately 36,000 people. Dow delivered sales of approximately $43 billion in 2024. References to Dow or the Company mean Dow Inc. and its subsidiaries. Learn more about us and our ambition to be the most innovative, customer-centric, inclusive and sustainable materials science company in the world by visiting www.dow.com.

As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com.

Es el único SMR diseñado para ser a la vez escalable y rentable, con la menor carga de construcción física por megavatio entre los SMR de escala de red.
Nuestro equipo de clase mundial está basado en Argentina, los Estados Unidos y el Reino Unido, trabajando juntos hacia una sola meta: electrificación a escala, comenzando en 2030.

La Oportunidad
Como Jr. Plant Layout Designer, vas a brindar soporte técnico al área de Layout de Planta, colaborando en la actualización de modelos 3D, preparación de documentación y asistencia en tareas de integración de disciplinas para el proyecto ACR300. El puesto está orientado a tu formación dentro del diseño de implantación de planta, modelado 3D y revisión espacial.
Este rol es ideal para arrancar tu carrera en un proyecto de gran escala donde el layout define cómo conviven las disciplinas en la planta. Vas a aprender con herramientas digitales de modelado, integración multidisciplinaria y verificación de interferencias.
Este puesto es ideal para alguien que:

• Cree que la energía nuclear es esencial para un futuro energético limpio y quiere ser parte de un proyecto que electrifica a escala.

• Disfruta del modelado 3D, del trabajo con herramientas digitales y de la integración entre disciplinas.

• Tiene atención al detalle, orden documental y orientación al cumplimiento de plazos.

• Quiere aprender de equipos con experiencia profunda en diseño de plantas industriales.

Qué Harás
Soporte a Modelado y Documentación de Layout

• Asistir en la preparación y actualización de modelos y documentación del área de Layout.

• Diseñar, modelar y preparar documentación asociada a revisiones de layout e integración de modelos.

• Dar soporte a la organización documental del área.

Detección y Seguimiento de Interferencias

• Utilizar herramientas digitales para la revisión de modelos y la detección de interferencias físicas y funcionales.

• Colaborar en el registro, seguimiento y actualización del estado de las interferencias.

Verificación Espacial y Funcional

• Colaborar en la verificación básica de accesos, espacios libres, rutas de circulación, áreas de mantenimiento y zonas de operación, conforme a los criterios definidos por los especialistas del área.

Apoyo a Revisiones de Modelo

• Apoyar la preparación de vistas, capturas, reportes gráficos, mark-ups y listados de observaciones para reuniones de coordinación interdisciplinaria y revisiones de modelo.

Qué Buscamos
Aprendizaje y Rigurosidad Técnica

• Atención al detalle en el modelado 3D y en el seguimiento de interferencias.

• Compromiso con la trazabilidad documental y con la calidad de los entregables.

Iniciativa y Responsabilidad

• Capacidad para asumir tareas asignadas con orden, autonomía progresiva y foco en resultados.

• Capacidad para identificar interferencias, elevar consultas y documentar avances.

Trabajo en Equipo y Comunicación Intersectorial

• Capacidad de interactuar con Engineering (mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation y piping), Nuclear, Safety, Licensing y Planning.

• Perseverancia, disposición al cambio y flexibilidad.

¿Por qué unirte a Meitner Energy?
Una misión que importa. Vas a ayudar a poner en línea energía nuclear limpia y escalable, no como una promesa futura, sino como un plan ejecutable que arranca en 2030. El trabajo que hagas acá acelera directamente la transición energética global.
Ownership real. Meitner es lo suficientemente chica como para que tus decisiones moldeen visiblemente la empresa, y lo suficientemente ambiciosa como para que esas decisiones importen. Contratamos personas que quieren ser dueñas de los resultados, no solo de tareas.
Equipo de clase mundial en tres continentes. Vas a trabajar con ingenieros, operadores y constructores en Argentina, EE. UU. y el Reino Unido, con experiencia profunda en lo nuclear, lo industrial y la ejecución.
Ejecución por encima del hype. El ACR300 está construido sobre tecnología probada de agua liviana con innovación dirigida, porque desplegar energía limpia a escala es un problema de ejecución, no un experimento científico. Valoramos el rigor, el criterio y el seguimiento.

Para postularte

postings.title: Food Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
About CookUnity

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About The Team

We are a small, hardworking, dynamic, and purpose-driven team focused on improving the way CookUnity creates and produces food. Our work centers on reducing environmental impact through real, operational initiatives: lowering food waste across all markets, strengthening responsible sourcing, elevating ingredient quality and nutrient value in our meals, and advancing lower-impact packaging solutions.

We partner closely with Culinary Ops, Chef Success, Supply chain to turn these commitments into daily practice, building cleaner standards, improving processes, and scaling innovations that make our meals better for people and for the planet.

The Role

We are looking for a recent Food Engineering graduate (or equivalent degree in Food Science or Technology) to join our team. The ideal candidate is organized, respectful, collaborative, analytical, and critical-thinking , with the potential to take leadership in research-oriented projects . They should be eager to learn, capable of structured analysis, and able to translate research findings into practical applications within our operations.

This role does not require prior field experience but demands a methodical and team-oriented mindset , curiosity for continuous improvement, and the ability to contribute ideas while following structured workflows.

Responsibilities

• Actively work on the Food Science Lab Project (Ingredients Integrity + Nutrients Optimization) by researching, studying and analyzing every step of CookUnity’s food production process, from ingredients till meals are consumed by customers.

• Understand and evaluate how meals are produced, identifying opportunities to improve nutritional value and overall ingredient performance.

• Participate in the Ingredients Integrity program by evaluating ingredient quality, formulations, storage practices, and kitchen usage, while collecting and organizing data to strengthen standards, improve sourcing decisions, and support nutrient-forward upgrades.

• Gain in-depth knowledge of food additives, their functions in the industry, and their regulatory restrictions in different applications.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Chefs, Sourcing, Cullinary Ops and Nutrition) to ensure ingredient quality, safety, and consistency.

• Maintain clear, organized documentation and reports to support research and innovation projects.

• Contribute to the development of clean, high-standard recipes aligned with CookUnity’s mission to deliver better, healthier meals.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Food Engineering, Food Science, or a related field.

• Fluent English (written and spoken).

• Strong organizational, analytical, and critical-thinking skills. Strong data collection, communication, and problem-solving skills required

• Have the ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment - skilled at planning, organizing, prioritizing, and executing multiple projects and activities simultaneously.

• Experience and a high level of expertise in data entry, a food production enterprise resource or recipe management software, food labeling and compliance programs, GSuite, and Slack.

• Team player with a proactive, respectful, and detail-oriented attitude.

• Interest in food innovation, ingredient quality, and applied research.

• Optimistic, resourceful, and ready to take on any challenges

Learn More About CookUnity

We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.

We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family leave

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefit platform

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates

We’ve Recently Seen An Increase In Recruitment Scams Across The Industry, And We Want To Make Sure You (and Your Data) Stay Safe While Applying To CookUnity. We Also Want You To Know That We Take This Seriously — Sometimes, As Part Of Our Process, We May Ask For a Brief “proof Of Humanity” To Confirm That We’re Connecting With a Real Person, Not An Impersonator. Here Are a Few Tips To Help You Protect Yourself And Know What To Expect From Us

• Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

postings.descriptionText:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms

• ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

• ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

• ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

• High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

• Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

• AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

• Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

• Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

• Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

• Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

• Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

• Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

• Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About The Role

We're looking for an experienced partnerships leader to build and scale our Commercial Partners Programme in Southern Latam — bringing together resellers, systems integrators, and consulting firms who help deploy ElevenLabs' technology to their clients across the Southern Latam market.

You'll own the reseller, integrator, and consulting partner strategy end-to-end — from building relationships with leading SIs, consultancies, and resellers, to onboarding, enabling, and activating them to sell and deliver ElevenLabs products.

This is a 0→1 build: you'll design and pilot partner incentive and enablement models, generate qualified pipeline through partner-led opportunities, and scale the programme against regional growth targets, while owning day-to-day execution and partner performance.

What Success Looks Like (First 6–9 Months)

• Partner-Sourced & Influenced Revenue: closed-won ARR through GSIs, RSIs, cloud providers, VARs, and technology partners reaching at least 20% of regional revenue

• Partner-Sourced Pipeline: qualified pipeline created through partners, with a focus on enterprise opportunities in target industries

• Revenue-Producing Partners: number of partners actively generating pipeline, opportunities, or revenue each quarter

• Time-to-First Revenue: speed from partner onboarding to first sourced opportunity and first closed-won deal

• Strategic Account Penetration: new enterprise accounts and executive relationships unlocked through partners that ElevenLabs would've struggled to access directly

Requirements

• 12+ years building and scaling an in-country SaaS/Cloud solution, with a strong network you can leverage from day one

• 4+ years owning RSI, GSI, and hyperscaler partnerships, with proven experience driving joint account planning, co-sell, and revenue — not just relationship management

• A builder mindset — experience creating partner motions from 0→1, rather than inheriting a mature programme

• Comfortable working with technical, API-driven products, and able to explain complex concepts to partners and customers

• Based in Buenos Aires

Bonus: Mix of 3-4 years in sales + 3-4 years in partnerships/alliances; mix of 3-4 years at a large company + 3-4 years at a smaller/less established company

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

You also know how to join a fan conversation: when a thoughtful reply adds something, when humour fits, and when an issue needs escalating. This is a hands-on role owning the relationship between a brand and its community through strong copy and thoughtful engagement.

Storm is an AI-native agency. AI tools and agentic workflows are central to how our teams work, and we hire people who want to work that way from day one.

AI-first doesn't mean AI-generated. The work itself is craft: finding the right angle, shaping a line and responding with judgment. You direct agents through Codex, using reusable skills and context libraries of brand voice, source material and editorial examples to produce copy variants, edit working documents and run structured checks. You catch the bland line, unsupported claim or reply that misses the mood, and make it better. Your editorial judgment stays in charge of every word.

You'll learn the ground first: what we make and the bar it has to hit. Social copy that earns attention. Community replies that make the brand feel like part of the fandom. Then you'll work from Storm's stack of AI and creative tools, and play a real part in improving how this work gets done.

About Storm Ideas

Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.
Storm brings together entertainment, fandom, creative production, community and technology.

We help major brands build stronger relationships with their audiences, while using AI to improve how that work is created, checked and delivered.

We are a remote-first, fast-moving company with established clients, a growing team, and a strong appetite for better tools, better systems, and better ways of working. AI is central to how we operate — every team, every role, this one included.

What You Will Do

• Write engaging, on-brand social copy for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube and other relevant platforms, with AI tools and agentic workflows as your default way of working.

• Review and refine social copy for clarity, accuracy and audience fit, adapting each piece to its platform and purpose.

• Learn each brand's voice, audience and subject matter deeply enough to judge when AI output fits. Maintain and evolve tone-of-voice guidance, source context and examples that people and agents can use consistently.

• Fact-check against supplied sources and proofread everything you deliver, including anything AI touched. Check names, claims, grammar, punctuation, links, accessibility and platform-native formatting; treat rights and brand safety as fixed points.

• Pitch social content angles and approaches that improve engagement and visibility. Apply copywriting best practice, using performance signals and feedback to improve attention, reach and the quality of the writing.

• Engage communities day to day: respond to comments and join relevant conversations on fan, talent and partner content. Keep replies timely, appropriate and consistent with the brand's personality and engagement approach.

• Stay close to culture, fandom, trends and platform developments. Surface timely engagement opportunities that suit the audience, and feed what you learn from conversations back into copy and content ideas.

• Use agents for repeatable work such as preparing copy variants, checking against source material and summarising community themes. Review their work critically, make the editorial decisions and keep useful records for clear handovers.

• Prioritise deadlines and responsive community work, balance a shared workload with colleagues across time zones, and adapt constructively to feedback and changing priorities.

• Keep improving how the work gets done: encode your best methods into reusable skills and workflows that agents and teammates can pick up and run, and teach what works so the whole team levels up with you. Test new capabilities against real briefs, compare the results with your current approach, and update shared methods when they improve quality or reliability.

Success means distinctive, accurate copy; timely community responses that fit the conversation; and improvements that reduce avoidable revisions and help teammates deliver consistently. You can show what your methods changed, using examples, feedback and useful measures.

What We Are Looking For

• Excellent written English and a strong editorial ear. Your writing shows precision, range, personality and an ability to adapt tone without losing clarity.

• Community judgment: you understand fan behaviour, can write a natural response and recognise when to engage, pause or escalate. You bring a real interest in TV, film and online culture.

• Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI agents in work, study or personal projects. You can show how you build context, direct production and checks, reject weak output and improve the result. You have examples beyond asking a chatbot for ideas.

• Confidence working with editorial documents, social platforms and AI tools. You may bring a traditional copy background with a developed AI practice, or have built your craft using AI from the start. Either path works here.

• Sound fact-checking and accessibility knowledge, with the attention to detail to hold the quality bar at speed. You can explain the choices behind your copy and replies.

• A systems mindset and ownership: you spot repeatable work, improve it and follow through. You can demonstrate a reusable method and explain how you help someone else use it successfully.

• Clear communication, reliable organisation and thoughtful asynchronous handovers. You share work well, respond to feedback and learn new tools with an eye for what improves the result.

What It's Like To Work Here

Modern Tech Stack
You’ll work with a supported AI stack, shared context and reusable skills, backed by our AI Operations team. You’ll build on established tools and methods, contribute improvements, and help colleagues put them into practice.

Your Methods Can Become How The Team Works
We actively encourage people to bring forward better ways of working. When a method you develop proves itself, you won't just use it quietly: you'll encode it as a skill others can run, teach it to the team, and watch it become the new standard, with your name on it.

Team-based
Join an international, remote-first team of 175+ people who value skill, initiative and collaboration. You work closely with copy and account colleagues and contribute to a shared quality bar.

Flexibility
Fully remote-first. You will work 37.5 hours per week within a 9am–5:30pm Pacific Time schedule, Monday–Friday, collaborating with colleagues across time zones.

Recruitment Process

Apply with your CV, a short note explaining your fit for the role, and writing samples or a portfolio. Samples are required; personal projects count. Social copy and community-response examples are especially useful.

Shortlisted applicants complete self-recorded video questions and a short, time-boxed copy and community practical task as one screening stage.

If successful, you'll meet Tania Pardisi, Senior Copy Manager, and Nicola Taghizadeh, Chief Creative Officer, together for an interview. We'll discuss your work, your approach to community relationships and your experience using AI, and answer your questions about the role and team.

Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway if this sounds like how you already work. We are more interested in your operational judgement, reliability, follow-through, and ability to use modern tools well than in a perfect traditional CV.

postings.title: Product Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Equipo de Producto · Houm · Proptech (YC W21) · Santiago híbrido · Argentina remoto · Chile, Argentina

Todo el mundo habla de agentes de IA. Pocos los ponen a trabajar de verdad en un producto que cobra arriendo, firma contratos y atiende a miles de personas todos los días. Esa es la capa donde se gana la pelea: software en producción, con ownership, y con IA como fuerza multiplicadora. Es justo donde vas a trabajar.

En Houm ya tenemos agentes y sistemas corriendo en producción, y para que sigan funcionando y escalen a todo lo que viene necesitamos a alguien con 1–3 años construyendo software de verdad, que entregue sin que le digan cada paso, y que use IA (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) como parte del oficio, no como anécdota.

Qué vas a hacer y con qué

Vas a diseñar, construir y operar servicios y features de producto: APIs, backends, integraciones, a veces frontend. Vas a manejar el producto en su totalidad: desde la definición del problema hasta la implementación, medición y evolución en producción. Vas a tomar un problema de negocio, dejarlo claro, shippearlo con tests, y dejar el contexto listo para el siguiente. No es un rol de "ticket cerrado y me voy": lo que construyas vive en producción en Chile, México y Colombia.

Este rol es versátil de verdad: vas a partir cerca del producto, pero hacia dónde crezcas depende de ti y de lo que descubras que te apasiona. Acá nadie se queda haciendo lo mismo por años.

El equipo (esto es lo que más nos enorgullece)

Somos un equipo de producto y tecnología chico, cercano y ameno, pero con una cantidad de desafíos casi infinita. Acá todos son máquinas: gente capaz, técnica y humanamente, de tomar problemas difíciles y sacarlos adelante. No hay egos ni capas eternas, hay personas buenas resolviendo cosas grandes.

Y estamos subidos con todo al boom de la IA, transformando cómo opera Houm de punta a punta. Sabemos que los primeros en llegar son los que ganan, así que apostamos a movernos rápido: probar, equivocarnos rápido y aprender, antes que quedarnos atrás esperando la certeza perfecta. Si te gusta aprender rápido y que las cosas se muevan, tienes un pie adentro.

Lo que de verdad nos importa

Antes que cualquier tecnología, buscamos una forma de ser:

Autodidacta . Cuando no sabes algo, lo aprendes. No esperas que te lleven de la mano.
Inquieto o inquieta. Te aburre quedarte quieto y siempre andas buscando cómo mejorar las cosas.
Motivado por la IA. No le tienes miedo: la usas (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, lo que sea) y te emociona lo que se puede construir con ella hoy. Sabes cuándo confiar y cuándo validar.
Buena persona , fácil de trabajar, que se explica bien con cualquiera.

¿Y lo técnico?

No necesitas saber nuestro stack de memoria el día 1. Sí necesitas base sólida y velocidad de aprendizaje. Lo que no se enseña es la actitud, y esa es justo la que andamos buscando.

En el día a día vas a estar cerca de esto (suma fuerte si ya lo has tocado):

Backend: Python (APIs / servicios; Django o FastAPI son un plus)
Frontend / producto: TypeScript y React (no hace falta ser especialista; sí haber construido UI real)
Datos: SQL y/o MongoDB; modelar y consultar sin miedo
Cómo trabajamos: Git, PRs, tests; Docker; algo de nube (AWS ideal)
IA en el oficio: Cursor / Claude / Copilot usados de verdad (prompt → validar → shippear)

Ideal: cómodo en Python o TypeScript y con ganas de moverte al otro. No buscamos alguien que solo haga tickets o solo scripts sueltos.

Lo único no negociable

Título (o próximo a egresar) de Ingeniería en Computación, Informática, Software o Civil Industrial con foco en TI/software.
Entre 1 y 3 años (aprox.) en el mercado: este rol no es junior-junior ni “arquitecto de 10 años”.
Actitud abierta a cómo trabajamos con IA. Si te resiste el cambio de tooling, este no es el lugar.

Lo que ofrecemos

Modalidad: Remoto a menos que estés en Chile (en este caso sería híbrido, 2 días presencial).
30 días de vacaciones
Tarde libre en tu cumpleaños (y el de tu hijo/a)
5 días extra de licencia por paternidad

Si eres esta persona, postula. Nos encantaría conocerte.

Escríbenos a postula.producto@houm.com con tu CV y pretensión de renta.

We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up.

How We Approach The Work

FDEs are trusted to shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for architect-level judgment:

• Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec.

• Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology.

• Chooses the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and defends why.

• Owns the architecture decision. Documents trade-offs (ADRs), sets success metrics, pushes back on scope that won’t deliver value.

Consultative Discovery

Clients rarely arrive with a fully formed problem, and the FDE’s first contribution is helping them see it clearly. You lead discovery with genuine curiosity, moving the conversation from stated requirements to underlying needs, and you build credibility through the depth of your understanding rather than the breadth of your pitch.

• Uncovers business drivers. What outcome matters, what it’s worth, why now, and what happens if nothing changes.

• Uncovers personal drivers. What each stakeholder is measured on, what they’re worried about, and what a win looks like for them individually.

• Surfaces constraints early. Security, compliance, data access, budget, skills, politics, timelines — the things that kill projects in month two.

• Aligns stakeholders. Spots conflicting goals between business, engineering, and risk, and brings them to a shared definition of success.

• Asks strategic questions. Follows the answer with “why,” “how do you know,” and “what happens today when…” — without interrogating. Clients leave the conversation understanding their own problem better.

• Earns authority through depth. Credibility comes from the quality of the questions and the insight in the playback, not from pitching technology.

What You'll Do

• Discover. Run workshops and process discovery with business and engineering stakeholders. Separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Come back with a scoped, defensible point of view.

• Structure the process and the spec. For any business or engineering process being automated, map the current state, decision points, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably.

• Architect & design. Design agentic systems end to end — orchestration, context and retrieval architecture, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and the boundaries between deterministic and non-deterministic components.

• Build. Ship working systems — agents, multi-step automations, internal tooling, integration layers. You are hands-on. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware.

• Engineer the delivery system. Own CI/CD for what you build: build, test, release, environments.

• Consult. Present to and defend decisions in front of CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and business leadership. Quantify impact in their terms. Support pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of professional software development experience with at least one mainstream production stack (TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, C#/.NET, or Go).

• 1 - 4 years of professional experience building and shipping LLM-powered and agentic AI systems beyond prototypes or demos.

• Advanced English is required.

• Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.

• Hands-on experience with frontier AI developer tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenAI Codex.

• Proven experience evaluating current-state environments and defining technical roadmaps.

• Demonstrated experience with APIs, service design, event-driven and distributed systems, and data modeling.

• Experience designing and owning CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, release, environments, and deployment processes.

• Strong understanding of context and specification engineering to produce reliable AI output.

• Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including APIs, webhooks, event streams, iPaaS platforms such as n8n or MuleSoft, and MCP.

• Track record of leading client-facing discovery calls, asking "why" before "how" to decompose unstructured business problems.

• Skilled at exercising end-to-end delivery ownership and managing project scope without requiring product manager supervision.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• Forensic attention to detail.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams.

• Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.

• Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Strong Plus

• Production AI operations (Day 2): eval harnesses, observability and tracing, cost and token economics, drift, debugging non-deterministic systems.

• Prompt- and eval-level regression testing running in CI and gating releases.

• Delivery in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing).

postings.title: Senior SDET, Agentic Quality
postings.descriptionText:
About Onfleet

Onfleet’s mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully . Our product includes intuitive smartphone apps for drivers, a powerful modern web dashboard for logistics teams, and automatic notifications and real-time tracking for recipients. Onfleet powers millions of deliveries every week for thousands of businesses around the world across a range of industries, from grocery and prepared meals to pharmacy, flowers, and furniture.

About The Role

Onfleet is hiring two senior SDETs to shape how our engineering teams build and trust automated quality. At Onfleet, the team that builds a feature owns its quality. Developers write and maintain their own tests. Your job is to make those teams better at it: you pair with them, teach, review, and find the cases they missed. You will not be the person who tests everyone else's work.

Together with our quality leads, you’ll own our test frameworks and the shared quality tooling every team depends on. You’ll also do feature development in production code and internal tooling. You’ll be part of our core quality engineering group, sometimes embedded on one team and sometimes working across several.

You’ll start by taking ownership of our existing automation and making it more reliable and complete, alongside greenfield work on new platform services. We measure this role by what the teams can do because you were there.

How We Work

We code using agents, and nearly 100% of our code is written this way. Generating code is the easy part. Knowing what good looks like, and holding the bar, is the job. The engineers who thrive here are scrutinizing and questioning: they reject AI slop and catch the wrong call before it ships.

Every engineer helps improve how we work instead of only following it. For this role that means building and improving the agentic tooling itself: test generation, review, verification, and the workflows around them.

We are candid and have a low ego. Challenge us on tooling direction, and expect to be challenged back.

What You’ll Do

• Strengthen the current suite. Improve reliability, extend coverage, and modernize patterns. A flaky test is a failing test.

• Own the test frameworks. Unit, integration, and end-to-end, treated with the same care as production code.

• Own the quality gates in CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery). Pipelines, checks, and gates, so standards are enforced by the system and not by people.

• Build agentic quality tooling. Extend the agents and workflows we use for test design, review, and verification.

• Raise the bar through teams. Pair on test design, review code, help make hard-to-reach code testable, and write things down so the practice outlives any one person.

• Ask the testability question early. In planning, ask how we'll test it and how we'll know it broke in production.

• Know when a release is healthy. Metrics, dashboards and alerts that tell us something is wrong before a customer does, and that tell a team whether a release is safe to keep rolling out.

• Ship features. Full-stack work in production code and internal tooling, alongside the teams you support.

What You'll Bring (required)

• 8 or more years of professional software development experience, in any role.

• 5 or more years where building and maintaining test automation was a core part of your job, as an SDET, test automation engineer, or software engineer who owned test infrastructure. Your title matters less than the work.

• You build software, not just tests: test frameworks, internal tools, CI tooling, or product features. You want feature development in production code and internal tooling to be part of your job here.

• Depth across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, including hands-on work with a browser framework such as Playwright or Cypress.

• Hands-on CI ownership: you have created, configured, or fixed a CI pipeline (GitHub Actions or equivalent), not just used one.

• A track record of being the person who drove automated test coverage on a team, whatever your role was.

• Working knowledge of DevOps practice: how code is built, deployed and monitored in production. You have added metrics, dashboards or alerts so a team knew when something broke.

• Daily professional use of AI coding agents, and experience building or improving agentic tooling, not just using it.

• A multiplier mindset: you get your satisfaction from the team shipping safer and faster, not from your own test count.

• Excellent written and spoken English, roughly C1 level, and experience working day to day on an international team.

Nice To Have

• Mobile development (Android or iOS) and mobile test automation, using native frameworks such as Espresso or XCUITest, or cross-platform tools such as Appium or Maestro.

• TypeScript, Node.js, and React.

• Rust, or another statically typed language.

• Clear evidence of driving CI/CD practice for a whole team or company.

• Production canaries and progressive delivery: you have used production signals (error rates, latency, business metrics) to decide whether a release continues or rolls back, through canaries, feature flags or automated rollback.

• Test data and environment management: getting a realistic system into a known state quickly and repeatably.

• Test-driven development (TDD).

• AWS and cloud-native services.

Location and Benefits:

• Remote, open to candidates based in Canada or Latin America.

• The team works on US Pacific Time. You'll need to reliably work a schedule that frequently matches US Pacific business hours (9am to 5pm PT).

• Flexible PTO.

• Laptop and work-from-home setup stipend.

• Monthly technology stipends (internet and AI tooling).

Onfleet is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Onfleet's culture is one that strongly values diversity in its workplace and we are committed to working with potential team members who can bring diverse perspectives and experience to our company and culture.

We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply and we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $70,000 to $95,000 USD per year for candidates in both Canada and Latin America, depending on experience, skills, and background. Where an offer lands within that range reflects the depth and experience a candidate brings to the role.

How We Hire

You need an identity-verified LinkedIn profile to apply. That's the free "Verified" badge, the shield icon next to your name. We check for it, and applications without it don't move forward.

Before any offer, we verify your identity and work history. That includes a live video ID check and reference calls. We use AI, automated systems, and a person to review applications: every application that meets the requirements is also read by an engineering leader or a recruiter. If you misrepresent your identity or experience, the process ends.

Wendt Partners | Remote | Full-Time (Independent Contractor)

Working hours: Daily overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours (required)
