About Wendt Partners
Wendt Partners is a HubSpot Elite Solutions Partner helping B2B companies get more from their CRM, AI and revenue operations. Our whole team works remotely and serves clients across North America, the UK and Europe, and Australia and Asia-Pacific.

Role Overview
We're looking for a Technical Lead who is equal parts backend developer and project manager. You'll write and review code, and you'll run the development team that delivers our HubSpot integrations, migrations and custom builds.

You own delivery from start to finish: planning the work, assigning and confirming hours, keeping the team on schedule, making sure nothing goes live until it has been properly tested, and keeping clients informed in plain language. Our team works in Spanish and English every day, so you'll lead comfortably in both.

What You'll Do
Lead the development team
• Lead a team of developers on HubSpot integrations, migrations and custom builds
• Plan projects, break work into tasks, and assign and confirm hours each week
• Keep delivery on schedule and step in early when someone is blocked or falling behind
• Set coding standards, review pull requests and mentor developers

Build and own the technical work
• Design and build backend services, APIs, and integrations between HubSpot and other systems
• Plan and run data migrations into HubSpot, including mapping, cleanup, validation and cutover
• Work hands-on with the HubSpot APIs, custom objects, webhooks, private apps and custom-code workflows

Own quality and the client relationship
• Run QA on every project: test plans, UAT and sign-off before anything goes live
• Be the technical point of contact for clients and explain progress, risks and decisions clearly
• Keep projects, tasks and time tracked in HubSpot and our project tools

What You Bring
•Years of professional backend development (Node.js, Python, PHP or similar)
• Hands-on experience with HubSpot APIs, integrations or migrations
• Experience leading developers and managing projects end-to-end: planning, estimating, hours, and delivery
• A disciplined QA process. You don't ship untested work.
• Confidence speaking with clients and explaining technical work to non-technical people
• Fluent English
• Based in Latin America, with daily overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours
• HubSpot or project management certifications (PMP, Scrum or similar) are a strong advantage

What Success Looks Like
• Projects go live on time, on budget, and fully tested
• Your team knows its priorities every week, and hours are planned and confirmed
• Clients understand where their project stands without having to chase for updates
• Bugs are caught in QA, not by the client

Why Join Wendt Partners
• Fully remote. Work from anywhere, with a team spread across several countries.
• Paid time off. Company holidays and year-end closure.
• Employee Assistance Program. Confidential financial and mental health support.
• Real leadership. You lead the development team and own delivery from start to finish, instead of being one developer among many.
• HubSpot Elite Solutions Partner. You work on enterprise HubSpot projects with complex integrations, migrations, and custom builds.
• International clients in North America, the UK and Europe, and Australia and Asia-Pacific.
• Continuous learning support. Access to Udemy, plus financial grants for further education where relevant to your role.
• Room to grow. A lean team where strong delivery is noticed and rewarded.

Compensation
Competitive monthly compensation in line with experience.

Interview Process

• Application form and short video introduction

• Technical interview with a senior team member

• Final conversation with our Head of Operations

• Reference checks

How to Apply: Apply through our application form (about 15 minutes; please have your CV ready and record a 3–4 minute video): 👉 https://forms.fillout.com/t/dtnQfWwW7Nus

Wendt Partners is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from every background.

postings.title: ETL Developer
postings.descriptionText:
About the Company

"We are a team of over 200 professionals dedicated to creating innovative tech solutions for businesses. Based in Argentina, we develop platforms used across North America, always aiming to exceed our clients’ expectations.
Our expertise ranges from interface design to complete business software, with a team focused on technical support and quality control. We are guided by six core values that ensure excellence in every project. We’re growing and looking for people like you to join us."

Responsibilities:

As a Data Engineer specialized in ETL, you will play a key role in building and maintaining robust data pipelines that empower our teams to make data-driven decisions. Your responsibilities will include:

• Designing, developing, and testing scalable ETL processes.

• Extracting data from a variety of sources, including relational databases, flat files, APIs, and streaming services.

• Transforming raw datasets into structured, analytics-ready formats.

• Loading processed data into our target data platforms, such as data warehouses or cloud databases.

• Implementing robust error handling, logging, and monitoring mechanisms to ensure reliability and traceability of ETL workflows.

• Continuously optimizing ETL pipelines for performance, leveraging techniques such as query optimization, indexing, and parallel processing.

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and ensure accurate and timely delivery of insights.

Requirements:

• Intermediate or higher level of English (spoken and written).

• Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven ability to work independently in a dynamic, fast-paced, and results-driven environment.

• Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in software development and/or data engineering, with a strong focus on ETL design and implementation.

• Quick learner with a proactive mindset, capable of adapting to new technologies and evolving business needs.

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies is a plus.

Technical Skills:

Experience and proficiency in the following areas is highly valued:

Programming Languages :

• Advanced T-SQL (Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL Database)

• Python

• C# (preferred)

• ETL Tools:

• SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) – advanced level

• Data Visualization & Reporting:

• Power BI (strong plus)

• SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) (plus)

• Cloud Data Services:

• Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, and Databricks (nice to have)

What We Offer
"Join a company with over 20 years of experience, offering a competitive salary in USD and the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in the world.
We provide ongoing training, professional development, and a collaborative work environment. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging, international projects.
Additionally, we offer flexible PTO, extended parental leave, and an attractive hiring bonus."

postings.title: Back End Developer (AI Infrastructure)
postings.descriptionText:
About The Role

What if the code you write could directly power the AI systems shaping how millions of people interact with technology? We're looking for Back End Developers in Buenos Aires to design, build, and optimize the server-side systems and APIs that drive cutting-edge AI products — from data pipelines and model-serving infrastructure to scalable microservices that handle real-world traffic at scale.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. Whether you're a seasoned engineer looking for meaningful project work or a strong developer ready to apply your skills to AI-adjacent infrastructure, this is your chance to build things that matter.

• Organization: Alignerr

• Type: Hourly Contract

• Location: Remote

• Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

• Design, develop, and maintain robust back end services, APIs, and data pipelines

• Build scalable, high-performance server-side architecture to support AI training and inference workloads

• Write clean, well-documented, and testable code following engineering best practices

• Integrate with databases, message queues, cloud services, and third-party APIs

• Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability as usage grows

• Collaborate asynchronously with distributed teams of engineers, researchers, and product leads

• Troubleshoot production issues, conduct code reviews, and contribute to architectural decisions

• Work independently on task-based and project-based assignments on your own schedule

Who You Are

• Proficient in one or more back end languages — Python, Go, Java, Node.js, Rust, or similar

• Solid understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and distributed systems

• Experienced with relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, etc.)

• Comfortable working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

• Familiar with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex systems independently

• Self-motivated, reliable, and effective when working asynchronously without close supervision

• Clear communicator who can document decisions and collaborate across time zones

Nice to Have

• Experience building infrastructure for machine learning or AI systems

• Familiarity with data processing frameworks (Apache Kafka, Spark, Airflow, or similar)

• Background in performance optimization, caching strategies, or high-throughput systems

• Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices

• Experience with serverless architectures or event-driven design patterns

• Contributions to open-source projects or a strong portfolio of personal/professional work

Why Join Us

• Work on cutting-edge AI infrastructure projects alongside leading research labs

• Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work from anywhere

• Freelance autonomy with access to meaningful, technically challenging work

• Build systems at the intersection of software engineering and artificial intelligence

• Collaborate with a global network of talented engineers and researchers

• Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

This is a hands-on architecture and leadership role, working embedded with a global fintech client: you won’t own product models yourself, but you will shape how every model and AI component is trained, deployed, monitored and run in production, enabling Data Science and AI teams to take their work from idea to production in a reliable, observable and compliant way.

You will define and evolve the end-to-end ML platform architecture (data, training, model registry, serving, monitoring and governance) used by multiple squads, and set the standard patterns teams build on: reproducible training pipelines and experiment tracking, model packaging, versioning and promotion flows from dev to production, and online and batch inference with safe rollout strategies such as canary, shadow deployments and rollback. postings.title: Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) -  SQL Server
postings.descriptionText:
Tu Misión

Serás uno de los referentes técnicos en confiabilidad, performance y evolución de nuestra plataforma de SQL Server dentro de la organización. Trabajarás junto al equipo actual liderando la evolución de una plataforma crítica que soporta a aerolíneas alrededor del mundo, impulsando mejoras en arquitectura, performance, confiabilidad y seguridad. No buscamos un administrador de bases de datos tradicional: buscamos un ingeniero que combine un conocimiento profundo de SQL Server con principios de Reliability Engineering, capaz de diseñar soluciones, automatizar operaciones, anticipar riesgos y elevar el nivel técnico de toda la organización.

✅ Tus Responsabilidades Clave

• Ingeniería de Plataforma: Diseñar y evolucionar la plataforma SQL Server sobre AWS RDS, actuar como referente en decisiones de arquitectura de alto impacto, definir estándares de performance, operación y confiabilidad, y liderar iniciativas de modernización.

• Performance Engineering: Resolver problemas complejos de rendimiento, analizar execution plans, waits, bloqueos y concurrencia, diseñar estrategias de indexación/optimización y realizar capacity planning y tuning continuo

• Cloud Database Engineering: Administrar SQL Server Enterprise sobre Amazon RDS, optimizando costos, almacenamiento e IOPS, aprovechando las capacidades administradas de AWS y diseñando estrategias de alta disponibilidad (HA) y Disaster Recovery (DR).

• Reliability & Automation: Automatizar procesos operativos, mejorar la observabilidad y el monitoreo, reducir el riesgo operativo y diseñar procesos resilientes para plataformas críticas.

• Liderazgo Técnico y Mentoring: Compartir conocimiento con el equipo, participar en revisiones de arquitectura, promover buenas prácticas de ingeniería y colaborar codo a codo con Desarrollo, DevOps y Arquitectura.

• Garantía de Operaciones Globales: Asegurar la disponibilidad, performance y escalabilidad continua de la plataforma crítica de datos que soporta las operaciones de aerolíneas en todo el mundo.

• Evolución y Modernización del Core de Datos: Impulsar la confiabilidad y la modernización técnica de la infraestructura, reduciendo riesgos operativos mediante automatización y observabilidad.

• Alta Disponibilidad y Disaster Recovery (HA/DR): Diseño e implementación de estrategias robustas de alta disponibilidad y recuperación ante desastres.

• Performance Engineering: Experiencia avanzada en Performance Tuning, análisis de execution plans, latencias (waits), bloqueos y concurrencia, además de estrategias de indexación, optimización y capacity planning.

• Automatización e Infraestructura como Código: Dominio de PowerShell o Python para la automatización de procesos.

🤝 Soft Skills

• Ownership y Proactividad: Capacidad para tomar la propiedad total de la plataforma, proponer mejoras continuas y cuestionar decisiones técnicas constructivamente sin requerir supervisión constante.

✨ Nice to Have (Deseables)

• Familiaridad con versiones recientes de SQL Server (2019 / 2022).

• Uso avanzado de capacidades administradas en AWS (entornos Multi-AZ y Performance Insights).

• Manejo de herramientas de observabilidad y monitoreo (especialmente Datadog).

• Infraestructura como Código, CI/CD y contenedores (Terraform, Kubernetes).

• Herramientas de versionado de esquema (Flyway, Liquibase o similares).

• Experiencia previa en productos SaaS de alta disponibilidad o en entornos con marcos de cumplimiento estrictos (PCI DSS, ISO 27001).

🎁 Beneficios que ofrecemos

• 15 días hábiles de PTO por año.

• Equipamiento de trabajo

• Posibilidad de trabajar desde otro país por hasta 3 meses, sujeto a políticas de la compañía.

• Programa de referidos con incentivos.

• Participación en eventos y conferencias de tecnología.

• Oportunidades de aprendizaje, mentoring y desarrollo profesional.

postings.title: MLOps Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
About Promtior
Promtior is at the forefront of the Agentic AI revolution, delivering cutting-edge solutions that transform businesses across industries — bridging technology and people to turn AI into a real competitive advantage. Since 2023, we’ve helped organizations boost operational efficiency through tailored Agentic AI solutions, from discovery and development to full implementation, across three core lines: AI Product Delivery (predictive analytics, intelligent automation, AI-driven chatbots, image processing), AI Department as a Service (LATAM-based teams that integrate directly with our clients’ teams), and AI Adoption Consulting (helping companies find and act on AI opportunities across their business).
We’re a team held together by genuine relationships, constant exchange, and shared learning. We believe innovation happens when people feel included and collaborate with purpose, and we aim for professional growth to go hand in hand with personal well-being.

About the Role
We’re looking for an MLOps Engineer to join our Engineering team as the senior technical reference for ML and AI infrastructure. This is a hands-on architecture and leadership role, working embedded with a global fintech client: you won’t own product models yourself, but you will shape how every model and AI component is trained, deployed, monitored and run in production, enabling Data Science and AI teams to take their work from idea to production in a reliable, observable and compliant way.

Key Responsibilities
You will define and evolve the end-to-end ML platform architecture (data, training, model registry, serving, monitoring and governance) used by multiple squads, and set the standard patterns teams build on: reproducible training pipelines and experiment tracking, model packaging, versioning and promotion flows from dev to production, and online and batch inference with safe rollout strategies such as canary, shadow deployments and rollback. You will balance reliability, performance and cost for ML workloads, working closely with SRE, Infrastructure and FinOps.
You will be the go-to reference for complex MLOps questions, reviewing and challenging the design of new models and data pipelines so they meet platform standards and non-functional requirements. You will partner with product squads such as Fraud and Anomaly Detection to establish clear SLAs and SLOs, proper logging, metrics and alerting, and you will strengthen on-call readiness through playbooks, dashboards and incident reviews.
A core part of the role is using agents and AI services to automate as much of MLOps as possible: feature store operations (pipelines, backfills, parity checks, data quality and drift monitoring), training and evaluation pipelines, promotion gates and rollbacks, runbook generation, alert triage and incident enrichment, and cost optimization recommendations. You will define the infrastructure, contracts and guardrails to consume these AI services safely, and contribute to their evaluation, observability and safety (prompts, policies, PII redaction and auditability) together with the AI team.
You will also set technical standards for model and data access control, PII handling, auditability of model changes and deployments, and environment separation, working with InfoSec and Architecture to stay aligned with regulatory requirements while keeping the platform practical for engineers and data scientists. Finally, you will mentor MLOps and Data/ML engineers on system design, reliability, observability and CI/CD for ML, and lead design and architecture reviews that help teams converge on simple, robust solutions.

Required Experience

• Solid experience owning or designing MLOps platforms or ML infrastructure used by multiple teams.

• Strong hands-on experience building and operating production ML workloads on Databricks, including Feature Store (ideally with Unity Catalog), MLflow experiment tracking and model lifecycle management, and batch and real-time model deployment.

• Experience building production-grade ML pipelines: experiment tracking, reproducible training, model registry, CI/CD for models and data pipelines, and online and batch inference at scale.

• Strong background in distributed systems and data/stream processing (Spark, Flink or similar).

• Familiarity with cloud-based ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI or equivalent) and container-based deployments.

• Strong understanding of observability for ML systems: metrics, logs and traces, as well as data and model drift, freshness and quality checks.

• Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating infrastructure and AI/ML trade-offs into business language.

Especially Valued

• Experience rolling out AI assistants inside engineering organizations (code or infra copilots, AI-powered log analysis), including policies and best practices.

• Exposure to LLM and AI infrastructure such as gateways, vector stores and evaluation harnesses.

• Prior experience as Technical Referent, Tech Lead or Architect for platforms or shared services.

• Contributions to internal standards, RFCs, guilds or tech communities.

Benefits

• 20 paid days off per year.

• Hybrid work model.

• Flex Days: monthly team activities.

• Professional development courses.

• Internal clubs (soccer, padel, running, cinema).

Location
Montevideo, Uruguay.
Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Corrientes or Chaco, Argentina.

• · Hybrid work arrangement

About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

• Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.

• Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.

• Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.

• Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.

• Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a Machine Learning Operations Engineer (AI/ML).

• You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

• 3+ years of professional software development experience with Machine Learning and MLOps practices.

• Advanced English is required.

• Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.

• Proven experience deploying Machine Learning and AI models to production environments via APIs or endpoints.

• Practical experience implementing MLOps practices, including model tracking, versioning, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

• Hands-on experience with LLMs or Generative AI concepts and integrations.

• Solid understanding of core infrastructure and systems concepts, including containerization, cloud platforms, and CI/CD workflows.

• Proven experience with Python programming skills for ML development, automation, and production applications.

• Familiarity with ML lifecycle tools like MLflow, or data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, or BigQuery is a plus.

• Experience with agentic workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangChain, or LangGraph is a plus.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• Forensic attention to detail.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.

• Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.

• Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Nice To Have

We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus

• Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity.

• Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.

Work Authorization Requirements

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.

• FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

• Competitive pay.

• 100% remote work.

• The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.

• Continuing education opportunities.

• Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

About Deep.BI
We provide enterprise support and consulting for open-source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks, YugabyteDB, and other emerging technologies. Our customers run mission-critical, high-volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We are a small, world-class expert, remote-first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.

Role Overview
As an Expert YugabyteDB Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production, with an emphasis on supporting YugabyteDB clusters. You will dive deep into query optimization, transaction throughput, schema and sharding design, replication, and HA/DR configuration. Your job is to ensure that large-scale distributed SQL systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.
While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills. Knowledge of DevOps, infrastructure, security, or SRE practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful.

Key Responsibilities

• Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in YugabyteDB and other distributed SQL / OLTP database clusters (transaction contention and conflicts, query regressions, tablet hotspots, replication lag, compaction stalls, connection saturation).

• Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, sharding and indexing strategies, connection pooling, and configs to maximize efficiency under high read and write load. Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE and execution plans on the YSQL (PostgreSQL-compatible) layer.

• Architecture and design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, primary key and sharding design, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches including synchronous replication, xCluster asynchronous replication, read replicas, and geo-distributed deployments.

• Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.

• CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.

• Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.

• Optional / nice-to-have:

• Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation).

• Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements.

• Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.

• Additional PostgreSQL proficiency is a big plus.

• Open-source contributions to yugabyteDB.

• C/C++ skills.

Requirements

• 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting YugabyteDB clusters in larger-scale production (not just querying or application usage; no PoCs).

• Proven experience with query optimization, indexing, schema and sharding design, and transaction throughput tuning.

• Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts ( consistency, Raft consensus, replication, failover, scaling).

• Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups.

• Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics, and SQL (PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred given YugabyteDB's YSQL compatibility).

• Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios).

• Strong English language communication skills , able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing.

• Bonus : Experience with PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, TiDB, Google Spanner, Apache Cassandra, Vitess, or similar distributed SQL / OLTP databases.

• Bonus : Experience with Apache Druid, StarRocks, Clickhouse, Apache Doris or similar distributed SQL / OLAP databases.

• Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).

• Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.

• Bonus: C/C++ Skills

What We Offer

• Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale.

• Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases and communities.

• Competitive salary.

• Support for conference travel and OSS contributions.

• Flexible contract structure (direct employment, via a global payroll partner, or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.

Location and Working Style

• Remote-first. We collaborate online across multiple time zones.

• Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

postings.descriptionText:
StarRocks Expert Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support
Location: Remote (South & Central America, US Working Hours)
Department: Engineering - Open Source Database support
Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering

Role Overview
As a StarRocks Expert Database Engineer (DBE) , you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.

While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful.

Key Responsibilities

• Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)

• Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.

• Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.

• Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.

• CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.

• Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.

• Optional / nice-to-have:

• Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)

• Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements

• Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.

Requirements

• 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs)

• Proven experience with query optimization, indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines.

• Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)

• Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups

• Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL

• Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (i ncident scenarios)

• Strong English language communication skills, able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing

• Bonus : Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases

• Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).

• Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.

About Deep.BI
We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.

What we offer

• Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale.

• Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.

• Competitive salary

• Support for conference travel and OSS contributions

• Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.

Location & working style

• Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.

• Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

postings.title: Head of Engineering
postings.descriptionText:
About Rebill

Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.

The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.

Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.

Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.

Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.

Built locally. Designed to scale globally.

Rebill is backed by leading global investors such as Tiger Global, Y Combinator (W22), Soma Capital and SV Angel, and angels including Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox).

About The Role

You run engineering day to day: delivery, reliability, and the technical bar of everything we ship.

Rebill processes real money across six markets on its own infrastructure. Event-driven microservices on a message bus, Kubernetes across Azure and AWS, infrastructure as code, and smart routing across a different set of local acquirers in every country. Card data lives in an isolated, tokenized environment.

We are AI-native by design. You will push engineering beyond AI-assisted coding into agentic workflows: autonomous coding and review agents, evals, feedback loops, human-in-the-loop controls, observability, and guardrails that let us safely automate more of the SDLC and production operations. The goal is not to use AI more; it is to rethink how a small engineering team can build and operate financial infrastructure.

You will hire and co-lead a small, high-caliber in-house engineering team alongside the CTO, while managing external engineering partners.

This is a hands-on seat. You review pull requests, write code, automate aggressively, and stay close to production. You are intellectually curious and passionate about documenting and sharing what you learn, inside Rebill and with the broader engineering community.

What You Will Own

• Reliability. Uptime, incident response, observability, and the performance of payment routing. When approval rates drop in one market at two in the morning, you are the person who knows why.

• Delivery. The quarterly technical roadmap, release cadence, and the honesty of our dates. Engineering commitments that hold are worth more than ambitious ones that do not.

• Technical bar. Code review standards, testing, on-call, and documentation across a team that is part in-house and part external. Raising the floor is most of the job.

• Time to market. Today every new acquirer and every new payment method is its own integration project. Your job is to turn that into something closer to configuration, so opening a market takes weeks instead of quarters.

• Capacity decisions. What we build in-house, what we keep with partners, and what that costs. You bring the numbers and defend the call.

What We Are Looking For

• 8+ years as a software engineer building payments, banking, or financial infrastructure that moves real money. This is a hard requirement.

• You come from payments: acquiring, processing, ledgers, reconciliation, or a fintech moving real transactional volume. Not a company that happened to charge cards.

• Hands-on. You still write and review code, and you are the person who goes into the incident, not the one who asks for the postmortem.

• You have worked with external engineering partners or agencies and can describe what you did to make that model work.

• Distributed systems in production: event-driven architectures, queues, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code.

• Fluent English and Spanish. Our acquirers, auditors, and merchants do not share one language.

• Based in Buenos Aires, Bogotá, or Miami (hybrid).

• AI tools as part of how you work. Everyone at Rebill uses them daily to move faster.

Nice to have

• Portuguese at a working level for Brazil.

• Prior startup or YC-company experience at a similar stage.

What We Offer

• A senior package matching the seat: competitive base and meaningful equity.

• Direct access to the founders, with no layers in between.

• Ownership of a payments platform that is already in production across six markets, at the point where the decisions you make still shape it.

• Hybrid base in one of this locations: Buenos Aires, Bogotá, or Miami. (sponsorships not available)

How We Hire

An intro conversation, a technical session on a real problem from our platform, and a conversation with the founders. No take-home exercise that we would not pay for. We will tell you what is still open and what is held together with tape. We expect the same candour back.

postings.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month.

• Location: Remote-first (Argentina)

• Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)

• Application Information:

• Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled

• This posting is for a new position.

As An Senior Infrastructure Engineer You Will

• Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP.

• Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on.

• Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments.

• Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate, improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy.

• Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation.

• Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence.

About You

You’ll thrive as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer if you:

• Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.

• Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime.

• Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like.

• Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle.

• Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles.

• Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP.

• Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following:

• Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling.

• Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana

• Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance.

• Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing.

You Are

• Collaborative: You possess a collaborative spirit, thriving when working with both your immediate team and cross-functional partners.

• Strategic thinker: You're a strategic thinker, adept at defining clear business needs and evaluating solutions to make informed build-versus-buy decisions.

• Comfortable with ambiguity: You navigate ambiguous situations with ease, gathering data and making progress even with incomplete information or unclear requirements.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying . Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

Our Core Behaviors

• Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

• Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

• Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.

• Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

• Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.

• Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.

• Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.

• Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

• Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

• Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.

• Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

postings.title: Solutions Architect Lead / Tech Lead
postings.descriptionText:
¿Te apasiona la tecnología, disfrutás de resolver desafíos técnicos complejos y te motiva desarrollar equipos?

¡En Minders te estamos buscando! 🚀

Queremos sumar un/a Solutions Architect Lead / Tech Lead que combine experiencia técnica, liderazgo de personas y una mentalidad hands-on para acompañarnos en nuestro crecimiento en América Latina.

En este rol, vas a liderar y desarrollar nuestro equipo de Solutions Architects, asegurando la calidad técnica de las soluciones que diseñamos e implementamos para nuestros clientes.

Vas a tener la oportunidad de combinar liderazgo de equipos, arquitectura de soluciones y participación activa en proyectos , dentro de una startup dinámica, colaborativa y en constante evolución.

Trabajarás directamente reportando a nuestro Head of Engineering y de manera cercana con los equipos de Sales, Customer Success y Delivery.

🎯 ¿Cuáles serán tus principales desafíos?

• Arquitectura e implementaciones técnicas: Vas a liderar el diseño y participar activamente en la implementación de soluciones tecnológicas, principalmente en plataformas como Amplitude y Braze, asegurando integraciones eficientes, escalables y alineadas con las necesidades de nuestros clientes.

• Liderazgo y desarrollo de personas: Vas a gestionar y acompañar a nuestro equipo de Solutions Architects, brindando feedback continuo, liderando evaluaciones de performance, impulsando planes de desarrollo y promoviendo su autonomía y crecimiento profesional.

• Calidad técnica y mejora continua: Serás responsable de supervisar la calidad técnica de las implementaciones, establecer buenas prácticas e identificar oportunidades para mejorar nuestros procesos y estándares.

• Planificación y organización del equipo: Vas a coordinar prioridades, distribuir responsabilidades y planificar la capacidad del equipo, asegurando el cumplimiento de nuestros compromisos técnicos.

• Referencia técnica y resolución de problemas: Serás un referente técnico-funcional para nuestros equipos, clientes y prospects, participando directamente en la resolución de desafíos técnicos complejos.

• Consultoría estratégica y preventa: Trabajarás junto a Sales y Customer Success, liderando conversaciones técnicas con clientes y prospects, entendiendo sus necesidades y proponiendo soluciones alineadas con sus objetivos de negocio.

🔎 ¿Qué buscamos en vos?

• Más de 5 años de experiencia en arquitectura de soluciones, desarrollo de software, integraciones tecnológicas o implementación de plataformas SaaS.

• Al menos 2 años de experiencia liderando equipos técnicos con reportes directos, incluyendo gestión de performance, feedback y desarrollo de personas.

• Experiencia hands-on en diseño de arquitectura, integraciones y resolución de problemas técnicos complejos.

• Conocimientos sólidos de arquitectura de software, APIs, SDKs y servicios web.

• Experiencia trabajando con bases de datos SQL/NoSQL, ETLs, pipelines de datos y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos.

• Capacidad para traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones técnicas y comunicarlas a diferentes stakeholders.

• Inglés avanzado y dominio de español o portugués.

• Experiencia trabajando directamente con clientes en entornos consultivos.

✨ ¡Sumás puntos si además tenés!

• Experiencia con plataformas de Product Analytics, Customer Engagement o Marketing Technology, especialmente Amplitude y Braze.

• Experiencia en preventa técnica y acompañamiento de clientes enterprise.

• Experiencia en startups o entornos tecnológicos de rápido crecimiento.

• Experiencia liderando equipos distribuidos en diferentes países.

• Formación universitaria en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Ciencias de la Computación o carreras afines.

🎁 ¿Qué ofrecemos en Minders?

Queremos que tengas espacio para crecer, seguir aprendiendo y disfrutar de un buen equilibrio entre tu vida personal y profesional. Por eso, ofrecemos un paquete de compensación competitivo y beneficios pensados para acompañarte dentro y fuera del trabajo. 🚀

• 💵 Compensación competitiva en USD.

• 🏥 Cobertura médica OSDE 310.

• 🌴 Vacaciones: 3 semanas pagas al año, que se convierten en 4 a partir del segundo año.

• 🏢 Modelo híbrido: 2 días por semana en nuestra oficina de Recoleta.

• 📚 Presupuesto de aprendizaje y desarrollo: para seguir creciendo con capacitaciones en idiomas, habilidades técnicas y soft skills.

• 🌎 Work from Anywhere: después de tu primer año, disfrutá de hasta 6 semanas al año trabajando de forma remota desde cualquier parte del mundo.

• 🎂 Birthday Off: tu cumpleaños es para vos, ¡disfrutá de tu día libre!

• 👨‍👩‍👧 Family Day Off: un día libre para celebrar el cumpleaños de tu hijo/a.

Pero… ¿Quiénes somos?

Somos Minders, una consultora especializada en Martech y Growth.

Ayudamos a equipos de producto y marketing a retener usuarios, optimizar experiencias digitales y escalar sus negocios a través de datos, engagement y experimentación.

Somos partners oficiales de Amplitude, Braze y Airbridge en Latinoamérica y trabajamos con algunas de las empresas más innovadoras de la región: Mercado Libre, Rappi, Kavak, Stone, Globoplay, Creditas, Bold, Davivienda, Banco General, entre muchas otras.

Creemos en un enfoque Human to Human: detrás de cada estrategia hay personas con objetivos reales. Por eso diseñamos soluciones pensadas para generar impacto, conexión y resultados sostenibles.

📍 Tenemos oficinas en Buenos Aires, São Paulo, Ciudad de México y Bogotá.

Si te apasiona el crecimiento, aprender y desafiarte, este también puede ser tu lugar.

👉 Conocé más en minders.io

postings.title: Machine Learning Operations Engineer (AI/ML) - Remote - Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

• Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.

• Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.

• Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.

• Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.

• Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Opportunity

Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a Machine Learning Operations Engineer (AI/ML).

• You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis.

What We're Looking For

• 3+ years of professional software development experience with Machine Learning and MLOps practices.

• Advanced English is required.

• Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required.

• Proven experience deploying Machine Learning and AI models to production environments via APIs or endpoints.

• Practical experience implementing MLOps practices, including model tracking, versioning, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

• Hands-on experience with LLMs or Generative AI concepts and integrations.

• Solid understanding of core infrastructure and systems concepts, including containerization, cloud platforms, and CI/CD workflows.

• Proven experience with Python programming skills for ML development, automation, and production applications.

• Familiarity with ML lifecycle tools like MLflow, or data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, or BigQuery is a plus.

• Experience with agentic workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangChain, or LangGraph is a plus.

• Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.

• Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.

• Forensic attention to detail.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.

• Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.

• Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Nice To Have

We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus

• Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity.

• Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.

Work Authorization Requirements

• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis.

• FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future.

What We Offer

• Competitive pay.

• 100% remote work.

• The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.

• Continuing education opportunities.

• Opportunity to grow and expand your career.

Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

postings.title: AI Content Engineer (Remote)
postings.descriptionText:
Build the machine that makes thousands of photoreal AI pieces a month, cheap enough to be a business and good enough to reach millions. You work directly with the founder.

Most AI influencer work is either beautiful stills nobody sees, or slop at volume for accounts that die in a month. We want both: thousands of photoreal pieces a month, cheap enough to be a business, good enough to reach millions. If you would rather build the machine than click generate, read on.

Vertex Marketing Group builds AI creators and makes the content for real ones. Today one good AI video clip costs us a few dollars on hosted tools. Your job is to get that quality for a fraction of the price, then run it at a scale nobody else does. You own the outcome.

What you'll do
• Build and run the content engine: ComfyUI, character LoRAs and video models (Wan, Kling, Seedance) on rented GPUs, producing hundreds of pieces a day across creators
• Drive the cost per piece down until top-tier motion and video costs a fraction of what hosted tools charge
• Engineer characters and formats for reach: test, read the views, kill what does not travel, double down on what does
• Automate it with Claude Code, MCPs and agents: batch runs, quality gates, dashboards, so output scales without adding people
• Get it seen: account setup and operations, multi-account publishing, distribution at scale across many accounts and surfaces

Requirements
• You have built a ComfyUI pipeline with character LoRAs on rented GPUs where one face holds across hundreds of pieces, and you can show it
• You build with Claude Code, MCPs and agent workflows, and you have automated something end to end that runs without you
• You can tell good from hype from brain rot in two seconds and say why: light, skin, hands, head size, sign text, edit style
• You know the cost per piece of the last thing you built, and how you would halve it
• Clear written English at minimum, perfect is better. Based in Europe or Latin America

Big plus: a development, infrastructure or IT architecture background, and experience running many Instagram accounts. We want a nerd about the tech and the content, both.

Compensation
$4,000 to $6,000 per month, full-time, remote. Where you land in the range depends on what you show us. Same rate from day one of the paid test. Reviewed after 6 months.

Why Vertex?
• You own the outcome: your engine, your numbers, your call on what ships
• You work directly with the founder, in a small team of sharp people who are fun to work with
• Our own stack plus paid tools, with the budget to run it
• The mission: become one of the best in the world at this, fast, then package what we build for other agencies
• Fast decisions. You'll know within 48 hours at every stage

postings.descriptionText:
¡En Cocos, creemos que invertir es fácil y para todos!

Por eso, desarrollamos una plataforma 100% digital, simple y segura, que ya usan más de 1 millón de personas.

Nuestra misión es transformar el sistema financiero y democratizar el acceso al mercado de capitales, con soluciones innovadoras y personalizadas, integrando todos los productos financieros en una misma app.

Contamos con un equipo increíble, formado por los mejores profesionales en cada área, siempre poniendo al usuario en el centro de todo.

¡Tenemos una oportunidad para vos! Estamos buscando un/a Engineering Manager para armar, liderar y escalar un equipo de ingeniería. Buscamos a alguien que pueda definir bases técnicas y de equipo para que Cocos siga creciendo. 🧑🏽‍💻

• Aplicar y fomentar el uso de IA en el equipo de forma segura.

postings.title: Solutions Architect
postings.descriptionText:
Possumus is looking for a Solution Architect to join our dynamic team!

Possumus is a leading technology and AI company, specialized in software development and Microsoft Cloud solutions for the Banking, Fintech, and Oil & Gas sectors. We focus on delivering innovative technological solutions that help our clients optimize processes and achieve their business goals.

As a Solution Architect, you will transform complex business and technology challenges into viable, secure, scalable, operable, and economically sustainable solutions. You will act as a trusted advisor to our clients, connecting business needs, technology, pre-sales, and delivery throughout the entire solution lifecycle.

Responsibilities

• Lead discovery workshops, technical assessments, ideation sessions, and solution-definition activities with clients and internal stakeholders.

• Understand clients business objectives, technology environments, processes, constraints, and expected outcomes, identifying both explicit and implicit requirements.

• Design and communicate end-to-end solution architectures aligned with business and functional objectives, clearly documenting principles, assumptions, decisions, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.

• Define and validate functional and non-functional requirements, considering security, identity, integration, data, AI, observability, resilience, availability, scalability, performance, governance, compliance, operations, and cost.

• Translate complex or ambiguous business challenges into clear, actionable, and technically viable solution alternatives and technology roadmaps.

• Act as a trusted technical advisor, communicating complex technology concepts clearly to technical, functional, commercial, and executive audiences.

• Lead the technical solutioning process during pre-sales, contributing to discovery meetings, proposals, RFPs, RFIs, high-level estimations, technical presentations, demonstrations, and proofs of concept.

• Collaborate with Growth, Delivery, Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, Data, AI, Security, and Operations to ensure the feasibility, quality, and sustainability of proposed solutions.

• Support the implementation of approved solutions, preserving architectural consistency and assessing changes that may affect scope, risks, costs, operations, or long-term sustainability.

• Promote architecture principles, standards, reusable patterns, and best practices, contributing to Architecture Reviews and documenting relevant decisions through Architecture Decision Records when applicable.

• Evaluate emerging technologies and their applicability to specific client needs, promoting simple, sustainable, and reusable solutions over unnecessary complexity.

• Share architectural knowledge, mentor technical professionals, and contribute to strengthening Possumus discovery, consulting, pre-sales, and solution architecture capabilities.

Minimum Requirements

• 7+ years of professional experience in technology, including at least 4 years in Solution Architecture, technical consulting, solutioning, or equivalent responsibilities.

postings.title: Detection Engineering
postings.descriptionText:
Why Join AspenView?
At AspenView, we’re more than a nearshore IT partner—we’re a people-first, purpose-driven company that believes great culture drives great outcomes. We’re passionate about connecting talent and technology to deliver measurable value for clients—and meaningful career paths for our people.
Here’s what you can expect:

• Competitive base

• Flexible work model: hybrid, remote, or in-office

• Real growth opportunities and leadership visibility

• Inclusive, respectful culture that blends U.S. innovation with Colombian heart

• A company that listens, invests in you, and celebrates wins together

The Senior Detection Engineer is a hands-on professional responsible for designing, building, testing and tuning the detections that decide which security events become alerts for a 24/7 SOC serving a large US consumer lender. Working on-site from AspenView's secure delivery suites in Bogotá, Medellin or Buenos Aires , you will work across telemetry from CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, Okta, Palo Alto, Proofpoint and AWS flowing through Abstract Security into Elastic. You will be one of two senior detection engineers on the service, reporting to a US-based Detection Engineering Lead you speak with daily. This role calls for real autonomy: you will be expected to take a use case from idea to production without being walked through it.
What you will do:
Detection Development

• Own detection use cases end to end, from threat research and logic to testing against simulated attacks, documentation and release, with client approval for changes that affect alerting.

• Build correlation and multi-stage detections across endpoint, identity, network, email and cloud telemetry, designed around the attack chains a consumer lender actually sees.

• Create custom IOAs in CrowdStrike, custom detections in Microsoft Defender, identity detections on Okta, and AWS control-plane coverage.

Tuning & Data Quality

• Tune the noisiest and weakest rules with evidence, documenting what changed, the effect on the false-positive rate, and proof the rule still catches what it should.

• Fix parsers and data-quality issues when a source routed through Abstract arrives in Elastic incomplete or mis-mapped.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

• Peer review rules with your fellow detection engineer and turn hunt findings and Tier 2 feedback into backlog items.

• Work alongside the threat hunters on the same floor, turning good hunts into production detections.

• Support major incidents when needed by writing emergency detections or sweeping for related activity.

Tools & Technologies:

• SIEM & Detection: Elastic Security (EQL, ES|QL, KQL); Splunk (SPL), Sentinel or Chronicle also relevant.

• Data Pipeline: Abstract Security, or equivalents such as Cribl or Logstash.

• Endpoint, Identity & Cloud: CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, Okta System Log, AWS CloudTrail and GuardDuty.

• Engineering: Git, Python or PowerShell, and MITRE ATT&CK.

• Testing & Automation (Bonus): Sigma, YARA, Atomic Red Team, Caldera and SOAR playbooks.

What you bring:

• Experience: 3+ years writing, testing and tuning detections in production on a SIEM or analytics platform, with rules you can explain and defend. Deep query skills in at least one detection language and the ability to pick up another quickly.

• Technical Depth: Understanding of how attacks show up across endpoint, identity and cloud telemetry, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, plus working knowledge of log pipelines and where data goes missing between source and alert.

• Communication: English at B2 or above, strong enough to defend a rule's logic to a US-based lead and the client's security team.

• Mindset: Autonomous and evidence-driven. You treat detections as code, with Git, peer review and testing before release, and you follow security rules and change control consistently.

• Availability: On-site work in Bogotá or Buenos Aires during US Eastern business hours, with no shift rotation. Access requires identity, criminal background, employment and education checks, repeated periodically.

• Bonus Qualifications: Hands-on Elastic Security (the most valuable extra on this stack); Abstract Security, Cribl or Logstash; CrowdStrike custom IOAs and Defender advanced hunting; financial services experience under SOX or PCI DSS; a background in incident response or threat hunting; and GCDA, GCIA, GCED, SC-200 or Elastic certifications.

postings.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Location: LATAM (remote)

The role

We're hiring a hands-on Senior Site Reliability Engineer to keep FileScience reliable for customers. Some of the hardest failures are quiet ones: a backup stops making progress, finishes with files missing, or reports success when it shouldn't. You'll work with our engineering team to catch these problems, improve monitoring and incident response, and fix reliability issues in production code and infrastructure.

What You Will Do

01 Define how we measure reliability. Set service-level indicators and objectives (SLIs/SLOs) for product availability and backup jobs. Show what we can and cannot yet measure, and use the results to decide what to improve first.

02 Make failures easier to find. Add logs, metrics and traces that identify the affected customer and job. Build useful alerts, reduce noise, and regularly check that monitoring works and alerts reach the right person.

03 Lead incident response. Maintain incident tools, escalation paths and runbooks. Diagnose problems, keep people informed, confirm service has recovered, and follow through on fixes that prevent repeat incidents.

04 Check that backups actually work. Build checks for whether each customer's backups run when expected, capture the expected data and can be restored. Work with product engineers to compare source and backup data and test recovery.

05 Automate recurring operational work and ship reliability fixes. Work with product engineers on safer deployments, growing workloads, queue backlogs and third-party API failures. Test changes before rollout, keep a rollback path where possible and verify the result.

Requirements:

Core Experience

• Hands-on experience keeping production systems reliable after launch, including responding to incidents and improving the systems over time.

• Strong AWS troubleshooting skills across services, networks, containers, storage, queues and databases. You can investigate problems that involve both application code and infrastructure.

• Experience building and maintaining observability, SLOs, useful alerts, runbooks and recovery tests in production.

• Ability to read, debug and change production Python code and build dependable automation. Practical understanding of partial failures, retries, idempotency, concurrency and backpressure.

• Experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD and safe production changes, including testing, rollback and access controls.

• Clear written and spoken English, good organization and independent problem-solving. You can turn incomplete requirements into a practical plan, prioritize your work and communicate progress, risks and decisions.

Nice to have

• Experience with backup, synchronization or data-integrity systems, or data pipelines that run for long periods across many customers.

• OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Sentry or incident-management platforms, or comparable tools.

Our stack

Python and AWS: ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, S3, SQS, DynamoDB, Aurora PostgreSQL and CloudWatch.

How We Work

We work in a fast-paced environment where priorities change and requirements may be incomplete. You will be expected to work autonomously: investigate problems, identify next steps, make sound decisions and drive work forward without waiting for detailed instructions.

Keep the engineering team informed and involve others when their input is needed.

We value practical production experience, sound judgment and seeing work through.

postings.title: Threat Hunting Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Why Join AspenView?
At AspenView, we’re more than a nearshore IT partner—we’re a people-first, purpose-driven company that believes great culture drives great outcomes. We’re passionate about connecting talent and technology to deliver measurable value for clients—and meaningful career paths for our people.
Here’s what you can expect:

• Competitive base

• Flexible work model: hybrid, remote, or in-office

• Real growth opportunities and leadership visibility

• Inclusive, respectful culture that blends U.S. innovation with Colombian heart

• A company that listens, invests in you, and celebrates wins together

We are seeking a Threat Hunter Analyst to join the security operations team of a large US consumer lender in the financial services sector, working on-site from AspenView's secure suite in Bogotá, Medellín or Buenos Aires . You'll design and run hypothesis-driven hunts across endpoint, identity, network, email and AWS telemetry in Elastic, reporting to the on-site Threat Hunting Lead and working closely with Detection Engineering so that every good hunt ends as a working detection. This is a hands-on role for someone who can take raw intelligence and turn it into a hunt without being told how, and who knows what living-off-the-land, credential abuse and lateral movement look like in real logs, not just someone who has triaged alerts from a queue.
What you will do:
Hunt Design & Threat Intelligence

• Build hunts from threat intelligence relevant to US consumer finance, recent incidents and known telemetry gaps

• Turn raw intelligence into testable hypotheses on your own

• Decide which data sources and timeframes will answer each hunt question

• Map attacker tradecraft to MITRE ATT&CK to shape and prioritize hunts

Hunt Execution & Investigation

• Run scheduled and ad hoc hunts across CrowdStrike, Defender, Okta, Palo Alto, Proofpoint and AWS data in Elastic

• Pivot quickly when an initial query surfaces something worth chasing

• Separate real findings from noise

• Escalate live attacker activity to Tier 3 and the Incident Response Lead with the evidence attached

• Run indicator and behaviour sweeps during major incidents to scope how far an attacker reached

Detection Engineering Partnership

• Hand candidate detections to Detection Engineering, written well enough to build from

• Identify logging gaps and document them for remediation

• Make sure your hunts end as production detection rules

Reporting & Knowledge Sharing

• Write clear, reproducible hunt reports covering what was tested, found, ruled out and couldn't be tested

• Walk the client's security team through findings directly, in English

• Document hunts so anyone on the team can rerun them

Tools & Technologies:

• Platforms & Infrastructure: Elastic Security (EQL, ES|QL), Splunk or Microsoft Sentinel (equivalent SIEMs), Palo Alto, Proofpoint

• Security & Threat Intelligence: CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, MITRE ATT&CK, MISP, OpenCTI, Recorded Future, FS-ISAC, malware triage and memory forensics

• Cloud & Data Analysis: AWS (control-plane and cloud telemetry), Okta (identity telemetry), Python, Jupyter

What you bring:

• Experience: 3+ years in threat hunting, Tier 3 investigation or incident response, with hunts you can walk through from hypothesis to outcome, including the ones that found nothing

• Technical Depth: Fluent querying across large data sets in Elastic, Splunk, Sentinel or equivalent, and a strong grasp of living-off-the-land, credential and session abuse, lateral movement and cloud control-plane abuse as they appear in logs

• Consulting / Leadership: Confidence presenting findings straight to a US client's security team, working well with Detection Engineering and IR, and interest in growing into a Threat Hunting Lead, IR Lead or Detection Engineering Lead role

• Mindset: Works independently, stays rigorous and curious, and knows that a hunt proving a control works is a good result

• Language: English at B2 or above

• Location & Schedule: On-site in Bogotá, Medellín or Buenos Aires during US Eastern business hours (no rotating shifts), with occasional call-ins during major incidents

• Security Clearance: Willing to undergo identity, criminal-background, employment and education checks, repeated periodically, and to work in a clean-desk, VDI-only environment

• Clearance: Must pass identity, criminal-background, employment and education checks, repeated periodically.

• Nice to have: Financial-sector threat experience (fraud-motivated intrusion, ransomware, BEC), detection-writing skills, and certifications such as GCTI, GDAT, GCIH, GCFA or eCTHP

postings.title: Technical Product Support Engineer (Remote): AMER
postings.descriptionText:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

About The Role

We're looking for a curious, technically-minded problem solver — not someone to just close tickets.

You'll troubleshoot complex customer issues across voice, messaging, APIs, IoT, and AI products, digging into networking problems, debugging integrations, and analysing logs alongside engineering teams. But this role goes further: we're building an AI-first support model, and as you develop product expertise, you'll help shape it — building bots, automating workflows, and turning repetitive tasks into cron jobs. If you've ever spotted a repetitive task and actually built the fix for it, you'll fit right in. A background in software engineering, networking, or a related technical field (however you got there) is ideal — We care about what you can do, not where you learned it.

What You'll Do

• Troubleshoot: complex customer issues across networking, APIs, and communications products

• Investigate: using tools like Postman, cURL, Wireshark, Linux terminal and our internal tooling

• Collaborate: with customers, vendors, and engineering teams to resolve cases

• Automate: contribute to bot-building and workflow automation

• Document: solutions and improve self-service resources

• Learn: VoIP protocols, internal systems, and new technologies as the role evolves

Your Toolkit

• Troubleshooting: Postman, cURL, Wireshark, sngrep, Linux terminal

• Ticketing and Comms: Zendesk, Slack

• Collaboration: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Meet)

• Automation: n8n, Zapier, OpenClaw (internal AI platform), scripting (Python, Bash, etc.)

• Version Control: GitHub

• Analytics: Metabase, Graylog, Jira

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

• Background in Computer Science, IT, networking, or equivalent hands-on experience

• Networking fundamentals: solid understanding of how the internet works, including DNS, routing, IP addressing, and HTTP/HTTPS

• API experience: comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and tools like Postman or cURL

• Linux terminal proficiency: comfortable navigating filesystems, reading logs, and running commands

• Problem-solving mindset: you dig into issues, ask good questions, and don't give up easily

• Communication skills: you'll need to be highly proficient in English, both written and verbal - owning customer communication and technical documentation from day one

Nice-to-Have

• Familiarity with scripting or programming (Python, Bash, JavaScript, or similar)

• Understanding of AI concepts such as RAG, MCPs, embeddings, and prompt engineering

• Experience using n8n, Zapier, Git/GitHub, or similar

You don’t need to tick every box - if you’re keen to learn that's the box that matters most !

This role operates on AMER timezone, 9am–6pm Monday to Friday

• Improve logging and create automated resolutions based on triggers to avoid future issues.

• Hands-on experience as an IT professional with full stack infrastructure knowledge and experience troubleshooting incidents and production issues.

• Working knowledge of network administration & security (Cisco/Juniper), identity & access management (Active Directory, Azure AD, SAML, OpenID Federation, certificates, and keys), cybersecurity, on-prem & cloud architecture, Windows & Linux OS, performance monitoring, application & database troubleshooting, change management, and API integration.

• Experience supporting critical and major incident response.

• Strong written and verbal communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to convey business and technical information to a diverse audience.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with persistence in resolving difficult issues.

⭐ Nice to Have

• 100% remote.

• Competitive salary in ARS.

• Opportunity to work on global enterprise projects with an international team.
