postings.title: Logistics Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About The Role

Halter is the world’s leading provider of virtual fencing technology, on a mission to make 50% of the world’s land more productive and sustainable. We are building a world-first operating system that is transforming how farmers manage their land and animals. It is ambitious technology - but it only matters if it lands perfectly in the real world.

That is where the Logistics Specialist role comes in.

Every week, new farmers are joining Halter, chomping at the bit to receive their hardware and get started on the journey. Collars, towers, and accessories need to be packed, freight coordinated, and delivered on a rapid timeline. When a deployment runs well, it feels seamless. When it doesn’t, everyone feels it. We are looking for someone to come in and run our dispatch process like a clinic.

You will own the end-to-end flow of hardware going out to new customers. Think of yourself as the air traffic controller of our dispatch operation - directing traffic, clearing bottlenecks, spotting risks early, and keeping everything moving at pace. This role sits at the centre of operations. You will be the person who sees what is happening in real time and makes sure momentum never drops.

Key Responsibilities

• Coordinate and dispatch new hardware orders to producers across Argentina, Uruguay and the wider region

• Work closely with our freight, customs and warehousing partners, holding them accountable to speed and quality

• Manage timelines, track shipments, and proactively solve delivery issues

• Keep our internal teams in South America and Auckland HQ aligned and informed

• Dive into the details when something doesn’t look right

• Continuously improve the dispatch process so it scales cleanly

• Do whatever else it takes to make Halter succeed in South America - this is an early-stage market entry

Who We’re Looking For

We’re casting the net wide. Whether you’re early in your career or have years of logistics experience, we want to hear from you. We’ll match the level to your experience.

At every level, you'll be a great fit if you:

• Naturally take ownership (you don’t wait to be told something is stuck)

• Like running a tight ship and take pride in operational excellence

• Can zoom into the detail without losing sight of the bigger picture

• Are confident holding partners accountable

• Stay calm under pressure and enjoy high-tempo environments

• See problems as puzzles, not blockers

• Are comfortable with ambiguity - this is an early-stage market entry and things will be imperfect

• Speak fluent Spanish and English. English proficiency is a requirement for this role. The recruitment process will include interviews conducted in English, and a significant part of the day-to-day work will also be conducted in English. Candidates should feel comfortable communicating, participating in professional conversations, and working effectively in English. If you are not comfortable having professional conversations in English, this role may not be the right fit for you.

Bonus points for:

• Experience with imports, customs brokers or product approvals in Argentina or Uruguay.

• Experience in a startup, scale-up or agricultural technology business.

• Knowledge of cattle production or rural South America.

Why this role matters

Standards, speed, and getting it right for farmers matter deeply here. When deployment is sharp, disciplined, and thoughtful, everything downstream works better - from customer experience to cash flow to global expansion. If you are excited by the idea of building an operational engine that can scale globally - and being the person at the centre of making it world-class - we would love to hear from you!

There is real scope for this role to grow. As complexity increases, this could evolve into broader ownership across logistics, supply chain optimisation, international freight, inventory strategy, or operational leadership. If you’re ambitious, this is a front-row seat to building something that scales worldwide. This isn’t just about dispatching hardware - it is about building the engine that powers Halter’s global expansion. You will be directly involved in shaping and strengthening a world-class supply chain from the ground up.

You won’t just execute a process - you’ll help design the future state. Maybe you have worked in logistics, supply chain, operations, warehousing, dispatch, or manufacturing. Maybe you have been the person who quietly keeps everything moving behind the scenes. This isn’t a passive coordination role. We are looking for someone with hunger.

Our Office First Approach

There’s a reason you visit your friends in person, live with your family and don’t do dinners over Zoom. Humans are wired for connection. We believe a world-class, in-person office culture is the best way for high-performing teams.

Being office first is a core pillar of our culture. We believe in-person connections are key to driving your own growth, learning, impact, and building genuine long-lasting relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful and aligned work. We don’t like having heaps of rules or policies, but this means having strong, trusted relationships is critical.

We’re office first, not office only. This means working from the office everyday is our default setting, but we flex when we need to. We have a high-trust culture, so everyone is trusted to do what’s best for Halter.

Our office vibe is something special, it’s hard to describe until you’re here, but people at Halter who have come from fully remote or hybrid companies say they could never go back - the high energy and spectacular people they are now surrounded by everyday makes work so enjoyable. Your growth, your learning and your impact is truly unlimited here, and a big part of that comes from being together solving problems, innovating, building context, and constantly learning from each other.

• Please submit your application in English

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

• Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

• Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

• You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

• This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

postings.title: Pasante de EHS
postings.descriptionText:
BAT está evolucionando a gran velocidad hacia un negocio global multicategoría. Nuestro propósito es construir A Better Tomorrow™ creando un mundo sin humo.

Para lograr nuestra ambición, buscamos personas dispuestas a unirse a este viaje. ¡Tomorrow can’t wait , hagámoslo realidad juntos!

British American Tobacco Argentina tiene una oportunidad emocionante como Pasante de EHS en Pilar, Zona Norte, Argentina.

Tus responsabilidades incluirán

• Asistir a los Analistas de EHS con análisis y reportes.

• Realizar evaluaciones de riesgos y peligros.

• Ayudar a los Analistas de EHS a actualizar documentación relacionada con programas e informes técnicos.

• Revisión de compromisos legales.

• Gestión de la agenda de acciones de EHS.

¿Qué buscamos?

• Estudiante universitario activo cursando estudios relacionados con EHS (Licenciatura en Seguridad y Salud, Gestión Ambiental, Ingeniería o Ciencias, etc.).

• Conocimiento general sobre regulaciones de EHS.

• Conocimiento de estrategias preventivas relacionadas con la prevención de riesgos de EHS.

• Manejo del paquete Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowePoint y Outlook)

• Manejo de inglés básico

QUÉ TE OFRECEMOS?

• Ofrecemos un bono por desempeño anual de nuestro mercado (sujeto a elegibilidad)

• Nuestra gama de beneficios varía según el país e incluye diversos planes de salud, iniciativas para conciliación entre el trabajo y la vida personal, apoyo para el transporte y días de vacaciones flexibles con incentivos adicionales

• Tu crecimiento profesional con nosotros no tiene límites; Está impulsado por tus aspiraciones. Únete a BAT y forma parte de un entorno que fomenta el avance interno, donde la progresión de tu carrera no es solo una declaración de intenciones, es una realidad que estamos ansiosos por construir juntos. Aprovecha la oportunidad y toma las riendas de tu desarrollo; Tu próximo capítulo comienza aquí.

• Tendrás acceso a plataformas de aprendizaje online y programas de crecimiento personalizados para nutrir tus habilidades de liderazgo

• Priorizamos la mejora continua dentro de un entorno transformador, lo que nos prepara para el cambio constante.

POR QUÉ UNIRTE A BAT?

Somos una de las pocas empresas nombradas como uno de los Mejores Empleadores Globales por el Instituto “Top Employers”, certificados por ofrecer excelentes condiciones laborales.

La colaboración, la inclusión y la asociación son la base de todo lo que hacemos en BAT. Nuestra finalidad es permitir que cada individuo prospere, independientemente de su género, orientación sexual, estado civil o de pareja, reasignación de género, raza, religión o creencia, color, nacionalidad, origen étnico o nacional, discapacidad, edad, habilidades, experiencia, educación, antecedentes socioeconómicos y profesionales, estado de veterano, perspectivas y formas de pensar. Sabemos que abrazar todo tipo de talento es lo que nos hace más fuertes y mejor preparados para cumplir nuestros objetivos comerciales.

Consideramos las pausas en la carrera profesional como oportunidades, no obstáculos. A través del programa Global Returners, apoyamos a profesionales que buscan reiniciar sus carreras después de una ausencia prolongada en el mercado laboral (por ejemplo, tiempo dedicado al cuidado de la familia, permisos parentales, servicio nacional, sabático y/o inicio de un propio emprendimiento).

Ven, aporta tu diferencia y descubre todas las posibilidades que tenemos para ti en BAT. Obtén más información sobre nuestra cultura y nuestra galardonada experiencia laboral aquí .

Si necesitas ajustes razonables o acuerdos para ayudarte a rendir al máximo durante el proceso de selección, te animamos a que nos lo notifiques. Estamos totalmente comprometidos a apoyarte para que puedas demostrar todo tu potencial.

En Danone no es solo una pasantía. Es el comienzo de todo lo que viene!

postings.descriptionText:
About AllShore Talent

AllShore Talent partners with growing organizations to build high-performing technology and consulting teams. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture.

About The Role

Adobe Workflows, API Integration and Digital Media

AllShore Tallent is seeking a mid-to-senior QA Engineer specializing in creative automation to validate end-to-end creative automation and digital media production workflows. The role spans Airtable intake and status control, AWS orchestration, Adobe Photoshop APIs, and Frame.io review and approval. The current use case focuses on static banners and Photoshop outputs, with motion graphics and video workflows in the pipeline, including one moving into implementation.

The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to tracing distributed workflows, finding edge cases, maintaining state integrity, and verifying data isolation, with a background in digital media workflow engineering, ad-tech production pipelines, creative automation, or cloud-native integration QA.

Key Responsibilities

• Validate asynchronous, event-driven pipelines in which intake actions trigger background state machines and webhooks. Trace the complete flow from Airtable through AWS and Photoshop APIs to Frame.io.

• Verify idempotency, de-duplication, race-condition handling, and queue throttling, including duplicate Frame.io Approved webhooks.

• Test recovery from network interruptions, expired tokens, corrupt or oversized source media, missing manifest keys, and simulated API service limits. Verify circuit breaker thresholds, queue pausing, slot release, and manual or administrator recovery.

• Design deterministic cache lifecycle tests that distinguish reusable asset-level caches (Creative/DMC) from isolated template-level manifests. Confirm that template timestamp changes and asset re-uploads invalidate caches correctly and prevent stale file delivery.

• Reconcile assets, folders, and version stacks. Test URL-encoded filenames, duplicate same-name folder structures, version stack collisions, and protection of active in-progress uploads from deletion.

• Validate AI cropping and graphical transformations across human and non-human subjects in landscape and portrait source files. Assess bounding-box and focal-point detection, identify unnecessary Firefly Generative Expand versus appropriate native cropping, and verify masks preserve native boundaries.

• Inspect typography, font substitutions, leading, multi-line wrapping, bold ranges, safe-zone margins, CTA button bounds, disclaimer visibility, and ratings bug placement across aspect ratios.

• Document reproducible, step-level defects in Jira Cloud with complete asset and log context, and evaluate results against acceptance criteria associated with Epics, Stories, and Bugs.

Required Qualifications And Technical Skills

• QA experience: Mid-to-senior QA engineering experience aligned with digital media workflow engineering, ad-tech production pipelines, creative automation, or cloud-native integration QA. Strong end-to-end troubleshooting, edge-case testing, state integrity, and data isolation skills.

• Airtable: Practical understanding of field types, formulas, automations, and trigger actions. Ability to validate Action = Execute and Automation Status transitions from Pending to Queued to In Progress to Review, Approved, or Finalizing. Experience checking field hygiene, null and fallback values such as NA, Automation Version Stack ID tracking, and Invalidate Asset Cache and Creative Allocation overrides

• Frame.io: Strong practical knowledge of Frame.io as an automated review and approval surface, including version stacking, Approved asset status hooks, share-link generation, and structural validation. Experience with API authentication nuances, including server-to-server (S2S) authentication and workarounds, custom headers, and rate-limiting behavior.

• Adobe Photoshop and imaging APIs: Solid conceptual understanding of artboards, smart objects, layer hierarchies and masks, text layers, typography leading and sizing, and bounds calculation. Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop APIs and smart-object replacement mechanics. Ability to inspect and validate PSD/PSB, JPG, PNG, and GIF outputs, including raster and animated renditions as applicable.

• AWS orchestration and observability: Comfort navigating SQS queues, DynamoDB locking and slot tracking, Step Functions / state machines, Lambda, and S3 asset storage and overwrite behavior. Ability to trace execution logs, correlation IDs, and failure payloads to distinguish upstream intake errors, service timeouts, and circuit breaker trip states.

• Workflow reliability: Experience testing asynchronous and event-driven systems, webhook de-duplication, idempotency, concurrency, throttling, resilience, circuit breakers, layered caching and invalidation, and asset and folder synchronization edge cases.

• Visual quality assurance: Understanding of bounding-box and focal-point detection, native cropping, Firefly Generative Expand, and mask boundaries. A keen eye for digital display production and design standards across multiple output formats and aspect ratios.

• Jira Cloud: Deep comfort working with Epics, Stories, Bugs, acceptance criteria, and detailed, reproducible defect reports supported by assets and logs.

Preferred Skills

• Familiarity with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Motion Graphics templates (MoGRTs), Adobe Media Encoder with particular emphasis on presets, and video codecs, output formats, and resolutions to support upcoming motion graphics and video use cases.

postings.descriptionText:
Arionkoder is an AI consulting firm helping companies build, embed, and own AI systems that drive real business outcomes. We combine Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation to craft digital products and solutions that create lasting impact — guided by a human-centric approach and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what technology can do.

We are looking for a Quality Lead experienced in leading quality efforts - not only for their own testing output, but for the team achieving its quality objectives. This is a hands-on leadership role: you remain a practicing quality engineer, equally comfortable designing manual and exploratory test scenarios as writing and maintaining automated suites in CI, while also setting the quality direction, planning the work, and creating the conditions for others to do their best work.

The QA Lead is the primary quality reference. You define the quality strategy for the products in scope, make or facilitate the key quality decisions, keep visibility over what everyone is working on, surface risks and blockers early, and ensure no significant quality risk stays invisible. You do not need to be the deepest expert in every tool or layer you understand how the pieces fit together and ensure the team's work follows a coherent quality vision.

You bring an AI-first mindset to the craft - using AI tools to accelerate test design, automation, triage, and reporting, with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when not to - and you push that way of working into the team. You also own quality for LLM-powered features (assistants, RAG, agents, etc.) where “pass/fail” is a judgment you have to operationalize through evals: curated datasets, graded criteria, baselines, and regression thresholds.

This is not a role for someone who waits for tickets to be marked "ready for QA", nor for someone who leads only from a spreadsheet. We need a lead who challenges unclear requirements, asks the uncomfortable questions early, coaches others to do the same, and treats production confidence as a team deliverable — measured in fewer surprises in production, faster releases, and a stronger quality culture across the teams you work with.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership and Team Accountability :

• Be accountable for the team achieving its quality objectives - providing direction and fostering ownership, not doing everything yourself.

• Maintain visibility into what each team member is working on, how they are approaching it, and where support is needed.

• Identify blockers, risks, and deviations early, and adjust the quality plan when circumstances change.

• Plan and distribute quality work across the team: scope, sequencing, ownership, and realistic effort estimates.

• Ensure quality decisions are made at the right level with the right people; delegate where possible and resolve issues when the team cannot reach a conclusion.

• Create an environment where team members participate in decisions, challenge ideas, take responsibility, and develop autonomy.

• Evaluate team members against the expectations of their role and seniority; provide actionable feedback and meaningful growth opportunities.

• Improve the team's quality practices, tools, processes, and ways of working by turning experience and feedback into practical changes.

Quality Strategy and Direction

• Establish and communicate a coherent quality vision for the products in scope; ensure individual decisions and implementations fit together.

• Define test strategies based on product risk, release goals, and business impact - not generic checklists.

• Influence quality upstream by reviewing requirements and designs to surface ambiguity, edge cases, and testability issues early.

• Identify non-functional risks (performance, security, accessibility, data integrity) and ensure they are addressed or escalated with clear owners and mitigation plans.

• Define and maintain the team's quality standards: definition of done, bug hygiene, coverage expectations, documentation.

Manual QA and Exploratory Testing

• Run and lead structured exploratory sessions guided by risk and user personas.

• Cover what automation can't yet: complex flows, visual checks, new feature shakedowns, third-party integrations.

• Document findings clearly: reproducible steps, environment, expected vs. actual, severity, impact - and hold the team to the same bar.

• Act as a user advocate during pre-release validation.

Test Case Design and Documentation

• Design and review test cases covering happy paths, edge cases, negative scenarios, role/state transitions, integrations, and relevant non-functional risks.

• Maintain traceability to requirements, acceptance criteria, and product risks.

• Build and maintain smoke tests, regression suites, and release checklists as living, team-owned assets.

Automation QA

• Guide the automation approach: framework, layers, structure, test data, reporting - and contribute to it hands-on.

• Decide what to automate based on stability, ROI, and risk - and what not to; make that reasoning explicit so the team can apply it.

• Keep flakiness under control as a team-level metric, not an individual annoyance.

• Review automation work from others and raise the bar through review and pairing.

Defect Management and Quality Reporting

• Own defect triage and prioritization across the team; keep hygiene clean (title, severity, repro, environment, links).

• Produce concise release quality reports: what was tested, what wasn't, known risks, recommendations.

• Communicate quality status, trade-offs, progress, and risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Surface trends and turn them into actionable improvements.

Release Readiness and Quality Gates

• Own release validation: smoke, regression, environment checks, sign-off criteria.

• Define and enforce quality gates for staging, UAT, and production.

• Coordinate with DevOps on hotfixes, rollback, and post-release monitoring.

• Make confident go/no-go calls backed by evidence, and stand behind them.

AI-Augmented QA

• Use AI tools daily to accelerate test case generation, exploratory charters, automation, defect triage, and reporting.

• Apply judgment to every AI-assisted output - treat AI as a force multiplier, not a shortcut.

• Establish how the team uses AI in quality work: what is accelerated, what is always human-reviewed.

Mandatory

Required Qualifications:

• 7+ years of professional Quality Engineering / QA experience in modern software products, with demonstrable depth in both manual and automation (not one bolted onto the other).

• 2+ years leading a QA effort or a team - owning the quality objective for a product or team, planning and distributing work, unblocking others, and being the quality reference people escalate to. Formal line management is not required; demonstrated leadership accountability is.

• 5+ years designing test cases, test plans, and test strategies for non-trivial systems - covering happy paths, edge cases, negative scenarios, integrations, and non-functional risks.

• 4+ years building and maintaining automated test suites in production-grade CI environments, with hands-on framework decisions and ownership of flakiness, reliability, and reporting.

• Strong experience with at least one modern UI automation tool (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, or equivalent) and at least one API testing approach (Postman, REST clients, or automated API frameworks such as RestAssured, Supertest, Pytest+requests, or similar).

• Working knowledge of test case management tools (Qase, TestRail, Xray, Zephyr, or similar) and bug tracking tools (Jira, Linear, Asana, or similar).

• CI/CD fluency: comfortable wiring automated tests into pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar; understands quality gates, parallelization, and reporting.

• Scripting/programming proficiency in at least one of: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or equivalent — sufficient to write, debug, and refactor automation code without dependency on engineers.

• Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals: risk-based testing, equivalence partitioning, boundary analysis, exploratory testing techniques, regression strategy.

• Strong release readiness mindset: ability to define quality gates, run release validation, and make confident go/no-go calls backed by evidence.

• Planning and estimation: ability to clarify scope, validate assumptions, identify uncertainty, and produce realistic quality plans and estimates with a team.

• Coaching and feedback: ability to evaluate others' work against role expectations and give actionable, direct feedback.

• Stakeholder communication: ability to explain quality status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including clients.

• Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable working in fully remote, distributed teams.

• Senior judgment: ability to operate autonomously, challenge unclear requirements, prioritize by risk, and own outcomes without micromanagement.

• AI-first working style: hands-on, daily use of AI tools (Claude, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate test design, automation, debugging, and documentation with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when not to.

Preferred

• Experience building or scaling a QA function: hiring, onboarding, defining career expectations, or standing up a QA practice from scratch.

• Experience contributing to or building a QA playbook or organization-wide quality standards.

• Experience leading quality in a client-facing or consulting context, where quality status and trade-offs must be defended to an external stakeholder.

• Performance and load testing experience (k6, Locust, JMeter, or similar) and the ability to design realistic load scenarios.

• Security testing awareness: OWASP Top 10, injection patterns, authentication/authorization edge cases.

• SQL for data validation; comfort reading logs and traces to debug failures past the UI layer.

• Familiarity with observability tooling (Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Sentry, or similar) for production quality feedback loops.

• Experience working with enterprise integrations (GitHub, Jira, Slack, Confluence) and validating contract behavior between systems.

postings.title: Video Editor - Remote
postings.descriptionText:
Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired as long as there is activity.

About This Role

Interview language: English

In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Senior Video Editing Quality Assurance Specialist (SME) to review and evaluate AI-generated and human-edited video content, ensuring professional post-production quality, technical accuracy, visual consistency, and adherence to project-specific guidelines. You will assess video outputs for editing quality, pacing, continuity, transitions, color grading, audio synchronization, storytelling, technical specifications, and overall production standards. You will identify editing errors, provide precise written feedback, compare multiple video outputs, and help establish consistent quality expectations across video editing and AI training projects. This role is with a fast-growing AI Data Services company, delivering training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your professional video editing expertise will directly help improve the world’s premier AI models by making their video understanding, editing, and generation capabilities more accurate, consistent, and aligned with professional production standards. Portfolio requirement Mandatory: As a part of selection process, applicants must ready to provide a working link to a professional video demo reel or portfolio that can be accessed by the team. The portfolio should demonstrate professional editing capabilities, preferably including commercial, broadcast, film, television, or advanced digital video projects.

Your profile

• 5+ years of professional video editing experience in film, television, broadcast, advertising, commercial production, digital media, or related post-production environments.

• English proficiency at C1–C2 level to understand complex project guidelines, communicate technical feedback, and provide detailed written evaluations in English.

• Advanced proficiency in at least two non-linear editing (NLE) systems, with Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve strongly preferred. Experience with Avid Media Composer or Final Cut Pro is also valuable.

• Previous experience as a Lead Editor, Senior Video Editor, Post-Production Supervisor, QC Coordinator, or in a comparable quality-focused production role.

• A shareable professional video demo reel or portfolio is mandatory, and must be accessible to the team for evaluation.

• Deep understanding of editing fundamentals, including pacing, continuity, shot selection, narrative structure, transitions, visual composition, and storytelling.

• Strong knowledge of video technical standards, including frame rates, resolutions, codecs, containers, aspect ratios, color spaces, export settings, and broadcast/digital delivery specifications.

• Experience with color correction, color grading, audio editing, synchronization, sound mixing, subtitles, captions, and motion graphics.

• Ability to identify subtle editing defects, including jump cuts, continuity errors, dropped frames, audio drift, inconsistent color, compression artifacts, inappropriate transitions, and technical delivery issues.

• Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail, with the ability to explain why an edit does or does not meet professional standards.

• Experience reviewing other editors' work, providing structured feedback, conducting technical QC, or supervising post-production workflows.

• Reliable, self-directed, and able to maintain consistent quality in an hourly, remote contractor environment across time zones.

• Prior experience with AI-generated video evaluation, AI data training, video annotation, multimedia QA, or rubric-based evaluation is a strong plus.

Key Responsibilities

• Evaluate video editing quality: Review edited and AI-generated video content for pacing, continuity, transitions, storytelling, visual consistency, audio quality, and professional production standards.

• Perform technical quality assurance: Identify frame-rate inconsistencies, dropped frames, codec issues, color mismatches, synchronization problems, compression artifacts, and export-related defects.

• Optimize AI video performance: Evaluate and compare AI-generated video outputs, identifying visual artifacts, temporal inconsistencies, unnatural motion, continuity problems, and editing-quality issues.

• Develop AI training content: Create expert-level editing scenarios, reference examples, quality assessments, and structured feedback that reflect real-world post-production standards.

• Ensure production consistency: Evaluate adherence to creative briefs, editing instructions, style guides, technical specifications, and project-specific rubrics.

• Provide expert feedback: Clearly document video editing errors, explain their impact, and recommend appropriate corrections using professional editing terminology.

• Support quality calibration: Help establish consistent evaluation standards across editors, reviewers, and video quality assessment workflows.

• Maintain professional standards: Ensure reviewed content meets expectations for visual storytelling, technical delivery, audio-visual coherence, and overall production quality.

• 100% remote work.

• The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.

Familiarity with machine translation and post-editing workflows.

Apply through Rex.zone with a resume highlighting robotics programming, cell integration work, commissioning experience, and examples of troubleshooting or cycle-time optimization. postings.descriptionText:
About AllShore Talent

AllShore Talent partners with growing organizations to build high-performing technology and consulting teams. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture.

About The Role

The Principal Program Manager is responsible for executing complex enterprise generative AI implementation programs with discipline, urgency, and measurable results.

This individual will orchestrate multiple integrated workstreams, ensuring that technical implementation, business objectives, governance, organizational readiness, and user adoption remain aligned throughout the program. The Principal Program Manager will establish the operating structure required to move programs forward, proactively address risks and dependencies, and ensure that new capabilities become embedded within the client’s organization.

This is not a traditional project coordination or status-reporting position. The Principal Program Manager must be capable of leading large-scale enterprise software implementations, driving accountability across teams, navigating complex technical and organizational environments, and communicating effectively with senior executives.

The successful candidate will combine strong program-management discipline with an understanding of generative AI, enterprise technology, data, security, governance, and organizational change.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Implementation Leadership

• Lead large-scale enterprise generative AI implementation programs from planning through deployment, adoption, and ongoing optimization.

• Translate business objectives and technical requirements into an integrated implementation strategy, program roadmap, and measurable delivery plan.

• Develop comprehensive adoption plans addressing organizational change, communications, training, skill development, process redesign, and user readiness.

• Establish governance models, decision-making structures, success metrics, and scalable roadmaps for embedding generative AI capabilities throughout client organizations.

• Ensure implementation decisions remain aligned with business outcomes, technical feasibility, security requirements, governance standards, and responsible AI practices.

• Partner with business, technology, data, security, legal, compliance, and change-management leaders to resolve issues and maintain alignment.

• Help clients move from experimentation and isolated use cases to scalable, repeatable, and governed enterprise AI capabilities.

Program Management Excellence

• Lead cross-functional teams of consultants, engineers, architects, data professionals, change-management leaders, and subject matter experts.

• Manage multiple concurrent workstreams while maintaining visibility into integration points, critical dependencies, milestones, risks, and decisions.

• Establish the program structure, execution methodology, documentation standards, controls, and stage gates required for predictable delivery.

• Develop and maintain integrated program plans covering scope, schedule, resources, dependencies, milestones, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.

• Drive accountability across teams by assigning clear ownership, monitoring commitments, escalating obstacles, and ensuring timely resolution.

• Create and operationalize risk-mitigation strategies addressing technical, organizational, data, security, governance, adoption, and delivery challenges.

• Ensure required documentation, approvals, quality controls, and governance checkpoints are completed throughout the implementation.

• Monitor program health and proactively adjust plans based on emerging business needs, technical constraints, implementation findings, and adoption results.

• Identify cross-program conflicts and influence peripheral teams to prioritize work required for successful program delivery.

• Maintain strong delivery discipline while adapting implementation approaches as client needs and technical capabilities evolve.

Governance and Executive Communication

• Establish and facilitate cross-functional and cross-program operating cadences.

• Lead program syncs, workstream reviews, governance meetings, steering committee sessions, and executive business reviews.

• Provide clear visibility into program progress, outcomes, risks, dependencies, decisions, and required leadership actions.

• Create executive-level reporting that connects implementation progress to business value and adoption.

• Facilitate decisions and tradeoff discussions involving scope, timing, risk, resources, technical complexity, and organizational readiness.

• Ensure business and technical stakeholders remain aligned on priorities, responsibilities, decisions, and success criteria.

• Communicate upcoming changes and explain their potential impact on users, business processes, technical teams, and customers.

• Define and report metrics covering delivery performance, implementation quality, risk, adoption, operational readiness, and business outcomes.

Adoption and Organizational Change

• Ensure generative AI capabilities are operationalized and adopted rather than simply deployed.

• Partner with change-management and business leaders to identify impacted roles, processes, skills, and operating models.

• Develop adoption strategies that address stakeholder engagement, communications, training, enablement, feedback, and reinforcement.

• Track adoption and usage metrics, identify barriers, and implement corrective actions.

• Establish feedback loops that allow implementation and adoption strategies to evolve based on user needs and program results.

• Support the development of sustainable governance and operating models that remain effective after implementation.

Required Qualifications

• Ten or more years of progressive program or project management experience.

• At least five years of experience managing complex enterprise software, technology, platform, or digital transformation implementations.

• Demonstrated experience leading large, multi-workstream programs involving business, technology, data, security, governance, and organizational change.

• Strong understanding of artificial intelligence and machine-learning technologies, particularly generative AI applications in enterprise environments.

• Experience managing the implementation, integration, adoption, or scaling of AI-enabled products or capabilities.

• Ability to navigate complex technical architectures, system integrations, data ecosystems, and implementation dependencies.

• Understanding of enterprise considerations involving data quality, security, privacy, governance, performance, responsible AI, and production readiness.

• Experience developing and executing organizational change-management and adoption plans.

• Experience establishing program governance, success metrics, reporting, delivery methodologies, documentation standards, and stage gates.

• Experience leading programs using Scrum@Scale, SAFe, Disciplined Agile, LeSS, or a comparable scaled delivery framework.

• Demonstrated ability to manage concurrent workstreams and proactively resolve cross-team dependencies.

• Experience facilitating steering committees, governance reviews, executive business reviews, and cross-functional program meetings.

• Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate technical progress, risks, decisions, and tradeoffs to non-technical leaders.

• Demonstrated ability to influence teams and stakeholders without direct authority.

• Strong sense of accountability, urgency, organization, and ownership.

• Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience leading enterprise generative AI or agentic AI implementations.

• Experience taking an AI capability from proof of concept through production deployment and enterprise adoption.

• Consulting or professional services experience working directly with large enterprise clients.

• Experience within Adobe, digital experience, creative production, content supply chain, MarTech, or enterprise workflow environments.

• Experience coordinating globally distributed teams and delivery partners.

• Experience managing vendor, platform, and systems-integration dependencies.

• Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI, model evaluation, human-in-the-loop workflows, and production AI operations.

• Relevant program-management or Agile certifications.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means complex implementation programs move forward with urgency, discipline, and clear accountability. Workstreams remain aligned, dependencies and risks are addressed before they affect delivery, executives have reliable visibility into progress, and implementation decisions support measurable business outcomes.

Most importantly, generative AI capabilities must become a sustainable part of how the client operates. Success is measured not only by deployment, but also by adoption, operational readiness, governance, and lasting business value.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About The Role

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today.

What You'll Actually Be Building & Execution

Leadership & Team Excellence

• Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.

• Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.

Technical Strategy & Authority

• Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.

• Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.

Customer & Business Impact

• Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.

• Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.

You're Our Builder Lead If…

• You Have Proven Leadership: 4+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.

• You Bring Advanced Technical Depth: Deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.

• You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.

• You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.

• You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

Nice-to-Haves

• Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.

• Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines.

• Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Our standards are high, and the ownership is total. Role Overview

About Remote

Remote is building the infrastructure that makes global payroll and employment possible for everyone, everywhere. Our team is made up of people who want to own a piece of that work, not just contribute to it. That work happens across six continents, only Antarctica left to go, entirely remote. In this role, you will run the audit execution layer of the EOR Operations Compliance & Audit Program. You own own end-to-end audit delivery a set assigned country portfolio across our EOR Ops domains (Onboarding, Mobility, Lifecycle, and Benefits), coordinate with payroll operations, and act as a peer subject-matter expert alongside Legal and International Operations — resolving domain-level compliance questions directly.

This is an opportunity to help run the compliance and audit function in EOR Operations at Remote. You'll build and own the control library for a portfolio of countries, shape how AI-assisted audit tooling is designed and implemented, and work as a trusted peer to Legal and International Operations on some of our highest-exposure markets. We’re hiring a Sales Manager to lead our remote Sales team.

The team handles inbound property owner inquiries from first contact through onboarding. Technical & Work Requirements

• Ability to work Eastern Time business hours

postings.title: Engineering Engagement Lead (S&P 500 Customer) - LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
Space Inch is looking for an Engineering Engagement Lead to look after our engineers within a long-standing partnership with one of the largest investment managers in the U.S, who is a S&P 500 company . Our engineers work embedded in the client's teams, and the client directs their day-to-day work. Your job is everything around that work: making sure each engineer meets Space Inch's standards, understanding what they're building and why it matters to the client's business, helping them grow, and keeping communication clear between our people and the client.

This is a people, communication, and account role , which means that you won't assign tasks, run sprints, or make architecture decisions. An engineering background is a preference, but it's not a disqualifying criteria. What really matters is an engineer's mindset : you can sit down with an engineer or a client's engineering manager, understand what's being built, and have a real conversation about it.

Our mission, vision, and values

At Space Inch, we prioritize alignment with our clients and team, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs. We are committed to delivering exceptional work while supporting the personal and professional growth of our team members.

Working at Space Inch

• Our remote-first team of around 80+ people is based across the EU (mostly Croatia), the US, and Latin America, with a growing presence in Brazil

• Occasional travel for client visits and company retreats

• This role is embedded within a single long-standing client partnership, though you'll draw on Space Inch's broader engineering community and practices

• We support work/life balance for our team

Requirements

• Experience: 10+ years in engineering and people leadership, engagement or account management, or technical project/product management in an agency, consultancy, nearshore, or client-embedded environment; preferably coming from an engineering background, but not a must

• An engineer's mindset: you understand modern software development (SDLC, common architectures and stacks) well enough to follow what engineers are building, hold your own with client engineering and product managers, and notice when something is off. You don't need to write code

• Real curiosity about the client's business: you invest the time to learn the domain, why each application matters, and what workflow it replaces, so client stakeholders see you as someone who adds value

• A clear system for evaluating people: you can explain how you know someone is doing a great job, using standards, evidence, and feedback from several sources, and how you turn that into specific, actionable coaching

• Exceptional communicator and mediator who handles sensitive topics (compensation, retention, disengagement, underperformance) directly and with care, across written, async, live, and cross-cultural communication

• Proven track record of growing engineers: you've guided engineers along their career paths, from junior to senior and from individual contributor toward leadership, built development plans that led to real promotions, and can point to people who grew under your leadership

• Experience managing senior client stakeholders: gathering honest feedback, managing expectations, and showing the value our people bring

• Practical fluency with AI as a working tool: you can assess whether engineers are using AI well against defined practices and push them to improve

• Experience leading distributed or remote people, including those who work mostly on their own

Key Responsibilities

• Evaluation against our standards: Regularly assess every engineer and project against Space Inch's project success standards, and whether we're meeting both the client's needs and our team members' needs

• Client feedback loop: Work with the client's engineering and product managers to gather feedback on each engineer, including quality of work, taking into account how each client team operates

• Coaching and growth: Run regular 1:1s, give candid feedback, and build development plans that help engineers level up. Work with Engineering Leads, who coach informally, to round out evaluations

• Retention and connection: Keep engineers engaged and connected to Space Inch, especially those working alone on client projects. Spot retention risks early and resolve them

• Coaching and career growth: Run regular 1:1s, give candid feedback, and build development plans tied to Space Inch's career paths. Identify engineers who are ready for the next level, build their promotion cases, and support those moving toward leadership roles. Work with Engineering Leads, who coach informally, to round out evaluations

• Account management: Act as Space Inch's senior point of contact with the client on how our people are doing; manage expectations and help tell the story of the impact of our work

• Facilitating communication: Help engineers navigate shifting priorities, unclear ownership, and unrealistic timelines, and bridge communication gaps between our team and the client

• AI practice: Check that engineers follow the AI practices we define, help them improve, and share what works across the team

Typical challenges you'll be solving

• Understanding a wide range of client applications well enough that client managers take your input seriously

• Keeping engineers who work individually within client teams motivated and connected to Space Inch

• Helping engineers handle a fast-changing client environment: shifting priorities, unclear ownership, and tight deadlines

• Growing engineers' careers when the client directs their daily work, and making their progress visible enough to support promotions

• Turning feedback from engineers, Engineering Leads, and client managers into fair, specific evaluations and coaching

• Raising the bar on how the team uses AI, measured by outcomes rather than adoption for its own sake

Qualities for success

• Strong people instincts: engineers trust your guidance, feel supported in 1:1s, and are honest with you about what isn't working

• Adapts communication style across coaching, difficult conversations, and client discussions

• A systems thinker who builds repeatable ways to evaluate and grow people, and spots broken communication loops before they escalate

• Comfortable making decisions and owning the outcome, even when the first attempt fails

• Calm under client pressure, and doesn't pass that pressure to the team

The role is right for you if

• You lead through trust, conversation, and presence, and you enjoy helping people get better at what they do

• You like learning how a business works and connecting people's work to what the client actually needs

• You enjoy building a clear system for evaluating and developing people, and refining it over time

• You find it rewarding when someone you've coached takes the next step in their career.

• You're comfortable in a setup where the client directs the day-to-day work and your impact comes through people and relationships

The role is not right for you if

• You want to run delivery, assign work, or own a product roadmap

• You want a primarily hands-on engineering role

• You aren't interested in learning the client's business in depth

• You'd rather wait for direction than propose a way forward

What's In It For You

• Work closely with leadership on one of Space Inch's most important client partnerships

• Shape how Space Inch evaluates, develops, and supports engineers in client-embedded work

• Leadership team that values people-first thinking and technical excellence

• Remote-friendly, collaborative, pragmatic culture

Compensation & Benefits

• Monthly salary: 6,500.00-9,000.00 USD for a full-time B2B collaboration, based on experience and skills

• Remote-first setup

• Health & Wellbeing: PTO + 100% paid sick leave + annual health checkup budget

• Stay active: Wellness subsidy

• Continuous Growth: An education budget specifically designed to fuel your learning and help you expand your knowledge base

Space Inch is not responsible for any job boards scraping this ad without showing the position as remote, but Brazil, Peru, Colombia or Argentina exclusive. Applicants from other countries will not be considered.

Space Inch is committed to providing an environment of equal employment opportunity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination. Space Inch believes in treating all employees and applicants with respect and dignity, fostering a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed.

postings.title: Risk & Disputes Intern
postings.descriptionText:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Risk & Disputes Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Risk & Disputes Intern , you will be responsible for analyzing and responding to card and ACH disputes filed against Sezzle. Working closely with our fraud/risk team and our customer disputes team, you will navigate issues on a case by case basis to determine the best course of action to help our customers get unstuck. Analysts will also make recommendations to our management on how to improve and scale our processes.

We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time Monday through Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - Central Time. This will be a paid internship.

What You'll Do:

• Investigate disputed credit card, debit card, and ACH transactions and take suitable action to resolve those disputes within the allowed timeframes.

• Work cross functionally with relevant departments (fraud, disputes) to determine next steps on a case to case basis.

• Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to identify patterns or trends.

• Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis.

• Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our loss prevention mechanisms, processes and tools.

• Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies.

• Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses.

• Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

What We Look For:

• Experience in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment

• Attention to detail and ability to multitask

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

• Strong business judgment and communication skills

• Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

• You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation : The salary for the Risk & Disputes Intern is $800 USD monthly as an independent contractor.

#Full-time

Pay Range

postings.title: Salesforce Administrator
postings.descriptionText:
The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Salesforce Administrator with 2–5 years of experience to help manage and improve our Salesforce environment. You will own day-to-day administration and configuration and partner with stakeholders across the business to shape how Salesforce supports our operations. This is a hybrid role based in Argentina. You'll work within a governed release process and a ticket-driven (Jira) support model, supporting a Manufacturing Cloud–based org (Opportunities, Sales Agreements, and forecasting) in a regulated automotive-semiconductor environment.

What You Will Do

Administration

• User & security management: Manage users, roles, profiles, permission sets, and permission set groups, applying least privilege access with a clear, auditable trail of approvals.

• Declarative configuration: Build and maintain Flows, validation rules, page layouts, record types, custom objects, and custom fields.

• Reporting: Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and list views for business stakeholders, and support downstream reporting/BI needs, including Tableau.

• Data quality: Support data hygiene through imports, deduplication, and mass updates.

• User enablement: Provide end-user support and training and maintain documentation.

• Ticket management: Triage and work the support backlog in Jira (access requests, data corrections, configuration changes, user provisioning, and day-to-day business support), following documented SOPs and keeping an audit-ready record.

• Release & change management: Support the deployment pipeline (changes promoted through developer and QA sandboxes to production using Git and a Salesforce DevOps tool such as Gearset), participate in the formal change-control process (change requests, approvals, communication and rollback plans, and before/after QA evidence), assist with sandbox refreshes, and administer AppExchange/managed packages.

What You Will Need

• 2–5 years of Salesforce administration experience.

• Salesforce Certified Administrator credential (required).

• Familiarity with declarative tools: Flow, validation rules, reports/dashboards, and the security model.

• Familiarity with a Salesforce deployment/DevOps tool (e.g., Gearset) and basic source-control (Git) concepts.

• Comfortable working within a formal change-management and release-approval process.

• Strong attention to detail and a genuine eagerness to learn.

• Good written and verbal communication skills.

• Professional working proficiency in English.

• Based in Argentina and able to work a hybrid schedule from our local office.

Preferred Qualifications

• Progress toward or completion of additional certifications such as Platform App Builder.

• Exposure to Manufacturing Cloud (Sales Agreements, account-based forecasting), Sales Cloud, and/or Service Cloud.

• Basic understanding of development concepts such as Apex and SOQL (a plus, not required).

• Exposure to integration tooling such as MuleSoft.

• Exposure to Salesforce AI (Agentforce, Prompt Builder).

• Experience in manufacturing, semiconductor, or global B2B enterprise environment.

• Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or in progress / equivalent experience.

Why Allegro?

Join Allegro and become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

We foster a culture of Real Innovation , empowering you to push boundaries, develop cutting-edge solutions, and drive continuous improvement.

Your work will create a Real Impact by solving complex real-world challenges that fuel our success and shape the future of technology.

You’ll experience Real Connection , collaborating with talented colleagues around the globe in an environment built on trust, respect, and a shared purpose.

postings.title: VP of Sales
postings.descriptionText:
About Rebill

Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.

The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.

Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.

Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.

Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.

Built locally. Designed to scale globally.

Rebill is backed by leading global investors such as Tiger Global, Y Combinator (W22), Soma Capital and SV Angel, and angels including Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox).

About The Role

You own new cross-border revenue.

Rebill sells to companies that charge consumers in Latin America without holding a legal entity there: software, AI, travel assistance, education, and subscription businesses. The buyer usually sits in the US. The revenue sits in LATAM. You are the person in front of that buyer.

For the first two quarters you close accounts yourself. After that you build the team that closes them at scale. You inherit a live pipeline and a small commercial team, and you report to the co-founders.

We prefer Miami, where one of the founders is based. New York and the Bay Area work too. So do Mexico City, Bogotá and Buenos Aires, if you already sell to US and global companies from there and can be on a plane when a deal needs it.

Why this role exists

Rebill has grown on founder-led sales. That has taken the company further than it should have, and it has reached its limit.

The cross-border product carries materially better unit economics than local processing, and it is the part of the business with the most room in the US market. Nobody at Rebill wakes up every day responsible for opening and closing those accounts. That is the gap this seat closes.

What you will own

New cross-border revenue. Net new revenue from companies collecting in Latin America without a local entity. You carry a number from month one and you are measured on net revenue, not processed volume.

Closing, personally. The first two quarters you are in the deals, not above them. Discovery, pricing, objection handling, and signature.

The sales team. Hiring, ramping, and managing account executives as volume justifies it. You design the comp plan and the quota structure with the founders.

The commercial motion. Qualification criteria, pricing conversations, and the handoff to implementation. Today that lives in the founders' heads. It should live in a process.

Acquirer and partner leverage. Rebill holds direct relationships with acquirers in Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and the United States. You turn those relationships and our partner network into a channel.

What we are looking for

• You come from payments. This is the one requirement we do not flex on. 10+ years selling B2B payments, with a track record in cross-border collection or local acquiring into Latin America or the Americas. We are not going to teach you the industry.

• You have closed merchants, not banks or processors. Our buyer is a CFO, a COO, or a founder at a company that sells to LATAM consumers.

• You have built a sales team from a small base and scaled it. We are looking for someone who took a company from a few million in ARR to a multiple of that, not someone who inherited a running machine.

• Fluent English. You run discovery, negotiate and close in English with a US buyer, wherever you are based. Professional Spanish, Portuguese, or both, enough to hold a technical conversation with a merchant.

• Fluency in the economics: take rate, FX spread, installments, approval rates, chargebacks. You can defend a price without a solutions engineer in the room.

• Based in Miami, New York, the Bay Area, Mexico City, Bogotá or Buenos Aires. Miami is preferred. Wherever you sit, you travel to the US, across LATAM and to industry events.

• AI tools as part of how you work. Everyone at Rebill uses them daily to move faster.

Nice to have

• Time at a regional PSP or inside the LATAM business of a global acquirer.

• Experience selling into travel assistance, education, or subscription businesses.

• Portuguese at a working level for Brazil.

• Prior startup or YC-company experience at a similar stage.

What we offer

• A package weighted toward what you close: base, an aggressive variable tied to the net revenue you generate, and meaningful equity.

• Direct access to the founders and to the product team, with no layers in between.

• Hybrid where we have an office (Miami, Buenos Aires, Bogotá). Remote from the other cities, with regular time in Miami.

How we hire

An intro conversation, a working session on a real account from our pipeline, and a conversation with the founders. We will tell you what is still open. We expect the same candour back.

postings.title: Inspections Coordinator
postings.descriptionText:
You'll own the daily inspection calls and scheduling for a US home-services company, making sure every permit gets closed out on time.

Remote · LATAM · Full-time · Independent Contractor · Early morning US Eastern shift (approximately 6–7 AM to 2–3 PM ET, with some flexibility)

Why this role exists

Our client is a plumbing and construction company in the US. They run a busy appliance installation side, where almost every job needs a permit and an inspection. Inspections happen after the work is done, but they protect the company's license and close out every permit. They also hold up the whole operation if they aren't closed.

There is a large backlog, over 150 inspections at different stages, and hundreds of new inspections and permits come in every week. The owner is building the system from the ground up: a customer booking portal that connects to the technicians' schedule. It will cut about 30 hours a week of back-and-forth with customers. By the time you start, the process will be organized and documented. You'll learn it alongside the owner and then run it.

You'll report directly to the owner. The team (owner, plumbing coordinator, office team) works together in a WhatsApp group. Everyone has their own role, and the work is a cascade: if one step isn't done, the next person can't do theirs. The owner needs someone they can trust to do the job without being chased.

What you'll own
• Call town inspectors within their narrow windows (often one hour, same day, e.g. 7:30–8:30 AM) to book the day's inspections
• Start every day with a checklist of who to call, for which inspection, and at what time
• Plan one or two days ahead so no call window is missed
• Track bookings in the spreadsheet and send booking links to customers
• Tell each inspector which jobs are scheduled and when, and check them off once confirmed
• Keep the owner informed when a stand-in is needed so plumbers aren't double-booked
• Work down the backlog by prioritizing the towns with the most outstanding permits, then close out town by town
• Handle both past inspections (the backlog) and new inspections and permits
• Navigate the rules of around 50 Massachusetts towns, each with its own process
• Tools: Google Sheets, WhatsApp, FieldPulse

Why this is interesting
• You'll learn a system built from scratch with the owner
• A new booking portal will automate much of the customer scheduling
• A small, close team where each role matters and your work is visible
• Autonomy and trust: the owner doesn't want to micromanage
• A real impact on the business, since closed inspections keep the company running

What we're looking for
