postings.title: Commissioning Specialist
postings.descriptionText:
Este puesto es responsable de las pruebas finales y la puesta en marcha de sistemas audiovisuales complejos durante y después de la fase de construcción del proyecto. Asimismo, brindará liderazgo técnico y de gestión en tareas importantes o asignaciones tecnológicas, y establecerá objetivos y planes que permitan cumplir con los objetivos del proyecto.

Trabajará en estrecha colaboración con el Project Manager para proporcionar documentación de los resultados de las pruebas realizadas durante la verificación y puesta en marcha de los sistemas audiovisuales.

QUIÉNES SOMOS

AVI-SPL es un proveedor de soluciones de habilitación digital que transforma la manera en que las personas y la tecnología se conectan, con el objetivo de mejorar las experiencias, generar nuevo valor y permitir que las organizaciones prosperen y crezcan. Somos el mayor proveedor de soluciones tecnológicas para la colaboración, incluidos nuestros servicios gestionados, reconocidos por su excelencia.

Nuestros expertos altamente certificados y líderes en innovación comparten una visión: ayudar a las personas a trabajar de manera más inteligente y vivir mejor. Nuestro éxito comienza con nuestra gente; y un entorno laboral que promueve una cultura de inclusión y pertenencia nos permite crecer y prosperar juntos.

QUÉ HARÁS

Este puesto es responsable de realizar las pruebas finales y la puesta en marcha de sistemas audiovisuales complejos durante y después de la fase de construcción del proyecto. Asimismo, brindará liderazgo técnico y de gestión en tareas importantes o asignaciones tecnológicas, y establecerá objetivos y planes que permitan cumplir con los objetivos del proyecto.

Trabajará en estrecha colaboración con el Project Manager para documentar los resultados de las pruebas de los sistemas y de su puesta en marcha.

Responsabilidades diarias

• Leer e interpretar esquemas electrónicos y planos arquitectónicos.

• Verificar el funcionamiento punto a punto de los sistemas.

• Revisar el alcance del trabajo del proyecto (SOW, Scope of Work) para garantizar la calidad y la integridad de la instalación.

• Probar sistemas integrados y realizar tareas de diagnóstico y resolución de problemas en sistemas AMX/Crestron y DSP.

• Realizar la instalación en campo de programas de control (AMX/Crestron), con capacidad para cargar y descargar programas.

• Escribir código para sistemas DSP (procesamiento digital de señales).

• Realizar modificaciones menores de programación bajo la supervisión de un ingeniero o programador.

• Ajustar y optimizar los sistemas de audio y video para garantizar su máximo rendimiento.

• Configurar dispositivos con direcciones IP para establecer la comunicación dentro de una red.

• Capacitar a los clientes y preparar la documentación final del proyecto, según sea necesario.

• Actuar como enlace con el cliente en ausencia del Project Manager.

• Elaborar, realizar el seguimiento y completar una lista de pendientes del proyecto (Punch List).

• Tener disponibilidad para trasladarse a diferentes lugares de trabajo.

• Realizar otras tareas, asumir responsabilidades y participar en proyectos adicionales según sea necesario para brindar soporte al equipo y a la organización, adaptándose con flexibilidad a las prioridades y los objetivos cambiantes.

Aspectos a tener en cuenta

• AVI-SPL se reserva el derecho de modificar los horarios y el lugar de trabajo según sea necesario. Los horarios pueden variar de acuerdo con los requerimientos del cliente y pueden incluir viajes a distintas ubicaciones para brindar soporte a la cuenta.

• Este puesto se desempeñará generalmente en las instalaciones de los clientes y puede desarrollarse en entornos de trabajo similares a los de una obra en construcción.

QUÉ BUSCAMOS

Requisitos indispensables

• Comunicarse e interactuar de manera profesional y oportuna con los empleados internos, clientes y colegas.

• Contar con habilidades comprobadas de redacción profesional y comercial.

• Tener dominio del uso de equipos de prueba y calibración.

• Brindar soporte durante las pruebas de aceptación del usuario (User Acceptance Testing, UAT).

• Contar con conocimientos de programación básica en AMX/Crestron, incluyendo modificaciones y resolución de problemas.

• Tener capacidad para diagnosticar problemas complejos en los sistemas.

• Poseer conocimientos avanzados sobre el flujo de señales de audio, video y control.

• Comprender los fundamentos de redes IP.

• Tener un nivel avanzado de manejo de PC.

• Contar con habilidades efectivas de comunicación e interacción con empleados, clientes y colegas.

• Tener excelentes capacidades para gestionar múltiples tareas y adaptarse a prioridades cambiantes.

• Ser capaz de trabajar y tomar decisiones de manera independiente, cumpliendo con los plazos establecidos.

• Poseer sólidas habilidades organizativas y una excelente atención al detalle.

• Contar, como mínimo, con título secundario completo o equivalente.

• Tener capacidad para subir y trabajar regularmente en escaleras a alturas de hasta 35 pies (aproximadamente 10,7 metros), así como para levantar y manipular equipos, herramientas y materiales.

Requisitos deseables

• Se valorará contar con formación formal en Electrónica o en un campo relacionado.

• Se valorará contar con un mínimo de cinco años de experiencia en instalaciones audiovisuales (AV).

• Se podrá considerar un título universitario de cuatro años o experiencia militar como alternativa a la experiencia laboral requerida.

• Experiencia con soluciones de videoconferencia empresarial, tanto en hardware como en software, como Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, BlueJeans, Cisco TelePresence, entre otras.

• Se valorará contar con la certificación AVIXA CTS (Certified Technology Specialist), correspondiente a la certificación general de especialista en tecnología audiovisual.

• Experiencia en metodologías de comisionado FAT, SAT, loop checks y gestión de punch list.

🕐 Diagrama 14x7

⏰ Jornada 08 00 a 18 00 hs.

🏭 Industria Oil & Gas

Beneficios

Prepaga para titular y grupo familiar primario.

Nuestra visión

Currently, pay rates for experts range from $20 - $50 USD per hour

Job Description

Creá experiencias de compras que la gente quiere llevar a casa.

Buenos Aires - Don Torcuato

En el Grupo Electrolux, empresa líder global en el mercado de bienes de consumo, buscamos todos los días transformar la vida para mejor para nuestros consumidores, colaboradores, y planeta. Compartimos ideas y perspectivas para, juntos, desarrollar soluciones que entreguen una vida más agradable y sustentable.

Vení, y unite a nosotros como sos, porque creemos que puntos de vista diferentes nos vuelven más fuertes e innovadores. En nuestra comunidad global, con personas en más de cien países, escuchamos unos a otros, y activamente colaboramos y crecemos en la diversidad e inclusión.

¡Unite a nosotros en nuestra increíble misión de construir los hogares del futuro!

Un día típico de trabajo

El Electrolux Group es uno de los más grandes proveedores en el mercado latinoamericano de electrodomésticos (Electrolux y Gafa). Con 7600 empleados y presencia comercial en los países de Latinoamérica (3 plantas en Brasil, 1 planta en Argentina y 1 planta en Chile), tenemos una comprensión sólida de las necesidades e intereses del mercado, que nos permiten crear productos de diseño innovador y significativo, apoyando los consumidores en la construcción de los hogares que desean.

Que vas a hacer:

Actuando como Ingeniera/o de Laboratorio, serás responsable de gestionar y dar seguimiento a las certificaciones y requisitos regulatorios del portafolio de productos, asegurando el cumplimiento normativo en Argentina. Además, coordinarás con organismos certificadores, autoridades, proveedores y áreas internas para garantizar la vigencia de aprobaciones, la correcta documentación técnica y la adaptación a cambios regulatorios que impacten al negocio. Ayudá a Electrolux a continuar transformando la vida para mejor, y vamos a ayudarte a diseñar la carrera de tus sueños.

Algunas responsabilidades serán:

• Gestionar y monitorear las certificaciones del portafolio de productos, asegurando el cumplimiento de los requisitos regulatorios vigentes.

• Coordinar y dar seguimiento a procesos de certificación, renovaciones de certificados, licencias y aprobaciones ante organismos reguladores y laboratorios.

• Administrar la documentación técnica y regulatoria necesaria para la certificación y comercialización de productos.

• Monitorear cambios normativos y regulatorios, evaluando su impacto en el negocio y comunicando actualizaciones a las áreas internas.

• Trabajar en conjunto con áreas de I+D, Calidad, Supply Chain, Marketing, Product Line y Operaciones para garantizar la conformidad regulatoria durante todo el ciclo de vida de los productos.

Quien sos vos:

Requisitos:

• Estudiante avanzado o graduado de Ingeniería Eléctrica, Electrónica, Mecánica, Industrial, Producción o carreras afines.

• Conocimientos básicos en regulaciones técnicas, certificación de productos y evaluación de la conformidad.

• Comprensión del proceso regulatorio argentino y capacidad para interpretar requisitos técnicos y normativos.

• Manejo intermedio de Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel y PowerPoint.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio o avanzado.

Donde vas a estar:

Vas a actuar en el Centro de Distribución de Buenos Aires, centro de las operaciones logísticas en la región. Localizado en Don Torcuato, en el área metropolitana de Buenos Aires, es el lugar de trabajo de equipos centrados en la entrega de experiencias extraordinarias a los consumidores.

Para seguir nuestro compromiso de crear una cultura de inclusión y cuidado del bienestar de las personas, ofrecemos estos beneficios:

• Compra de productos Electrolux con precios preferenciales;

• Obra social OSDE para vos y tus familiares directos;

• Crédito mensual para utilizar en máquinas expendedoras;

• Licencia paternidad extendida de 4 semanas;

• Participación en nuestro programa de Referidos;

• Numerosas oportunidades de aprendizaje y flexibilidad en tu trayectoria profesional.

Como parte del Electrolux Group, vamos a invertir continuamente en vos y en tu desarrollo. No existen barreras que indiquen a dónde puede llevarte tu carrera.

postings.title: SSr. Nuclear Instrumentation Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Sobre Meitner Energy
La misión de Meitner Energy es transformar el panorama energético global mediante soluciones nucleares limpias, sostenibles y escalables. Estamos comprometidos con redefinir cómo el mundo alimenta a la industria y al comercio para liderar la transición hacia un futuro más limpio.
En el centro de nuestro trabajo está el ACR300: un reactor modular pequeño (SMR) Gen III+ de 300 MWe diseñado para tener impacto a escala de red desde el primer día. Construido sobre tecnología probada de agua liviana con innovación dirigida y orientada a la ejecución, el ACR300 ofrece desempeño de carga base de alta utilización, independiente de las condiciones climáticas o las limitaciones de almacenamiento. Es el único SMR diseñado para ser a la vez escalable y rentable, con la menor carga de construcción física por megavatio entre los SMR de escala de red.
Nuestro equipo de clase mundial está basado en Argentina, los Estados Unidos y el Reino Unido, trabajando juntos hacia una sola meta: electrificación a escala, comenzando en 2030.

La Oportunidad
Como SSr. Nuclear Instrumentation Engineer, vas a desarrollar e implementar la ingeniería de los sistemas de instrumentación nuclear (incore y excore) del proyecto ACR300, en el alcance de ingeniería básica y contratación de provisión, asegurando la calidad técnica y el cumplimiento de los requisitos normativos internacionales y de la autoridad regulatoria nuclear nacional (ARN).
Este rol es clave para Meitner en este momento porque la instrumentación nuclear es lo que efectivamente permite ver el núcleo: medir flujo neutrónico, potencia y comportamiento del reactor. Tu trabajo hoy define qué tecnologías se seleccionan, qué equipos se califican y qué instrumentación llega a la planta.
Este rol es ideal para alguien que:

• Cree que la energía nuclear es esencial para un futuro energético limpio y se toma la seguridad nuclear como parte central del trabajo.

• Disfruta del trabajo con detectores neutrónicos, calificación de equipos y normativa técnica nuclear.

• Tiene capacidad analítica, atención al detalle y foco en entornos de alta criticidad.

• Quiere crecer en una empresa donde sus decisiones técnicas efectivamente definen la instrumentación nuclear del reactor.

Lo que harás
Ingeniería Básica y Gestión de Requisitos

• Desarrollar y revisar documentos de ingeniería básica de los sistemas de instrumentación nuclear incore y excore (bases de diseño, especificaciones funcionales, arquitectura de sistemas, listas de señales, diagramas funcionales).

• Definir y gestionar los requisitos de los sistemas de instrumentación nuclear según normativa aplicable (IEEE 323, 344, 603, IAEA, ARN), asegurando su trazabilidad desde las bases de diseño hasta la verificación.

• Evaluar tecnologías y componentes aplicables: detectores de neutrones (incore y excore), electrónica de proceso, cableado resistente a radiación, calificación sísmica y ambiental.

Coordinación Interdisciplinaria y V&V

• Coordinar con otras disciplinas (I&C, Process, Nuclear, Mechanical, Electrical, Nuclear Safety) para la integración de la instrumentación nuclear en el diseño global de la planta.

• Participar en revisiones de diseño y actividades de V&V vinculadas a la instrumentación nuclear.

Contratación y Gestión de Proveedores

• Elaborar especificaciones técnicas para la contratación de ingeniería y suministro de equipos de instrumentación nuclear, incluyendo requisitos de calificación y ensayos.

• Revisar y comentar documentación técnica de proveedores: ingeniería de detalle, calificación de equipos, ensayos y certificaciones; participar en evaluaciones técnicas de ofertas.

Seguimiento del Proyecto y Mejora Continua

• Colaborar con el Jefe de División en el seguimiento del avance de los entregables, identificando desvíos respecto al cronograma y proponiendo acciones correctivas.

• Identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos de diseño y verificación del área, proponiendo y documentando lecciones aprendidas y buenas prácticas.

Lo que buscamos
Aspectos innegociables
Orientación a la Seguridad Nuclear y Rigurosidad Técnica

• Orientación a la seguridad nuclear y cultura de seguridad.

• Capacidad analítica y atención al detalle en entornos de alta criticidad.

• Capacidad de estructurar soluciones técnicas en entornos normativos complejos.

Comunicación y Trabajo en Equipo

• Comunicación efectiva oral y escrita, en particular en la elaboración de documentos técnicos.

• Trabajo en equipo multidisciplinario con Engineering (Process, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, I&C), Nuclear Safety y Licensing.

Organización y Adaptabilidad

• Organización y cumplimiento de plazos en proyectos con hitos regulatorios.

• Adaptabilidad ante requisitos cambiantes en proyectos de largo plazo.

Requisitos

• Graduado/a universitario en Ingeniería Nuclear, Electrónica, Electromecánica o carreras afines.

• Experiencia de 3 a 8 años en industria nuclear, energía, oil & gas o procesos industriales.

• Inglés avanzado (lectura de normas y documentación técnica).

• Manejo del paquete Microsoft Office.

• Conocimiento de normativa de instrumentación nuclear (IEEE 323, 344, 603, IAEA).

• Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional.

Calificaciones valoradas

• Manejo de CAD.

• Experiencia en calificación de equipos para entornos radiactivos.

¿Por qué unirte a Meitner Energy?
Una misión que importa. Vas a ayudar a poner en línea energía nuclear limpia y escalable, no como una promesa futura, sino como un plan ejecutable que arranca en 2030. El trabajo que hagas acá acelera directamente la transición energética global.
Ownership real. Meitner es lo suficientemente chica como para que tus decisiones moldeen visiblemente la empresa, y lo suficientemente ambiciosa como para que esas decisiones importen. Contratamos personas que quieren ser dueñas de los resultados, no solo de tareas.
Equipo de clase mundial en tres continentes. Vas a trabajar con ingenieros, operadores y constructores en Argentina, EE. UU. y el Reino Unido, con experiencia profunda en lo nuclear, lo industrial y la ejecución.
Ejecución por encima del hype. El ACR300 está construido sobre tecnología probada de agua liviana con innovación dirigida, porque desplegar energía limpia a escala es un problema de ejecución, no un experimento científico. Valoramos el rigor, el criterio y el seguimiento.

Para postularte
Si estás listo/a para sumarte a nuestro equipo, enviá tu CV a hiring@meitner.energy con el nombre del rol en el asunto.

The Position
The Tableau Administrator & System Lead Delegate is responsible for overseeing the administration and management of BI’s Global Tableau Server and Tableau Cloud environments. This role ensures the integrity, availability, and performance of Tableau systems, acting as a technical lead/ delegate for all Tableau-related operations and projects. The position requires deep expertise in Tableau, leadership skills, and the ability to collaborate with IT teams, business analysts, and data users across the organization.

Tasks and responsibilities

• System Administration: Manage Tableau Server / Cloud infrastructure, including installation, upgrades, configuration, and monitoring.

• User Management: Administer user access, permissions, and group policies; onboard new users / projects and provide technical support.

• Performance Optimization: Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure optimal operation and reliability.

• Security & Compliance: Implement and maintain security protocols, ensure compliance with data governance policies, and manage authentication/integration with enterprise systems.

• Backup & Recovery: Develop and oversee backup procedures, disaster recovery plans, and restoration processes for Tableau environments.

• Technical Expertise: Support Tableau system operations and leads by applying best practices, collaborating with administrators, mentoring 2nd level support team, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

• Collaboration & Support: Work closely with data analysts, business intelligence teams, and stakeholders to enable effective data visualization and reporting solutions.

• Documentation: Maintain accurate and up‑to‑date system documentation for general operational needs and GxP compliance, including configurations, procedures, and validation evidence, ensuring version control and audit readiness.

• Capacity Planning: Forecast usage trends and plan for system scaling, upgrades, and resource allocation.

• Incident & Change Management: Manage incident response and change requests related to Tableau systems.

• Training & Knowledge Sharing: Provide training and guidance to users and teams on Tableau best practices and capabilities. Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams.

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

• 3+ years of experience administering Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud.

• 3+ years of experience with Tableau Desktop.

• Strong understanding of database systems, networking, and security concepts.

• Experience with scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell) and automation tools.

• Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

• Background with AWS.

• Background with GxP system is preferred.

• Professional English level.

Key Competencies

• Technical expertise in Tableau and related Business Intelligence technologies.

• User oriented.

• Problem-solving and critical thinking.

• Attention to detail and process orientation.

• Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills.

Our Company

Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,300 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com.

Why Boehringer Ingelheim?

postings.title: Customer Support Engineer - Santa Fe
postings.descriptionText:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
The Support Engineer is a key driver within the Solutions and Services department, dedicated to ensuring seamless system performance and superior customer outcomes. This department is responsible for delivering high-impact implementation and post-implementation services that align with contractual excellence and market-leading best practices.

Job Description

Este rol debe garantizar la disponibilidad absoluta y el rendimiento óptimo de los sistemas de misión crítica en la Provincia de Santa Fe (específicamente la red de radio TETRA y el sistema de despacho 911 CAD). La persona actuará como el ancla técnica en terreno y el nexo clave entre el Integrador, el cliente y los equipos de soporte de Motorola, responsabilizándose del ciclo de vida del producto, la administración de la infraestructura de servidores/redes y sirviendo como el principal punto de escalación ante incidentes graves.

Misión Principal del Rol: P roteger y asegurar la operatividad continua de herramientas de comunicación que salvan vidas (red TETRA y 911). Su enfoque está en traducir requerimientos complejos del cliente en una ejecución técnica impecable, auditando implementaciones de hardware y software junto a ingenieros de TI y RF bajo los más altos estándares de confiabilidad contractual.

Funciones y Responsabilidades

• Confiabilidad del Sistema y Ciclo de Vida: Asumir la propiedad técnica del ciclo de vida del sistema TETRA. Asegurar la estabilidad de los subsistemas del Core de TI mediante ajustes proactivos de configuración y pruebas rigurosas de aceptación de actualizaciones.

• Interfaz Técnica con el Cliente: Actuar como Experto en la Materia (SME) para las contrapartes técnicas del cliente y proveedores, apoyando las activaciones y manteniendo registros de datos precisos para garantizar la transparencia operativa.

• Dominio de Infraestructura: Mantener un entorno de alta disponibilidad gestionando plataformas de Redes, Firewalls, Servidores, WAN, LAN y PCs.

• Monitoreo y Escalación: Establecer pautas de alto rendimiento para optimizar la salud de la solución, monitorear la red y actuar como el primer punto de escalación técnica, derivando problemas a los proveedores cuando sea necesario para una resolución rápida.

Basic Requirements

• ONSITE - Santa Fe o Rosario

• Formación: Grado Universitario/Licenciatura en Ingeniería (Electrónica, Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas o afín).

• Experiencia: Desde 5 años de experiencia relevante en soporte de TI o Telecomunicaciones.

• Ubicación: Vivir en Rosario de preferencia o en Ciudad de Santa Fe (para cobertura de la provincia de Santa Fe).

• Conocimientos Técnicos Requeridos:

• Sólidos conocimientos en Redes (Networking) y alta capacidad de diagnóstico (Troubleshooting).

• Administración de Servidores: Windows Server y Linux.

• Experiencia en plataformas de monitoreo de red (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds, Federos).

• Habilidades básicas en administración de Bases de Datos: SQL Server y SSRS.

• Experiencia con herramientas de gestión ITSM (ServiceNow, iTOP, Remedy).

• Deseable: Experiencia administrando Microsoft CRM, Antivirus, soluciones de Backup y conocimientos en VMWare o Microsoft.

Requisitos Operativos

• Inglés Intermedio: lecto-escritura.

• Registro de conducir vigente.

• Disponibilidad para trabajar en esquema presencial 5x2 con un sistema de guardia/retén rotativo 24/7 (on-call).

• Disponibilidad para realizar horas extras cuando el servicio de misión crítica lo requiera.

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

You assist other teams by triaging escalated issues and then working with all the involved parties until they are resolved. • Experience with Linux, Open Source tools and shell scripting.

• Experience with containers and automation/orchestration tools such as Docker, Ansible, Jenkins, Kubernetes.

• Familiarity with programming in Python, Elixir or Go are a plus.

Job Description

Job responsibilities

• Operate and support on and off‑prem No-SQL products like MongoDB, Graph and Cache Db products across dev/QA/production, performing incident triage, root‑cause analysis, and recovery for member failures, region issues, and client connectivity, with end‑to‑end monitoring and appropriate escalation paths.

• Manage capacity and performance on physical/VM infrastructure:

• Execute controlled rolling upgrades, patching, and configuration changes via on‑prem change management; validate in lower environments, plan maintenance windows, and deliver zero/low‑downtime outcomes using conventional approaches to break down technical problems and drive remediation.

• Monitor cluster health using on‑prem observability stacks (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana): build dashboards and alerts.

• Maintain KBs/runbooks; coordinate with platform, network, storage, and vendor teams for hardware/network incidents, patch validation, and cross‑platform architecture changes to modernize processes and resolve issues of moderate complexity .

• Apply Linux and networking fundamentals (TCP, DNS, load balancing) and container/orchestration basics (e.g., Kubernetes) where applicable; leverage automation and scripting to scale operations and improve resiliency .

• Add to a team culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and respect; be accountable for significant decisions across projects spanning multiple technologies and applications .

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• Formal training or certification in Infrastructure Engineering concepts and 6+ years applied experience operating distributed infrastructure in production environments; strong problem‑solving across projects of moderate scope .

• Extensive experience on N0-SQL products like MongoDB where one should know architecture , backup and recovery , exposure to performance troubleshooting. Working experience on Shards is plus.

• Production experience with Valkey/Redis (cluster mode, replication, persistence via RDB/AOF); capacity and performance management for low‑latency use cases .

• Strong Linux and networking skills, including tuning OS/network parameters (file descriptors, TCP keepalive, MTU, buffers) and understanding DNS and load balancing in enterprise environments .

• Experience designing dashboards/alerts in Splunk/Dynatrace or equivalent for JVM/GC, heap/off‑heap, queue depth, client connections, and WAN metrics; ability to partner across application and infrastructure teams to identify capacity risks and govern remediation .

• Foundational understanding of containers and orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes) is sufficient to operate cache services interacting with containerized clients and platform tooling .

• Experience tuning Linux parameters for performance.

• Exposure to microservices architectures and REST APIs used by cache clients; understanding of authentication and data structures for secure, efficient cache access patterns.

• Experience automating and managing database tasks using Python and API framework

• Experience in developing and using AI skills/agents

Additional Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Preferred experience with one or more of the following technologies is desired; see product areas below.

• TigerGraph: Production operations for TigerGraph clusters including schema design and GSQL optimization; controlled patching/rolling upgrades; monitoring and capacity management via enterprise observability; on‑call incident response, root‑cause analysis, and tuning for low‑latency SLAs.

• Gemfire : Administer Cache products like Gemfire/Valkey.

• MongoDB Atlas: Operate Atlas clusters with right‑sizing and autoscaling policies, multi‑region/global configurations, and maintenance within change controls; configure security and networking (private endpoints/peering, RBAC, API governance, encryption); implement cost/capacity guardrails; manage snapshots and point‑in‑time restore with periodic DR testing.

Morgan and Chase brands. We offer a competitive total rewards package, including base salary determined by role, experience, skill set, and location; eligible roles may receive commission‑based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation. Benefits and programs include comprehensive health care, on‑site health and wellness centers, retirement savings, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, and financial coaching, subject to eligibility .

Additional details on total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute and provide reasonable accommodations for religious practices and disability needs. High Risk Roles may be subject to enhanced pre‑hire screening, including criminal and credit background checks as permitted by law, to be completed prior to employment or assignment .

Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

postings.title: IT Operations Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Title: IT Operations Analyst

Hiring Manager: Dave Bergen

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated IT Operations Analyst who is best in class, with a high IQ and a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with strong prospects for continued growth and increased ownership.

You will be an integral part of the IT Operations team as we continue to grow our presence in Colombia. As Colombia's IT Operations point of contact, you will be accountable for local device inventory management, Google Workspace administration, MDM implementation, and ongoing maintenance. Most importantly, you will provide our end users the highest level of IT Support.

Due to the requirements of the position, only English resumes will be accepted.

Compensation

The compensation range for the role is $2,000 - $2,600 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. Specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on factors such as education, experience, qualifications, and alignment with market data. Exceptional candidates may receive salaries outside of the posted ranges.

What You'll Do:

• Be the one of the main points of contact for device inventory procurement, deployment, physical security, and management for employees in Colombia, including macOS and Windows OS-based devices.

• Respond promptly to incoming ITSD tickets in Jira, working on the issue from inception to completion.

• Contribute to working down assigned items in our existing Jira backlog of initiative-based elements as we work to continue to be a more proactive IT Operations team.

• Maintain a high level of technical change awareness regarding our large application stack and be well-versed in IT Security. You should possess the ability and confidence to convey this information accurately to the larger engineering team and, in some cases, the organization as a whole.

• Obtain and provision hardware and software requests as assigned. This position requires on-call responsibilities and occasional after-hours work.

• Conduct IT Operations onboarding training for organization new hires, as well as processing IT-focused employee termination responsibilities

• Contribute to existing and future IT audit work on access control history and quarterly software vendor audits.

What We Look For:

• Applicants must be fluent in English.

• Experience between 2 -6 years

• Has a team-oriented mindset, sharing the workload but also being willing to step up when resources are minimized. Our ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who shows patience and a willingness to learn.

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

• Systems and skills knowledge should include a high aptitude in cloud-based productivity suite administration, macOS device management and configuration using enterprise tools, IT service management platforms with experience in ticket automation and workflow design, enterprise Windows device management using third-party solutions, productivity software suite administration, and management of enterprise endpoint security platforms.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

• Possess the ability to be a self-starter:

• Identify a problem.

• Assess the situation and any variables

• Work quickly and accurately to resolve the problem

• Identify areas where processes can be improved to reduce the reoccurrence of existing problems

• Take the initiative and work autonomously to implement the improvement.

• Ability to react to a rapidly changing organization with a true start-up mentality.

• Experience and comfort working on an agile team – an ideal candidate should be familiar with agile concepts, including Jira ticketing classification, pointing, and meeting workflows.

• Possess a high level of organization with the ability to document workflows accurately and in a manner that can be replicated. Change management is critical to the success of our IT Operations team for both auditing purposes and process improvement. Our ideal candidate would have experience and comfort in bringing these skills to Sezzle.

• Experience working with PCI-DSS, SOC 2 Type 2, and CIS controls; specifically in implementation, documentation, administration, and continued adherence to these controls.

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

• You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

#Full-time

This role is ideal for someone who sees IT operations as a strategic enabler of engineering velocity rather than just a support function. You will be based in our Union Square office, collaborating closely with colleagues in person and remotely across San Francisco, London, and Buenos Aires.

What you’ll do

• Triage and resolve technical issues with a focus on automation and continuous improvement

• Trace root causes across complex, multi-system failures, including Google Workspace, MDM, and AWS

• Build runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and documentation that elevate team capabilities

• Identify patterns in recurring issues and implement systematic fixes

• Analyze downstream impacts before making changes and understand the blast radius of identity and access management decisions

• Lead projects that address operational pain points such as device provisioning, access control, and compliance automation

• Design self-service solutions that empower engineers to move faster

• Translate technical issues for stakeholders across Engineering, People Ops, and Finance

• Partner with security to implement and maintain compliance controls

• Support rapid hiring by streamlining onboarding and provisioning processes

• Mentor future IT team members on troubleshooting methodology and systems thinking

Who you are

• 2 or more years of experience in IT operations or technical support, ideally supporting engineering teams in high-growth SaaS or AI companies

• Systems thinker who naturally traces dependencies and asks why something broke, not just how to fix it

• Strong incident management skills including triage, root-cause analysis, and pattern recognition

• Experience with identity management, single sign-on, and access control with Okta

• Clear communicator who can explain complex technical issues to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

• Self-directed with strong judgment on when to escalate versus resolve independently

• Motivated by building the operational foundation for a company defining a new category

• Comfortable with autonomy as an early technical operations hire and excited to shape how systems scale

Location

This is an on-site role based in our NYC, San Francisco, BA office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

Job Description

Join us to shape the future of payments and receivables for clients worldwide. As part of our Client Onboarding Implementations team, you will help deliver solutions that make a difference. You'll grow your skills, build your brand, and work alongside diverse, proactive colleagues. We value your curiosity, drive, and passion for exceeding client expectations. Together, we create opportunities for career advancement and personal growth.

Job Summary

As an Implementation Project Manager in the Payments team, you will lead end-to-end client onboarding for complex treasury product implementations. You will be the single point-of-contact for clients, guiding them through every step and ensuring a seamless experience. Our team thrives on collaboration, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to operational excellence. You will help translate business requirements into actionable solutions, manage expectations, and drive projects to successful completion.

Job Responsibilities

• Lead global client onboarding and implementation projects for payments and receivables solutions

• Serve as the project manager and primary point-of-contact for assigned implementations

• Deliver a first-class, end-to-end client experience during complex treasury product implementations

• Manage client and internal partner expectations with consultative advice

• Scope client requests and translate business requirements into detailed specifications

• Document project scope, meeting agendas, minutes, and plans using MS Office tools

• Update workflow tools for status tracking and document repository

• Establish timelines and dependencies to exceed expectations

• Demonstrate creative problem-solving and awareness of risks and client impacts

• Escalate issues as needed to remove obstacles and ensure project success

• Foster teamwork and positive results through collaboration

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• Passion for delivering consistent, exceptional client and partner experiences

• Project management experience

• Comfort in a fast-paced, dynamic client-facing environment

• Strong communication, partnership, and influence skills

• Adherence to policy and procedures; ability to meet or exceed established SLAs

• Proficiency with collaboration tools (WebEx, Zoom, etc.)

• Willingness to learn and implement new, API-driven technologies

• Urgency in resolving issues and advancing projects

• Payments and receivables experience or eagerness to learn

• MS Office Suite proficiency

• Ability to assess, prioritize, and manage time effectively

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

• Project management experience with complex treasury implementations

• Consulting or business analysis experience in ERP, systems integration, or API space

• Experience with workflow tools for project tracking

• Participation in business resource groups or innovation initiatives

• Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI-enabled analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to improve operational efficiency and accuracy, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, well-controlled execution through coaching, change adoption, and continuous improvement

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Global Banking business is one of the largest wholesale banking client franchises in the world. We serve clients, including corporations, governments, states, municipalities, healthcare organizations, education institutions, banks and investors.

Global Investment Banking supports a broad range of corporations, institutions and governments by providing strategic advice, capital raising and risk management expertise.

postings.title: Gerente de desarrollo IT
postings.descriptionText:
En Gire, hace más de 30 años impulsamos soluciones que transforman el ecosistema de pagos en Argentina. Hoy estamos atravesando una nueva etapa, donde la tecnología y la capacidad de ejecución son clave para evolucionar nuestro negocio. 🚀

Hoy buscamos sumar a nuestro equipo a un/a Gerente de Desarrollo IT .

🎯 Tu desafío
Liderar el área de Desarrollo de Software, definiendo la estrategia técnica y de producto, y construyendo una cultura de equipo basada en autonomía, calidad y mejora continua.

📋 Principales responsabilidades

• Liderar y hacer crecer equipos de desarrollo fullstack, con una impronta hands-on real, no solo de gestión.

• Definir la estrategia técnica y el roadmap de desarrollo, alineado a los objetivos del negocio.

• Impulsar la adopción y maduración de metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban), mejorando procesos de entrega de forma continua.

• Gestionar personas: selección, desarrollo, feedback y planes de carrera de los equipos a cargo.

• Liderar procesos de transformación cultural en el área, promoviendo ownership, autonomía y mejora continua como norma, no como excepción.

• Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con Producto, Infraestructura y otras áreas de negocio para asegurar entregas de valor.

• Adaptar equipo y procesos a un contexto de prioridades y tecnología en constante cambio.

🧠 Lo que buscamos en vos

• Experiencia como Gerente, Head o Engineering Manager liderando equipos de desarrollo de software (+ 5 años).

• Seas hands-on y mantengas conocimiento técnico actualizado — que puedas sostener una conversación técnica de fondo con su equipo, no solo gestionar desde arriba.

• Vengas de la industria de medios de pago, fintech o servicios financieros.

• Tengas trayectoria real implementando y madurando metodologías ágiles, no solo conocimiento teórico.

• Muestres flexibilidad genuina frente a cambios de prioridad, contexto y tecnología.

• Hayas liderado o impulsado procesos de transformación cultural en equipos técnicos.

🎯 Qué hace exitoso a este perfil:

• Combina criterio técnico con visión de negocio: toma decisiones de arquitectura y de gestión con la misma solvencia.

• Lidera con el ejemplo — entiende el código y las decisiones técnicas de su equipo sin perder foco estratégico.

• Es agente de cambio cultural, no solo de proceso: construye equipos con autonomía y sentido de ownership real.

• Se mueve con comodidad en contextos de alta exigencia y cambio constante, típico de una fintech en transformación.

• Uso intensivo de IA en el ciclo de desarrollo bajo metodologías spec-driven (SSD): orquestación de code agents a partir de especificaciones formales, con estándares de revisión, trazabilidad y seguridad del código generado, y productividad medible del equipo. Experiencia reciente y hands-on con Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot o similares

🚀 Lo que te ofrecemos
• Rol estratégico con alta exposición e impacto en el negocio.
• Desafíos complejos en un contexto de transformación tecnológica.
• Cultura colaborativa, dinámica y orientada a resultados.

Beneficios

👩🏻 ⚕️ Cobertura médica para grupo familiar
💰 Bono por objetivos
💻 Capacitaciones
🎂 Día libre por cumpleaños
👶 Licencias extendidas
🏋️ ♂️ Beneficios y descuentos
🙌 Reintegros

🌍 Por qué sumarte a Gire
Somos Empresa B Certificada y trabajamos para generar impacto real en el negocio y en la sociedad.
Acá vas a poder liderar, transformar y dejar huella. 💡

postings.title: Engineering Manager – Growth Foundations
postings.descriptionText:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Growth Foundations team builds the AI-native Growth Engine, enabling Growth teams across the company. We design and ship powerful AI-driven systems, tools and automations, as well as own the core infrastructure of Growth tools such as our website, user communications and martech. It’s a team with direct influence on company growth, global reach, and user engagement at scale. Our products serve millions of users globally.

The Role

As an Engineering Manager within Growth Foundations, you’ll lead and develop a team of engineers who deliver high-impact features, platforms, and tools that power our growth. You’ll ensure the team is aligned, supported, and set up to execute with excellence — turning complex challenges into simple, reliable solutions that reach users around the world. You will also stay hands-on and deliver production grade features personally every day.

The opportunity

• Lead, mentor, and support a cross-functional team of engineers delivering growth-critical systems and features

• Collaborate daily with Product and Design to define scope, set priorities, and ensure seamless execution

• Keep projects moving forward — maintaining clear expectations, realistic estimates, and transparent communication with stakeholders

• Provide technical guidance and context to help engineers make sound architectural and implementation decisions

• Foster a culture of accountability, trust, and learning — helping the team grow their impact and autonomy

• Improve team processes, communication, and collaboration across time zones

• Partner with other engineering leaders to ensure consistency and best practices across the broader Growth organization

• Leverage AI tooling daily to boost personal and team productivity

• Stay hands-on in the codebase, writing production-grade code and setting the bar for quality, reliability, and speed

What You Bring

• Experience leading engineering teams and delivering high-quality results in a collaborative environment

• Strong people leadership skills — you invest in coaching, clarity, and empowerment

• Solid technical foundation, especially on the backend; you can engage in design discussions, code reviews, and help engineers make pragmatic decisions

• Strong individual contributor background — you write production-grade code and lead by example

• High proficiency in modern AI-driven development — you use AI daily to boost personal and team performance through automation

• Familiarity with one or more modern programming languages (e.g. TypeScript, Rust, Go, Python, or similar)

• A product mindset — you care about how your team’s work impacts users and moves key metrics

• Clear communication and organizational skills, with the ability to align engineering efforts with business goals

• Experience working in distributed, remote-first teams

Nice to haves

• Experience with analytics, performance/paid marketing, experimentation, or growth tooling

• Background in developer experience, SDKs, or internal platforms

• Exposure to scaling teams or processes during high-growth phases

How You Lead

• You lead by setting context, not control — empowering engineers to make decisions with clarity and confidence

• You coach through curiosity, helping others grow their judgment and autonomy

• You communicate transparently, ensuring alignment across engineering, product, and design

• You model accountability and empathy, creating an environment of trust and shared purpose

We know that great engineers come from many backgrounds. If you're excited about the mission but don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

How We Work

We give engineers ownership and trust them to ship high-impact work with craftsmanship and accountability. We move quickly, experiment often, and learn continuously from data and user feedback. We build acquisition and engagement experiences that are fast, resilient, and measurable. We collaborate asynchronously across time zones, connected by clear communication and shared goals.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Stay connected

Learn on the Kraken Blog

Connect on LinkedIn

• Communication Skills:

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and actionable manner.

• Problem-Solving Mindset:

• Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities to address challenges and drive solutions effectively.

Key Attributes for Success

• Results-driven with a commitment to delivering excellence in project outcomes.

• Flexible and resilient in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

• Highly organized project management skills.

• Passionate about driving innovation and continuous improvement in project management practices.

postings.title: Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Core
postings.descriptionText:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring technical engineering manager to redefine the embedded Linux experience with the smallest, most secure, and most reliable operating system in the IoT market.

This is an opportunity for a technical leader passionate about open source software, Linux, containers, security, and the developer experience, to shape the future of Linux from the smallest systems up to desktops. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill as well as high caliber for inspiring and driving people.

Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardize the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.

As an engineering manager, you’ll lead a team of strong software developers to design and implement Ubuntu Core system software on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will meet stakeholders, prioritize requests, plan the roadmap and ensure the team can deliver their goals. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

The role entails

• Building and leading a distributed team of engineers through hiring, coaching, mentoring, feedback and career development

• Demonstrating sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team’s goals

• Coaching and mentoring team members with hands-on career development

• Effectively setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders

• Advocating and advancing modern, agile software development practices and helping develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices

• Contributing to a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values

• Actively participating in the leadership team and collaborating with other leaders in the organisation

What We Are Looking For In You

• Demonstrated competencies in embedded software development

• Strong skills in Golang, C++ and Shell

• A solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred

• Love for developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it

• Demonstrated ability of planning and executing to deliver high quality software in a timely manner

• Solid experience working in an agile development environment

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

• Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path

• Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

Nice-to-have skills

• Familiarity with an immutable Linux distribution, preferably Ubuntu Core

• Experience with multiple CPU architectures such as ARM, RISC-V

• Experience with Linux native containerization and security

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

• Annual compensation review

• Recognition rewards

• Annual holiday leave

• Maternity and paternity leave

• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.

Job Title: Social Media Manager

About The Company

Our client is a business focused on facilitation, trauma-informed training, and breathwork experiences.

Job Description

We are looking for a creative and strategic Social Media Manager. You will develop and manage the online presence for a business that offers facilitation, trauma-informed training, and breathwork experiences. You need to know how to create content that gets attention, builds trust, and engages the right audience. You will develop content strategies, use psychological hooks to engage viewers, find trends, and adapt content for different platforms. This role focuses on organic social media. Paid advertising is handled by another specialist.

Responsibilities Of The Role

• Develop and implement a social media strategy that matches the business goals.

• Create and manage content pillars that show the business's expertise and values.

• Create and maintain a content calendar for posts, videos, and stories.

• Develop compelling hooks and storytelling for content.

• Research social media trends and identify content opportunities.

• Create content concepts and guide the creation of posts and captions.

• Perform basic video editing for short-form content.

• Maintain a consistent brand voice and messaging.

• Schedule and publish content regularly on social media platforms.

• Monitor and respond to comments and messages to build community.

• Track key organic social media metrics like reach and engagement.

• Use performance data to improve content and try new formats.

• Work with the paid advertising specialist to ensure consistent messaging.

Required Experience And Qualifications

• Proven experience managing social media for businesses or brands.

• A portfolio with real examples of social media profiles you managed.

• Ability to explain your contributions to managed profiles.

• Strong understanding of social media content strategy and audience engagement.

• Experience creating effective content hooks and openings.

• Ability to identify and adapt trends for a brand.

• Basic video editing skills for social media.

• Excellent writing, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to interpret social media analytics and improve performance.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to maintain a schedule.

• Ability to work independently and communicate effectively remotely.

Preferred Skills

• Experience managing social media for wellness or education businesses.

• Experience creating educational content for service-based businesses.

• Familiarity with Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

• Experience using social media scheduling and planning tools.

• Understanding of audience psychology and engagement.

• Experience collaborating with marketing team members.

Portfolio Requirement

You must submit real examples of social media profiles you have managed. Include links to profiles, examples of content, your responsibilities, and any performance results. Clearly state your personal contributions.

Personality

• Creative

• Proactive

• Analytical

• Familiar with engaging social media content

• Comfortable working independently

• Able to bring forward new ideas

• Able to use performance data to improve content

Software & Tools

• Social media scheduling tools

• Content planning platforms

• Basic analytics dashboards

Schedule

Part-time for the first month, approximately 20 hours per week.

Expected to transition to full-time after the first month.

Candidates should coordinate with a team in or near the Israel time zone.

Exceptional candidates in other time zones will be considered.

Salary And Benefits

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

postings.title: Business and Technical Communiations Analyst - EY GDS
postings.descriptionText:
Job Summary:

About The EY Mercury Support Team (MST)

As an organization jointly owned by Finance and Enterprise Technology, the MST is a centralized and global organization that provides strategic deployment, adoption, and operational support for an integrated, SAP-centric platform (Mercury) and manages and supports the Mercury user community. The MST plays an integral governance role in the global Mercury solution and works closely with the business to enable the benefit and value to be realized from the investment in Mercury and to set the future direction and technology road map.

Responsibilities:

The Business and Technical Communications Analyst maintains and administers the Global Operations Communications Tool (GOCT), helps ensure the platform remains reliable and fit for purpose, and uses it to support planned and unplanned technology communications.

The role administers GOCT configuration, templates, access, audience targeting, monitoring, and documentation. It also partners with Product Management, Development, and communications stakeholders to support tool enhancements, releases, operational maintenance, service disruptions, and P1–P3 incidents.

Key responsibilities include:

• Administers GOCT configuration, communications templates, shared mailboxes, OneAccess groups, audience targeting, and supporting documentation in accordance with brand and governance standards.

• Monitors GOCT dashboards and the administration mailbox, triages user queries and communication failures, and resolves or escalates issues within required timelines.

• Supports planned maintenance, service disruptions, and P1–P3 incidents by drafting, coordinating, targeting, and releasing timely operational communications through GOCT.

• Coordinates GOCT enhancements and releases by documenting requirements, supporting user acceptance testing, preparing release communications, and validating production updates in partnership with Product Management and Development teams.

• Creates and maintains clear, accurate, and brand-compliant operational communications, templates, guidance, and supporting materials for GOCT and related digital channels.

• Collaborates with global and regional stakeholders to coordinate contributors, incorporate local requirements, and ensure accurate audience targeting.

• Supports contingency procedures for issuing critical communications when GOCT or dependent services are unavailable.

• Develops a working understanding of GOCT dependencies, integrations, data sources, access groups, and downstream communication channels to support issue diagnosis and release validation.

• Assesses communication needs, tracks issues and risks, identifies competing priorities, and escalates decisions when required.

• Maintains configuration records, operating procedures, support documentation, known-error guidance, release notes, and knowledge articles.

• Tracks GOCT usage, communication failures, incidents, service requests, and recurring issues; identifies trends and recommends operational improvements.

Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:

Senior communication capability required with MST leadership. The role also requires relationship management skills to influence and motivate resources from other ET organizations that leverage our communications tool.

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

• Excellent English writing, editing, proofreading, verbal communication, and active-listening skills, with strong attention to detail.

• Demonstrated ability to understand technology-related information and translate it into clear, relevant communications for business users, with awareness of operational impacts.

• Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage changing priorities and deliver accurate work within compressed timelines.

• Ability to assess requests, identify conflicts, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and escalate decisions, risks, or issues when needed.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functions, regions, and time zones in a virtual, global environment.

• Strong issue-triage, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills, with responsiveness to user needs and adherence to firm policies.

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.

• Experience creating and managing SharePoint content is preferred.

• Familiarity with IT service management practices, including incident, problem, change, and release management.

Supervision Responsibilities:

The role will not have any direct reports.

Other Requirements:

• Occasional “off-shift” hours will be required to support communications and will be balanced with local HR laws.

Job Requirements:

To qualify, candidates must have:

• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Information Systems, Business Administration, Technology Management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Five to seven years of experience supporting internal corporate or technology operations communications.

• Experience supporting operational communications for planned technology events, service disruptions, critical incidents, or large-scale system implementations.

• Experience using IT service-management or work-tracking platforms, such as ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, or Jira, to document requirements, manage incidents, and track enhancements.

• Experience administering or supporting an enterprise communications platform, including templates, audience targeting, user access, issue monitoring, testing, or release validation.

• Experience applying change management principles, methodologies, or tools is preferred.

• Experience in the accounting or finance industry is helpful but not required.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

• Career development: At EY, your career is yours to shape! We’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences ey.com/au/careerdevelopment

• Flexible work arrangements: Our flexible work policies empower you to balance your professional and personal life, fostering a culture of trust and autonomy.

• A comprehensive benefits package: From a yearly wellness incentive, to access to additional 8 weeks of flex leave per year, and family-friendly policies, including 26 weeks of gender-neutral paid parental leave, we cater to your diverse needs to help you thrive both personally and professionally www.ey.com/au/benefits

• Compensation: A competitive compensation package will be offered, including salary, benefits, and potential for performance-based incentives..

postings.descriptionText:
Full-time or part-time | Remote |
Are you a graphic designer who understands how to make beauty products stand out online? Do you enjoy turning product benefits into clear, compelling visuals that help shoppers decide what to buy?
We are looking for an eCommerce Graphic Designer to join The eRetailer Agency as our work with international beauty brands expands.
This is an ongoing B2B contractor role , available full-time or part-time, with an initial three-month probationary period .

About us The eRetailer Agency is an eCommerce agency working with leading consumer brands around the world. We help brands grow across Amazon and other marketplaces through strategy, content, design and advertising.
We are a remote-first, international team that values creativity, ownership and practical ideas. You will work closely with our strategists, e-merchandisers, copywriters and designers to create content for international markets.

Your role Your main focus will be creating eCommerce content for (beauty) brands. You will work across several clients and projects, developing new creative concepts and adapting existing designs. We manage our workflow in Asana, with a prioritised task list covering both larger projects and smaller daily requests.

What you will do
• Design content like secondary images, A+ Content, Premium A+ Content and Brand Store assets

• Create visuals that explain product benefits, highlight key features and address shopper questions.

• Apply brand guidelines consistently while adapting designs for different marketplaces and audiences.

• Develop master concepts and roll them out across products, variants and markets.

• Collaborate with our content and strategy teams to turn briefs into effective designs.

• Incorporate feedback accurately and prepare organised, editable source files.

• Manage your tasks in Asana, communicate progress and meet agreed deadlines.

• Support wider design needs, including presentations, marketing materials and digital assets.

What you bring
• At least three years of relevant graphic or digital design experience.

• Experience working with beauty brands , supported by a strong portfolio.

• Hands-on experience designing for Amazon and other major marketplaces

• A strong understanding of eCommerce design, including visual hierarchy, product storytelling and mobile readability.

• Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator . Experience with InDesign and Figma is an advantage.

• Fluent English , both spoken and written.

• Attention to detail and confidence managing several priorities in a remote environment.

• A positive, proactive approach: comfortable collaborating with others and working independently.

Availability and working arrangement
• We are open to full-time or part-time availability , with consistent, agreed working hours.

• Your schedule must include at least four hours of overlap with our European business hours, following CET/CEST .

• This is a B2B contractor arrangement , so you must be able to invoice for your services. It is not an employment contract.

What we offer
• A competitive B2B fee based on your experience and agreed workload .

• After the probationary period: 26 paid days off per year, plus public holidays. (The allowance for part-time collaboration will be agreed proportionately)

• Flexibility to work remotely within your agreed schedule.

• A fun, fast-paced environment with a varied mix of creative projects.

• The opportunity to design for major international brands, particularly in beauty .

• A collaborative, international culture that values creativity and autonomy.

• Clear briefs, constructive feedback and room to contribute your own ideas.

• A friendly, no-ego team with big ambitions.

﻿
Interested? Apply directly through LinkedIn with your CV in English and a portfolio showcasing your relevant beauty and eCommerce work. We look forward to seeing what you can bring to the team.

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Resumen e Impacto del Rol

El Planificador de Medios Senior Integral lidera el diseño, la ejecución y el análisis de campañas publicitarias 360°. A diferencia de un especialista enfocado en un solo canal, el perfil integral domina la interacción entre los canales tradicionales (TV, exterior, radio, prensa) y los digitales (social ads, programática, search, retail media, CTV, video online).

Su labor va más allá de "comprar espacios": traduce datos del consumidor e insights del mercado en estrategias de contacto efectivas a lo largo de todo el embudo de conversión ( Full-Funnel ).

La búsqueda está centrada en Estudiantes avanzados o promediando carrera Lic. en Publicidad o afines para sumarse al equipo. Buscamos un perfil organizado, prolijo, con ganas de seguir aprendiendo, que tenga capacidad para trabajar en equipo y con excelente predisposición.

Habilidades y Experiencia

• Experiencia de por lo menos un año como planner Sr. en cuentas o agencias grandes, o dos años en cuentas chicas.

• Experiencia en pautas ON y OFF.

• Manejo de Excel

• Manejo de armado de planes, tácticas on, reportes digitales, conocimientos de métricas digitales para armado de recomendaciones.

• Inglés nivel intermedio.

• Residir en Córdoba, Rosario o Mendoza, contando con conocimiento del mercado local.

Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios ( Be Extraordinary ), invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo ( Lead Optimistically ), creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo ( Championing Growth and Development ) de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto ( Create an Open Environment ) basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. Nuestro paquete integral de beneficios refleja este compromiso e incluye seguro médico, de visión y dental, planes grupales de retiro, un generoso programa de tiempo libre pagado, descuentos preferenciales con aliados y días dedicados al bienestar y la salud mental de nuestro equipo.

En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Creemos que el mejor trabajo surge cuando estamos juntos, potenciando la creatividad, la colaboración y la conexión en un entorno abierto y colaborativo. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

Agradecemos a todas las personas que se postulen a esta vacante; sin embargo, solo contactaremos a los candidatos seleccionados para una entrevista.
