En ERM estamos en búsqueda de un/a Consultor/a en Sostenibilidad para integrarse a un equipo dedicado, asignado a un proyecto estratégico de certificación internacional para un operador del sector de hidrocarburos en Argentina. El rol requiere una sólida experiencia técnica en gestión socioambiental y relaciones comunitarias, articulando con diferentes áreas del negocio y aplicando estándares internacionales.

En ERM, sabemos que crear un entorno de trabajo diverso, equitativo e inclusivo es una parte esencial para hacer de nuestra empresa un excelente lugar para desarrollar una carrera.

Principales responsabilidades:

• Elaborar, revisar y actualizar reportes técnicos de sostenibilidad y desempeño socioambiental.

• Recopilar, sistematizar y analizar información e indicadores ESG de distintas áreas.

• Organizar y mantener la documentación y las evidencias requeridas para procesos de certificación y auditoría.

• Dar seguimiento a planes de acción, compromisos y requerimientos de información.

• Apoyar la identificación de brechas frente a estándares internacionales y la preparación de recomendaciones.

Requisitos:

• Título universitario en Ingeniería, Ciencias Ambientales, Ciencias Sociales o disciplinas afines.

• Experiencia en gestión ambiental y social (E&S), criterios ESG y relacionamiento con grupos de interés.

• Conocimiento de estándares internacionales, incluyendo IFC Performance Standards, Principios de Ecuador y marcos de reporte ESG y sostenibilidad.

• Disponibilidad para realizar viajes según las necesidades de los proyectos

Antecedentes:

Desde que establecimos nos establecimos en la región de América Latina y el Caribe (LAC) en la década de 1990, ERM ha crecido de manera constante, empleando ahora a más de 800 profesionales en sus oficinas de Argentina, Brasil, Colombia, Guyana, México y Perú. Durante más de 30 años, hemos construido equipos de consultoría de clase mundial, especializados en medio ambiente, sostenibilidad y consultoría social, con una sólida base de clientes en múltiples sectores económicos como petróleo y gas, manufactura y productos químicos, entre otros. A lo largo de tiempos desafiantes, ERM ha permanecido comprometida en apoyar a estos sectores, ya que nuestros clientes continúan invirtiendo en el mercado local.

Como parte de nuestra expansión regional, ERM busca mantener el liderazgo en la industria asociándose con importantes clientes que comparten nuestro compromiso con la sostenibilidad. Con una base sólida en industrias clave, somos pioneros en el avance de la agenda ESG (Ambiental, Social y de Gobernanza) en América Latina y el Caribe. Nuestro trabajo incluye contribuir a iniciativas de financiamiento sostenible, desarrollar estudios temáticos y apoyar la implementación de estándares internacionales para las partes interesadas.

Quiénes Somos:

Como la mayor consultora global dedicada exclusivamente a la sostenibilidad, nos asociamos con las principales organizaciones del mundo, creando soluciones innovadoras a los desafíos de sostenibilidad y desbloqueando oportunidades comerciales que satisfacen las necesidades del presente, mientras preservamos oportunidades para las futuras generaciones.

También consideramos nuestra diversidad como una fortaleza que nos ayuda a crear mejores soluciones para nuestros clientes. Nuestro equipo diverso de expertos de clase mundial apoya a los clientes en todos los niveles de sus organizaciones para operacionalizar la sostenibilidad, respaldado por nuestra profunda experiencia técnica en la resolución de temas ambientales, de salud, seguridad, riesgo y asuntos sociales. Llamamos a esta capacidad nuestro enfoque de "boots to boardroom" un modelo de servicio integral que permite a ERM desarrollar soluciones estratégicas y técnicas que impulsan objetivos tanto en el campo como a nivel ejecutivo.

Si deseas leer más sobre Diversidad, Equidad, Igualdad e Inclusión (DEIB) en ERM, puedes visitar nuestro sitio web o conocer nuestros avances en el Informe de Sostenibilidad 2026 .

postings.descriptionText:
¡Estamos Buscando: Key Account Manager (KAM) - Canal Moderno!

Importante empresa de consumo semi-masivo con venta estacional se encuentra en la búsqueda de un Key Account Manager (KAM) para el Canal Moderno .
Si te apasionan los desafíos comerciales, tenés un perfil analítico, proactivo y contás con experiencia sólida gestionando grandes cuentas (supermercados, E-Commerce y nuevos canales), ¡esta oportunidad es para vos!

Principales Responsabilidades:

• Gestión Comercial End-to-End: Cumplir con los objetivos de ventas mensuales y por temporada (facturación, mix de productos, apertura de categorías y rentabilidad).

• Forecasting: Realizar el pronóstico de ventas en unidades y facturación por familia de productos y clientes en base a las metas de la compañía.

• Estrategia y Planes de Acción: Desarrollar e implementar planes para optimizar la facturación, exhibición y distribución en los puntos de venta.

• Coordinación de Equipo en Punto de Venta: Definir necesidades y diseñar ruteos para el equipo de repositores, trabajando en conjunto con Marketing para asegurar la mejor presencia de marca en el salón.

• Relacionamiento Clave: Desarrollar y potenciar relaciones comerciales sólidas con los encargados de salón de las distintas cadenas.

• Gestión de Cobranzas y Acuerdos: Asegurar el cumplimiento de los acuerdos comerciales e interactuar con Finanzas, Administración de Ventas y Logística para garantizar un servicio de excelencia y el cobro en los plazos establecidos.

¿Qué buscamos? (Requisitos Excluyentes):

• Formación Académica: Graduados universitarios de las carreras de Administración de Empresas, Comercialización, Marketing o afines.

• Experiencia: Más de 5 años en áreas comerciales dentro de empresas de consumo semi-masivo con venta estacional, realizando venta directa a cadenas de supermercados.

• Herramientas: Manejo avanzado de Microsoft Excel.

• Competencias clave: Perfil con alta adaptabilidad, capacidad de aprendizaje, orientación a resultados, trabajo en equipo y tolerancia a la presión.

• Movilidad: Contar con auto propio (gastos cubiertos por la empresa).

Zona de residencia: GBA Norte

postings.title: Business Development & Relationship Executive
postings.descriptionText:
Are you passionate about helping financial institutions grow, innovate, and better serve their members?

We're seeking an experienced and results-driven Business Development & Relationship Executive to serve as a trusted advisor to credit union leaders across a multi-state territory, primarily in the Midwest and West Coast regions. This is an exciting opportunity for a consultative sales professional who thrives on building executive relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering solutions that drive meaningful business results.

In this role, you will partner with mid-sized and large credit unions to understand their strategic goals and align our payment, digital, and correspondent banking solutions to support their success. Through a combination of in-person meetings, virtual consultations, and strategic planning discussions, you will help credit unions improve operational efficiency, increase member engagement, grow revenue, and enhance the overall member experience.

Unlike traditional sales positions that focus solely on prospecting, this role combines relationship management and business development. Approximately 50% of your time will be dedicated to strengthening and expanding existing relationships, while 50% will focus on identifying and securing new business opportunities.

What You'll Do

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with credit union executives and key decision-makers.

• Serve as a strategic advisor by understanding each credit union's business objectives and recommending solutions to support growth and operational excellence.

• Expand existing relationships by identifying opportunities across our suite of payment, digital, and correspondent banking products and services.

• Generate new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and industry engagement.

• Deliver compelling presentations and consultative sales discussions with executive leadership teams.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a seamless client experience and successful implementation of solutions.

• Stay informed of industry trends, emerging technologies, payment innovations, and competitive developments.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in financial industry sales.

• Experience with selling to credit unions and technology products is a plus.

• Strong selling and relationship-building skills are required.

• A professional, confident leader capable of earning respect from business leaders, C-Suite, and stakeholders.

• Collaborative and participative management style.

• Excellent written, oral, and influential communication skills.

• Strong creative problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.

• Knowledge of correspondent banking and payment products is a plus.

• Finance analytical skills and knowledge of the credit union industry are preferred.

• Experience with SalesForce is preferred.

Travel & Compensation

• Travel approximately 60%, primarily within the United States.

• Most travel consists of day trips with limited overnight stays.

• Competitive compensation package with a target annual earning opportunity of approximately $160,000, including:

• Approximately 75% base salary

• Approximately 25% incentive compensation

We are looking for someone that may have held the following positions below:

Territory Sales Manager

Regional Sales Manager

Regional Sales Executive

Strategic Account Executive

Business Development Executive

Relationship Manager

Payments Consultant

Payments Sales Executive

Sales, Digital Payments

Sales, Real-time Payments

Sales, FedNow

Account Manager

Sales Representative

Sales Executive

Outside Sales

About Corporate One

We are a leading wholesale financial services provider to more than 700 of America’s credit unions. As a trusted and highly respected investment, funding, and payment solutions partner to credit unions for more than 80 years, Corporate One has developed innovative solutions for credit unions throughout our history. We, along with our subsidiary companies (CUSOs), Lucro Commercial Solutions and Accolade Investment Advisory are committed to our member credit unions and their mission to help their communities thrive.

Why Should You Apply?

Employment with Corporate One includes being part of a collaborative environment where every individual is part of a team, making a difference to credit unions and the communities they serve. We are dedicated to improving the financial lives of others. You’ll enjoy a friendly and casual work environment where personal autonomy, self-initiative, innovative thinking, and continuous learning are highly valued. We are proud to have an average tenure of 10 years!

We Are Proud To Offer

• Organizational Strengths: Corporate One Federal Credit Union is one of the nation’s largest and most progressive corporate credit unions with more than $7 billion in assets and an average staff tenure of 10+ years.

• Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Corporate One offers competitive compensation, a generous 401(k) matching contribution, and quality health and ancillary benefits.

• Work Life Balance: Generous PTO (Paid Time Off) starting with 4 weeks/year, 11 paid holidays, and paid parental leave.

• Learning and Development: We provide a full library of online training as well as group and individual training, a mentoring program, and business coaching, all focused toward helping you grow and be successful.

• Additional Benefits Too Cool to Not Mention: Ongoing special events throughout the year, tuition reimbursement, wellness program, pet insurance, and more!

Corporate One Federal Credit Union is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status.

As the financial landscape continues to evolve, so do we. That is why it is an exciting time to join our team! Please visit our website to learn more at https://www.corporateone.coop/.

The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.

This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.

• Responsable de realizar presentaciones a los clientes con el fin de asesorar, formar y promocionar nuestros productos y servicios, relacionados con los procesos de tratamiento de aguas residuales urbanas e industriales (bombas y mixers sumergibles, aireadores, trituradoras, tamices, decantadores, filtros).

• Crear valor agregado para el cliente y, a continuación, alinearse para ofrecer una solución, garantizando una experiencia positiva para el cliente.

• Preparar planes de ventas y realizar revisiones periódicas de la situación para mantener los volúmenes de pedidos, y gestionar los procesos administrativos de ventas.

• Promocionar activamente todo el portafolio de productos Sulzer en los mercados asignados.

• Alcanzar o superar los objetivos de venta acordados para el segmento o región.

• Desarrollar e implementar estrategias comerciales consistentes con los objetivos de Sulzer.

• Preparar y acompañar activamente las ofertas para los clientes en las regiones y segmentos asignados.

• Responsable por la proyección precisa de ventas para su región y cuentas relacionadas.

• Revisar órdenes de compra, contratos, términos y condiciones para las cuentas y clientes asignados.

• Preparación de ofertas en coordinación con el departamento de ofertas y propuestas, garantizando que se cumplen los aspectos técnicos y financieros adecuados, incluidos los precios y las condiciones comerciales.

• Visitas con clientes importantes y buscar prospectos potenciales.

Requisitos

• Mínimo 5 años de experiencia como ingeniero de ventas y/o ingeniero de aplicaciones en el área de gestión de agua urbana y/o industrial.

• Titulado en ingeniería industrial, mecánica, hidráulica o afín.

• Experiencia en ventas directas e indirectas a clientes industriales.

• Conocimientos sobre procesos de tratamiento de aguas residuales urbanas e industriales, bombas centrífugas y motores eléctricos.

• Cartera de clientes/relaciones existentes en los mercados de industrias y aguas municipales, incluyendo O&M, EPC, empresas de ingeniería y usuarios finales

• Disponibilidad para viajes (50% del tiempo)

• Manejo de inglés intermedio.

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación.

• Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente.

• Proactivo.

• Motivado, con un historial demostrado de obtención de resultados por encima de los objetivos y las expectativas.

What we offer you

Beneficios

• Salario y prestaciones acordes con el mercado.

• Bonificación anual basada en los objetivos corporativos y personales.

• Seguro médico y dental.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

postings.title: Field Sales Engineer - Rosario, Argentina
postings.descriptionText:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources.

Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.

About The Job

We are looking for a Field Sales Engineer to join our team in Argentina, with a strong commercial focus on the oilseed processing industry in the Greater Rosario area.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and strengthening relationships with customers, identifying new business opportunities and promoting Alfa Laval’s products and services through a consultative and value-based sales approach.

Key Responsibilities

• Follow established sales processes and guidelines to promote and sell Alfa Laval products and services.

• Analyze market trends, customer needs and buying behavior to develop sales plans aligned with business objectives.

• Identify, develop and manage leads, converting them into concrete business opportunities and maintaining a healthy sales pipeline.

• Maintain an active presence in the market through customer visits, meetings and regular interactions.

• Develop a deep understanding of customers’ processes and needs, highlighting the value and differentiation of Alfa Laval solutions.

• Manage your customer portfolio through proactive commercial planning and effective use of our sales tools.

• Build and maintain strong relationships and a broad network across key customer organizations.

• Develop competitive and profitable commercial proposals, follow up opportunities and drive conversion.

• Use CRM and other commercial tools consistently to support sales activities and decision-making.

• Contribute to the development of the Field Sales Engineer team by sharing experience and supporting the commercial sales process.

What You Know

• Solid experience in technical and/or industrial B2B sales, ideally at a senior level.

• Strong knowledge of the industrial market and experience managing complex customer relationships.

• Experience within the oilseed, edible oils or related process industries will be considered a strong advantage.

• Degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial Engineering or a related field. Advanced students with relevant commercial and industry experience may also be considered.

• Intermediate English level, with the ability to interact with international and central teams when required.

• Availability to travel domestically, mainly within the assigned territory.

Who You Are

• You are a commercially driven professional who enjoys being close to customers and building long-term relationships.

• You combine autonomy, resilience and a strong results orientation with the ability to understand customer challenges and turn them into business opportunities.

• You are comfortable managing your own agenda, working independently in the field and navigating a competitive industrial environment.

What’s in it for you ?

This role offers a high level of autonomy and ownership, together with the opportunity to work closely with some of the most relevant industrial customers in the Greater Rosario region.

You will join a global company with strong technical expertise, internationally recognized technologies and opportunities for continued professional development and career growth.

Job Description

As a Manager – Sales, you will provide strategic direction and progressive leadership to achieve sales and profit goals within a region, specific line(s) of business or channels. You will design and recommend sales and marketing programs and set short and long-term sales strategies. You will manage a single location with a total sales revenue of up to $50 million and manage a team of direct reports.

Responsibilities

• Develops and administers sales plans to ensure customer satisfaction, assigned quota attainment, good reference accounts, and highly skilled and motivated staff.

• Partners with Marketing to develop and implement sales marketing programs and initiatives.

• Determines annual sales and gross profit plan by implementing marketing strategies and analyzing trends and results.

• Establishes sales objectives by forecasting and developing sales quota for territories.

• Projects expected sales volume and profit for existing and new product lines and customers.

• Maintains sales volume, product mix and selling price by keeping current with market supply and demand, changing trends, economic indicators and competitors.

• Coordinates order service by directing account representatives and executives on quotations, proposals, project order management techniques, and customer complaint resolution.

• Establishes and adjusts billing margin by monitoring costs, competition and market conditions and negotiating cost side levels.

• Manages sales staff by recruiting, selecting, orienting and training employees.

• Maintains sales staff results by coaching employees, planning, monitoring and appraising job results.

• Develops and maintains relationships with top customers.

• Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications and participating in professional societies.

• Forecasts and communicates intricate details to senior business managers.

• interfaces with internal support departments to establish positive customer experience.

• Partners with suppliers to maintain customer relationships, provides training to staff, and executes marketing programs and initiatives.

• Partners with various internal departments to troubleshoot issues such as inventory and operations

Qualifications

• High School Degree or Equivalent required; Bachelor’s Degree - Sales, Business Administration, Engineering, or relevant field preferred

• Prior professional sales experience in related industry/3+ years

• Prior experience with managing a sales team or sales programs/1+ year

• Working knowledge of business and management principles in strategic planning, resource allocation and coordination of people and resources

• Demonstrated verbal, written, analytical, persuasion and interpersonal skills

• Knowledge of principles and processes for providing customer and personal services, including customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction

• Ability to exercise teamwork, leadership, and flexibility

• Excellent time management and computer skills

• 5 years related industry professional sales

• 2 years managing staff and programs at national, district or regional level

• Ability to travel up to 25%

Working Environment: Outside Sales – Work is generally performed in an office environment, but employee may need to travel to customer sites or warehouse facilities. Driving may be required for an extended period of time with frequent stops and starts. Can be exposed to outdoor weather conditions.

Si te interesa desarrollarte como JEFE DE VENTAS en el equipo de nuestro cliente IMPORTANTE EMPRESA, ¡desafíate a vos mismo y crea tu futuro!

We're asking you to be the senior technical and strategic voice on the work, build the next generation of TP leaders behind you, and help shape how a practice that operates differently from a traditional consulting firm continues to evolve.

What You'll Do
You'll lead at the level above engagements — setting direction on the hardest work, developing the managers running it, and being the person clients ask for when things get complicated. The fundamentals of leading great TP work still apply. What's different is the kind of practice you're leading inside.
We've built something that doesn't look like traditional consulting. Less rigidity, more flexibility, and technology and AI woven into how the work gets done — and what that looks like is changing quarter by quarter. The role you're hired into today will look different in a year, and different again in two. At this level, you're not just operating in that environment — you're shaping it.

Day to day, that means:

• Setting direction on complex, high-stakes engagements — method selection, structuring, defensibility, controversy

• Being the senior technical voice clients ask for: intangibles, financial transactions, restructurings, planning conversations

• Leading and developing managers — they are your most important deliverable. Building the bench underneath them

• Setting the standard for how the team operates — how we use the platform, where AI fits, where judgment is non-negotiable, how we handle hard moments with clients

• Helping shape how the practice evolves — what we build, what we automate, what stays human, where the bar should move next

• Stepping in on the hardest moments — escalations, technical disputes, complex negotiations

What's non-negotiable here

• Client first. Their outcomes are how we measure ourselves, and you set that tone for the team.

• AI fluency. Not enthusiasm, not curiosity — fluency, with a strategic point of view. You're not just using these tools well; you have an opinion about where the practice should go because of them.

• Flexibility and ownership. Senior leaders here operate on a moving floor. The role itself will evolve. The leaders we want are the ones who help shape the change, not the ones waiting for it to settle.

What success looks like in your first months
The complex work runs cleanly under your leadership. Your managers are visibly stronger. Clients seek you out on the hardest issues. You're already shaping conversations about where the practice should go — not just running it as it is.

What You Bring

• 10+ years of transfer pricing experience, with substantial engagement leadership and people management at scale

• Deep, demonstrated command of OECD TP principles, with hands-on work across documentation, planning, controversy, and complex transactions

• Track record of leading managers — not just analysts. You've grown people who've grown teams

• Fluent / professional / native English

• Demonstrated leadership in adopting AI and technology in TP delivery — and a clear point of view on where it goes next

Additional Benefits
